jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.excerpt: About CoEnterprise CoEnterprise is an award-winning B2B software and professional services company founded in 2010.
jobs.description:
About CoEnterprise

CoEnterprise is an award-winning B2B software and professional services company founded in 2010. A leader in supply chain and business analytics, CoEnterprise delivers innovative solutions that help organizations connect data, gain visibility, and make faster, smarter decisions. Its industry-leading AI-enabled supply chain platform, Syncrofy, provides actionable, data-driven insights without requiring advanced technical expertise. Fueled by a commitment to people and long-term partnerships, CoEnterprise has supported more than 850 customers across 6,000+ projects.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role and will be the company's Marketing leader. You will own the marketing function from strategy through execution, working directly with the CEO and closely with Sales, Product, and Technical teams.

You will be responsible for building a scalable demand-generation engine that creates qualified pipeline and revenue for our Syncrofy and Managed Services solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the overall marketing and demand-generation strategy for Syncrofy and Managed Services.
  • Build and manage programs across ABM, paid search/social, SEO, email, content, webinars, events, nurture campaigns, and other channels.
  • Define target accounts, industries, buyer personas, and buying committees.
  • Develop campaigns and messaging that generate qualified enterprise and mid-market leads that covert to closed won sales opportunities.
  • Build and optimize lead-generation, nurturing, scoring, and conversion programs.
  • Partner closely with Sales to align marketing campaigns with revenue and pipeline objectives.
  • Develop compelling content including case studies, whitepapers, webinars, solution briefs, industry content, and thought leadership.
  • Drive digital marketing, website conversion, SEO, paid advertising, and social programs.
  • Develop targeted marketing programs for the Managed Services business.
  • Build Syncrofy's market presence around supply-chain visibility, EDI managed services, order lifecycle optimization, and operational intelligence.
  • Own marketing analytics, attribution, reporting, and the marketing technology stack.
  • Identify, evaluate, and manage outside agencies, freelancers, and vendors when appropriate.
  • Continuously test, measure, and optimize marketing programs based on pipeline and ROI.
  • Establish and own the company's marketing processes, priorities, and roadmap.
  • Plan, organize, and lead Syncrofy and EDI Managed Services industry trade shows that generate leads and convert to closed won sales opportunities.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant demand-generation responsibility.
  • A highly motivated results driven marketing leader who takes initiative
  • Proven track record of generating qualified sales pipeline and revenue that converts to high percentage closed won sales opportunities.
  • Experience marketing complex B2B products or services with multi-person buying processes.
  • Strong experience with ABM, digital marketing, content, email, paid media, and marketing automation.
  • Strong understanding of the B2B sales funnel and Marketing/Sales alignment.
  • Data-driven approach with the ability to connect marketing activity to pipeline and revenue.
  • Excellent communication and content-development skills.
  • Comfortable operating as a one-person marketing department, setting strategy while personally executing.
  • Highly entrepreneurial, self-directed, and comfortable working with significant autonomy.

Industry Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is highly desirable:

B2B SaaS | Enterprise Software | Supply Chain | EDI Managed Services | B2B Integration | Supply-Chain Visibility | Managed Services | IT Services | Supply Chain and Logistics Technology | Retail Industry | CPG Industry | Distribution Industry

Experience marketing complex EDI Managed Services, supply-chain, or enterprise technology solutions is a strong plus.

What Success Looks Like

Success will be measured by the ability to build a predictable, scalable source of qualified pipeline for Syncrofy and Managed Services that has a high percentage of becoming closed won sales opportunities.

Key metrics will include:

  • Marketing-sourced pipeline
  • Qualified opportunities
  • Marketing-sourced revenue
  • Target-account engagement
  • Conversion rates
  • Cost per opportunity
  • Campaign ROI

We care much more about quality pipeline and closed won revenue than impressions, followers, or raw lead volume.

jobs.excerpt: ICF is a mission-driven company filled with people who care deeply about improving the lives of others and making the world a better place.
jobs.description:
ICF is a mission-driven company filled with people who care deeply about improving the lives of others and making the world a better place. Our core values include Embracing Difference, and we seek candidates who are passionate about building a culture that encourages, embraces, and hires dimensions of difference.


Our Health Engineering Systems (HES) team partners with customers to turn data into clear, actionable insights. We are seeking a Junior Data Scientist to support data exploration, analysis, modeling, validation, and visualization using PostgreSQL, SQL, Python, Databricks, and the DataConnect reporting environment using AWS QuickSight.


This role is well suited for an early-career professional who is curious, detail-oriented, comfortable learning new technologies, and able to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Use SQL and Python to extract, clean, transform, and analyze structured data from PostgreSQL and other approved sources.

  • Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and data-quality issues.

  • Assist with the development, testing, and documentation of statistical analyses, machine-learning models, and analytical workflows.

  • Develop and support notebooks and repeatable analytical workflows in Databricks.

  • Create and maintain clear visualizations, datasets, and reports for DataConnect using AWS QuickSight.

  • Validate analytical outputs and document assumptions, methods, limitations, and results.

  • Partner with data engineers to define data needs, resolve quality issues, and improve the usability of analytical datasets.

  • Translate business questions into measurable analyses with guidance from senior team members and stakeholders.

  • Write reusable, version-controlled code and basic unit tests for analytical functions and data transformations.

  • Present findings through concise written summaries, visualizations, and team demonstrations.

  • Follow established standards for data privacy, security, governance, and responsible use of data.

  • Participate in Agile planning, refinement, peer reviews, and continuous learning activities.

· Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications


· Bachelor's degree


  • 2+ years of experience using Python for data analysis, data preparation, and statistical modeling

  • Candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

  • Candidate must reside in the United States, be authorized to work in the United States, and have lived in the United States for three full years out of the last five years.

What you will bring


  • Bachelor's degree data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, economics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Academic, internship, project, or professional experience using Python for data analysis.

  • Foundational SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, filtering, and data validation.

  • Understanding of core statistics, data preparation, exploratory analysis, and model-evaluation concepts.

  • Ability to communicate analytical methods and findings clearly in writing and presentations.

  • Ability to work collaboratively, manage assigned tasks, and incorporate feedback.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database platform.

  • Experience using Databricks, Spark, notebooks, or cloud-based analytics platforms.

  • Experience creating data visualizations or dashboards with AWS QuickSight or a comparable business-intelligence tool.

  • Experience with common Python data-science libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, or PySpark.

  • Familiarity with TypeScript and its use in data applications, dashboards, services, or integrations.

  • Familiarity with Git, code reviews, unit testing, CI/CD, or Agile development practices.

  • Exposure to data governance, metadata, data quality, privacy, or responsible AI practices.

  • Experience working with health, public-sector, or other regulated data environments.

Job Location: This position requires that the job be performed in the United States. The candidate must reside in the United States, be authorized to work in the United States, and perform all work in the United States. ICF monitors employee work locations, blocks access from foreign locations and foreign IP addresses, and prohibits personal VPN connections.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT RENEW CAPITALRenew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries.
jobs.description:
ABOUT RENEW CAPITAL

Renew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries. We back the bold founders using technology to pursue Africa’s greatest opportunities.

With more than a decade of investing on the continent, Renew Capital is among the most active investors building Africa’s thriving private sector.

Renew Capital is powered by a team of investment, finance, legal, advisory and market development professionals. Our bench includes seasoned investors, analysts, operators and ecosystem experts with deep experience scaling businesses across Africa.

ROLE SUMMARY

The sr. financial analyst plays a critical role in evaluating, supporting and scaling high-potential ventures across Africa. This role sits at the core of Renew Capital’s investment process, supporting sourcing, due diligence, investment decision-making and portfolio value creation.

The sr. financial analyst will work closely with investment managers, portfolio company CFOs and senior leadership, building rigorous financial models and translating complex data into clear insights that inform investment decisions.

Responsibilities:

The sr. financial analyst’s responsibilities are focused on three core areas:

1. Investment Analysis & Due Diligence

  • Prepare and maintain robust financial models for pipeline and prospective investment opportunities.
  • Analyze historical financial data, forecasts and assumptions to assess risk, return, and scalability.
  • Evaluate capital expenditures, depreciation schedules, and capital structuring scenarios.
  • Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis and primary and secondary research to support investment theses.
  • Support financial and commercial due diligence processes from initial screening through investment committee review.

2. Portfolio Support & Monitoring

  • Work directly with portfolio company finance teams on budgeting, 13-week rolling cash flow forecasts, and financial controls.
  • Monitor portfolio company performance, identify trends, calculate key ratios, and flag risks or opportunities early.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with portfolio CFOs and founders.

3. Communication & Insight Generation

  • Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready materials for investment managers, leadership and the investment committee.
  • Prepare presentations, memos and dashboards that communicate insights concisely.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, distributed investment team across Africa using digital tools.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business or a related field; MBA or Master’s in Finance preferred.
  • 6–8+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, investment analysis, private equity, venture capital, investment banking or corporate finance, with exposure to growth-stage companies.
  • Advanced financial modeling expertise, including integrated three-statement models, valuation, scenario and sensitivity analysis and capital structuring.
  • Strong experience supporting or leading financial and commercial due diligence processes.
  • Proven ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear, decision-ready insights for senior leadership and investment committees.
  • Excellent Excel and financial analysis skills, with experience working with large, complex data sets.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with investment teams, portfolio company CFOs and founders across diverse markets.
  • CFA or other recognized investment or financial modeling credentials preferred.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

As Renew Capital continues to expand its investment activity across Africa, strong financial analysis is essential to deploying capital responsibly and supporting portfolio companies through growth and complexity. This role provides exposure to venture investing across multiple sectors and markets, with the opportunity to influence real investment outcomes.

Location and Travel Opportunities:

This is a remote role; however, candidates must be based in Morocco.

We invite you to learn more about Renew Capital by visiting our website:.

Renew Capital is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran or disability status, or any other basis prohibited by law. jobs.excerpt: Why Castelion, Why NowCastelion is moving incredibly fast to develop and deliver advanced defense systems at a time when execution matters more than ever.
jobs.description:
Why Castelion, Why Now

Castelion is moving incredibly fast to develop and deliver advanced defense systems at a time when execution matters more than ever. We believe focus and technical excellence are decisive advantages - and we are building a team that can deliver real capability, not just concepts.

This is a rare opportunity to join at an early stage, where your work will directly shape critical systems, influence major technical decisions, and have immediate, real-world impact.

Energetics Safety Manager

The Energetics Safety Manager leads Castelion's enterprise Energetics Safety Program and is responsible for establishing the policies, standards, procedures, training, and risk management framework needed to support the safe design, manufacture, storage, transportation, testing, and disposal of energetic materials.

As part of the Environmental, Health & Safety organization, this role provides independent energetics safety oversight and partners with Engineering, Manufacturing, Test, Facilities, Security, Supply Chain, Quality, and Program Management to integrate safety throughout the product and operational lifecycle. The position supports and coordinates energetics safety across all Castelion locations conducting energetic operations.

Responsibilities

Energetics Safety Program

  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Castelion's Energetics Safety Program.
  • Establish and maintain company-wide policies, standards, procedures, specifications, and training for energetic operations.
  • Promote consistent practices across manufacturing, ground test, flight test, storage, transportation, and disposal activities.
  • Incorporate lessons learned, regulatory changes, and industry practices into program improvements and the broader EHS Management System.

Energetics Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain processes for identifying, evaluating, documenting, and managing risks associated with energetic materials and operations.
  • Lead or facilitate qualitative and quantitative hazard analyses, including PHAs, HAZOPs, FMEAs, What-If analyses, QRAs, and Quantity-Distance evaluations, as appropriate.
  • Support facility siting, hazard classification, blast and fragmentation assessments, consequence analysis, and operational readiness activities.
  • Partner with Engineering and Operations to develop risk reduction strategies using sound engineering principles and the hierarchy of controls.
  • Ensure residual risks, assumptions, and required safeguards are clearly documented and elevated through the appropriate risk acceptance process.

Safety Integration & Operational Support

  • Lead the integration of energetics safety across engineering, manufacturing, and test operations without assuming ownership of technical design or operational execution.
  • Establish standardized approaches for safely conducting energetic manufacturing, ground test, and flight test activities.
  • Coordinate energetics safety support for major test campaigns and other high-consequence operations to ensure personnel, facilities, equipment, and safeguards are aligned.
  • Support operations conducted at external ranges and ensure alignment with applicable customer and range safety requirements.

Engineering & Test Review Participation

  • Represent EHS as a key stakeholder throughout the engineering and operational lifecycle.
  • Participate in design reviews, manufacturing and production readiness reviews, operational readiness reviews, and ground and flight test readiness reviews.
  • Evaluate whether energetics hazards, risk controls, and verification requirements are appropriately identified and addressed before execution.
  • Provide independent recommendations regarding energetics risk, operational safeguards, and residual risk acceptance while preserving Engineering's authority over technical design decisions.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance

  • Lead enterprise compliance with applicable energetics and explosives safety requirements.
  • Interpret and implement applicable DoD explosives safety standards, DoD 4145, ATF, OSHA, DOT, NFPA, and federal, state, local, customer, and range-specific requirements.
  • Develop compliance strategies, maintain required documentation, and support regulatory inspections, customer audits, government reviews, and explosives safety approvals.

Training & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and maintain Castelion's Energetics Safety Training Program, including qualification and competency expectations based on operational hazards and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead or support investigations involving energetic materials, identify root and contributing causes, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
  • Integrate lessons learned into standards, procedures, training, and future design and operational reviews.
  • Track leading and lagging indicators, identify trends, and implement improvements that strengthen safety performance and operational effectiveness

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, Occupational Safety, Chemistry, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible experience supporting energetic materials or explosives operations in aerospace, defense, military, manufacturing, or another high hazard industry.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or implementing energetics safety programs, technical standards, procedures, and operational requirements.
  • Experience leading or facilitating hazard analyses and risk assessments, including qualitative and quantitative methodologies such as PHAs, HAZOPs, FMEAs, What-If analyses, QRAs, and Quantity-Distance evaluations.
  • Experience participating in multidisciplinary design reviews, readiness reviews, and high consequence test or manufacturing activities.
  • Working knowledge of applicable DoD explosives safety requirements, ATF regulations, OSHA, DOT hazardous materials regulations, and NFPA codes and standards.
  • Ability to provide independent safety oversight, influence cross-functional teams, and communicate risk-based recommendations without direct operational or engineering authority.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience supporting solid rocket motor manufacturing, propulsion systems, missile programs, or other energetic defense applications.
  • Experience supporting ground and flight test operations, external government test ranges, explosives safety approvals, facility siting, or quantitative consequence modeling.
  • Professional certification such as CSP, CIH, CHMM, or equivalent.
  • Active Secret security clearance or the ability to obtain one.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Benefits And Perks

All full-time employees are granted meaningful long-term equity, sharing in the company's significant growth trajectory. We offer four (4) weeks of paid time off, ten (10) company-paid holidays, and comprehensive health benefits - including 100% employee-covered medical and strong dependent coverage, along with dental and vision plans. We also provide paid parental leave to support growing families, a $100 monthly fitness stipend to promote health and performance, and onsite EV charging for convenience. In addition, employees enjoy perks like catered meals, company-covered food during high-demand periods, and a fully stocked kitchen to stay fueled throughout the day.

While this position does not currently require a U.S government-issued security clearance, it may in the near future. Therefore, the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government–issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Affirmative Action/EEO Statement

Employment with Castelion is governed on the basis of competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Twelve months from now, this person will have helped establish a deeper bench of trusted creator relationships, a reliable pipeline of high-quality creator-led content, and a more scalable approach to activating talent across the business with clear learnings on how creator partnerships can contribute to brand and marketing objectives.

This is a remote-based role reporting to the Senior Manager, Influencer Marketing.

  • Build a scalable, always-on creator engine: Establish and manage a consistent pipeline of 6–12 creator partnerships per month, creating a reliable cadence of culturally relevant content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and emerging platforms and formats.
  • Bring an established network and grow strong creator relationships: Come into the role with trusted relationships across creators, talent managers, agents, and influencer agencies, and continue expanding that network to give Instacart stronger access to established and emerging talent, more effective negotiations, and long-term partnership opportunities.

jobs.description:
REX SOFTWARE GROUP

Senior Position Description

AI Native Senior Software Engineer

Reports to

Head of Engineering (or relevant Tech Lead)

Direct Reports

None (informal technical mentoring across the product stream and wider engineering team)

Location

Australia-based (East coast preferred / Remote AU)

Scope

Product stream technical leadership, with cross-stream influence on AI-native standards and practices

Domain

AI-native software development, AI agent orchestration, and product delivery

Role Overview

Rex Software Group is transitioning to an AI-native operating model. This is not about adding AI features to a traditional development process, it is a fundamental shift in how we build and ship software. Our target is Level 4 AI maturity: humans define the architecture, usage scenarios, and acceptance criteria, while AI agents autonomously write, review, and fix code.

The AI Native Senior Software Engineer is a senior engineering role for builders who already work this way and can set the standard for others to follow. You will be embedded within a product stream (Rex CRM or Rex PM) as its most experienced AI-native practitioner, expected to deliver production-quality software using AI coding agents as your primary development tool, and expected to shape how the rest of the stream, and over time the wider engineering organisation, works with AI agents.

You are not writing every line of code by hand, you are orchestrating AI agents to do it, auditing their output, and ensuring the result meets the architectural and quality standards of the codebase. This is explicitly not a “vibe-coding” role. At senior level, you also carry accountability for the technical decisions and AI-native practices of your stream, not just your own output.

This role requires a different profile to a traditional senior software engineer. You must have the engineering maturity to recognise when AI-generated code is correct, performant, and secure, and the judgement to know when it is not, at a level that lets you set standards others follow. You must be comfortable providing constructive, architectural feedback to AI tools the same way a senior engineer coaches a junior developer, with patience, precision, and clear expectations, and you must be equally comfortable coaching human engineers in how to do the same.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Native Product Development & Technical Leadership

  • Deliver production-quality features and fixes within your assigned product stream using AI coding agents as the primary development tool, taking on the most architecturally significant or ambiguous work in the stream
  • Set the technical direction for how AI agents are orchestrated within your stream, including standards for prompting, context management, and agent-generated code review
  • Critically audit AI-generated code for correctness, performance, security, and adherence to Rex's coding standards, and coach other engineers to do the same
  • Own and continuously improve the prompts, context documents, and system instructions (AGENTS.md, Skills, and related documentation) that train AI agents on Rex's architecture, patterns, and conventions for your stream
  • Identify tasks best suited for AI-assisted development versus manual implementation, and help other engineers build this judgment
  • Make or strongly influence build-vs-buy and architectural trade-off decisions within your product stream

Engineering Quality & Architecture

  • Own the system architecture within your stream, including database schemas, API contracts, service boundaries, and deployment pipelines, and ensure AI-native workflows respect and reinforce that architecture
  • Lead technical design discussions, code reviews, and architectural decisions within your product stream, and act as an escalation point for complex technical judgement calls
  • Set and maintain test coverage standards, ensuring AI-generated code is consistently accompanied by appropriate automated tests across the stream
  • Debug and resolve the most complex issues across the stack, leveraging both manual investigation and AI-assisted diagnostic techniques
  • Drive proactive identification and remediation of technical debt, balancing delivery speed with long-term code health at a stream level

Mentoring, Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Mentor other engineers in AI-native development practices, prompting strategies, and workflow improvements, both within your stream and across the wider engineering organisation
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers within your product stream to shape and deliver against roadmap priorities
  • Represent your stream's AI-native practices and progress to engineering leadership, contributing to group-wide AI development strategy
  • Document effective patterns and failure modes, and drive adoption of these across teams
  • Lead by example in sprint ceremonies, technical planning, and cross-stream knowledge sharing
  • Support the broader engineering team in adopting AI-native development practices through hands-on collaboration, coaching, and structured knowledge transfer

What We Are Looking For

Essential

  • Several years of demonstrated experience building software using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cody, Aider, or equivalent) as a primary development tool, with genuine agent-driven development workflows, not just autocomplete
  • A portfolio, GitHub profile, or personal projects that evidence a mature AI-native development approach, including evidence of setting standards or mentoring others in this way of working
  • Deep software engineering fundamentals: strong command of system design, data structures, API design, testing strategies, and deployment practices, sufficient to confidently audit AI-generated output and coach others to do the same
  • Senior-level engineering maturity to distinguish good AI-generated code from bad, including recognising subtle issues with performance, security, edge cases, and architectural fit that AI agents commonly miss
  • Proven experience working across the full stack (frontend and backend), with the ability to context-switch between layers and take ownership of architecturally significant work
  • A constructive and patient approach to working with AI tools, and demonstrated ability to coach and mentor other engineers, human or AI-assisted, with clear architectural feedback
  • Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to influence technical direction in a collaborative, cross-functional product team

Desirable

  • Experience with any of Rex's core technologies: PHP/Laravel, Vue.js/React.js, PostgreSQL/MySQL, Docker, Kubernetes, or GCP
  • Experience in SaaS, proptech, or real estate technology environments
  • Deep familiarity with prompt engineering techniques, context window management, and strategies for improving AI agent output quality at scale
  • Contributions to open-source projects or public writing that demonstrate thought leadership in AI-native software development
  • Experience leading or mentoring within agile product teams with end-to-end delivery ownership
  • Prior experience helping a team or organisation transition to a new technical practice or operating model

Key Competencies

  • AI-native mindset — you default to AI-assisted development, continuously refine your own workflows, and help others do the same
  • Engineering taste — you can assess code quality, architectural fit, and production readiness with authority, regardless of whether a human or an AI wrote it
  • Technical leadership — you set direction, make judgement calls under ambiguity, and are trusted as an escalation point for your stream
  • Pragmatic judgement — you know when to use AI agents and when to write code manually, and can teach that judgement to others
  • Curiosity and adaptability — AI tooling evolves rapidly and you stay current, experimenting with new tools and techniques and sharing what you learn
  • Ownership and accountability — you own the code and technical decisions across your stream, whether written by you, a teammate, or an AI agent
  • Coaching and influence — you actively raise the capability of those around you and contribute positively to team and organisational culture

Success Measures

Success in this role will be demonstrated by:

  • Consistent delivery of production-quality, architecturally significant features within your product stream, meeting sprint commitments and roadmap milestones
  • A high proportion of your stream's deployed code is AI-generated, audited, and meeting quality standards, contributing to the group's target of 50% AI-written deployed code by August 2026
  • Measurable uplift in the AI-native proficiency of engineers you have mentored or coached
  • Positive impact on team velocity and delivery efficiency as evidenced by DORA metrics
  • High-quality code reviews and technical decisions that demonstrate sound, senior-level engineering judgment across both human-written and AI-generated code
  • Active contribution to Rex's AI development strategy, including documentation of effective patterns, prompts, and workflows adopted beyond your own stream
  • Effective technical leadership within your product stream, with positive feedback from product managers, designers, and fellow engineers
  • Demonstrated depth in AI-native development proficiency over time, with increasing sophistication in agent orchestration, output quality, and the ability to teach it

Why Join Rex Now

  • You will be joining a company that is genuinely restructuring around AI-native development; this is not an innovation lab or a side project, it is how we are building the production line
  • Work directly with experienced engineering and AI leadership who are invested in making this transition succeed and help shape it at a senior level
  • Real ownership within a product stream, your work and technical decisions ship to production and impact thousands of real estate agencies across Australia, New Zealand, and the UK
  • Opportunity to define the playbook for AI-native development at a company that is early in this transition and values people who bring ideas and leadership, not just execution
  • PE-backed business with clear growth ambitions and the investment to support them

Confidential

About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

The Senior Engineer II role is a senior technical leadership position responsible for delivering complex software solutions, driving technical strategy, and elevating engineering quality across teams. In this role, the engineer is expected to independently lead large, ambiguous, or mission-critical initiatives and coordinate work across multiple engineering groups and stakeholders.

We have a strong preference for candidates based in Vancouver, BC who are able to work in a hybrid capacity. However, we are open to remote candidates across Canada.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Develop complex software solutions: Lead end-to-end delivery of large or ambiguous initiatives that span multiple systems or teams, leveraging AI-assisted coding tools and autonomous development workflows where applicable.
  • Own and lead projects: Take full ownership of project execution, from design through rollout, integrating agentic workflows and automated guardrails to ensure technical and business goals are met.
  • Provide technical guidance: Offer deep expertise to team members, supporting them through code reviews, architectural decisions, and best practices for collaborating with AI coding agents.

  • Ensure system reliability: Lead improvements in reliability, scalability, observability, and incident response; help define standards and processes that support operational excellence in automated and agent-driven environments.
  • Raise engineering quality: Improve engineering patterns, tooling, documentation, and processes that increase productivity and code quality across multiple teams, incorporating automated code review and refactoring agents.
  • Communicate at a senior level: Clearly articulate complex technical concepts to engineers, product managers, and leadership; serve as a trusted technical voice on modern software practices.
  • Manage ambiguity: Operate effectively in undefined or rapidly evolving situations, bringing clarity, structure, and direction for others, particularly in the transition toward agentic SDLC.

  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member

Healthie is backed by leading investors, and while we've $42M raised to date, more importantly, we operate with fiscal responsibility and have been profitable for more than half of our time as a company. About the role

Overall, you’re more technical than the typical support professional.

Position Title: Senior Systems Engineer – Interoperability

Reports to: Senior Manager Global Systems Engineering

Position Summary: This role will be responsible for developing architecture and design while informing requirements, verification, and validation. This position will apply architectural design principles to develop system architectures and lead the integration of engineering disciplines to implement designs that enable the successful launch of life-saving oncology systems in a competitive market.

Key Responsibilities: This role will define requirements, verify, and validate system interoperability. This position will lead the integration of engineering disciplines to deliver system solutions that successfully meet the needs of our customers and development partners.

Key Product Development Responsibilities:

  • Co-led with Product Management the baseline interoperability objectives for projects.
  • Oversee the development of user needs and lower-level decompositions of requirements that are derived from project interoperability objectives, in coordination with the Requirements Management team.
  • Lead multi-disciplinary product development teams to implement the project’s interoperability requirements.
  • Oversee the development of verification and validation test cases for interoperability requirements, in coordination with the Verification and Validation team.
  • Document system capabilities in product/project deliverables.

  • Own the creation and maintenance of the DICOM Conformance Statement.
  • Establish best practices, governance processes, and technical documentation to ensure consistent and compliant DICOM behavior across product lines.
  • Drive interoperability testing, troubleshooting, and certification efforts, including participation in IHE Connectathons or similar integration validation activities.
  • Provide subject-matter expertise on DICOM standards, IHE profiles, and medical imaging interoperability to internal teams and external collaboration partners.
  • Mentor engineers within the team to build broader team knowledge and capabilities.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Key Customer-Oriented Responsibilities:

  • Co-led with Client Delivery Project Management the collection of specific integrations and configurations needed by a prospective customer.
    • For collected integration needs, determine the ability of the baseline product to support the customer’s application. In situations where there is a lack of alignment, work with Product Management to disposition the needs.
    • For collected configuration needs, ensure the delivered product is configured to match the agreed upon specification.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, clinical customers, and collaboration partners to implement and validate customer DICOM/IHE workflows.
  • Conduct joint debugging sessions using DICOM logs, network traces, and validation tools (e.g., DVTk, Offis DCMTK) to resolve interoperability issues.
  • Work with the customer’s IT team and vendors to prepare for product installation, proactively identifying potential issues.

Relevant Knowledge and Skill requirements:

  • Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in engineering or a science-related field.
  • At least 12 years of engineering experience, with experience in interoperability of medical and imaging systems.
  • Extensive experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Customer-facing experience in collecting tailored needs.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with DICOM standards and IHE integration profiles, including implementation, validation, and troubleshooting of interoperability workflows.
  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.
  • Clear and concise writing and communication skills

About Leo Cancer Care

Cancer is one of the biggest killers that we face today, with 1 in 5 people diagnosed at some point in their life. It affects us all. 50% of all patients diagnosed with cancer should receive Radiation Therapy as part of their treatment, but due to the cost, size, and complexity of current technology, the number that do is around half of that.

Current Radiation Therapy is delivered with a patient lying supine on a table while a large machine is rotated around them, delivering radiation from different angles to kill the tumour. Lying on a table, many patients report that they feel like a passenger in their treatment, feeling vulnerable throughout the entire process. Leo Cancer Care was founded with one clear goal: to bring a more human approach to treating cancer and empower patients to face treatment on their own terms.

We are looking for an enthusiastic individual to complement our passionate team in their mission to revolutionize cancer treatment. jobs.excerpt: CHIEF MARKETING OFFICERWe're seeking a Chief Marketing Officer to lead Pavilion's marketing function and drive growth across new membership bookings, renewals, and new products.
jobs.description:
CHIEF MARKETING OFFICER

We're seeking a Chief Marketing Officer to lead Pavilion's marketing function and drive growth across new membership bookings, renewals, and new products. This person will oversee product marketing, lifecycle marketing, performance marketing, digital and web experience (brand & content), and sales enablement, including the team responsible for direct outreach and final-stage conversion.

Pavilion serves GTM professionals globally through membership, education, events, and community. Our primary commercial measure is bookings: the cash a customer pays after discounts, whether for a new membership or a renewal.

We need an experienced, tenured marketer who can set a clear strategy, make sound investment decisions, and build a team that takes ownership of results. As a member of executive leadership, the CMO will help determine business priorities and hold peers accountable for the decisions and commitments that support them. You should bring direct experience building acquisition and lifecycle programs, the judgment to challenge agency recommendations, and practical experience using AI to improve marketing team efficiency and performance. The ability to jump into execution to support a lean team as needed will be imperative.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy and Leadership with Player-Coach Mentality

  • Translate business goals into marketing priorities, initiatives, metrics, and a resourcing plan. Work with executive leadership to agree which offerings and audiences take priority.
  • Hold executive peers accountable for agreed goals and commitments. Make dependencies visible, challenge conflicting requests, and secure decisions when priorities exceed the team's capacity.
  • Build confidence and motivation within the team through clear direction, realistic workloads, useful feedback, and recognition of results. Create an environment where a best-in-class marketing team can propose ideas and question assumptions.
  • Develop team leaders across product marketing, lifecycle, performance marketing, and sales enablement. Set responsibilities and recommend hiring or agency support based on business needs.
  • Establish a regular review of bookings/other performance with leadership,Finance, and RevOps. Maintain a shared definition of bookings and dashboards that distinguish cash collected from pipeline or unpaid commitments.
  • Expertly weave in and out of strategic leadership and pushing things forward. Pavilion is at a stage where the player-coach mindset is critical; it’s not enough to simply know who to ideally hire, our leadership team must be able to jump in and get the job done if needed as well.

Growth Oversight

  • Own the marketing plan and budget against agreed targets, with clear contributions from new member acquisition, renewals, and B2B efforts.
  • Lead performance marketing across paid media, SEO and AEO, and event acquisition. Evaluate strategy and results with the expertise of someone who has built and run these programs directly.
  • Allocate spend based on cash bookings, acquisition cost, retention, and payback. Assess how pricing and discounts affect conversion and the value of each booking.
  • Test new channels to reach GTM professionals globally, with clear criteria for expanding, revising, or stopping an investment against a clear geographic strategy that aligns with our Chapter model delivery.

AI and Marketing Operations

  • Set priorities for AI agents and automated workflows in areas such as content production, segmentation, reporting, and lead scoring.
  • Bring specific examples of tools or workflows you have built or deployed and the measurable effect on cost, output, or performance.
  • Equip the team to use these tools responsibly, with clear ownership and review of customer-facing work. Measure whether adoption improves results or saves meaningful time.

Lifecycle Marketing

  • Lead lifecycle programs that improve activation, engagement, upgrades and renewal bookings, using member behavior and cohort performance to guide decisions.
  • Partner with MemberSuccess and Program Managers on onboarding, nurture, and milestone communications, with clear ownership of renewal outreach and member handoffs.
  • Build referral, upgradel and win-back programs, and use member feedback to address barriers to continued membership.
  • Own lead nurture series and various conversion-focused lifecycle flows to aid in demand capture when interested GTM leaders decide to convert on one of Pavilion’s various products

Product Marketing across B2C and B2B Offerings

  • Lead Product Marketing, including Growth Product (CRO) across Pavilion's offerings, defining audiences, positioning, and the reasons to buy or renew.
  • Clarify the relationship between membership, education, events, and team solutions so prospective customers understand what they receive and which offering fits their needs.
  • Develop go-to-market plans for courses that are sold both standalone and as part of membership, coordinating with Learn on launch timing and the transition into the member experience.
  • Own B2B marketing strategy and execution for Learn courses sold in bulk, including buyer messaging, demand generation, and support for team and company purchases. Align with Sales on pipeline quality and conversion to cash bookings.

Sales Enablement and Conversion

  • Lead the sales enablement team responsible for direct follow-up with prospective members in the final stage of their decision, including calls and other outreach that help them convert.
  • Set lead prioritization, follow-up standards, and handoffs between marketing and member-facing teams. Equip the team with relevant messaging, member proof points, and responses to common objections.
  • Manage Synapsa and 1Mind playbooks and responses to ensure consistency and quality control for the brand
  • Track conversion to paid bookings and use findings to improve campaigns and outreach. Agree pricing and discount guardrails with leadership and Finance.

Brand and Communications

  • Lead Pavilion's brand presence across web, social, events, and content, with consistent messaging and brand identity about the value of Pavilion’s offerings
  • Oversee thought leadership, PR, and storytelling grounded in member outcomes. Work with Learnand Community to surface member success and insights.
  • Establish a clear role for community content and executive thought leadership, including Sam's personal brand, within the broader marketing strategy.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Senior marketing leadership experience with responsibility for strategy, budgets, and commercial results, including meaningful experience in membership, community, or subscription businesses.
  • A record of setting priorities with executive leadership, challenging assumptions constructively, and securing the decisions and resources needed to deliver against goals.
  • Experience building team confidence and developing managers, with concrete examples of changes in team performance and ways of working.
  • Demonstrated performance marketing expertise, including direct experience building and running paid, SEO, or other acquisition programs and managing agencies or contractors.
  • Proven success in product marketing and lifecycle marketing, including positioning, launch planning, and renewal programs.
  • Strong content and communications judgment; fluency in marketing analytics, cash bookings, and budget management.
  • Practical experience building or deploying AI agents and marketing workflows, with the ability to explain the tools used and their measurable impact.

Preferred: Familiarity with event marketing and community storytelling in a global business serving GTM professionals.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 90 Days

  • Assess bookings performance across acquisition, renewals, course-led membership purchases, and B2B for Learn, including pricing, discounts, and final-stage conversion.
  • Agree bookings targets and business priorities with leadership and Finance, supported by a marketing plan, budget, and clear decision-making responsibilities.
  • Establish team responsibilities and a working rhythm that gives people clear priorities and timely decisions. Address the most immediate gaps in conversion and renewal programs.
  • Begin practical AI and process improvements with defined measures of success.

First Year

  • Delivery against agreed bookings targets, with clear reporting on new memberships and renewals, including the contributions of courses and B2B efforts.
  • Improved acquisition efficiency and conversion to paid membership, with disciplined spending and discounting.
  • Stronger renewal performance attributed to Lifecycle channels, supported by evidence of member activation, engagement, and value.
  • Clear positioning across Pavilion's offerings and consistent messaging across marketing and member-facing teams.
  • A team with stronger confidence, clear ownership, and the ability to recommend strategy. Executive leadership follows through on agreed priorities and commitments.
  • Measurable returns from AI tools and workflow improvements.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Competitive salary + performance bonus tied primarily to agreed bookings targets
  • Stock options in a profitable, mission-driven company
  • Comprehensive health benefits and professional development budget
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment
  • Access to Pavilion membership and education
Salary: $250K - $275K

Job Details:

Client Services Consultant, Training & Implementation


Location: Remote (Canada or USA)

Reports To: Operations Manager, BEC Legal Systems

Travel: up to 10%: periodic visits to the Cincinnati office, occasional client sites, and industry conferences (e.g., ILTACON)


About BEC Legal Systems

BEC Legal Systems has served the legal community for decades, evolving from its roots in Cincinnati, Ohio into a trusted provider of enterprise software for law firms and corporate legal departments nationwide. Our product suite - including CoreRelate Cloud, CoreRespond, MatterLink, Docket Enterprise, LegalBar, and Assemble-It - helps legal teams manage attorney calendars, track matters, and automate document creation directly within the Microsoft Office environment they already rely on.

Our clients stay with us because our team knows their firms, their workflows, and their deadlines. We are building a cross-trained Client Services team where every consultant brings deep expertise in one area and can step in across implementation, training, and support, so clients get fast, knowledgeable help from people who understand their environment.


How Our Team Works

Client Services is made up of consultants, each with a core specialty: Training & Implementation, Support, and Data & Integrations. Each consultant spends most of their time in their specialty, covers a defined share of work in another area, and contributes to shared team assets such as our knowledge base and training materials. Support coverage is scheduled, not ad hoc, so implementation and training commitments stay protected.


About the Role

As Client Services Consultant, Training & Implementation, you will be BEC's lead trainer and own complex implementations and upgrades from kickoff through go-live. You will consult with clients to understand their business practices, configure solutions that fit their workflows, and deliver the training that drives adoption.

You will also take scheduled support rotations and train your teammates so the whole team can deliver implementations and training with confidence. This is a hands-on, client-facing role that combines project management, software configuration, training delivery, and support. You will work closely with R&D, QA, and Sales, and you will travel to client sites and other locations as needed.


Key Responsibilities

Core Specialty: Training & Implementation (approximately 60%)

  • Training Program Ownership: Own BEC's client training program, including curriculum design, onsite and web-based delivery, and recorded or self-serve training assets.
  • Implementation Delivery: Lead complex implementations and upgrades of BEC's products from initial configuration through go-live, on schedule and in line with client expectations.
  • Business Practice Consultation: Work with clients to understand their current business practices and recommend best practices to implement during installations and conversions.
  • Client Education: Educate clients on proper software configuration, application integrations, and data entry so they can fully leverage the software's capabilities.
  • Data Partnership: Partner with the Data & Integrations consultant on data mapping and validation during implementations.

Cross-Coverage: Support (approximately 25%)

  • Support Rotation: Take scheduled support rotations, owning Level 1 triage, resolution, and SLA performance while on rotation.
  • Escalation: Escalate Level 2 issues and product defects, using the team's defined escalation path.
  • Post-Go-Live Support: Support clients during the post-go-live period, including reporting of issues and enhancement requests.

Team Enablement (approximately 15%)

  • Peer Training: Train and certify teammates on implementation and training delivery for priority products.
  • Knowledge Base: Contribute knowledge base articles drawn from implementation and training experience.
  • Product Expertise: Provide product use expertise to internal R&D and QA teams, informing product direction and quality.
  • Internal Training: Assist with training of BEC employees when needed.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing professional services role leading client onboarding, implementations, and training.
  • Hands-on experience with legal practice management, matter management, docketing, or document automation platforms (e.g., BEC's suite or comparable tools) as a user, trainer or administrator.
  • Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to improve personal productivity, optimize workflows, or improve client communication.
  • Capability to excel in a data-driven, metrics-oriented environment, and to build the metrics where they do not yet exist.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong listening skills and a genuine service orientation.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely, in a lean organization where leaders are both strategic and hands-on.

jobs.description:
Position Title: VP, Value Based Care Operations

FLSA Status: Exempt, Full-time Regular

Location: Remote

Travel Required: Extensive

Who we are:

US Health Partners (“USHP”) seeks to redefine high-quality specialty care in the United States and establish a high-performing, technology-enabled care delivery platform. USHP is partnering with the country’s leading physicians to build a comprehensive, out-patient focused specialty care network targeting the nation’s cardiovascular concerns. Our physician-led organization is passionate about supporting exceptional care and enriching the lives of patients across the United States. We envision the opportunity to create a scaled, cutting-edge, technology-enabled healthcare services platform that leverages a value-based delivery model.

Position Summary:

The VP, Value Based Care Operations is responsible for turning USHP's value-based care strategy into consistent, measurable execution across every market and clinical practice. This role builds and leads the operating model, programs, and performance infrastructure that allow USHP's physician-led cardiovascular practices to succeed under risk-based and quality-linked arrangements, including care management, quality and risk adjustment, utilization and total cost of care management, and payer partnership operations. The VP partners closely with operational and division leadership to equip practices with the tools, data, workflows, and accountability needed to deliver on value-based targets. As a member of the operations leadership team, the VP, Value Based Care Operations shares accountability for the organization's clinical quality and financial performance at scale.

Responsibilities may include:

Value-Based Care Strategy & Operating Model

  • Translate USHP's value-based care strategy into an enterprise operating model, roadmap, and annual operating plan in partnership with executive leadership.
  • Define standard value-based care workflows, protocols, and playbooks that can be deployed consistently across sites, divisions, and newly acquired practices.
  • Establish governance, performance cadences, and escalation paths that connect enterprise value-based care priorities to division and site-level execution.
  • Partner with the SVP, Operations to align value-based care operations with clinical standards and overall business objectives.

Practice-Level Execution & Care Delivery

  • Partner with Division Medical Presidents, Regional Medical Directors, and Site Medical Directors to implement value-based care programs and initiatives at the practice level.
  • Lead care management, care coordination, patient outreach, and transitions-of-care programs designed to improve outcomes and reduce avoidable utilization in cardiovascular populations.
  • Operationalize cardiovascular-specific pathways, such as chronic disease management, post-procedure follow-up, and appropriate-use and site-of-care strategies, in collaboration with clinical leadership.
  • Support site teams in embedding value-based care workflows into daily practice operations, including patient attribution, panel management, and gaps-in-care closure.
  • Provide training, tools, and onboarding support so physicians, advanced practice providers, and practice staff understand and can act on value-based care expectations.

Quality, Risk Adjustment & Compliance

  • Oversee quality performance and reporting for value-based programs.
  • Lead risk adjustment and documentation accuracy programs in partnership with clinical leaders, ensuring accurate, compliant, and complete capture of patient acuity.
  • Direct continuous improvement efforts, using performance data to identify variation, prioritize interventions, and hold divisions and sites accountable for results.
  • Partner with Legal to ensure value-based care programs meet regulatory, contractual, and program integrity requirements.

Payer Partnerships & Financial Performance

  • Partner with Finance leadership to support the operational requirements of value-based contracts, including shared savings, risk-sharing, capitation, and quality incentive arrangements.
  • Monitor and manage total cost of care, utilization trends, and shared savings or risk performance, with regular reporting to executive leadership.
  • Serve as the operational lead in payer and program performance reviews, translating contract terms into practice-level targets and action plans.
  • Work with Division Medical Presidents and operations partners to connect value-based performance to divisional financial results and revenue growth initiatives.

Data, Analytics & Technology

  • Define business requirements for value-based care analytics, dashboards, and reporting in partnership with Data, Analytics, and Technology teams.
  • Ensure physicians and practice leaders have timely, actionable, and trusted performance data at the division, site, and provider level.
  • Evaluate and implement technology-enabled tools that support population health, risk stratification, remote patient monitoring, and care gap management.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Build, develop, and lead a high-performing value-based care operations team, including population health, care management, quality, and analytics leaders.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning across clinical and non-clinical teams.
  • Serve as a trusted partner and voice for value-based care in enterprise planning, board reporting, communications, and change management initiatives.

Growth & Market Development

  • Partner with executive and operations leadership to evaluate value-based care opportunities in de novo sites, acquisitions, and new market entries.
  • Lead value-based care operational due diligence and integration planning to bring acquired practices onto USHP's standard operating model.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MHA, MPH, or related) preferred. A medical degree is not required for this role.
  • 8+ years of progressive healthcare leadership experience, including significant experience leading value-based care, population health, or clinical operations at a multi-site or enterprise level.
  • Demonstrated success operationalizing value-based care programs and driving quality and financial performance across multiple markets, divisions, or practices.
  • Experience with risk-based and value-based arrangements, such as Medicare Advantage, ACO/MSSP, capitation, or shared savings contracts, strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of quality measurement, risk adjustment, and total cost of care management.
  • Proven experience building, developing, and leading high-performing teams.

Competencies:

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and lead both physician and non-physician leaders.
  • Track record of leading through others at scale within a multi-site, physician-led environment.
  • Skilled at partnering with and enabling physician leaders to succeed, rather than directing top-down.
  • Strategic thinker with strong financial, analytical, and operational acumen.
  • Data-driven approach to performance improvement, with the ability to translate analytics into practice-level action.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills across clinical and non-clinical stakeholders.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands and fingers to handle or feel, as well as talk and hear. The employee is regularly required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is required to stand and walk. The employee may lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Biostatistician
jobs.excerpt: Overview / About usThe Biostatistician executes statistical analyses of patient-centered outcomes (PCO), including patient-reported outcome (PRO) and clinical outcome assessment (COA)-related endpoints, in direct support of the Director, Biostatistics' PRO/COA methodology workstream.
jobs.description:
Overview / About us

The Biostatistician executes statistical analyses of patient-centered outcomes (PCO), including patient-reported outcome (PRO) and clinical outcome assessment (COA)-related endpoints, in direct support of the Director, Biostatistics' PRO/COA methodology workstream. Working within the standards, templates, and R-based tooling the Director establishes, this role performs hands-on PRO efficacy analyses (e.g., MMRM, responder analyses, Time to Deterioration), applies the estimand framework and intercurrent event handling consistent with ICH E9(R1), and supports development of compliance- and audit-ready documentation for EU Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA) submissions under Regulation 2021/2282 and related dossiers. This role owns execution of assigned analyses from planning through reporting and translates complex statistical findings into decision-ready outputs for technical and non-technical audiences, partnering directly with Sponsors and internal cross-functional teams to deliver scientifically rigorous work within consulting timelines.

Responsibilities / Position overview

PRO/COA Statistical Execution

  • Executes JCA analyses, related PRO analyses, and post-hoc PRO analyses of US trials as directed by the Director, Biostatistics.
  • Performs PRO efficacy analyses including MMRM, ANCOVA, responder analyses, and Time to Deterioration (TTD), consistent with methodology and standards established by the Director.
  • Applies multiple imputation and other missing-data methods (e.g., tipping point analysis, pattern mixture modeling, as directed) to address missingness in longitudinal PRO/COA data.
  • Supports development and application of Minimal Important Difference (MID) thresholds for responder analyses, under Director oversight.
  • Applies estimand framework principles and intercurrent event handling consistent with ICH E9(R1).
  • Conducts subgroup and effect-modification analyses to characterize how patient-centered treatment benefit varies across populations and PICOs.

Statistical Strategy Input & Study Design Support

  • Contributes to fit-for-purpose analytic strategies for PCO under the Director's direction, aligned to study objectives, evidence needs, and stakeholder context.
  • Articulates key assumptions, tradeoffs, and limitations of assigned analyses to support decision-making under real-world constraints.

Statistical Analysis Planning & Documentation

  • Prepares clear, reviewable analysis plans and technical documentation (SAP-style methods documents, analysis specifications, output shells) using templates and standards established by the Director, ensuring transparency, reproducibility, and audit readiness.
  • Contributes documentation aligned to JCA dossier appendix requirements (protocols, SAPs, evidence-synthesis reports, programming code), including JCA Appendix D.3 evidence-synthesis standards.

Methods for Challenging PRO/COA Data

  • Selects and applies appropriate approaches for skewed, bounded, categorical, and longitudinal PRO/COA data, including missing data handling and sensitivity analyses, consistent with Director-defined methodology.

Trial PRO Endpoint Analysis & Post-hoc Analysis

  • Designs and implements statistical approaches for analyzing PRO/COA endpoints in interventional studies, aligned to protocol objectives and Director-set standards.
  • Conducts post-hoc analyses of clinical trial data to identify additional treatment benefits or insights related to patient-centered outcomes.

COA/PRO Evidence Packages

  • Authors or contributes to JCA submission dossiers (e.g., PICO-specific summaries) and statistical/quantitative sections of COA regulatory dossiers, under Director review.

Results Interpretation & Reporting

  • Interprets analytical results and develops clear, decision-ready reports and evidence narratives suitable for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Statistical Programming in R

  • Develops and executes statistical programming in R using the reusable, functional-programming-based tools and traceable, quality-controlled workflows established by the Director, to deliver reviewable outputs in a collaborative programming environment.

Sponsor Partnership & Consulting Delivery

  • Partners with Sponsors and internal cross-functional teams as a consultative methodological resource; maintains strong client relationships by delivering scientifically rigorous analyses while staying responsive to timelines, including JCA submission deadlines tied to EMA centralized procedure timing.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or higher in Biostatistics, Statistics, Quantitative Psychology/Psychometrics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • 3–5 years of experience designing and executing statistical analyses in an applied setting (life sciences consulting, health outcomes research, applied academic/medical research, or similar), including end-to-end delivery from analysis planning through reporting.
  • Experience analyzing PICOs and PRO/COA endpoints in interventional clinical trials and translating results into stakeholder-relevant evidence.
  • Demonstrated expertise applying trial-aligned statistical methods for PRO endpoints, as applicable (e.g., MMRM, ANCOVA, logistic regression, responder analyses, non-parametric approaches when appropriate), including missing data handling and sensitivity analyses.
  • Working knowledge of estimand framework principles and intercurrent event handling consistent with ICH E9(R1).
  • Working knowledge of the EU HTA Regulation (2021/2282) and JCA process, including PICO scoping methodology and awareness that a single JCA may involve multiple member-state-specific PICOs; familiarity with national HTA body considerations (e.g., IQWiG/G-BA, HAS, NICE) and FDA/EMA PRO guidance a plus.
  • Proficiency in R for statistical programming, including the ability to apply functional-programming-based tools and own analysis workflows end-to-end (data-to-results-to-reporting) using reproducible, reviewable code.
  • Experience preparing analysis plans and technical reports using standardized templates to ensure consistency, efficiency, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate modeling decisions, diagnostics, limitations, and implications clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in a quality-controlled and collaborative programming environment.
  • Experience leveraging emerging AI tools to scale statistical programming and enhance scientific writing efficiency while maintaining analytical rigor and documentation quality.
  • Direct experience contributing to a JCA dossier (e.g., Appendix D.3 evidence synthesis) preferred but not required.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Bonus
  • Pension
  • Private Healthcare
  • Dental Cover
  • Enhanced Eye Care Cover
  • Electric Car Scheme
  • Staggered working hours

jobs.description:
Title: Senior Associate - Corporate Development

Location: India (Remote)

About Mati Carbon

Mati Carbon is an XPRIZE-winning mission-driven global enterprise on an ambitious goal to boost smallholder farmer income and resilience, regenerate soil ecology, and durably remove carbon – all at no cost to the farmers. We deploy Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) and related technologies with a locally-led decentralized model across SE Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa, and are rapidly scaling with the backing by a global coalition of leading research institutions, funders, and buyers – including the Yale University, JP Morgan, Shopify, Stripe, H&M Group, The Schmidt Family Foundation, Livelihood Impact Fund among others.

Role Overview

The planned hire will work directly with Mati's leadership across three critical priorities: corporate strategy, capital formation, and transaction execution. Functioning as the analytical and executional backbone for the senior leadership, you will prepare strategic business cases and investment materials, model capital structures, support fundraising processes, and manage complex transactions and partnerships. This is a high-visibility role for someone who combines rigorous financial skills with a genuine passion for purpose-driven work.

Key Responsibilities

Capital Formation

  1. Support the management in building and executing Mati's capital formation roadmap across the capital stack, e.g. multilateral debt, blended finance, and grant opportunities — including preparation of information memoranda, financial models, funding applications, and due diligence data rooms.
  2. Conduct financial modelling and scenario analysis to support capital structure decisions;
  3. Support funder engagement with the DFIs, Foundations, Multilaterals, Impact Investors, Commercial Lenders, Climate funds, Corporate Partners etc.
  4. Track and manage the fundraising pipeline, investor correspondence, and follow-up actions across active processes.

Transaction Execution & Partnerships

  1. Support execution of strategic transactions including partnership agreements, off-take contracts, MoUs, joint ventures, and M&A opportunities.
  2. Coordinate due diligence across legal, financial, technical, and operational workstreams; liaise with external advisors including legal counsel, auditors, and financial advisors.

Strategy Development

  1. Support the development and articulation of Mati's corporate strategy, including market entry, competitive positioning, and multi-year growth planning across geographies.
  2. Conduct in-depth research on carbon markets, climate policy, agri-input value chains, and the competitive landscape to inform strategic decisions. Prepare Board-ready strategy materials, briefing documents, and decision frameworks; monitor sector trends, regulatory developments, and peer activity.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 3–6 years of professional experience in structured finance, commercial lending, management consulting (financial advisory), investment banking, or private equity.
  • Demonstrable experience with financial modelling, transaction delivery, due diligence, or capital raising — ideally across multiple deal types or sectors.
  • Top-Tier MBA, Chartered Accountant (CA), CFA, or equivalent world-class postgraduate qualification strongly preferred.
  • Prior exposure to impact investing, climate finance, carbon markets, agricultural value chains, or ESG-aligned deal making is a significant advantage.
  • Experience working with or for DFIs, Multilaterals, or development-stage ventures is a plus.

Skills & Attributes

  • Outstanding analytical and financial modelling skills — comfortable with complex capital structures, sensitivity analysis, scenario planning and commercial lender relationships.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to distil complex ideas into compelling narratives for investors, partners, and leadership.
  • High ownership mindset — able to manage workstreams independently and deliver quality outputs under tight timelines.
  • Collaborative, low-ego team player; comfortable with ambiguity and the pace of a fast-growing startup.

Mission Alignment

  • A genuine passion for climate action, sustainable agriculture, or development impact — motivated by purpose as much as performance, and eager to contribute to institution-building at a critical stage of growth.
  • Alignment with Mati's values: farmer-first thinking, scientific integrity, operational excellence, and grounded ambition.

What We Offer

  • A rare opportunity to work at the strategic core of a high-growth, globally impactful climate venture — with direct exposure to the CXOs from day one.
  • A mission-first culture combining urgency, scientific rigour, and deep respect for the communities we serve.
  • An entrepreneurial opportunity to be part of the journey to scale an SME-level enterprise to a world-class global organisation.
  • Competitive compensation benchmarked to top operator peers, with performance-linked incentives and long-term upside participation.
  • Remote-first flexibility with meaningful opportunities for in-person engagement across Mati's field operations in India and beyond.
