jobs.title: Finance Systems & Process Lead
jobs.excerpt: ITHAKA’s mission is to expand access to knowledge and education around the world.
jobs.description:
ITHAKA’s mission is to expand access to knowledge and education around the world. Our services — JSTOR, Portico, and Ithaka S+R — enable people everywhere to learn, to grow, and to overcome barriers to education. In carrying out our mission, as employees we feel a deep responsibility to members of our community and to each other, and we are committed to building and sustaining a culture where everyone can thrive.

The Role

ITHAKA is looking for a Finance Systems & Process Lead to drive the integrity, improvement, and strategic evolution of ITHAKA’s core financial platforms, including Acumatica (ERP), Ramp (accounts payable management), Adaptive Insights (planning & forecasting), and Vertex (tax compliance).

This role is for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems by combining technology, process improvement, and strong business partnership. You will own the evolution of Finance systems and processes, ensuring they not only operate reliably but continuously become more efficient, scalable, and valuable to the organization.

You are a proactive leader who identifies opportunities for improvement, develops compelling business cases that clearly articulate benefits, trade-offs, resource requirements, and expected outcomes, and partners across the organization to turn those ideas into reality. Success in this role comes from combining analytical thinking, practical execution, and the ability to influence stakeholders through evidence and collaboration.

This is not a support function. It is an opportunity to shape how Finance operates by modernizing systems, simplifying processes, and helping the organization make better, faster decisions enabled by technology and thoughtful process design.

Responsibilities

Systems Ownership

  • Own configuration, user access, master data, integrations, and operational health across Acumatica, Ramp, Adaptive Insights, Vertex and other Finance-owned technologies, including future finance systems.
  • Proactively monitor and resolve sync errors, data mismatches, and workflow failures.
  • Maintain system documentation, change logs, and productive vendor relationships; coordinate upgrades and new feature rollouts.
  • Provide expert-level support to Finance and Operations staff; triage issues quickly and correct their root causes.

Process Leadership & Improvement

  • Continuously evaluate Finance and cross-functional processes for improvement opportunities to reduce manual effort and error risk—take action to initiate improvements.
  • Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to evaluate current approaches, using evidence to develop alternatives and clear recommendations to improve outcomes.
  • Ensure improvement recommendations are supported with business justification to build alignment and appropriate prioritization of all opportunities.
  • Drive continuous improvement by navigating competing priorities, gaining support for recommended priorities and maintaining focus on delivering meaningful business outcomes.
  • Design and implement automation to eliminate manual effort; create high-level workflow solutions and engage the right technical or functional partners to finalize and build them.

Governance & Controls

  • Ensure financial systems support audit readiness, internal controls, and data governance standards.
  • Maintain documentation for integrations, configurations, and key workflows; support annual audits and ad-hoc reviews.
  • Partner with Finance leadership on system-level controls for expense management, AP/AR, and tax compliance.

Project Execution

  • Develop business cases that articulate expected value, resource requirements, implementation approach, and success measures to support prioritization and investment decisions.
  • Drive finance systems projects from problem definition through implementation and adoption—with clear owners, execution needs, and expected timelines at every stage.
  • Identify and engage the right stakeholders at the right time; neither building in isolation nor over-socializing every decision.
  • Exercise sound judgment about when to work through an issue independently and when to escalate.
  • Communicate project status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to Finance leadership, engaging leadership early enough in the process to effect change.

Experience and Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with ERP, spend management, bill pay, and financial planning systems in an operational or ownership capacity.
  • Direct experience with at least two of: Acumatica, Ramp, Adaptive Insights, Vertex, or comparable platforms. Salesforce experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated track record of initiating and completing process improvements—not just documenting or recommending them.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and lead organizational change without direct authority.
  • Evidence of pushing back on stakeholders productively: successfully advocating for a better approach even when it was initially unwelcome.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills; able to build a case, present trade-offs, and influence decisions across levels.
  • Self-directed: comfortable owning work end-to-end with limited oversight, while keeping leadership appropriately informed.
  • Experience in a nonprofit, SaaS, or dual-model organization preferred.
  • Familiarity with API integrations, workflow automation, or low-code tools (e.g., Power Automate, Zapier, or native ERP automation).
  • Accounting or finance background sufficient to understand how system configurations affect financial reporting.
  • Experience supporting systems implementation or migration projects in a Finance context.

Work Authorization and Sponsorship

ITHAKA is not currently considering candidates who require any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) to work in the United States.

Compensation and Benefits

At ITHAKA we believe in openness and fair pay. Part of living those values is our commitment to clarity about salary ranges, so candidates know what to expect. The starting salary for this position ranges from $104,000 – $130,000 per year. Starting pay may vary with job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. At present, our total compensation package for benefits-eligible employees includes medical, dental, and vision plans, an employer-paid 10% retirement contribution, paid parental and caregiver leave, 22 days of paid time off, 11 paid holidays, up to 12 sick days, wellness benefits, and more. Please note that ITHAKA, at its discretion, may make changes to its benefits programs from time to time.

Work for ITHAKA

We are committed to our organizational values of belonging, evidence, speed, teamwork, and trust. We take seriously the need for everyone to feel welcome. Belonging is one of our core values, and it shows in our vibrant culture. People from a wide range of backgrounds work at ITHAKA, and we believe that unique perspectives help us realize new insights and build better solutions.

We want to work with people who are passionate about ideas like these and who wish to contribute their perspectives and talents to ITHAKA’s mission. We enthusiastically welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and credentials. We want to hear your story and include your perspective in the transformative work we aim to do.

Learn more about Working at ITHAKA.

Apply Now

Although ITHAKA has physical offices in New York and Ann Arbor, Michigan, our employees are distributed across the continental United States. At this time, we’re not considering candidates who are unable to work and reside in the continental U.S.

Candidates may apply by submitting an application online through our career site, if you have any questions about your application, please contact us at . ITHAKA is committed to providing reasonable accommodations, if there’s anything we can do to accommodate any portion of the application or hiring process, please contact us at .

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to identity or other status protected by law. We invite you to read our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement. ITHAKA cares about your privacy, learn more about our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.description:
About Us:

The United States has the poorest maternal and birth outcomes of all developed countries with the underserved, Black, Brown, Indigenous communities disproportionately affected. Nadia Care is working to drastically change the experience of affected communities by reimagining how we deliver meaningful and compassionate care to expectant moms.

Nadia Care’s mission is to improve pregnancy, birth and the postpartum journey for women and their families by reimagining how maternity care is delivered. Our team is focused on building trust-based engagement and wrap-around support for expectant moms at home, in person and virtually to ensure they have all the social support they need for a successful and joyful pregnancy journey. We help our members with care navigation, doula support, assistance with lactation, nutrition, housing, transportation and a wide range of other needs. We leverage technology to support our virtual engagement that allows us to meet all our moms where they are.

We ensure that our members have trusted sources for support, resources, and information throughout their pregnancy, delivery and well into postpartum. Nadia Care does not replace the primary obstetrician or doctor’s relationships. Instead, we support expectant mothers with all other health-related social needs not typically available through their doctors’ offices.

Our Values:

  • Empathy is at the heart of everything we do. We must always center the experiences of the mothers and families we serve, as well as support and uplift one another.
  • Collaboration is what makes us stronger. We achieve the greatest impact when we work together, share knowledge, and elevate each other’s strengths.
  • Resilience reflects our ability to push through challenges, adapt in a fast-changing environment, and remain committed to our mission no matter the obstacles.

The Role:

As the Specialty Care Manager, you are the operational anchor and cross-functional owner for all contracted specialty care roles across Nadia Care, including Doulas, Registered Dietitians (RDs), and International Board Certified Lactation Consultants (IBCLCs). Sitting within Care Operations, this role directly oversees all specialists and contractors across all regions simultaneously, driving end-to-end coordination, roster availability, panel matching, compliance audit trails, contractor administrative accountability, and onboarding. Clinical scope-of-practice and quality-of-care concerns are escalated directly to Regional Managers and Clinical Leadership.

You serve as the operational liaison connecting members to birth support, ensuring real-time labor activation, enforcing documentation standards, partnering with Licensing, Credentialing & Enrollment, and leading candidate interviews for all incoming specialists.

Key Responsibilities

Contractor Performance, Charting & Accountability

  • Documentation & SLA Enforcement: Track visit completion, labor attendance, and charting timelines across all contracted specialists (Doulas, RDs, IBCLCs).
  • Charting Audits: Conduct routine charting and documentation audits across platform systems (e.g., Athena, Spruce, Acuity). Follow up on incomplete charts, overdue visit notes, or missing documentation.
  • Performance Escalation: Identify, document, and escalate contractor administrative non-compliance, missed labor events, or boundary violations to the Senior Manager of Care Operations, while routing clinical scope-of-practice or quality-of-care issues directly to Regional Managers and Clinical Leadership.
  • Invoice Review & Contract Compliance: Perform regular invoice review against active contracts to verify contractor billing accuracy, confirm rate adherence, and enforce compliance with contracted service terms.

LCE Credentialing Support & Roster Compliance (Doulas, RDs, IBCLCs)

  • LCE Liaison: Function as the primary operational interface with the Licensing, Credentialing & Enrollment (LCE) department.
  • Document Collection: Serve as the primary document collector for LCE credentialing accuracy, actively tracking, collecting, and maintaining up-to-date credentialing artifacts (licenses, certifications, liability insurance, background checks) from all contracted Doulas, RDs, and IBCLCs prior to expiration.
  • Roster Integrity: Maintain an accurate, audit-ready credentialing and payer-approval status tracker across all contract specialists to ensure no contractor provides unbillable or uncredentialed care.

Recruitment, Interviewing & Event Representation

  • Contractor Interviewer: Lead interviews for incoming Doula, Registered Dietitian, and Lactation Consultant candidates, evaluating prospective contract applicants for operational fit, communication skills, and adherence to clinical scope boundaries.
  • Community Recruitment Events: Represent Nadia Care at community, collective, or regional recruitment events (in-person or virtual) as needed to support doula and specialist pipeline growth.
  • Collective Partner Engagement: Maintain collaborative, accountability-driven relationships with regional doula collectives and specialty contractor networks.

Cross-Functional Care Team Alignment

  • Interdisciplinary Sync: Partner closely with Regional Managers, Maternity Navigators, Care Coordinators, and RNs to ensure specialty care (birth support, nutrition, lactation) integrates smoothly into broader member care plans.
  • Data & Capacity Reporting: Produce monthly panel summaries detailing active assignments, upcoming delivery windows, credentialing renewals, and contractor capacity constraints.
  • Enablement & Ops Alignment: Partner closely with onboarding, enablement, and care delivery teams to ensure contractor workflows, operational updates, and training materials remain fully synchronized.
  • Recruitment & Credentialing Partnership: Partner directly with Credentialing and Provider Enrollments Manager and the Talent Acquisition team to streamline specialist hiring, onboarding, and compliance.

Member Birth Support & Active Labor Coordination (Doulas)

  • Matching & Enrollment: Coordinate doula assignments for all opted-in members, ensuring every member has a primary and confirmed backup doula matched prior to 30 weeks gestation.
  • Member Onboarding: Lead member-facing communication regarding birth support expectations, visit cadences (prenatal, labor, postpartum), and labor activation protocols.
  • Active Labor On-Call Coverage: Participate in a structured, team-backed rotation for live labor events to confirm doula dispatch, manage backup handoffs, and resolve real-time coverage bottlenecks.
  • Delivery Window Tracking: Maintain a real-time, accurate delivery tracker across the active member panel; review upcoming due dates weekly and proactively redistribute assignments to prevent clustering gaps.

Qualifications

  • Professional Experience: At least 3-5 years handling care coordination, maternal health operations, or contractor panel administration across multiple care verticals (Doulas, Registered Dietitians, IBCLCs), with strong autonomous startup experience, organizational skills, and operational strength. A specific clinical specialty background is not required, though prior experience working alongside clinical disciplines is a plus.
  • Systems & EHR Proficiency: High fluency with digital care systems and platforms (e.g., Athena Health, Spruce, Acuity, Slack, Google Workspace).
  • Structured On-Call Rotation: Willingness and ability to participate in a structured, team-backed on-call rotation outside standard business hours for active labor triage and coverage emergencies.
  • Interviewing & Evaluation Skills: Demonstrated experience evaluating contractor candidates and conducting structured interviews.
  • Detail-Oriented: Highly organized with strong communication skills to hold independent contractors accountable to administrative, charting, credentialing, and SLA standards, while appropriately routing clinical quality-of-care matters to Regional Managers and Clinical Leadership.
  • Startup Flexibility: Comfortable with operational ambiguity, rapid scaling, and wearing multiple hats as roles and responsibilities may shift to meet the evolving needs of a hypergrowth startup.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish a plus given the member populations served across our markets.

This is a full-time salaried position with a pay range between $70K-$80K annually. Exact compensation will depend on direct and relevant experience.

At Nadia Care, we value transparency and want you to feel prepared at every stage of your candidate journey. Below is our standard interview process for this role:

  1. Recruiter Screen | 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview | 60 minutes
  3. Team Interview | 45 minutes

Please note that this process is subject to change, but we will always keep you informed along the way.

  • Full-Time Salaried Employees (Exempt): Enjoy unlimited time off after the 90-day introductory period.

As the Creative Designer (DTC), you will execute DTC creatives (video editing & graphic design) for ads, web, email, and organic content by translating clear creative direction into fast, consistent, and high-quality outputs. You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Efficiency: produces a high volume of creative assets quickly while maintaining quality and minimizing wasted effort.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changes in creative direction, feedback, and priorities without friction.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: keeps files, assets, and tasks well organized, ensuring easy access and clear structure.
  • Creativity / Innovation: develops variations and new ideas from top-performing creatives and DTC Lead feedback, improving and expanding existing concepts.
  • Teamwork: collaborates closely with the DTC team to stay aligned on creative direction, priorities, and execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through creative execution.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a creative professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, combines speed with consistency, and is motivated by clear creative direction, performance feedback, and continuous improvement.

Points North is creating a new role to support and safeguard three of our products: ACA Reporter, Who's Where, and Attendance Advisor. As our Software Quality & Support Specialist, you'll split your time between helping customers get unstuck and testing what we build before it reaches them. You'll troubleshoot issues, turn what customers tell you into clear input for our product team, and validate new features and fixes for each release to ensure everything is functioning as intended. It's a great fit for someone who enjoys solving problems for people, likes digging into why something broke, and can move easily between a customer conversation and a test plan.

Frontline Client-Facing Software Support

  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve software questions and issues related to functionality, configuration, data, workflows, and system use.
  • Clearly communicate issue status, resolution steps, workarounds, and expected next actions to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Document customer interactions, troubleshooting performed, root causes, and resolutions in the support ticketing system.
  • Prioritize and escalate defects, data concerns, and complex technical issues based on business impact, urgency, and established service expectations.

Functional Quality Assurance

  • Review requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and reported issues to develop effective test scenarios and test cases.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and user acceptance testing across supported product lines.
  • Validate new features, enhancements, bug fixes, and configuration changes in appropriate test environments before release.
  • Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, severity, supporting evidence, and relevant environment details.
  • Retest resolved defects and verify that changes do not create unintended impacts in related workflows or products.
  • Maintain test cases, regression suites, test data, and release validation documentation.
  • Participate in release readiness activities and communicate testing progress, risks, defects, and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Advocate for customer usability, accessibility, data integrity, and product quality throughout the development lifecycle.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Translate customer feedback and support trends into actionable input for product planning and quality improvements.
  • Participate in product demonstrations, release reviews, team meetings, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Balance daily support demand with planned testing commitments, communicating conflicts and risks early.
  • Follow established security, privacy, documentation, and change-management practices when handling customer and test data.

  • Technical aptitude with experience supporting or testing SaaS, workforce management, attendance, scheduling, HR, payroll, compliance, or reporting software.
  • Curious with a growth-oriented mindset
  • Familiarity with defect tracking, test management, customer support, or knowledge management tools.
  • Experience testing web-based applications across browsers, devices, roles, permissions, and data scenarios.
  • Working knowledge of software development and release processes, including Agile practices.
  • Experience using basic data analysis or database query tools to investigate issues and validate results.
  • Familiarity with Affordable Care Act reporting concepts or other compliance-driven software is beneficial.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent and relevant experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in software support, technical customer service, software quality assurance, or a similar role.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot software issues methodically and explain technical information to non-technical users.
  • Experience documenting support cases, defects, test cases, or process instructions with accuracy and clarity.
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and follow-through.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to manage sensitive or high-impact customer situations professionally.

Who we are

MixRank processes petabytes of data every month from web crawling. We have hundreds of customers using our data products including Google, Amazon, Facebook, Intel, and Adobe, across industries Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Security.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of project or program management experience, with a proven track record delivering complex, multi-stakeholder client projects (such as software implementations, integrations, or data migrations).

jobs.title: CFO Fraccional

jobs.description:
Buscamos un/a CFO Fraccional que se sume como partner estratégico del CEO y del Directorio, aportando experiencia financiera, visión de negocio y capacidad para acompañar a la compañía en sus próximos desafíos de crecimiento.

Buscamos a una persona con experiencia ejecutiva en estrategia financiera, levantamiento de capital, estructura de financiamiento y planificación financiera, que pueda combinar una mirada estratégica con un sólido entendimiento de la operación financiera.

¿Cuál será tu desafío?

Como CFO Fraccional, tendrás un rol estratégico en la evolución financiera de Datamart, participando en decisiones relacionadas con crecimiento, financiamiento, inversión y sostenibilidad financiera.

Entre tus principales desafíos estarán:

💰 Estrategia y planificación financiera

  • Diseñar y orientar la estrategia financiera de largo plazo de Datamart.
  • Participar en la planificación financiera corporativa y en la evaluación de distintos escenarios de crecimiento.
  • Preparar y presentar análisis financieros, indicadores y proyecciones para apoyar la toma de decisiones del CEO y Directorio.
  • Liderar el seguimiento ejecutivo del presupuesto operativo anual.

📈 Fundraising e inversionistas

  • Liderar y/o acompañar procesos de levantamiento de capital.
  • Participar en rondas de financiamiento, análisis de cap table, term sheets y valorizaciones.
  • Participar en conversaciones y negociaciones con inversionistas actuales y potenciales.
  • Preparar información y análisis financieros para procesos de inversión y financiamiento.

🏦 Financiamiento y estructura de capital

  • Evaluar alternativas de financiamiento y estructura de capital.
  • Participar en negociaciones de deuda y otras alternativas de financiamiento.
  • Mantener una visión integral de la liquidez y posición financiera de la compañía.
  • Acompañar la relación ejecutiva con entidades financieras.

📊 Gobierno y control financiero

  • Definir y fortalecer procesos, controles internos y políticas financieras.
  • Establecer criterios y niveles de aprobación para pagos y operaciones financieras relevantes.
  • Identificar riesgos financieros y proponer medidas de mitigación.
  • Participar como contraparte financiera en procesos de auditoría externa.

🤝 M&A e iniciativas estratégicas

  • Participar en procesos de M&A, due diligence y oportunidades de inversión.
  • Evaluar financieramente nuevas oportunidades de negocio, adquisiciones o alianzas estratégicas.
  • Analizar escenarios, valorizaciones, retornos y riesgos asociados a decisiones de inversión.

🤝 ¿Con quién trabajarás?

Trabajarás directamente con el CEO y el Directorio, aportando una mirada financiera estratégica para acompañar las principales decisiones de la compañía.

Además, trabajarás de manera coordinada con nuestro Head of Finance, quien lidera la operación financiera y entrega la información consolidada necesaria para el análisis, planificación y toma de decisiones estratégicas.

El rol contempla una relación de colaboración y coordinación con el equipo de Finanzas, sin responsabilidad jerárquica sobre el equipo.

🔎 ¿Qué buscamos?

  • Formación profesional en Ingeniería Comercial, Ingeniería Civil Industrial, Finanzas, Contabilidad, Economía o carrera afín.
  • Experiencia senior en posiciones como CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance o similares.
  • Experiencia en Corporate Finance, FP&A y planificación financiera.
  • Experiencia comprobable en fundraising y relación con inversionistas.
  • Conocimiento de cap table, term sheets, valorizaciones y estructuras de financiamiento.
  • Experiencia en estructura de capital y negociación de deuda.
  • Experiencia en M&A y/o procesos de due diligence.
  • Experiencia trabajando directamente con CEOs, founders y/o Directorios.
  • Idealmente experiencia en empresas de tecnología, SaaS, fintech o compañías de alto crecimiento.
  • Inglés avanzado, idealmente.

🧠 Nos interesa especialmente que tengas

  • Visión estratégica y orientación al negocio.
  • Excelente capacidad analítica.
  • Capacidad para convertir información financiera compleja en recomendaciones claras.
  • Habilidades de negociación y comunicación ejecutiva.
  • Capacidad para trabajar con autonomía.
  • Criterio y manejo de información confidencial.
  • Capacidad para moverte cómodamente entre la estrategia y los números.

🌎 ¿Por qué Datamart?

En Datamart trabajamos para transformar la forma en que las empresas financieras y bancarias conectan, verifican y utilizan datos, desarrollando soluciones tecnológicas que facilitan procesos financieros y de negocio.

Somos una compañía de tecnología con una cultura remota, colaborativa y orientada a resultados, donde buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de desafíos relevantes y aportar desde su experiencia.

Si te interesa asumir un desafío estratégico y ser parte de una compañía en crecimiento, queremos conocerte.

jobs.excerpt: About NetLawNetLaw (netlaw. com) is the technology platform behind Hargrove Firm LLP's online estate planning practice, delivered to clients across the United States through financial advisors.
jobs.description:
About NetLaw

NetLaw (netlaw.com) is the technology platform behind Hargrove Firm LLP's online estate planning practice, delivered to clients across the United States through financial advisors. Estate planning remains one of the last major areas of legal work still handled largely by hand, and we are building the platform that changes that.
We are hiring multiple backend developers.

The work

We build most of our system in-house rather than assembling it from third-party libraries — the data layer, the analytics, the frontend components that present them.

The domain is unusually demanding. Estate planning rules differ in every state, the documents we generate carry legal weight, and the platform sits between a law firm, financial advisory firms, and a range of external data and service providers. Requirements arrive as legal and business rules rather than as specifications, and part of the work is turning them into something a system can express correctly.

There is a great deal of work ahead: new services, new features across existing ones, and new partner and provider integrations arriving regularly. Most of what you build will be built from scratch, and it will stay in the product. The first call goes both ways — we will go into specifics about the work, and we want to understand how you work.

The stack is .NET 8+/C#, SQL Server, EF Core, Azure (App Services, Container Apps, Application Gateway), and event-driven messaging over MQTT and Azure Event Hubs. Microservices, minimal APIs, webhooks, WebSockets, and some JavaScript where the work extends into the frontend.

What we are looking for

Someone with taste in code. The developer we want is the one who looks at five hundred lines handling a problem and recognizes that fifty will handle it better — covering every case the longer version covered, while remaining far easier to read six months later. Not brevity for its own sake, but the ability to find the structure that makes most of the code unnecessary.

That instinct is what we screen for, because it cannot be taught quickly and it determines what the codebase looks like in two years.

Specifically: strong C# and .NET, substantive Entity Framework Core experience (relationships, query performance, recognizing an N+1 before it reaches production), confident SQL Server skills, and practical experience with event-driven communication between services. Azure experience is an advantage; the rest we can teach.

A degree in computer science is welcome but not required. We are interested in what you can do and how you think about it.

Working with us

You would join our backend team in Croatia, working closely with our CTO, our frontend lead, and the rest of engineering. We review each other's code, we discuss decisions before committing to them, and we expect people to raise objections when they see a problem.

Our standard for how code is written is high, and review here concerns itself as much with how something is expressed as with whether it works. Most people find that an adjustment, because writing genuinely clean code requires knowing more, not less — you cannot simplify something you only partly understand. Some adapt to it quickly and others take longer. It is the part of the job we are least willing to compromise on, and it is worth knowing that before you apply.

Hiring process

Three steps: an introductory call, a short take-home exercise of two to three hours that we then review together, and a technical session in which you read existing code and discuss how you would improve it.

The technical session is conducted without AI assistance. We use these tools daily and have no objection to them; we simply need to understand how you reason when the tool is wrong.

We begin with a paid ninety-day period so that both sides can be confident in the fit. Compensation is discussed in the first conversation.

jobs.title: Codirecteur(trice) général(e)
jobs.excerpt: À propos de nous!  Le Service d’hébergement St-Denis (SHSD) est un organisme communautaire qui accompagne et héberge des jeunes de 15 à 20 ans vivant différentes situations de vulnérabilité.
jobs.description:
À propos de nous!

Le Service d’hébergement St-Denis (SHSD) est un organisme communautaire qui accompagne et héberge des jeunes de 15 à 20 ans vivant différentes situations de vulnérabilité. Nous leur offrons un milieu de vie sécuritaire, accueillant et bienveillant où ils peuvent trouver du soutien, développer leur autonomie et avancer à leur rythme.

Grâce à une approche humaine et adaptée aux réalités de chaque jeune, notre équipe travaille au quotidien à créer un véritable lieu d’appartenance et à favoriser leur pouvoir d’agir.

Sommaire du rôle

Relevant du conseil d’administration, la codirection au développement organisationnel contribue au développement et à la pérennité du Service d’hébergement St-Denis. Conjointement avec la codirection à la gestion organisationnelle, elle assure la définition des orientations stratégiques et leur mise en œuvre, tout en assumant des responsabilités clés en matière de gouvernance, de développement philanthropique, de financement et de représentation.

En collaboration avec la codirection à la gestion organisationnelle, elle contribue également à la gestion quotidienne des opérations, à la gestion des ressources humaines, à la mobilisation de l’équipe et à la qualité des services.

Développement philanthropique et gestion financière

  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de développement philanthropique et de diversification des sources de revenus afin d’assurer la pérennité financière de l’organisme;
  • Évaluer les possibilités de développement de nouveaux projets;
  • Préparer les demandes de financement et les redditions de comptes auprès des bailleurs de fonds, notamment pour le PSOC;
  • Rechercher, solliciter et fidéliser les donateurs;
  • Mettre à jour les bases de données liées au financement;
  • Rédiger et envoyer les lettres de remerciement et les reçus de charité;
  • Participer à l’élaboration des prévisions budgétaires en collaboration avec la codirection à la gestion organisationnelle;
  • Élaborer et suivre le budget annuel en collaboration avec la codirection à la gestion organisationnelle;
  • Assurer la gestion du cycle comptable, notamment le traitement des factures des fournisseurs, les dépôts bancaires, les comptes à recevoir et à payer ainsi que la gestion de la petite caisse;
  • Faire le suivi de la facturation lors des congés de maladie et des sommes à payer pour le régime de retraite;
  • Collaborer avec le service comptable externe pour la tenue de livres;
  • Prendre en charge les activités liées à la fin d’année fiscale, notamment les déclarations de fin d’année auprès des différentes instances;
  • Effectuer le travail préparatoire requis pour les vérifications comptables.

Représentation et visibilité

  • Assurer une veille stratégique sur les enjeux socio-politiques pouvant avoir une incidence sur l’organisme et sa mission;
  • Développer et maintenir des partenariats stratégiques avec des entreprises, des fondations et d’autres acteurs clés afin de soutenir la mission et le rayonnement de l’organisme;
  • Assurer la représentation de l’organisme et maintenir une présence active auprès des regroupements, partenaires et instances de concertation pertinents à sa mission (ex. RACQ, FACQ, table de concertation, comités et évènements sectoriels);
  • Recueillir les rétroactions des partenaires afin d’évaluer la qualité des services;
  • Soutenir la codirection à la gestion organisationnelle dans la mobilisation de l’équipe et des jeunes dans le cadre d’actions publiques et citoyennes.

Gouvernance

  • Assurer la mise en œuvre et le suivi de la planification stratégique en cohérence avec la mission et les orientations de l’organisme;
  • Assurer le suivi et la mise en œuvre des décisions prises par le conseil d’administration;
  • Cerner et évaluer les enjeux internes et externes susceptibles d’avoir une incidence sur l’organisme et soutenir la prise de décision stratégique;
  • Planifier et animer les réunions du conseil d’administration;
  • Accueillir et intégrer les nouveaux membres du conseil d’administration;
  • Organiser et coordonner l’assemblée générale annuelle;
  • Mettre à jour les documents officiels de l’organisme;
  • Soutenir le bon fonctionnement de la vie associative et démocratique de l’organisme et favoriser la participation des membres;
  • Assurer, en collaboration avec la présidence du conseil d’administration, la représentation et le rayonnement de l’organisme auprès des partenaires et lors d’activités stratégiques;

Gestion des opérations et de l’immeuble

  • Planifier les rénovations et les travaux d’entretien majeurs;
  • Superviser les travaux et assurer la coordination avec les fournisseurs;
  • Assurer le suivi, l’administration et le renouvellement des assurances de l’organisme (ex. assurances habitation, professionnelle, des administrateurs et collectives) ainsi que du régime de retraite des employés;
  • Préparer et animer, en collaboration avec la codirection à la gestion organisationnelle, les réunions d’équipe selon les sujets et les responsabilités de chacune.

Qualifications requises et exigences

  • Diplôme d’étude universitaire de premier cycle en administration dans un autre domaine pertinent;
  • Formation en développement philanthropique (atout);
  • Minimum de 3 à 5 années d’expérience dans un rôle similaire;
  • Expérience de gestion dans un modèle de cogestion (atout);
  • Excellente connaissance du milieu communautaire, de ses mécanismes de financement et de ses principaux partenaires;
  • Bonne connaissance des pratiques et approches d’intervention dans le domaine de l’itinérance, l’hébergement communautaire et/ou des jeunes;
  • Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques et de la suite Microsoft Office;
  • Assurer les déplacements liés aux activités de représentation;
  • Excellente maîtrise du français, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.

Nos avantages

  • Poste permanent à temps plein avec un horaire de 37,5 heure par semaine;
  • Possibilité d’un horaire sur mesure à 4 jours par semaine;
  • Télétravail;
  • 10 jours de congés personnels;
  • 5 jours de congés pour obligation familiale;
  • 4 semaines de vacances par année;
  • Régime de retraite avec contribution de l’employeur;
  • Assurances collectives payé à 50% par l’employeur.

Ta candidature

Tu souhaites contribuer à la mission du Service d’hébergement St-Denis et mettre ton expérience au service de notre équipe?

Fais-nous parvenir ton CV ainsi qu’une courte lettre de motivation. Nous avons hâte d’en apprendre davantage sur toi!

Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact as a TRANSITION MANAGER supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects, build your skills, and grow a rewarding career.


At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As a TRANSITION MANAGER supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) in Austin Texas, you will help ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter.

GDIT is partnering with the Department of Veterans Affairs to modernize and secure enterprise systems supporting millions of Veterans. As the Transition Manager, you will lead all technical, operational, and programmatic activities for the Phase‑In period of the IOSS Application Services program. You will manage the smooth transfer of responsibilities, processes, tooling, documentation, and operational ownership across major service lines including Identity & Access Management, Cybersecurity, PKI, Web/Middleware, Application Virtualization, Printer Security, Database Administration, and Operations Control.

You will ensure continuity of operations, compliance with federal and VA policies, coordinated onboarding, operational readiness, and effective stakeholder communication. You will oversee Phase‑In governance—schedule, risk, performance, reporting, and quality—to establish a stable, secure, mission‑ready environment as GDIT assumes full operational responsibility.


HOW A TRANSITION MANAGER WILL MAKE AN IMPACT


  • Lead all Phase‑In transition activities ensuring a seamless, disruption‑free shift to full operational capability.
    • Manage knowledge transfer, documentation, SOPs, tooling access, and operational handoff across all Application Services domains.
    • Oversee onboarding, account provisioning, baseline assessments, readiness checks, and transition risk mitigation.
    • Establish transition governance including schedules, sync meetings, dependency mapping, risk boards, and stakeholder communications.
    • Ensure alignment with federal cybersecurity requirements, VA Handbook 6500, TRM, and all PWS‑defined security and privacy standards.
    • Coordinate cross‑functional integration with Cybersecurity, ICAM, PKI, Web/Middleware, Virtualization, Printer Security, Database, and OC/CMOP teams.
    • Produce executive‑ready reports, dashboards, and updates on readiness, risks, onboarding progress, and transition performance.
    • Ensure validated documentation, SOPs, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks are fully transitioned to GDIT ownership.
    • Identify modernization opportunities and ensure the Phase‑In establishes a foundation for Zero Trust, cloud migration, and long‑term enterprise improvements.

What You’ll Need to Succeed


  • Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience in enterprise IT operations, program management, or technical leadership.
    • Experience overseeing large-scale federal or enterprise IT transitions across multiple technical domains.
    • Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and compliance obligations (NIST SP 800‑53, RMF, Zero Trust, TIC 3.0).
    • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional engineering and operations teams in multi‑vendor environments.
    • Experience with modernization efforts across identity services, PKI, vulnerability management, database operations, web/middleware hosting, virtualization, and workflow automation.
    • Proven skills in project management, stakeholder communication, risk mitigation, status reporting, and governance.
    • Strong organizational skills, strategic thinking, and ability to present technical information to executive audiences.
    • Ability to support escalations, incident coordination, and enterprise governance activities as needed.

Desired Qualifications

  • PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or ITIL v4 certification
    • Experience supporting VA or other federal agencies
    • Experience leading RMF, ATO, cyber compliance, or large systems integration programs
    • Technical depth in cloud platforms, PKI, ICAM, virtualization, middleware, databases, or enterprise monitoring
    • Experience managing performance‑based contracts and KPI/AQL delivery environments

Security Clearance

  • Must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance

Work Location

• Austin, TX or Remote

No visa sponsorship available


GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

  • Mission‑focused culture supporting those who serve
    • AI‑powered career advancement tools and robust internal mobility
    • Competitive pay, benefits, 401(k) match, and wellness programs
    • A collaborative, innovative, military‑friendly workplace
    • Opportunities to modernize VA’s Application Services environment and lead enterprise transformation across critical systems nationwide
The likely salary range for this position is $112,840 - $121,900. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Less than 10%

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.

About Our Work:

We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. jobs.excerpt: Penguin Random House is seeking a Technical Product Analyst to join the Customer Operations team supporting Distrotheque (DTQ), our proprietary metadata and asset distribution platform.
jobs.description:
Penguin Random House is seeking a Technical Product Analyst to join the Customer Operations team supporting Distrotheque (DTQ), our proprietary metadata and asset distribution platform. DTQ plays a critical role in distributing book metadata and digital assets to PRH customers and partners and continues to evolve alongside the changing needs of our business and the marketplace.

Reporting to the Director, Customer Operations & Product Management, the Technical Product Analyst will work closely with the team's Business Systems Analyst and internal technology partners to support the ongoing development, testing, and reliability of DTQ. This role will provide technical and analytical support throughout the product-development lifecycle, with particular focus on detailed requirements, quality assurance, troubleshooting, and release readiness.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how complex systems work, digging into technical and data-driven problems, and ensuring that software solutions function reliably and meet business requirements. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills and attention to detail with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Partner with the Business Systems Analyst and business stakeholders to translate business needs into detailed functional and technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Analyze DTQ workflows, business rules, data flows, integrations, and system dependencies to assess requirements and the impact of proposed changes.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive functional, regression, integration, and release testing for enhancements, fixes, and new functionality.
  • Document, investigate, and track defects through resolution, partnering with technology teams to reproduce issues and validate fixes.
  • Build and maintain regression test coverage for critical DTQ functionality and identify opportunities to improve or automate testing practices.
  • Support Agile development activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, requirements clarification, and release preparation.
  • Troubleshoot production and operational issues, using data and system analysis to identify root causes and recommend sustainable solutions.
  • Monitor system processes and exception reporting, escalating issues and identifying recurring patterns or areas of risk.
  • Support production releases through testing, validation, documentation, and post-release monitoring.
  • Maintain clear functional, technical, testing, and process documentation to strengthen shared knowledge of DTQ.
  • Analyze data and system performance to identify opportunities for improved reliability, efficiency, automation, and product functionality.
  • Collaborate closely with the Business Systems Analyst, Customer Operations SMEs, and technology partners to ensure solutions meet documented requirements and broader business needs.
  • 3+ years of experience in technical product analysis, business systems analysis, software quality assurance, or a related field.
  • Experience translating business needs into detailed functional or technical requirements.
  • Experience developing and executing software test plans, test cases, and regression testing.
  • Strong analytical and technical problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to investigate complex system or data issues.
  • Experience working with data and using it to troubleshoot issues and validate system behavior.
  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and tools such as JIRA, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with both business and technical partners.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while working independently and as part of a collaborative team.
  • Experience with metadata, digital asset management, distribution systems, or other complex data-driven platforms preferred.
  • Familiarity with ONIX and book industry metadata standards is a plus.
  • Experience with automated testing, scripting and structured data feeds is a plus.
  • Ops nerds welcome! 

This is position is open to remote.

Salary range for this position is $70,500 - $75,000. Please apply using our online application process and include your résumé and cover letter. Full-time employees are eligible for our comprehensive benefits program.

Applications for this role will be accepted through November 4 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we review applications on a rolling basis. Before applying for any role at Penguin Random House, we recommend you review our applicant resources page and our FAQs page.

The salary range listed is specific to each particular open position and takes into account various factors including the specifics of the individual role, and candidate's relevant experience and qualifications.

Our range of benefits include, but are not limited to, Medical/Prescription drug insurance, Dental, Vision, Health Care/Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Pre-Tax and Roth 401(k), Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance, Life/AD&D Insurance, Commuter Benefits, Student Loan Repayment Program, Educational Assistance & generous paid time off.

jobs.title: Global Account Executive, Pharmaceuticals
jobs.excerpt: About UsSince 1989, SHI International Corp.  has helped organizations change the world through technology.
jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Global Sales Account Executive will drive strategic growth for SHI International by developing and expanding relationships with existing and developing Pharmaceutical accounts. This role requires a proven ability to build executive-level relationships, influence complex buying decisions, and create joint go-to-market strategies that unlock significant revenue opportunities.

This is a remote position with a home office setup; however, it is required to reside in the NJ, NY, PA, or MN territory to support business needs. Up to 50% of travel is required for this position.

Role Description


Strategic Account Development:

  • Identify, engage, and grow partnerships with assigned Pharmaceutical accounts.
  • To influence global IT spend and drive SHI’s solutions portfolio.
  • Develop and execute account plans aligned with SHI’s global sales strategy and objectives.

Pipeline & Opportunity Management:

  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of opportunities through proactive outreach, networking, and collaboration with SHI’s internal teams.
  • Leverage SHI’s sales management platforms to track progress and ensure attainment of quarterly and annual targets.

Relationship Building:

  • Establish trusted advisor relationships with senior stakeholders within accounts, including executive management, technology leadership, and sourcing teams.
  • Collaborate with SHI Account Executives, Technical Strategists, and OEM partners to deliver integrated solutions.

Solution Positioning:

  • Promote SHI’s full portfolio of IT infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and services offerings.
  • Align solutions with customer business objectives and IT priorities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Work closely with internal support teams, marketing, and partner alliances to execute joint initiatives and events.
  • Influence internal stakeholders to prioritize pharmaceutical market strategies and resources.

Behaviors and Competencies


  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences and can facilitate effective communication between others.
  • Time Management: Can consistently use time effectively, balance multiple tasks, and meet deadlines.
  • Self-Development: Can actively seek feedback and use it constructively for personal growth.
  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze situations and can lead the development and execution of strategic initiatives.
  • Decision-Making: Can analyze complex information, predict long-term consequences, and make decisions that align with strategic goals.
  • Professionalism: Can proactively seek out challenges, initiate projects, and contribute to a professional work environment.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Can communicate effectively, build relationships, resolve conflicts, and influence others in significant situations.
  • Self-Motivation: Can proactively seek out challenges, initiate self-development projects, and contribute to personal or professional innovative ideas.
  • Performance Management: Can provide constructive feedback to others, identify performance gaps, and implement improvement plans.
  • Business Development: Can proactively seek out new markets, initiate strategic partnerships, and contribute to the development of innovative business strategies.

Skill Level Requirements


  • Expertise in client relationship building and new business development - Intermediate
  • Ability to cold call and create new business opportunities - Intermediate
  • Ability to identify, create, develop, and manage high-impact sales opportunities and lead a team to achieve and exceed sales targets - Intermediate
  • The capability to identify potential clients, effectively negotiate terms, and successfully finalize business transactions. - Intermediate
  • The understanding of key business principles and practices to make informed and effective decisions that contribute to organizational success. - Intermediate
  • The ability to efficiently manage tasks and projects by prioritizing responsibilities and effectively utilizing time to achieve objectives. - Intermediate

Other Requirements


  • Completed Bachelor’s Degree or relevant work experience required
  • Minimum 3-5 years of successful IT field sales experience
  • Minimum 50% time outside of an office setting meeting with existing and potential customers
  • Travel to customer sites within dedicated territory
  • Travel to SHI, Partner, and Customer Events

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $150,000 - $250,000 which includes a base salary and commissions. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual.

Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending

jobs.title: UX Visual Designer
jobs.excerpt: Join Mutual of Omaha's Digital Experience & Design team as a UX Visual Designer, where you'll create intuitive, engaging digital experiences that connect customer needs with business goals.
jobs.description:
Join Mutual of Omaha's Digital Experience & Design team as a UX Visual Designer, where you'll create intuitive, engaging digital experiences that connect customer needs with business goals. In this role, you'll collaborate with UX researchers, designers, developers, and business partners to design and deliver visually compelling, accessible, and user-centered solutions across digital platforms. You'll help shape the future of our digital experiences by bringing concepts to life through high-fidelity designs, interactive prototypes, and scalable design systems that drive consistency and innovation.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary:
    • UX Visual Designer: $86,000-$114,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Create high-fidelity mockups, visual designs, and interactive prototypes that deliver intuitive and engaging user experiences across web and digital platforms.
  • Partner with UX researchers, designers, developers, product owners, and business stakeholders to translate user needs and business objectives into effective design solutions.
  • Contribute to and evolve design systems, visual standards, and reusable components that promote consistency, scalability, and efficiency.
  • Design responsive experiences that perform across devices, browsers, and assistive technologies while adhering to accessibility best practices.
  • Present design concepts, recommendations, and rationale to stakeholders, incorporating feedback and user insights into iterative improvements.
  • Support the end-to-end design process, from concept development and requirements gathering through implementation and validation.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Experience creating user-centered digital experiences, visual designs, wireframes, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Proficiency with modern design tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of responsive design principles, digital accessibility standards, and usability best practices.
  • Familiarity with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and related web technologies.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and presentation skills with the ability to influence outcomes across cross-functional teams.
  • You promote a culture of diversity and inclusion, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.
  • Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States.

PREFERRED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, User Experience, Visual Communication, or a related field.
  • Experience working in Agile product development environments.

Clinically driven. Digitally inspired.

Amplify Care is a not-for-profit organization (founded in 2014 as the eHealth Centre of Excellence) dedicated to helping clinicians and their teams thrive through the implementation of innovative digital health and AI solutions. We focus on technologies that truly meet clinical needs: streamlining workflows to reduce administrative burden, supporting evidence-based decision-making at the point-of-care, enhancing clinical pathways, improving interoperability between disparate information systems, and advancing data quality to support proactive care are just a few examples of the ways we create impact, always with the goal of helping clinicians focus on what matters most: the people they serve.

At Amplify Care, collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We’ve built a supportive, inclusive workplace where ideas are welcomed, creativity is encouraged, and teamwork drives meaningful change. Recognized as a Great Place to Work for two years in a row (ranking in the top 15 organizations in our size category) and certified as a Living Wage Employer, we’re proud to be a place where purpose, innovation, and people come together.

Position Description:

The Change Management Specialist will play a key role in the successful implementation and adoption of digital health technologies. By applying a structured change management approach and methodology, the Change Management Specialist will apply their technical skills to conduct implementation activities to support clinicians in a variety of settings in the community. The individual selected will need to build and support numerous partner relationships as a vital part of the Change Management mandate at Amplify Care. This position will work to integrate change management and adoption activities into several Amplify Care programs.

Key Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Apply a structured change management approach and methodology for the “people side of change,” resulting from projects and change efforts.
  • Be involved in the Change Management functional team projects and support organizational priority work.
  • Provides quality improvement supports to primary care clinicians and organizations to optimize the use of EMRs.
  • Ensure the alignment of change management activities with participating health service practitioners, to smooth the adoption process and contribute to problem solving resulting in successful implementation.
  • Incorporate adoption and change management strategies based on situational awareness of the details of the change and the groups being impacted.
  • Conduct implementation activities, document lessons learned and present findings in a logical and easy-to-understand manner.
  • Be an active and visible coach to clinicians and partners.
  • Work with organizations and the program team to create workflows and manage measurement systems to track adoption, utilization, and proficiency of individual changes.
  • Identify resistance and performance gaps, and work to develop and implement corrective actions.
  • Create and enable reinforcement mechanisms and celebrations of successes.
  • Work with the program team in the execution of work plans and activities to support project implementation.
  • Work with system partners to remove barriers to change.
  • Provide workflow and change management support to clinicians to help embed these tools into existing and new processes.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in an eHealth or health care capacity
    (Primary Care experience an asset)

  • Excellent active listening and interpersonal skills
  • Strong ability to pay attention to detail.
  • Knowledge and experience developing and building tools in EMRs an asset.

jobs.description:
ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY

321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Content Strategist & Creator at 321, you will be a full-time member of our Social Media & Content team, helping plan, capture, and create authentic social content for a diverse portfolio of client accounts. You'll work remotely, with regular travel to client locations throughout Illinois and the Midwest for on-site content capture sessions. Your role combines hands-on production skills with content strategy — shaping what we create and why, shooting compelling photos and videos, and editing content for social platforms using AI-enhanced tools.

You'll also help grow our creator and influencer programs, sourcing, vetting, and reaching out to creator partners who can extend our clients' reach with authentic, trusted voices.

This role sits at the intersection of content strategy, production, brand storytelling, creator partnerships, and AI-powered workflows. You'll bring expertise in mobile and professional content capture, the ability to quickly understand brand voices, and the strategic thinking to turn business objectives into scroll-stopping content. As part of an AI-first organization, you'll use intelligent tools to accelerate ideation and editing and to scale content production while keeping storytelling authentic and on-brand.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Content Strategy & Planning

  • Partner with the Director of Social Media & Content and Social Media Managers to develop content plans, themes, and series for assigned client accounts
  • Translate client objectives, brand voice, and audience insights into shoot concepts, shot lists, scripts, and hooks
  • Contribute to editorial calendars, ensuring a steady pipeline of captured and edited content for each account
  • Identify content opportunities from client operations, including project showcases, team spotlights, customer testimonials, and educational topics
  • Review content performance data and use insights to recommend new formats, concepts, and improvements
  • Use AI tools for research, ideation, scripting, and trend analysis to inform content strategy

On-Site Content Capture

  • Travel to client locations throughout Illinois and the Midwest for scheduled content capture sessions (typically full-day shoots)
  • Capture high-quality photo and video content using professional and mobile equipment based on project requirements and creative briefs
  • Direct on-camera talent, including business owners, employees, customers, and team members, to create authentic, engaging content
  • Scout and use diverse locations, lighting conditions, and environments to create visually dynamic content
  • Capture B-roll, process documentation, before-and-after transformations, team culture moments, and customer testimonials
  • Work efficiently to maximize output during limited on-site windows, capturing multiple content concepts per session
  • Adapt your shooting approach to each industry, from roofing job sites and medical facilities to real estate properties and legal offices

Content Editing & Post-Production

  • Edit captured content into platform-optimized posts using CapCut, Canva, Adobe tools, and other editing applications
  • Create content in multiple formats and aspect ratios (9:16 for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts; 4:5 and 1:1 for feed posts; 16:9 for YouTube) from single capture sessions
  • Use AI-powered tools for captioning, scene detection, color correction, audio enhancement, background removal, and other creative enhancements
  • Add text overlays, graphics, transitions, music, and effects that align with platform trends and client brand guidelines
  • Ensure brand consistency across all content, including color grading, typography, logo placement, and visual style
  • Organize and deliver content with clear file naming conventions and maintain asset libraries of raw and edited footage

Platform-Specific Optimization

  • Stay current on platform trends, audio, editing styles, and formats across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube
  • Create native content for each platform, from fast-paced TikTok videos to polished LinkedIn business content
  • Optimize content for organic reach and social search, using strong hooks, captions, on-screen text, and keywords
  • Incorporate trending audio, effects, and formats while maintaining brand authenticity and professional standards
  • Test and iterate on content styles based on performance data and platform changes

Creator & Influencer Partnerships

  • Source creators and influencers who align with each client's audience, industry, geography, and brand values, with a focus on local and niche creators
  • Vet potential partners by reviewing content quality, audience demographics, engagement authenticity, brand safety, and past partnerships
  • Conduct outreach to prospective creator partners, communicate campaign concepts, and coordinate next steps
  • Maintain a creator database with contact information, rates, audience data, performance history, and partnership status
  • Support creator campaigns by preparing briefs, coordinating content deliverables and approvals, and tracking usage rights
  • Ensure creator content follows FTC endorsement and disclosure guidelines and applicable industry compliance requirements
  • Track and report on creator content performance to inform future partnerships

Collaboration & Professionalism

  • Participate in pre-production planning calls to align on shoot concepts, deliverables, and creative direction
  • Provide creative input based on on-site observations, platform expertise, and performance insights

  10. Long-term thinker, excited about growing with MixRank and contributing to our sustained success.

We're looking for someone who sees sales not just as a job, but as a craft to be honed and perfected. You should be excited about the prospect of diving deep into the world of data, becoming an expert in our field, and using that knowledge to drive value for our clients.

What you’ll be doing

  3. Navigate complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, from C-level executives to product and engineering teams. Internally, collaborate closely with customer success, engineering, and analyst teams to ensure smooth deal progression and client satisfaction.

Why we’d be a great fit

  2. Competitive Compensation: We follow a "Draw Against Commissions" model. Your base salary is designed to be slightly uncomfortable, while your On-Target Earnings (OTE) are set to be more than comfortable.
