jobs.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

At Granicus, our website and content management systems are central to our broader digital strategy serving more than 7,000 public sector organizations and we are looking for a highly-qualified product leader to drive our CMS and AI web strategy of the future. The Manager, Product Management role will lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Content Management Systems serving our government and destination marketing customers. These products enable public-sector organizations and destination marketing organizations to create, manage, and deliver trusted digital experiences to residents, visitors, businesses, and other audiences.

This leader will own and evolve Granicus’ current CMS portfolio while defining and building the next generation of AI-forward content management products. The role requires strong judgment to balance customer needs, platform modernization, market differentiation, commercial outcomes, and responsible adoption of emerging technologies.

In addition to strategic product leadership, this role is expected to be hands-on in shaping early product direction. The Manager of Product Management will prototype new concepts, workflows, and experiences to test ideas with customers, validate assumptions, and accelerate learning before committing to full-scale development. This includes using modern product development and AI-assisted tools to rapidly explore solutions, demonstrate concepts, and partner with engineering and design to refine ideas into production-ready products.

This is a deeply customer-oriented role. The Manager of Product Management will spend significant time with customers, prospects, and customer-facing teams to understand their goals, workflows, constraints, and evolving expectations. They will translate those insights into a focused product strategy and partner closely with engineering, UX, product marketing, sales, customer success, and business leaders to deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

Essential Function

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for CMS products serving both the government and destination marketing markets.
  • Define and drive the strategy for AI-forward content management experiences that help customers create, organize, govern, optimize, personalize, and publish content more effectively.
  • Develop a deep understanding of government and destination customers, including their content operations, publishing workflows, governance requirements, audience needs, and organizational constraints.
  • Spend regular time with customers and prospects through discovery, advisory sessions, roadmap validation, usability research, and strategic account engagement.
  • Prototype new concepts, workflows, and experiences to test ideas with customers, validate assumptions, and accelerate learning before committing to full-scale development.
  • Use modern product development and AI-assisted tools to rapidly explore solutions, demonstrate concepts, and partner with engineering and design to refine ideas into production-ready products.
  • Balance investment across current-product improvements, platform modernization, customer commitments, technical sustainability, and next-generation innovation.
  • Partner with engineering, architecture, UX, data, and AI teams to translate strategy into scalable, intuitive, and reliable product experiences.
  • Establish a clear platform strategy that supports the distinct needs of government agencies and destination marketing organizations while identifying opportunities for shared capabilities and investment.
  • Lead product discovery and prioritization using customer evidence, product data, market analysis, commercial opportunity, technical considerations, and company strategy.
  • Own portfolio-level outcomes such as customer adoption, engagement, satisfaction, retention, expansion, revenue growth, operational efficiency, and platform health.
  • Identify packaging, pricing, bundling, upgrade, and cross-sell opportunities in partnership with product marketing, sales, finance, and customer success.
  • Conduct ongoing market and competitive analysis across government technology, destination marketing technology, digital experience platforms, CMS solutions, and AI-enabled content tools.
  • Partner with product marketing and go-to-market teams on positioning, launches, sales enablement, customer communications, and market readiness.
  • Communicate product strategy, roadmap decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and results clearly to executive, customer, and cross-functional audiences.
  • Drive alignment among stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Finance, Legal, Security, and executive leadership.

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of product managers and product owners responsible for areas within the CMS portfolio.
  • Establish clear ownership, expectations, goals, and decision-making frameworks across the team.
  • Conduct regular one-on-ones, provide timely performance feedback, and support the professional development of direct reports.
  • Build a strong product culture grounded in customer discovery, prototyping, evidence-based decisions, accountability, experimentation, and measurable outcomes.
  • Coach the team on the effective and responsible use of AI throughout product discovery, prototyping, analysis, planning, documentation, and delivery workflows.

Tangible Artifacts / Owned Outputs

  • CMS portfolio vision, strategy, and roadmap
  • Current-product and next-generation AI-forward CMS investment plans
  • Prototypes, concept demonstrations, and customer validation findings
  • Product requirements, business cases, and success metrics
  • Packaging, pricing, migration, and go-to-market recommendations
  • Executive updates, roadmap communications, and team development plans

You Will Love This Job If You Have

What You Will Bring:

  • Significant B2B SaaS or enterprise product management experience, ideally with CMS, digital experience, or website platforms.
  • A strong customer orientation and a record of using direct customer engagement to shape product strategy.
  • Hands-on experience prototyping products and features, including use of AI-assisted tools to test ideas before full-scale development.
  • Experience owning established products while building new products or leading modernization.
  • Working knowledge of content workflows, governance, integrations, personalization, accessibility, and multichannel delivery.
  • Experience delivering practical AI-enabled capabilities with appropriate attention to security, privacy, and responsible use.
  • Strong technical fluency and the ability to partner effectively with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams.
  • Excellent communication skills and the judgment to make clear decisions amid ambiguity and competing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building or managing CMS, digital experience platform, website, content workflow, or web-publishing products.
  • Experience serving government agencies, public-sector organizations, destination marketing organizations, or other highly regulated or mission-driven customers.
  • Familiarity with government digital-service requirements, including accessibility, security, privacy, records management, governance, and public trust.
  • Experience with generative AI, intelligent content workflows, semantic search, personalization, content optimization, or AI-assisted authoring.
  • Experience leading platform modernization, product consolidation, replatforming, or customer migration initiatives.
  • Experience with product-led growth, packaging, pricing, monetization, retention, and expansion strategies.
  • Experience working in a matrixed organization with multiple product, engineering, go-to-market, and executive stakeholders.

Experience/Credentials:

  • 8+ years of experience in product management, including people leadership.
  • Demonstrated success owning product strategy and business outcomes for complex software products or portfolios in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.
  • Experience managing, coaching, and developing product managers or product owners.
  • Significant customer-facing experience, including discovery, validation, advisory sessions, strategic account engagement, or market research.
  • Demonstrated experience prototyping new concepts and bringing new products or major capabilities from discovery through launch and adoption.
  • Experience working closely with go-to-market teams on positioning, commercialization, customer readiness, and sales enablement.
  • Strategic mindset with a high degree of comfort operating in ambiguity and navigating cross-functional complexity.

Pay Range

USD $128,000.00 - USD $178,000.00 /Yr.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

Security and Privacy Requirements

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

The Team

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Culture

The Impact

  • We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here.

The Benefits

At Granicus, we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance—starting from day one. Here’s what you can expect as a U.S.-based team member:

Flexibility & Balance

  • Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and live your life.

Family & Future

Growth & Recognition

Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.excerpt: Position: VP Channel Sales, Americas Location: Remote THE ROLE: IGEL is seeking a commercially driven, transformational VP Channel Sales, Americas to accelerate growth by transforming its partner ecosystem into a proactive engine for new-customer acquisition, enterprise expansion, and measurable revenue growth.
jobs.description:
Position: VP Channel Sales, Americas
Location: Remote

THE ROLE:
IGEL is seeking a commercially driven, transformational VP Channel Sales, Americas to accelerate growth by transforming its partner ecosystem into a proactive engine for new-customer acquisition, enterprise expansion, and measurable revenue growth.
This executive will lead IGEL’s Americas channel strategy, building on the company’s position in End User Computing (EUC) and secure digital workspaces while expanding its reach across cybersecurity, cyber resilience, and business continuity and disaster recovery (BC&DR).
The successful candidate will bring established executive relationships across leading national solution providers, cybersecurity specialists, distributors, and strategic technology partners. Equally important, they will know how to mobilize those relationships into joint go-to-market programs, partner-sourced pipeline, and repeatable revenue opportunities.
Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, this leader will collaborate with Americas Sales, Global Alliances, Partner Marketing, Presales, Product, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, and Revenue Operations to execute four strategic growth motions:
  • Adaptive Secure Desktop: Positioning IGEL as the trusted, governed endpoint foundation for secure workspace access across knowledge workers, frontline teams, and shared-device environments.
  • IT for OT: Establishing IGEL as a secure, centrally governed endpoint platform for operational environments across manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, energy, retail, and other industries.
  • BC&DR New-Customer Acquisition: Leveraging IGEL’s endpoint resilience and recovery capabilities to establish new customer relationships, engage security stakeholders, and accelerate new-logo pipeline generation.
  • BC&DR Enterprise Expansion: Expanding IGEL’s footprint within existing enterprise customers across additional users, devices, locations, business units, and recovery use cases.
This is a hands-on executive leadership opportunity for a channel leader who combines strategic vision, cybersecurity market credibility, strong commercial judgment, and the ability to turn partner relationships into measurable business outcomes.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in Channel Sales, Strategic Alliances, Partner Business Development, or Enterprise Sales, including significant experience leading regional or national channel organizations.
  • Proven success transforming partner ecosystems and building high-performing channel sales organizations.
  • Established executive-level relationships across major Americas solution providers, distributors, systems integrators, or strategic technology partners.
  • Demonstrated experience within the cybersecurity partner ecosystem, including security-focused solution providers, integrators, or security practices within major national partners.
  • Proven ability to engage and influence partner executive leadership, sales leadership, technical leadership, and solution portfolio decision-makers.
  • Strong understanding of partner economics, monetization strategies, services models, and partner sales incentives.
  • Demonstrated success building repeatable partner-led pipeline generation, new-customer acquisition, and co-selling programs.
  • Experience developing strategic business plans that deliver measurable revenue growth and partner performance.
  • Experience selling or developing channels for enterprise security, infrastructure, cloud, digital workspace, or business resilience solutions.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including revenue accountability, forecasting, pipeline management, business planning, and operational execution.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead organizational transformation, develop talent, and establish performance accountability.
  • Strong executive presence, communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to operate strategically while remaining personally engaged in partner relationships, critical opportunities, and day-to-day execution.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across sales, marketing, technical, customer success, and operational teams.
  • Willingness to travel throughout the Americas for strategic partner engagements, executive meetings, and industry events.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with major cybersecurity vendors, security-focused integrators, or security practice organizations.
  • Existing relationships with national solution providers, cybersecurity partners, distributors, or systems integrators within IGEL’s target ecosystem.
  • Experience developing partner-led security, ransomware resilience, business continuity, or disaster recovery solutions.
  • Familiarity with EUC, VDI, DaaS, endpoint operating systems, and modern digital workspace technologies.
  • Understanding of Zero Trust architectures, endpoint security, and enterprise cyber resilience strategies.
  • Experience building partner go-to-market programs across healthcare, financial services, government, manufacturing, retail, and other regulated or operationally complex industries.
  • Experience working with hyperscalers, strategic OEMs, distribution, managed service providers, and global systems integrators.
  • Experience expanding a technology company’s channel ecosystem into new solution categories or enterprise buying centers.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience; advanced degree preferred.

TASK AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Americas Channel Strategy and Transformation
  • Own and execute the Americas Channel Sales strategy in alignment with IGEL’s corporate growth objectives and go-to-market priorities.
  • Transform the channel organization into a proactive growth engine focused on new-customer acquisition, partner-sourced pipeline, enterprise expansion, and revenue performance.
  • Establish differentiated partner coverage strategies across national solution providers, regional resellers, cybersecurity specialists, distributors, systems integrators, managed service providers, and strategic technology partners.
  • Define partner segmentation, investment priorities, resource allocation, and measurable performance expectations.
  • Identify gaps in the partner ecosystem and recruit strategic partners that expand IGEL’s reach into new markets, industries, and enterprise buying centers.
  • Balance strategic planning with direct executive engagement and hands-on execution.
2. Strategic Partner Relationships and Ecosystem Development
  • Build and expand executive-level relationships across IGEL’s Americas partner ecosystem, including national solution providers and systems integrators.
  • Strengthen engagement with cybersecurity-focused solution providers, alongside other strategic security partners and integrators.
  • Leverage distribution and public-sector channel relationships to expand partner activation and market coverage.
  • Work in close alignment with IGEL’s Global Alliances organization to advance strategic technology relationships.
  • Develop joint business plans, executive sponsorship, and partner engagement strategies that translate strategic alignment into field execution and measurable business results.
  • Expand IGEL’s visibility within partner cybersecurity, infrastructure, digital workspace, and business resilience practices.
  • Personally engage in critical partner relationships, strategic opportunities, and executive-level sales pursuits.
3. Security-Led Channel Development
  • Build and execute a strategy to expand IGEL’s relevance within the cybersecurity partner ecosystem.
  • · Establish relationships with partner security practice leaders, CISOs, security architects, and security sales leadership.
  • Position IGEL’s immutable endpoint operating system and preventative security approach as a complementary component of enterprise cybersecurity and Zero Trust-aligned architectures.
  • Develop partner-led opportunities around endpoint security, cyber resilience, ransomware preparedness, and business continuity.
  • Identify joint solution opportunities with cybersecurity vendors, security-focused integrators, managed security providers, and other strategic partners.
  • Create repeatable security-led sales motions that introduce IGEL into new buying centers and enterprise accounts beyond traditional EUC teams.
4. Go-to-Market Execution and Revenue Growth
  • Translate IGEL’s four strategic growth motions into actionable partner go-to-market plans with defined target accounts, vertical priorities, enablement, partner ownership, and measurable outcomes.
  • Identify the partners best positioned to execute each motion based on customer relationships, industry expertise, technical capabilities, and commercial models.
  • Develop repeatable partner sales plays incorporating customer targeting, sales messaging, technical validation, joint account planning, and opportunity development.
  • Prioritize BC&DR as a strategic opportunity for accelerated new-customer acquisition while establishing differentiated strategies for expansion within existing enterprise accounts.
  • Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline development and channel revenue performance across the Americas.
  • Establish joint account planning, territory alignment, demand generation, and co-selling programs with priority partners.
  • Build engagement models connecting partner account executives, security specialists, solution architects, and IGEL sales teams.
  • Partner with Marketing to execute targeted campaigns, executive events, industry programs, and demand generation initiatives.
  • Establish disciplined pipeline management, opportunity qualification, forecasting, and performance measurement to improve partner productivity and revenue contribution.
5. Partner Economics and Commercial Development
  • Develop compelling partner value propositions that create measurable economic incentives to sell, deploy, manage, and support IGEL solutions.
  • Build partner business plans that incorporate resale opportunities, services revenue, solution integration, managed services, customer lifecycle opportunities, and enterprise expansion.
  • Understand partner profitability models, practice economics, sales compensation incentives, and commercial decision-making.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for partner-delivered services and recurring revenue.
  • Develop repeatable business models that encourage partners to proactively generate demand rather than simply fulfill existing opportunities.
  • Ensure strategic partners understand how IGEL contributes to their cybersecurity, resilience, infrastructure, and digital workspace practices.
6. Channel Organization Leadership and Executive Collaboration
  • Lead, develop, and optimize the Americas Channel Sales organization, building a high-performance culture focused on accountability, proactive business development, partner activation, and measurable results.
  • Assess organizational capabilities, partner coverage, and resource allocation to support the company’s growth objectives.
  • Develop and mentor channel sales leaders and individual contributors, establishing clear objectives and leadership expectations.
  • Collaborate with Americas Sales and global channel and alliance leadership to align regional execution with enterprise account strategies and corporate partner priorities.
  • Partner with Presales, Marketing, Enablement, Product, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to coordinate partner programs, technical enablement, solution development, and market expansion.
  • Provide the Chief Revenue Officer and executive leadership team with clear visibility into channel strategy, pipeline, revenue performance, risks, and investment priorities.
  • Represent IGEL at strategic partner executive meetings, industry conferences, customer engagements, and leadership events.
  • Incorporate partner feedback and market intelligence into go-to-market, product, and commercial planning.

WE OFFER

  • Health, dental, vision, and prescription benefits (employee premiums covered by IGEL)
  • 11 company-paid holidays per year
  • 18-22 days of PTO per year (18 days in year 1, 20 days starting in year 2 and 22 days after 5 years of service)
  • Sick time of 10 days per year, with rollover of unused days up to maximum limit
  • 401(k) plan with 100% company match, up to $15,000 per year
  • Paid maternity and paternity leave
  • Monthly home office allowance
  • Remote working opportunities and flexible working times, so you can combine your demanding work with your personal goals
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Financial Wellness tool
  • Company-paid life insurance policy, long-term disability (LTD), and short-term disability (STD) coverage
  • Wellbeing apps, including Rightway, Headspace and Wellhub
  • Training and development opportunities to advance your career
  • President’s Club for the highest performing salespeople and overachievers
  • An amazing culture powered by a workplace run on trust, empowerment, and feedback with a positive, inspiring working atmosphere
  • A highly motivated team that is already looking forward to your support in developing strategies and achieving common goals, together with you!
IGEL is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want the best available person in every job. Our policy prohibits unlawful discrimination based on color, creed, sex, religion, marital status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state or local laws.

Preamble

We are looking for an individual who is interested in becoming part of the HFDM Team in the Role of Flight Crew Representative. Applications or queries for this position are welcome from Pilots who have an interest in Flight Data Monitoring or want to find out more on the subject.

Prerequisites

  • EASA ATPL(H) License
  • AW169 Type rating

Preferred Qualifications

  • LTCC
  • AW139 Type rating

Scope of work

  • Performing HFDM Crew Contacts
  • Validation of Flight Actions
  • Regularly checking HFDM
  • Produce periodic HFDM Base monthly reports (if required by HFDM Manager)

Skill and Attributes

  • Analytical mind and ability to learn to use Aerobytes software.
  • Engaging personality allowing amicable contact of Pilots through dialogue and interaction.
  • Aptitude for self-learning and constant self-improvement.
  • Good verbal communication skills in the English language.
  • Ability to adapt to changing working environments and changing workloads.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively within a multi-cultural team.
  • Positive, proactive, and problem-solving attitude. .
  • Ability to work remotely online with limited support and oversight.
  • Collaborative and proactive approach towards all members of the HFDM Programme.
  • IT literate with Microsoft and iPad software.

Key responsibilities

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

It is the responsibility of the Flight Crew Representative to contact the crew (in consultation with the Gatekeeper) when an event exceedance (significant Level 2 or Level 3) has been identified and to explain and review that event, using playback and analysis software where appropriate. The pilot liaison will also relay any comments from the crew to the HFDM Programme. The Flight Crew Representative also acts as the pilot's advocate if requested to do so by the HRG or the pilot himself. He may be present when requested to do so by the pilot during the interview resulting from HFDM finding. When it is necessary to convene the HRG for the purpose of identifying a pilot, the pilot concerned may want to appoint a Flight Crew Representative. He has the right to choose from the Company’s pilot pool. This representative will act on a voluntary basis. Travel and accommodation will be borne by the Company. This role should be filled by an experienced and trusted pilot. In Westair usually they will be a LTCC so they are able to provide technical advice.

Specific Functions

  • To ensure that any significant low, medium and high-risk events are highlighted to the flight crews as soon as possible to prevent the risk of re‐occurrence. Events which require flight action need to be communicated to pilots within a period when they will be able to recall the flight with clarity and assist in HFDM Implementation and Operations Plan Weststar NDD (Westair) analysis process. The risk of delaying feedback requests is that pilots may be unable to recall particular flights and hence the benefit of the feedback system is lost. Therefore if a flight action is raised the FCR should make contact with the crew within 24 hours but (exceptionally) not exceeding 7 days.
  • To make a daily check in Aerobytes to confirm the integrity of the previous day’s HFDM uploads. It is common for failed downloads and this a valuable tool for alerting the HFDM Manager that there is an upload issue with a particular airframe or HFDM ground station.
  • To confirm the Flight action requested by Helinalysis is valid. FCRs must make a record of any Flight actions in the Crew Contact Diary in One Drive.
  • To carry out a periodic review of de‐identified HFDM data findings as member of the HFDM Review Group (HRG).
  • To determine and periodically review the alert detection threshold positions.
  • Together with HFDM Team, to make recommendations for changes to procedures and training to the Training & Standard of Flight Operations Management.
  • To investigate significant events discovered by the HFDM Programme.
  • Together with HFDM team, to make the decision to remove the protection of confidentiality in cases of gross misconduct or continued non‐compliance with SOP's. In such cases details of the case will be brought to the HRG to decide on the action taken. In this way the HFDM Programme remains just, as opposed to non‐punitive.
  • If required by the HFDM Manager, to produce periodic HFDM Base monthly reports and provide data in a format usable and easily understood for pilot debriefs and flight action or crew feedback requests.

For more information on this position, please contact the HFDM Manager, Richard Prescott at .

jobs.description:
We Move Fast, Think on Our Feet, and Have Fun Doing It!

At Eleven, we thrive on solving complex challenges and pushing boundaries. We work at a rapid pace, embracing change, and staying laser-focused on delivering exceptional value to our customers.

We’re looking for visionary problem-solvers who excel in dynamic environments, embrace AI tools in streamlining work processes, adapt quickly, and drive innovation. If you love thinking outside the box, collaborating with top-tier talent, and having fun while making an impact—let’s talk!

Position Purpose

Senior Network Engineer-Network Protocols & Devices role is part of our Agile/Scrum SaaS Solutions Engineering team. This role strengthens the team with deep network expertise, builds automation for network equipment, and helps support our global authentication service: an AWS cloud-based central authentication platform used around the world to effortlessly and securely connect guests and residents (and all their devices) to the internet with an at-home Wi-Fi experience. Our platform serves a variety of markets. From hotels and multi-family residences to campgrounds and college campuses, every day, tens of millions of people benefit from the services we provide.

This is a bridge role for a seasoned network engineer who already programs. You bring deep, hands-on experience running production IP networks—ideally Wi-Fi—including network authentication (RADIUS/AAA) and large, multi-vendor fleets of routers, switches, gateways, and access points, along with a track record of scripting to automate provisioning and troubleshoot issues at scale. You will start as the team’s network and device expert and, with mentorship from our senior software engineers, progressively take on the design and development of the software services that control and integrate with that infrastructure. A genuine desire to make that transition into software engineering is essential.

Reporting Relationships

This role reports to an Engineering Manager and has no direct reports.

Essential Job Functions

  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot a large, multi-vendor fleet of network devices—gateways, routers, switches, and access points—including MikroTik RouterOS (scripting, APIs, and policy enforcement), Meraki, Nomadix, Ruckus, and Aruba
  • Design, operate, and troubleshoot network authentication end to end: RADIUS, 802.1X, EAP methods, certificate-based authentication, captive portal and MAC-based flows, and related AAA workflows
  • Develop scripts and automation (Python, Bash, RouterOS scripting, vendor APIs) that streamline device provisioning, configuration management, authentication, and device lifecycle management across large deployments
  • Build diagnostic tooling and lead root-cause analysis of complex network and authentication issues across customer deployments, using packet captures, device logs, and platform telemetry
  • Serve as the team’s subject-matter expert on network protocols and devices: translate network behavior and vendor capabilities into clear requirements for the software platform, and review designs for how our services interact with network infrastructure
  • Progressively take on software engineering work alongside our senior engineers: architect, implement, and maintain the software systems that interact with or control network infrastructure, including RESTful APIs and security-hardened containerized services on modern Linux-based and AWS infrastructure
  • Collaborate with other development, product management, and UX team members to turn user stories into performant, scalable capabilities, features, services, and applications within the ecosystem
  • Partner with team members across functions to solve architectural, network-design, and code-design challenges
  • Stay informed about network, service-design, and code best practices and champion decisions that will scale and make a difference in the long term
  • Work within Agile methodology with two-week sprints
  • Identify and incorporate security requirements—across both the network and the software development lifecycle—and participate in security reviews as needed to facilitate technical discovery
  • Document network standards, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides; mentor teammates on network protocols and devices and contribute to team-level knowledge sharing and best practices
  • Participate in on-call rotation
  • Other duties as assigned

Working Conditions:

This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and printers. This job operates remotely, in a home office environment, with occasional travel for team meetings or company offsites.

Physical Demands:

Remains in a stationary position for extended periods of time. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, cell phones, computer mouse and computer monitor. For remote office setup; places, moves, installs, replaces and hooks up technology equipment that may weigh up to 20 pounds. Communicates complex information effectively to clients and co-workers via telephone, video, or email.

Candidate Requirements

Must Have:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production IP networks
  • Very strong command of network fundamentals—routing, switching, VLANs, NAT, firewalling, DHCP, DNS, VPNs, and QoS—with the ability to diagnose issues across Layers 2–7
  • Deep understanding of network authentication—RADIUS, AAA workflows, 802.1X, EAP methods, and certificate-based authentication—with hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting it in production
  • Hands-on experience with a variety of routers, switches, gateways, and access points from multiple vendors, including but not limited to MikroTik, Meraki, Nomadix, Ruckus, and Aruba
  • Experience managing a large fleet of network devices in large-scale, multi-site deployments, including centralized configuration management, monitoring, and firmware/lifecycle management
  • Programming and scripting experience applied to network operations: automating provisioning and configuration, and building tooling to troubleshoot issues (e.g., Python, Bash, RouterOS scripting, vendor REST APIs)
  • Strong Linux knowledge and comfort in CLI-driven environments
  • Genuine willingness and demonstrated aptitude to transition into software engineering: you want to move beyond scripting into designing and building production software services, and you are motivated to learn modern development practices (version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, cloud services)
  • Strong desire to help a successful company scale existing cloud-based services while also being a significant contributor to the development of new products

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with large-scale Wi-Fi/WLAN deployments in hospitality, multi-family, campus, or similar high-density guest environments, including cloud-managed and controller-based access points and RF fundamentals
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Relevant networking certifications (e.g., MikroTik MTCNA/MTCRE, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CWNA, or equivalent vendor certifications)

Help connect independent sponsors with capital for established, profitable businesses. This is a relationship-first role for someone who understands finance, knows how to follow up without being pushy, and wants to build a smarter deal origination engine—not just chase meeting targets.

About the Company:

Private equity investment group connecting accredited investors with lower middle market acquisition opportunities. The firm provides equity capital to independent sponsors acquiring established, profitable businesses in resilient industries with durable demand. Its focus is on proven businesses, not startups or venture capital.

Location:Fully remote; open to candidates based in Latin America, South Africa, and Europe

Your Mission: Day to Day Responsibilities

  • Manage outreach replies, follow-ups, introductory calls, and long-term nurture with independent sponsors.

  • Research and connect with sponsors, M&A professionals, lenders, attorneys, and referral networks.

  • Understand investment strategies, assess initial fit, gather transaction details, and prepare concise internal handoffs.

  • Explain deal-by-deal private equity to suitable accredited investors using approved messaging—no hard selling or performance promises.

  • Keep CRM records accurate, track next steps, and make sure promising contacts never fall through the cracks.

  • Develop follow-up cadences, refine sourcing channels, and report on what generates meaningful relationships and qualified deals.

Success isn't about sending the most messages. It's about building trust, creating a pipeline of relevant opportunities, and making relationships compound over time.

Your Toolbox: Skills to be Successful

  • Around 2–5 years of relevant experience in finance, investing, lending, M&A, financial services, or financially sophisticated B2B business development. Demonstrated ability matters more than a specific career path.

  • Working familiarity with EBITDA, enterprise value, leverage, and equity financing.

  • Strong written and spoken English, with a clear, concise, professional communication style.

  • Excellent organization, CRM discipline, and follow-through.

  • Persistence without pressure, sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to qualify genuine opportunities.

  • A proactive mindset: you can research new audiences, test sourcing channels, and build processes without waiting for a playbook.

  • Comfort working independently in a lean, fast-moving environment.

Private equity expertise is a plus, not a prerequisite. You should already speak the language of business and finance, though.

Your Perks: What's in it for you

  • Base salary plus a defined performance bonus.

  • Shape the CRM, relationship-management process, sourcing strategy, and reporting systems.

  • Work closely with senior leadership in a lean team, without layers of management.

  • Progress from managing outreach and follow-ups to leading sponsor relationships and owning a meaningful part of the origination process.

The growth path: Learn the model and own the pipeline in month one; lead sponsor calls and nurture relationships in months two and three; become a trusted point of contact and improve the origination engine by months four to six.

A quick reality check: This isn't a high-volume SDR job, a pure investment-underwriting seat, or a role with a finished playbook. It's for someone who enjoys relationship building, operational detail, and creating opportunities over the long term.

At Adaptive Teams, we don’t just fill positions – we create pathways to success. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, we’re here to help you grow, innovate, and make an impact. By providing powerful new ways for people to connect with one another, we support our clients to gain greater access to data, decision making, medical research, commerce, and much more. Our team is empowering customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

AURA Technologies is seeking a Chief of Staff to serve as a strategic and operational right hand to the CEO. This is not an administrative role. You will be the connective tissue across the organization — ensuring the CEO’s priorities are executed, identifying and resolving problems before they escalate, and providing leadership across multiple business functions. You will have direct oversight of key operational areas and will manage a team of directors and functional leads.

This role is designed for someone who has spent a significant portion of their career in or around the U.S. federal government and understands how the government operates — from procurement and contracting to program execution and compliance.   • Establish the operational rhythm of the business — leadership meetings, goal tracking, reporting cadences, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Identify organizational gaps and inefficiencies and take action — strategically creating and inserting structure, function, and accountability into key areas of the business to drive operational maturity and efficiency.

jobs.excerpt: CRO & UX Analyst Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-TimeExperience: 5+ YearsSchedule: Must be available for overlap with Sydney hours, including availability from 2:00 PM AEST Why this role mattersWe're hiring someone to help take our client to the next level.
jobs.description:
CRO & UX Analyst

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 5+ Years

Schedule: Must be available for overlap with Sydney hours, including availability from 2:00 PM AEST

Why this role matters

We're hiring someone to help take our client to the next level. This is not a freelance or contract role. You'll be all in with our team and our clients from day one.
We want a motivated person who lifts the team and inspires our clients. You have a can-do attitude. You believe every data problem can be solved, and you keep going until it is.

The role

You'll find out what users do once they land on a client's site, and why they don't convert. You'll spend most of your day in GA4 and behavioural tools like Hotjar, Contentsquare, FullStory or Microsoft Clarity. You'll also step back to spot trends and patterns, and explain what they mean for the client's business. You'll work closely with our senior CRO and CRO team.

Here's a typical task. A client's conversion rate dropped 15% last month. You work out which channel, device and landing page drove the drop. You check the ratios behind it, such as add-to-cart and checkout completion rates. Then you watch session recordings and heatmaps to see what users did. Then you write up the likely cause, what it's costing the client, and what to test. If the numbers look wrong, you check for a tracking issue first.

This role is not
We've had many applicants from adjacent fields. They're good backgrounds, but they're not this job. This role is not:

  • A tracking or tag setup role. Our developers handle implementation.
  • An A/B test build or development role. You'll analyse test results, but you won't build the tests.
  • A UX or UI design role.
  • A campaign, SEO, PPC or media reporting role. We care about what users do on the site, not how they got there.
  • A data science role. Python, SQL and BigQuery aren't required. If you have them, tell us how they'd add to the skills below, not replace them

What you'll do

GA4 analysis (the core of the role)

  • Build custom reports and explorations in GA4 to answer specific client questions.
  • Build funnel and path explorations to find where users drop off.
  • Create segments and comparisons, such as new vs returning, device, channel or landing page.
  • Find which pages, sources or user groups explain a change in conversion rate.

Business-level analysis

  • Spot trends and patterns over time, such as week-on-week, year-on-year and seasonal shifts.
  • Work with ratios, not just totals. For example: conversion rate, average order value, revenue per user, add-to-cart rate, and cart-to-checkout and checkout completion rates.
  • Tell a real change apart from noise or a shift in traffic mix.
  • Link site metrics to business outcomes like revenue, leads and lead quality.
  • Size opportunities. For example, what a 1% lift in checkout completion is worth to the client per year.

A/B test results and post-test analysis

This is critical to our business. We need to know why a test won or lost, not just that it did.

  • Analyse A/B test results and report them clearly, including confidence and sample size.
  • Break results down by segment, such as device, new vs returning, channel and landing page.
  • Dig into secondary metrics and funnel steps to explain what changed in user behaviour.
  • Use recordings and heatmaps of each variant to show why it won or lost.
  • Turn the findings into clear next steps and new test ideas.

Behavioural and UX analysis

  • Review session recordings, heatmaps and scroll maps to see what users actually do.
  • Run heuristic reviews of client sites and funnels to spot likely conversion blockers.
  • Check findings across GA4, behavioural tools and heuristics. Don't rely on one source.

Data quality

  • Spot when data looks wrong, such as missing events, duplicates, thresholding or sampling.
  • Work out whether it's a tracking issue.
  • Brief our developers clearly so they can fix it. You won't do the fix yourself.

AI and automation

  • Use AI tools to automate repeat work, such as reporting, data pulls and write-up drafts.
  • Use AI for basic data analysis, such as summarising exports, spotting outliers and first-pass trend checks.
  • Check every AI output before it's used. You own the accuracy, not the tool.
  • Look for new ways AI can speed up how we work.

Communication

  • Explain findings in plain English to the team and to clients.
  • Present and defend your own ideas live, on calls and in meetings.
  • Say so, politely, when you disagree.
  • Say "I'm not sure yet" when that's the truth. Then go and find the answer.
  • Double-check your findings before you share them.
  • Produce clear, well-structured write-ups.

What we're looking for

Skills

  • 5+ years working in the GA4 interface (or Universal Analytics before it) to answer conversion questions.
  • Strong skills building custom reports, explorations and segments in GA4.
  • Proven experience analysing A/B test results and explaining why tests won or lost.
  • Strong business sense. You're comfortable with trends, ratios and commercial metrics, and can explain what they mean for revenue.
  • Regular hands-on use of at least one behavioural tool: Hotjar, Contentsquare, FullStory or Microsoft Clarity.
  • Advanced use of AI tools for automation, reporting and basic data analysis, with a habit of checking the output.
  • Enough tracking knowledge to tell when data is wrong and explain the problem to a developer.
  • Strong written and spoken English.

Attitude

  • A curious mindset. You keep digging until you find the real answer, not the first plausible one.
  • A can-do attitude. No data problem is too hard for you.
  • You want to be part of a team long term and help it grow.
  • Confidence to share your own ideas, disagree politely, and admit when you don't know yet.
  • A habit of double-checking your work before you share it.

Nice-to-haves

  • A tracking or tagging background, such as Google Tag Manager. Useful for debugging, but not what the role is about.
  • Python, SQL or BigQuery skills, if you can show how they'd strengthen the GA4 and behavioural work above.
  • Certifications in Contentsquare, Hotjar, FullStory or similar tools.
  • CRO agency experience great to have but not necessary.

Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

Every salon, spa, and medspa deserves a front desk that never misses a call, never drops a message, and always knows what to say. Boulevard’s AI Receptionist is building that: agentic AI that handles client communication across voice and text so businesses can grow faster, operate leaner, and deliver an exceptional experience every time. As the product manager for AI Receptionist, you’ll own that vision end to end.

For a self-care business, the front-of-house experience is where client relationships are made or broken, so getting this right matters. It’s one of Boulevard’s highest-visibility bets, at a well-funded company early enough in its AI journey that you’ll genuinely shape the direction. Your work will have a direct, tangible impact on how thousands of small businesses show up for their clients.

What you’ll do here:

  • Set the vision, roadmap, and success criteria for the AI Receptionist suite, our answer to the modern contact center for self-care businesses.
  • Own how AI engages clients one-to-one across voice and text: when it handles conversations on its own, when it hands off to staff, and how that handoff feels seamless to clients and effortless for the team.
  • Shape how conversations stay continuous across channels, and design fallback behavior for when AI can’t resolve something.
  • Own the business outcomes (revenue, adoption, and retention) and define the product metrics behind them, like autonomous resolution rate, agent productivity, and CSAT.
  • Collaborate on pricing strategy and connect what’s happening in the product to what it means for our customers’ businesses.
  • Build deep fluency in how self-care businesses manage client communication today: what they trust, what they fear, and what they’d delegate in a heartbeat or never let out of human hands.

What you’ll need to thrive:

  • 5-8 years in product management, with experience in B2B2C or both B2C and B2B environments, so you know what it means to serve a business and their end customer at the same time.
  • Experience shipping AI-powered products: you know how to shape how AI behaves, design for when it falls short, and earn user trust over time.

The Analyst will develop and maintain financial models supporting site acquisitions, market expansions, development projects, and capital investments while creating presentation materials, including investment committee business cases for Executive Leadership, the Board of Directors, community stakeholders, and other key audiences. This role combines strong financial analysis, storytelling, and communication skills to transform complex information into actionable insights and compelling business recommendations.

In addition to analytical and financial responsibilities, the Analyst will support day-to-day portfolio management activities, including landlord communications, lease administration support, and coordination of site-specific real estate initiative. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where financial modeling, executive communication, and strategic planning intersect.

Financial Modeling & Investment Analysis

  • Build and analyze development pro formas, project budgets, construction cost forecasts, and investment scenarios.
  • Perform return-on-investment analyses, sensitivity analyses, and scenario modeling to support business decisions.

  • Monitor project financial performance and identify potential risks and opportunities.

Portfolio Management & Real Estate Operations

jobs.description:
The Senior Manager will lead the design, implementation, and evaluation of evidence-informed digital prevention interventions across Moonshot's U.S. Online Violence Prevention portfolio. This role combines substantive expertise in violence prevention and behavioral interventions with strong program and people leadership, ensuring campaigns are grounded in prevention best practices, responsive to the needs of their intended audiences, and effective in achieving meaningful prevention outcomes.

The Senior Manager will oversee a team delivering diverse prevention campaigns, including help-seeking interventions, bystander awareness, pre-bunking, and resilience-building initiatives. Working closely with digital advertising specialists, threat assessment practitioners, and other subject matter experts, they will ensure interventions are strategically sound, ethically delivered, and continuously improved through evidence and evaluation.

The role also includes oversight of complex project delivery, management and development of campaign teams, client engagement, and contributions to Moonshot's evolving prevention methodologies and organizational growth.

Candidates must be based in MA, CO, NY, VA, GA, PA, MD, WI, TN, TX, OR, NJ, or DC. Occasional travel may be required.

Your responsibilities will include:

Intervention Strategy, Design & Evaluation

  • Lead evidence-informed intervention design processes, identifying target audiences, risk and protective factors, behavioral objectives, theories of change, messaging strategies, and intervention pathways.
  • Oversee the design of diverse digital prevention initiatives, including help-seeking, bystander awareness, pre-bunking, and resilience-building campaigns.
  • Translate research, behavioral insights, and practitioner expertise into actionable intervention strategies, incorporating appropriate referral pathways and services where relevant.
  • Define meaningful intervention outcomes and oversee evaluation of campaign effectiveness beyond traditional digital advertising metrics, including help-seeking, service connections, and other intended behavioral outcomes.
  • Identify weaknesses in intervention strategies or outcomes and lead improvements informed by evidence, campaign findings, and emerging prevention research.

Project & Portfolio Delivery

  • Provide leadership and oversight across multiple projects, from scoping and planning through implementation, evaluation, and reporting.
  • Translate intervention strategies into actionable delivery plans, establish clear accountability, and exercise sound judgment in managing competing priorities, resources, budgets, and delivery risks.
  • Work closely with digital advertising specialists to ensure campaign execution, creative approaches, and optimization decisions support substantive prevention objectives.

Subject Matter Leadership & Quality Assurance

  • Apply substantive knowledge of targeted violence prevention, violent extremism, radicalization, and related fields to intervention design and delivery.
  • Collaborate with behavioral threat assessment practitioners, psychologists, researchers, and other specialists, recognizing when additional expertise or review is needed.
  • Ensure interventions meet high standards of ethical, evidence-informed practice, including appropriate safeguarding, risk management, specialist review, and staff wellbeing.
  • Strengthen the team's understanding of violence prevention principles and foster intellectual curiosity, interdisciplinary collaboration, and openness to practitioner feedback.

Client & Team Leadership

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for designated clients and partners, building trusted relationships and managing expectations throughout project delivery.
  • Brief clients and stakeholders on intervention strategies, progress, findings, and recommendations, translating complex information into actionable insights.
  • Lead and develop campaign managers and team members through effective delegation, coaching, constructive feedback, and clear performance expectations.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and professional development, fostering a collaborative and accountable team culture.

Organizational Development & Growth

  • Collaborate across Moonshot's Network Development, Research & Analysis, Campaigns, Product & Engineering, and Operations teams to deliver integrated prevention initiatives.
  • Contribute to standardized intervention methodologies, quality assurance processes, and organizational learning, ensuring lessons from campaign delivery inform future practice.
  • Contribute subject matter expertise to proposals, project scoping, methodologies, and staffing plans for new and existing opportunities.
  • Support the development of innovative prevention approaches that respond to emerging client needs and strengthen Moonshot's impact.

Requirements

Essential:

  • Significant professional experience in violence prevention, targeted violence prevention, preventing and countering violent extremism (P/CVE), behavioral interventions, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or overseeing evidence-informed prevention interventions, including translating research and behavioral insights into practical programs, defining intended outcomes, and using evaluation findings to improve effectiveness.
  • Strong understanding of targeted violence, violent extremism, radicalization, and prevention approaches, including relevant risk and protective factors.
  • Experience leading complex, multidisciplinary projects or programs, managing competing priorities, and maintaining accountability for high-quality delivery.
  • Experience leading and developing teams through coaching, delegation, performance management, and professional development.
  • Experience managing client or partner relationships, including communicating complex information and actionable recommendations to diverse stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and willingness to incorporate practitioner feedback, recognize the limits of one's expertise, and navigate sensitive ethical and operational considerations.
  • Candidates must be eligible to work in the US, and will be required to undertake and pass any relevant security clearance procedures per client needs.

Desirable:

  • Experience designing or delivering digital prevention interventions, online outreach campaigns, or strategic communications initiatives.
  • Familiarity with behavioral science and behavior change approaches, including experience with help-seeking interventions, bystander awareness, pre-bunking, or resilience-building programs.
  • Familiarity with behavioral threat assessment and management (BTAM) and multidisciplinary prevention approaches.
  • Experience working with government agencies, civil society organizations, technology companies, or practitioner networks.

Specialist expertise in digital advertising platforms is not required. The Senior Manager will work closely with colleagues responsible for advertising strategy, execution, and optimization.

Benefits

  • 15 days paid vacation leave, plus Federal holidays and 1 day additional paid leave for Native American Heritage Day.
  • Flexible public holiday policy with the option to work federal holidays in exchange for a day off at another time.
  • Full private healthcare package, including coverage for partners and children.
  • Dental & Vision Insurance.
  • Life & Disability Insurance.
  • 24/7 access to free counseling via our Employee Assistance Program.
  • 3% matched 401k contributions.
  • 401(k) Roth Contributions.
  • Generous maternity and paternity leave: 26 weeks paid maternity leave, 8 weeks paid paternity leave.
  • All permanent employees are granted share options upon employment.

Salary: $115,500 - $152,250 (depending on skills and experience).

jobs.title: Fractional Senior Game Designer
jobs.excerpt: About ExientExient is an independent games studio with a long track record of building and operating high-quality titles for mobile and beyond.
jobs.description:
About Exient

Exient is an independent games studio with a long track record of building and operating high-quality titles for mobile and beyond. Our portfolio spans original IP and world-renowned franchises, and our teams work across the full lifecycle, from concept and prototyping through live operations and ongoing content. We are a small and highly collaborative studio where designers have real ownership over the features they ship.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Game Designer to join us on a contract basis to strengthen our design capacity across multiple live and upcoming projects. This is a hands-on role for someone who can hit the ground running: contributing complex design work from day one, raising the quality and velocity of the team, and helping to advance our AI-assisted design workflows.I

This is a distinct, self-directed contractor engagement. You will operate as an independent supplier of design services under a contract for services, using your own judgement and working methods to deliver agreed outcomes across our project roadmap.

You will work closely with our existing design, art, engineering, and production disciplines to design, balance, and polish key features, and to flex onto proposals, pitches, and new opportunities as they arise.

What You'll Work On

As a Senior Game Designer at Exient, you'll play a central role in the design of our live mobile games, with Lemmings, one of gaming's most iconic franchises, at the heart of your work. This is a hands-on role for someone who can own features end to end and thrive across multiple projects at once.

Day to day, you'll:

  • Own feature and systems design for live free-to-play games. This means taking ideas from opportunity and concept through to detailed, implementation-ready documentation, then tuning and balancing them post-launch. It spans everything from onboarding and early-retention flows to monetisation, economy and live-ops events.
  • Design against data and player behaviour, working closely with Product, Analytics and Production to shape decisions around KPIs, retention and revenue, validate ideas through A/B testing, and turn insights into clear, actionable design.
  • Deliver a steady stream of seasonal and event content, keeping our games fresh through regular seasons, events and live-ops moments, often to external client and platform requirements.
  • Work across a varied portfolio. Lemmings is the core focus, but you'll also contribute to our wider slate of live and partner titles, taking ownership of your projects and balancing priorities as they shift.
  • Contribute to new concepts and pitches, helping shape GDDs, proposals and concept pitches for prospective projects and partners, including competitive analysis and scoping.
  • Design within real-world constraints, building features that meet evolving compliance and regulatory requirements as part of a responsible, player-first approach.
  • Help push our craft and ways of working forward, including making the most of AI-assisted design workflows, which are increasingly part of how our team works.
  • Partner across disciplines, working closely with artists, engineers and producers to take designs from documentation through to polished, well-integrated features in the game.
  • Prototype and pressure-test ideas quickly, using rapid iteration and playtesting to refine gameplay and feel before committing to full production.

You'll be a senior, autonomous member of a small, collaborative team, trusted to lead your own work, raise the bar on quality, and support and mentor those around you.

This list is indicative rather than exhaustive. The specific mix of work will flex with the studio's roadmap and priorities during the engagement.

AI-Assisted Design Workflow

You'll help elevate the AI-assisted ways of working already part of our design process. Our focus is workflow AI, using AI tools to work faster and smarter. The ideal contractor already treats these tools as part of their everyday craft and knows when to rely on them and when not to.

We're looking for practical, demonstrable experience using AI to accelerate design work, for example:

  • Ideation: generating and stress-testing divergent ideas at speed, then applying senior judgement to select what's worth building.
  • Structured specification: turning rough mechanics into explicit rule sets, state tables, and documentation ready to critique and prototype.
  • Economy and balance: accelerating the arithmetic-heavy work of curves, progression, and tuning tables, then validating through playtesting.
  • Rapid prototyping: reaching a playable, testable prototype faster, so more time goes on judgement, feel, and polish.
  • Documentation and iteration: drafting and maintaining design documentation, and feeding playtest results into the next iteration.

Just as important is knowing where human taste is irreplaceable: the strongest designers use AI to reach a playable build faster, then spend their judgement where it counts.

Experience & Qualifications

  • A minimum of five years' game design experience, the majority within a mobile games company.
  • A demonstrable track record of shipping and operating live mobile titles.
  • A degree in Games Design, Interactive Media, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience working on complex design projects in a fast-paced, multi-project environment.
  • A portfolio or case studies that show senior-level design thinking across mechanics, economy, and player experience.

Technical Skills

  • Strong command of core-loop, meta-game, game balance, economy, and monetisation models.
  • Excellent understanding of UI / UX and a strong sense of game flow, pacing, and player experience.
  • Ability to conceptualise, prototype, and implement game concepts using a range of tools, and to iterate from data and player feedback.
  • Practical, hands-on experience integrating AI tools into a design workflow (as described above).
  • Proficiency with design tooling such as Figma, Unity, Git, Jira, Confluence and Claude.
  • Confident with data: reading analytics, forming hypotheses, and using KPIs to guide balancing decisions.
  • Broad knowledge of games, with genuine passion for casual, mobile, and classic arcade genres.

Ways of Working

  • Self-motivated, organised, and able to deliver reliably while working largely autonomously.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to document and present design decisions.
  • Collaborative and dependable when working across disciplines and time zones.
  • Strong sense of accountability and ownership, with openness to self-critique and constructive feedback.
  • Comfortable moving between projects and adapting quickly to shifting priorities.

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
