Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Laboratory Data Ontologist

Remote | Canada or US

Overview

We are seeking a Laboratory Data Ontologist to strengthen the semantic foundation of our platform and the client-specific ontologies deployed on top of it. Labbit is built on a typed entity graph — samples, containers, locations, instruments, pools, and their provenance — and every implementation is, at its core, a modelling exercise: mapping a client's scientific and operational vocabulary onto that graph without losing fidelity.

This role sits within our Advisory group. You will spend ~50% of your time billable on client implementation projects as the modelling lead, and the remaining ~50% on internal stewardship — evolving the core ontology, codifying modelling practice, and supporting Sales pursuits. This is not a data engineer role and not a solutions architect role. You are a modeller, steeped in information theory, taxonomy design, and ontology engineering — whose primary deliverables are client and platform ontologies, reference models, and the standards that govern them.

Why This Role Matters

Our platform's differentiator is a configurable, versioned entity graph with immutable lineage. That model is only as valuable as the discipline behind it:

  • Advisory engagements deepen when modelling is treated as a first-class deliverable rather than a byproduct of configuration.
  • Sales wins when we can quickly show a prospect their world represented cleanly in our model.
  • Implementation delivers faster when client vocabulary maps to reusable patterns instead of bespoke types.
  • Platform evolves coherently when extensions across clients are legible as variants of shared abstractions rather than divergent one-offs.

Housing this role in Advisory keeps the practitioner close to real client problems — the billable work is where modelling craft is sharpened — while the non-billable half compounds those learnings into shared assets the whole company draws on.

What You Will Do

1. Lead Modelling on Client Engagements (~50% billable)

  • Serve as the modelling lead on Advisory and Implementation engagements where ontology depth is the critical risk
  • Run discovery sessions to elicit and structure client domain models
  • Produce target ontologies — entity types, controlled vocabularies, field taxonomies, workflow decompositions — as billable deliverables
  • Review changeset designs for modelling quality alongside implementation engineers
  • Coach client counterparts on stewardship of their own model post go-live

2. Steward the Core Ontology

  • Own the conceptual model behind Labbit's base entity types (@Sample, @Container, @Location, @Instrument, @Reagent, @Pool) and their inheritance semantics
  • Maintain design principles for when to extend a base type vs. introduce a new one
  • Review proposed changes to the base ontology for coherence, minimalism, and long-term extensibility
  • Curate the shared reference/IRI namespace so aliases remain meaningful across changesets and clients

3. Codify Modelling Practice Across Advisory

  • Author internal standards for taxonomy design, controlled vocabulary governance, and ontology versioning
  • Identify reusable extension patterns across client engagements and promote them into shared libraries
  • Establish review rituals so modelling decisions are traceable and reversible
  • Train Advisory and Implementation staff in applied ontology techniques
  • Build a shared library of domain reference models for our priority verticals (QC manufacturing, clinical genomics, CGT, stability)

4. Support Sales

  • Join late-stage sales cycles to lead ontology discovery sessions with prospects
  • Produce lightweight target models that demonstrate fit without over-committing to configuration
  • Translate prospect terminology (assays, panels, batches, lots) into our model in real time during demos

5. Inform Platform Direction

  • Surface modelling gaps discovered across client work as candidate platform investments
  • Advise Platform Engineering on schema evolution semantics (changeset migrations, deprecations, aliasing)
  • Contribute to decisions about first-class vs. reference-data entities, computed fields, and graph traversal features

What You Will Not Do

  • Own application development or feature delivery
  • Serve as project manager or delivery lead on client engagements
  • Replace implementation configuration engineers or platform engineers
  • Build a parallel modelling framework outside our changeset system

Qualifications

Required

  • Strong grounding in information theory, formal ontology, or knowledge representation (academic or applied)
  • 5+ years working with structured domain models — taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, ontologies, or graph schemas — in production settings
  • Fluency with at least one modelling formalism (OWL/RDF, property graphs, UML class models, ISA-Tab, or comparable)
  • Demonstrated ability to elicit domain knowledge from subject-matter experts and translate it into a coherent model
  • Comfort in a client-facing, billable advisory context — including scoping deliverables, running workshops, and defending modelling decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfort reading and reasoning about configuration-as-code artifacts (JSON schemas, BPMN, expression languages)
  • Excellent written communication — you will produce reference models, standards, and documentation that others rely on

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in laboratory informatics, life sciences, or another regulated scientific domain (QC manufacturing, genomics, clinical diagnostics, CGT)
  • Familiarity with LIMS, ELN, or scientific workflow platforms and their data models
  • Experience with versioned schema evolution and immutable/provenance data models
  • Exposure to regulated environments (21 CFR Part 11, GAMP5) and their implications for schema governance
  • Prior consulting or professional services experience with utilization targets

To further support our team, we offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive vacation
  • Flexible health spending account / Health Insurance
  • RRSP / 401 K matching
  • Annual professional development budget
  • The expected salary range for this role is: $150,000 - $190,000 CAD or USD
    Actual compensation may vary based on experience, domain expertise, and geographic location.

Job Title: Software Developer
Company: SMRTR
Location: United States or Canada, Remote
Employment Type : Full-time

About SMRTR

SMRTR builds software that helps businesses run more efficiently. Together with our sister companies Shea, a SYSPRO ERP partner, and DTEC, a distribution ERP provider, we are part of Solen Software Group. Our customers rely on us every day, and our Subscriptions, Renewals, Collections & Accounting team keeps that relationship healthy, making sure software subscriptions, renewals and services are billed on time and accurately, and that outstanding balances are resolved quickly and professionally.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a software developer with 3–5 years of experience to build product features and integrations for NG and SMRTR TRAC. Our stack is Vue, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL, with services on the JVM (Scala).

Working with our Director of Software Engineering, you will help deliver our 2027 roadmap: connecting our products to the ERP systems our customers run (starting with SYSPRO), AI-powered document capture, and new NG and TRAC features. You will join a small, experienced team where what you build reaches customers quickly.

Key Responsibilities

Product development

  • Build features across the front end (Vue, TypeScript) and back end (Node.js, Scala/JVM) for NG and SMRTR TRAC.
  • Design and work with PostgreSQL data models and queries (and some MongoDB), with attention to performance.
  • Fix defects and improve the reliability of the products you work on.

Integrations and APIs

  • Build and maintain REST APIs and integrations between NG / SMRTR TRAC and ERP systems such as SYSPRO, Microsoft Dynamics 365, VAI and NCR, following the team's integration patterns.
  • Contribute to AI document capture (classification and data extraction) and the print-to-NG driver.

Delivery and collaboration

  • Turn requirements from Professional Services, Sales and customers into working software, with guidance from engineering leadership.
  • Estimate your own tasks and deliver to agreed dates.
  • Support go-lives and help troubleshoot production issues.

Engineering practices

  • Write tested, reviewed and secure code in our GitHub-based workflow with CI/CD.
  • Write clear technical documentation and release notes.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to work faster, safely.

What You Bring

Required

  • 3–5 years of professional software development experience.
  • Production experience with Vue.js, TypeScript and Node.js.
  • PostgreSQL: schema design, SQL and query performance.
  • JVM experience, preferably Scala.
  • Experience building REST APIs and integrating with third-party systems.
  • Git-based workflows, code review and automated testing.
  • Clear communication with colleagues and, when needed, customers.
  • Authorized to work in the United States or Canada; set up for remote work.

Nice to Have

  • MongoDB.
  • Android or Xamarin.
  • ERP integration experience (e.g., SYSPRO, Microsoft Dynamics 365, VAI, NCR).
  • Document management, OCR or AI document capture.
  • Experience with manufacturing, distribution or food & beverage software.

How Success Is Measured

  • Features and integrations delivered on schedule
  • Quality: defects and production incidents in your code
  • Accuracy of estimates on your own work
  • Growing ownership of product areas over the year

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base salary of USD 65,000–85,000 (United States) or CAD 95,000–110,000 (Canada), depending on experience and location
  • Benefits according to country of employment (in the US: health, dental and vision insurance and a 401(k) with company match)
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Fully remote work with a collaborative, experienced team

Recruitment Disclaimer

Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Salary: $65,000 – $85,000 / year

jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager DACH (m/w/d) – Teilzeit / Contractor

Wir suchen eine strukturierte und serviceorientierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere Kunden in der DACH-Region unterstützt und ihnen hilft, das volle Potenzial von Abler zu nutzen.

Die Rolle startet in Teilzeit (ca. 10–20 Stunden pro Woche) und bietet die Möglichkeit, mit unserem Wachstum in der Region weiter zu wachsen.

Abler wird bereits von Organisationen im Umfeld von Clubs wie Chelsea F.C., Newcastle United oder Barcelona genutzt. In England arbeiten wir mit rund 40% der Clubs aus den Top 4 Ligen zusammen. Auch in Deutschland haben wir bereits erste Kunden und bauen unsere Präsenz weiter aus.

Wir sind überzeugt, dass wir eine sehr starke Value Proposition haben und echten Mehrwert für Sportorganisationen schaffen. Unser Ziel ist es, diese Qualität und Struktur auch im Breitensport verfügbar zu machen.

Wenn du die richtige Einstellung und Motivation mitbringst, unterstützen wir dich mit allem, was du brauchst, um in der Rolle erfolgreich zu sein.

Die Rolle

  • Du arbeitest eng mit neuen und bestehenden Kunden zusammen und stellst sicher, dass sie Abler erfolgreich einsetzen.
  • Dazu gehören das Onboarding neuer Vereine, die Unterstützung im täglichen Umgang mit der Plattform sowie die Beantwortung von Fragen.
  • Du bist Teil unseres Customer Success und Support Teams und arbeitest mit klaren Prozessen. Gleichzeitig hilfst du aktiv dabei, unseren Ansatz für Kundenbetreuung und Implementierung im DACH-Markt weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du sammelst Feedback aus dem Markt und bringst es in unser Produktteam ein, um sowohl das Produkt als auch unsere Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Je nach Interesse kann die Rolle auch Aufgaben im Bereich Go-to-Market und Marktentwicklung umfassen, z. B. bei der Identifikation potenzieller Kunden oder erster Business-Development-Aktivitäten.
  • Gelegentlich können auch persönliche Besuche bei Kunden Teil der Rolle sein.

Arbeitsweise

  • Remote-first Rolle (Arbeiten von zu Hause)
  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung im Rahmen der Teilzeit
  • Möglichkeit zur Unterstützung von Co-Working-Spaces je nach Bedarf
  • Gelegentliche Vor-Ort-Termine bei Kunden

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding neuer Vereine und Begleitung beim Setup
  • Unterstützung von Kunden im täglichen Einsatz von Abler
  • Beantwortung von Fragen und Sicherstellung einer positiven Nutzungserfahrung
  • Sammeln und Weitergeben von Kundenfeedback an das Produktteam
  • Mitgestaltung unserer Prozesse für Customer Success und Implementierung in DACH
  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Hilfsmaterialien und Guides
  • Unterstützung bei Go-to-Market und Marktentwicklung bei Bedarf

Das bringst du mit

  • Freude daran, Menschen zu helfen und Probleme zu lösen
  • Bezug zum Sport (z. B. als Spieler, Trainer oder im Verein)
  • Sicher im Umgang mit gängigen digitalen Tools (Du musst nicht hoch technisch sein, solltest aber offen sein, neue Systeme zu lernen (wir schulen dich auf Abler)
  • Strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Wohnsitz in der DACH-Region
  • Erfahrung mit Abler ist ein Plus
  • Spanischkenntnisse sind ein großes Plus (Unterstützung in anderen Märkten möglich)

Das erwartet dich

  • Flexible Teilzeitrolle mit Entwicklungsperspektive
  • Remote-Arbeitsumfeld mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Unterstützung bei Co-Working-Space möglich
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Team
  • Klare Prozesse, Einarbeitung und Unterstützung
  • Möglichkeit, aktiv Einfluss auf Produkt und Arbeitsweise zu nehmen

Über Abler

Abler entwickelt das Betriebssystem für Sportorganisationen.

Unsere Plattform wurde in Island entwickelt, einem Land mit einem der stärksten organisierten Sportsysteme weltweit. Island gilt international als Vorzeigemodell für erfolgreiche Sportentwicklung. Heute nutzen rund 75 % der gesamten Isländishen Bevölkerung Abler im Kontext von Sport - alles vom Breitensport bis hin zu professionellen Strukturen.

Unser Ziel ist es, Sportorganisationen besser zu machen und dadurch die Entwicklung von Menschen und Gemeinschaften durch Sport zu fördern.

Sport matters.

Bewerbung

Wenn dich die Rolle anspricht, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Bei Fragen kannst du dich direkt an den Hiring Manager wenden:
. Alle Bewerbungen werden vertraulich behandelt.

--English below--

Part-Time Customer Success & Implementation Manager (DACH)

We are looking for someone to support our customers in the DACH region and help them get the most out of Abler.

This is a part-time contractor role (around 10-20 hours per week to start), with the opportunity to grow over time as we expand in the region.

The Role

You will work closely with new and existing customers, helping them get set up and making sure they are successful using Abler.

This includes onboarding new clubs, answering questions, supporting them in their day-to-day use, and making sure they feel confident using the platform.

You will be part of our wider Customer Success and Support team, so you will not be alone. We will train you and support you closely, and you will have clear processes to follow. This role is not only about support. You will also play an important role in shaping how we work with customers in the DACH region. That includes collecting feedback, sharing insights with our product team, and helping us improve both the product and how we support our customers.

In addition, depending on your interest and capacity, the role can expand into supporting our go-to-market efforts in the DACH region. This may include helping identify potential customers, mapping the market, or supporting early business development activities.

From time to time, the role may also include visiting customers in person.

What You'll Do

  • Help onboard new clubs and guide them through setup
  • Answer customer questions and support them in using the platform
  • Work closely with clubs to make sure they are getting value from Abler
  • Collect customer feedback and bring it back to our product and development team
  • Support the development of how we approach customer success and implementation in DACH
  • Create and improve help materials, guides, and simple support content for customers
  • Support go-to-market and market development activities where needed, such as identifying potential customers or stakeholders
  • Occasionally visit customers in person

What We're Looking For

  • Someone who enjoys helping people and solving problems
  • A strong connection to sport, through playing, coaching, or working in a club
  • Comfortable using everyday digital tools and systems
  • You do not need to be highly technical, but you should be confident working with common software and willing to learn. We will train you on Abler
  • Organised and reliable, with good communication skills
  • Comfortable speaking and writing in German and English
  • Based in the DACH region
  • Experience with Abler is definitely a plus
  • Spanish language skills are a big plus, as there may be opportunities to support customers or activities in that region as well

What We Value

We look for people who have the Winner Mindset, Passion and Ownership.
Read here about our DNA

About Abler

Abler is building the operating system for sports organisations.

We help clubs run their programmes, manage their members, and communicate better, all in one place. Our goal is simple: help sport organisations run better and reach more people.

We are already used at scale in our home market and are growing internationally. We work with leading organisations connected to clubs like Chelsea, Newcastle, and Barcelona, and bring those same tools and standards to grassroots sport.

How to apply

If you are excited about the opportunity, join our talented team and make a significant impact on the future of our next generation through sport. We look forward to hearing from you soon!

Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and why you are the ideal candidate for this position.

All applications will be reviewed and treated with full confidentiality. If you have any questions about the application process or before you apply, please feel free to reach out to the hiring manager directly at

jobs.description:
RevenueBase:

  • We're building the data infrastructure that makes AI agents trustworthy instead of error-prone.

  • We provide continuously refreshed, verified B2B data for autonomous AI agents and GTM workflows.

  • We've tripled growth while maintaining 100% gross dollar retention and staying cashflow positive.

  • We power AI agents for Clay, Zoominfo, Dun & Bradstreet, and the next generation of AI GTM tools.

Why We're Hiring This Role:

  • The companies building the future of go-to-market are building on top of our B2B data infrastructure. Many are onboarded and running.

  • The hardest part of being a B2B data customer is figuring out how to run the right searches across the data to get the business outcome they bought us for. They need a technical partner to help them actually succeed with the product.

  • This role exists to own the full customer lifecycle — onboarding, activation, health, and expansion — across every account we have.

  • You are the founding hire for this function. When we hire behind you, you hire them.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the "first successful search" — every new customer's activation milestone. Get them there, fast. This is the most important thing you do.

  • Own customer health across all accounts. Know which customers are getting value, which are quiet, and which are at risk — before anyone asks.

  • Drive expansion and cross-sell. As we ship new API surface area (verification, enrichment, discovery, MCP), identify which customers need what and run the expansion conversation.

  • Run onboarding at scale. 3-5 new customers per month today, scaling to 10+. Make onboarding light, fast, and reliably successful.

  • Be the voice of the customer inside RevenueBase. Sit on top of every Slack channel, every support request, every integration conversation, and tell product and engineering what customers actually need.

  • Build the function. Write the playbooks, the health scoring, the expansion motion, and the onboarding framework — then rewrite them when they stop working.

Who You Are:

  • You've owned a quota before — NRR, expansion, or retention — and know how to drive it without being pushy.

  • You've worked at early-stage companies. You are allergic to process for process's sake. You write the playbook because there isn't one.

  • You are the most technical non-developer in every room, and developers respect you. You don't pretend to be an engineer, but you're not precious about getting into the weeds.

  • You don't wait to be told. The customer's success is your outcome, and you treat it that way.

Must have:

  • Tech literacy — enough to read a customer's integration code (Python, JSON, SQL, you name it), spot what's broken, write a small script to demonstrate an API call, and be credible in a technical conversation.

  • B2B data fluency — you know what firmographics, technographics, intent, and contact enrichment are. You understand why an email bounces, why a company name match is hard, and why verification matters.

  • API mental model — REST, webhooks, rate limits, authentication, and the difference between a batch file drop and a real-time API call. You can walk a customer through integrating our MCP server.

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience in B2B data, sales intelligence, or RevOps tooling

  • Experience with MCP servers or LLM-powered agent workflows

  • Prior founding CS or founding CE experience at an early-stage company

Your First 90 Days:

  • Days 1-30: Shadow every active customer conversation. Write queries against our Snowflake environment. Sit in on sales and onboarding calls. Build a map of all customers — health, usage, expansion potential, risk.

  • Days 31-60: Take ownership of onboarding. Run the "first successful search" milestone with every new customer. Publish a customer health scoring framework.

  • Days 61-90: Identify and execute your first three expansion opportunities. Ship the v1 onboarding playbook. Tell us what you need to do this job 10x better.

Who You Are Not:

  • You have not spent your career at companies with 1,000+ employees and defined CS processes.

  • You do not need a playbook to get started.

  • You are not looking for a pure relationship role with no technical depth, and you are not looking for a pure engineering role with no customer contact.

Why RevenueBase:

  • Product with real traction: Customers rely on our platform in production.

  • High ownership: Small team where your work directly shapes the product.

  • Customer-driven culture: Activation and retention are how we measure success.

  • Growth stage company: Clear product-market fit and momentum.

  • Impact over process: Less bureaucracy, more building.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience.

  • Meaningful ownership and long-term growth opportunities.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Fully remote-friendly team (East Coast / Boston preferred).

  • Direct collaboration with founders and core engineering leadership.

Data Specialist

About Syllo

Syllo is defining the Litigation AI category. We are the first unified platform designed to autonomously manage the entire litigation lifecycle end-to-end. Founded in 2019 by a team of litigators and engineers, Syllo enables legal teams to securely harness the power of AI across any matter, regardless of complexity or scale. Our technology supports Fortune 500 companies and AmLaw 200 firms managing their most complex litigation portfolios. Awarded ILTA Transformative Project of the Year and ALM eDiscovery Technology of the Year for 2026, we are the market leader in enterprise-grade litigation AI. Backed by top-tier VCs, we are at a clear inflection point — the team has doubled in the last six months and growth is accelerating.

About the role

Own the data layer that makes complex litigation possible.

This role is responsible for the technical data operations that underpin every case on Syllo's platform, from collection and processing through production and quality control. You will work directly with Client Services pods and internally with Product and Engineering to ensure data integrity at every stage. We are looking for someone with hands-on EDRM lifecycle experience, deep platform fluency, and the judgment to know when a data issue is a technical quirk versus a signal something is wrong.

What you will do

  • Own data operations: Manage ingestion, processing, and production workflows across active cases. Validate every output before it reaches the client.
  • Own quality control: Apply systematic QC standards across all data outputs, documenting findings and resolving issues before they reach the client or the pod.
  • Resolve complex data issues: Diagnose and resolve collection anomalies, processing failures, metadata errors, and production format disputes.
  • Advise on data strategy: Help clients structure their data workflows, processing specs, and review protocols for efficiency and defensibility.
  • Serve as the pod liaison: Receive data handoffs from Client Services pods, document chain of custody, and ensure all requirements are captured before work begins. Manage intake through a dedicated queue and communicate proactively about capacity and timelines.
  • Partner with Engineering and Product: Surface recurring data-layer issues, document edge cases, and contribute to platform improvement through product testing and timely feedback.
  • Build documentation: Create and maintain processing guides, QC checklists, and workflow standards that hold up as the client base grows.

What you bring

  • EDRM depth: You have owned the full lifecycle, from collection through production, on complex commercial cases with high data volumes.
  • Quality discipline: Your QC process is systematic, documented, and does not depend on memory.
  • Platform fluency: Hands-on experience with Relativity, Everlaw, Nuix, or comparable platforms. You can troubleshoot, not just operate.
  • Metadata and data structure knowledge: You understand file formats, processing parameters, load file specs, and why metadata integrity matters.
  • Cross-functional communication: You can explain a data issue to an attorney and a technical root cause to an engineer.

Experience and qualifications

  • 3+ years in eDiscovery, litigation support, or a data-focused legal role.
  • Hands-on EDRM lifecycle experience from collection through production on complex commercial cases.
  • Proficiency with at least one major eDiscovery platform; Relativity RCA or equivalent preferred.
  • Comfort working with metadata, large datasets, and technically complex data requests.
  • Experience with ticketing systems such as Jira or Linear is a plus.
  • Experience collaborating with engineering or product teams is a plus.
  • High aptitude for learning new software tools and enthusiasm for AI-powered products.

Total rewards and benefits

At Syllo, we believe in taking care of our team so they can focus on building the future of legal tech.

Compensation: Competitive base salary + equity options.

Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, and voluntary insurance options. Vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays. Access to benefit counselors and fitness class reimbursements.

Equal opportunity employer

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

This role is focused on the technical implementation of ICD 705, SCIF, SAPF, Open Storage Secret (OSS), TEMPEST, and related security requirements, translating security criteria into coordinated, constructible architectural and engineering solutions, construction documents, specifications, and technical details.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical liaison between government security stakeholders and multidisciplinary project teams and possess a strong understanding of how physical and technical security requirements integrate with architectural, engineering, telecommunications, audiovisual, electronic security, and other building systems. The position will support projects throughout both CONUS and OCONUS locations.

  • Support proposal development, technical approaches, scopes of work, and strategic growth opportunities for the Mission Critical and Secure Facilities practice.

  • Demonstrated experience interpreting and implementing ICD 705, SCIF, SAPF, OSS, TEMPEST, and related secure facility requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate security requirements into construction drawings, specifications, technical details, and multidisciplinary design solutions.
  • Knowledge of secure perimeter construction and RF/TEMPEST mitigation techniques, including penetrations, shielding, non-conductive breaks, waveguide-below-cutoff protection, and power/signal filtering.
  • Strong understanding of multidisciplinary building systems and their interaction with physical and technical security requirements.
  • Experience with secure facility assessments, technical design reviews, and construction-phase support.
  • Strong technical leadership, coordination, written communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel periodically in support of CONUS and OCONUS projects.

Minimum Requirements

  • Ability to pass drug, and background checks to work on Federal grounds, military installations, and school grounds.
  • This position requires U.S. citizenship due to federal contract/security requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 15+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years focused on SCIF, SAPF, TEMPEST, OSS, or comparable secure/classified facilities.
  • Advanced experience with the design, documentation, construction, inspection, and accreditation/certification of secure facilities.
  • Completion of recognized training related to ICD 705, SCIF/SAPF design and construction, TEMPEST, RF shielding, or related secure facility criteria.
  • Experience working directly with SSMs, SSOs, CTTAs, Accrediting Officials, and other government security authorities.
  • Experience developing secure facility standards, specifications, standard details, design guides, or quality-control procedures.
  • Experience supporting secure facility projects in both CONUS and OCONUS locations.

About Airship

Airship is trusted by world’s leading brands such as Alaska Airlines, BBC and The Home Depot to drive revenue growth and customer loyalty with exceptional cross-channel customer experiences. Today, brands are challenged to deliver seamless, unified customer experiences across a fragmented array of channels and devices— apps, websites, email, SMS, wallets and more.

Airship’s no-code, AI-powered platform was designed with non-technical, growth-focused teams in mind, making it easy to create, test and orchestrate hyper-personalized experiences across all channels. With the ability to easily enrich customer data and rapidly launch growth experiments, Airship enables brands to deliver consistent, meaningful interactions that accelerate conversion and foster deeper customer relationships.

We invite you to be part of our journey in building products and delivering services that touch millions of customers around the world every day.

To learn more about us, visit , read our blog or follow us on LinkedIn.

About Gummicube, an Airship Company

Gummicube develops powerful app discovery technology, enabling anybody with an app to quickly optimize for the most organic search visibility. Gummicube's DATACUBE software leverages proprietary big data for mobile to understand App Store search trends and the competitive landscape. Using DATACUBE, mobile search data and user behavior is no longer a black box -- resulting in greater visibility, more high-quality organic downloads and a lower overall cost of user acquisition.

Together, Gummicube and Airship enable brands, marketers, product owners and developers to optimize their entire mobile app experience — from the point of discovery to loyalty.

To learn more about Gummicube, visit .

About the Role

As Senior Director, Client Strategy, you’ll set the direction for Gummicube’s Client Strategy function over the next 12 months. You’ll lead client service and strategy for an assigned portfolio while strengthening the team’s capacity for future needs. You’ll partner with the Senior Director, Account & Client Services; both teams serve assigned accounts and share a focus on retention, client growth, and delivery.

What You'll Do

  • Lead client onboarding for your portfolio, helping clients understand Gummicube’s technology, approach, and opportunities for growth
  • Build relationships with senior client stakeholders and guide account plans based on their goals and performance data
  • Direct app store research, strategy, and testing recommendations that help clients improve visibility and conversion
  • Help your team navigate app store submission requirements and technical or compliance-related questions - bring in the appropriate product, technical, compliance, or legal experts when needed
  • Oversee the quality and timeliness of client analyses, reports, performance updates, and other agreed deliverables
  • Support retention and lead growth planning for your accounts, including renewals, expanded services, and opportunities to introduce relevant Airship services
  • Develop accurate revenue, retention, renewal, and opportunity forecasts for your portfolio. Help shape proposals, pricing recommendations, and contract discussions within approved parameters
  • Work with Business Development, Account & Client Services, product, data, creative, marketing, and engineering teams on client solutions and handoffs
  • Lead, coach, and develop your team through clear goals, regular feedback, career development, and performance management
  • Track market and platform changes, share client insights with Gummicube’s leaders, and use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly under company policy

These responsibilities may change as business needs evolve.

What We're Looking For

  • 8-10 years of experience in client strategy, account management, client services, digital marketing, or a related field
  • At least 4 years of experience leading and coaching teams
  • Experience setting a functional plan and turning it into clear goals, team capacity, and measurable results
  • A record of developing client strategies and account plans that improve outcomes, retention, or growth
  • Strong knowledge of mobile marketing and the ability to explain recommendations clearly to senior clients
  • Experience overseeing client work from onboarding through ongoing service and performance reporting
  • Commercial experience with renewals, proposals, pricing, forecasting, or account expansion
  • The ability to lead across functions, develop other leaders, and make sound decisions when priorities compete

We'd Be Delighted If You Also Have

  • Direct experience with App Store Optimization, app store analytics, conversion testing, or mobile user acquisition
  • Experience supporting complex app launches or working with app store submission guidelines
  • Experience leading work across account management, analytics, creative, or research teams
  • Familiarity with the App Store, Google Play, Apple Search Ads, or Google App campaigns
  • Experience supporting enterprise clients in an agency-style engagement or working with distributed teams

Work Location & Travel Requirements

Gummicube currently hires for this role within the United States. You must be based in an eligible Airship location. This is a fully remote position, with a preference for candidates who can work effectively with teams and clients in the Pacific time zone.

This role requires up to 10% travel for client meetings, company events, industry conferences, or other business needs.

Compensation

Compensation is determined by a variety of factors including market data, business needs, and geography. Base pay is part of your total compensation package and is dependent on multiple factors, including relevant skills, work experience, business priorities, market demands, and location.

Starting Pay Range: $190,000-$205,000 USD per year

Airship believes that employees should have the opportunity to benefit from value-creation, so equity is also offered with this role. In addition, Gummicube, as part of Airship Group, Inc., offers a benefits package as part of our Total Rewards approach to compensation.

Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible time off, company paid holidays, paid parental leave, and paid volunteer time off
  • Support for your overall wellbeing with mental health and wellness resources
  • Employer-subsidized life insurance as well as short-term and long-term disability

Ipas seeks a Strategic Partnership Manager to strengthen resource mobilization and the partnership portfolio in Africa. The manager will identify, cultivate, and expand a pipeline of institutional donors, foundations, corporate partners, and strategic collaborators whose priorities align with Ipas's mission and values.

The role will provide targeted business development support for high-value funding opportunities, deepen engagement with priority donors and partners, and contribute to compelling donor-facing materials, including expressions of interest, concept notes, proposals, budgets, presentations, results frameworks, and partnership strategies.

The Strategic Partnership Manager will demonstrate a strong commitment to reproductive justice, including human rights, abortion rights, gender equity, diversity, equity, and inclusion. The role will collaborate across the Ipas Network and promote shared leadership, trust, and inclusive, non-hierarchical approaches to learning and collaboration, while supporting effective stewardship of donor resources and adherence to Ipas's mission, values, and standards.

Primary Responsibilities:


1. Opportunity Pipeline Development and Donor/Partner Intelligence

  • Map priority foundations, institutional funders, corporate partners, and strategic implementing partners aligned with Ipas's mission and work.

  • Identify and track requests for proposals, calls for proposals, invitations, and relationship-led opportunities, and maintain an up-to-date pipeline tracker.
  • Support go/no-go decisions through fit assessments, competitiveness analysis, and risk and feasibility review, including deadlines, staffing, partnership needs, cost share, and indirect rate constraints.

  • Draft and refine positioning materials, including capability statements, one-pagers, brief slide decks, project summaries, and boilerplate language.
  • Build Ipas Network intelligence on key trends and opportunities in Africa.
  • Work with the Communications Service Node to contribute to external communications through the Ipas website, newsletters, and social media.
  • Prepare talking points, briefing notes, and agendas for external meetings; when requested, participate in meetings, capture next steps, and support follow-up.
  • Advise on partnership strategy, including lead versus sub-award roles, consortium roles, negotiation points, partner mapping, and outreach.
  • Work with the Development Service Node to report quarterly and annually on fundraising efforts and results and participate in annual management cycle activities.

3. Proposal Development, Review, and Quality Assurance

  • Support donor-facing submissions, including expressions of interest, concept notes, and full proposals, in coordination with internal teams and partners.
  • Develop and review technical narratives for compliance, clarity, and responsiveness to donor evaluation criteria.
  • Support required annexes, including results frameworks or log frames, workplans, monitoring, evaluation and learning plans, risk matrices, and staffing plans.
  • Coordinate with finance counterparts to develop and quality-check budgets and budget narratives for alignment with the technical approach and donor cost rules.
  • Provide structured written feedback through tracked comments or review memos and participate in review meetings to agree on revisions and next steps.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Ten or more years’ work experience managing programs and projects with increasing complexity and responsibility
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field

jobs.title: AI Studio Coach- AI-Powered Entrepreneurship
jobs.excerpt: About Break Through TechBreak Through Tech transforms how tech talent is discovered, developed, and connected to opportunity in the age of AI.
jobs.description:
About Break Through Tech

Break Through Tech transforms how tech talent is discovered, developed, and connected to opportunity in the age of AI. Working across higher education and industry, Break Through Tech delivers programs nationwide and integrates technical training, work-based learning, mentorship, and career readiness with deep employer partnerships to create more effective and scalable routes into early tech careers. Break Through Tech is actively shaping the field of early tech talent development by identifying what works, translating those insights into replicable models, and helping define more consistent approaches to how talent is prepared, assessed, and hired across institutions and employers.

At a moment when AI is reshaping every aspect of work and society, Break Through Tech’s mission is urgent: to ensure that the people who build what comes next — and who are in the room where the most consequential technology decisions of our time get made — look like the world they will shape. Learn more about our work at.

Position Summary

We are seeking several subject matter experts to partner with Break Through Tech program staff to deliver a first-of-its-kind program for up to 500 undergraduate fellows enrolled in our flagship, extracurricular AI Program.

AI has collapsed the cost of building a first version of almost anything, which has made the ability to build far less scarce than the judgment to know what is worth building. Employers and investors increasingly look for people who can identify a real customer problem, test their assumptions against evidence, and make disciplined decisions about what to pursue — skills that early-career technologists rarely get to practice.

The new 16-week AI-Powered Entrepreneurship program will enable our fellows — who will have already completed a rigorous 9-week Machine Learning Foundations course and a 3-month AI project sponsored by an industry partner — to take a venture from an unexamined idea to an evidence-backed pitch.

With expert guidance and support from their Coaches, fellows will work in teams of three to five to identify a customer problem, interview real customers, build and test an MVP with real users, and pitch their venture to a panel of judges at a culminating Flagship Event.

Across 4 units — Problem Opportunity, Customer Validation, MVP and Prototype, and Pitch and Business Model — fellows will apply the Lean Startup Build-Measure-Learn cycle while using AI tools for research, ideation, synthesis, prototyping, and pitch preparation. Asynchronous coursework will be complemented by virtual Workshops and Maker Days where teams do the work of venture building together, and by independent stretches where teams conduct customer interviews and usability testing in the field.

This is a hands-on coaching role rather than a traditional instructor position. The curriculum supplies the methodology, activities, facilitation guides, and evaluation criteria; Coaches bring the experience, questions, and judgment that help fellows turn those tools into real venture learning. Coaches should be comfortable working with early-stage ambiguity and helping teams make progress without prescribing the answer or taking ownership of the venture.

Coaches for this Specialization will each support 8–10 project teams (about 40 fellows). Coaches will be expected to facilitate end-to-end the live virtual events and design short concept reviews for them; form and support venture teams; monitor fellows’ progress in their Canvas course; grade and provide feedback on team deliverables against program rubrics; and host virtual office hours.

Essential Responsibilities and Duties

The essential duties of this role are grouped into these categories, with the approximate percentage of time spent on each category indicated below

  • Event Preparation and Facilitation (50%)
  • Facilitate and design short concept reviews for 4 Workshops (1.5 hours each)
  • Facilitate and design short concept reviews for 3 Maker Days (3.5 hours each)
  • Facilitate and support the culminating Flagship Event (3.5 hours), evaluating team pitches from an angel investor’s perspective alongside industry judges and volunteers
  • Review fellows’ Idea Board submissions ahead of Workshop 1 and form venture teams of three to five fellows around shared problem spaces
  • Create and monitor breakout rooms for team-based activities, rotating through every team to observe progress, ask evidence-based questions, and provide feedback and suggestions to ensure fellow success and engagement
  • Track attendance and ensure survey completion at the end of each event
  • Team Coaching and Office Hours (25%)
  • Provide venture mentorship — both with individual teams and in small group settings — on customer discovery, value proposition development, MVP scoping, business model generation, and pitch preparation
  • Help teams distinguish customer evidence from assumptions, opinions, and AI-generated conclusions, and challenge them to identify and test their highest-risk assumptions
  • Support teams through milestone decisions, including whether to iterate, continue testing, pivot, or pursue further development based on what their evidence actually shows
  • Encourage thoughtful use of AI as a venture-building and thinking tool, while reinforcing the importance of human judgment, primary customer research, and responsible AI practices
  • Create a supportive environment where fellows can fail fast, receive candid feedback, learn from unsuccessful assumptions, and improve through repeated practice
  • Provide practical guidance on commercialization, market strategy, startup funding, and investor readiness when appropriate
  • Find and recommend additional resources to support your fellows’ venture development (e.g., accelerator programs, pitch competitions, non-dilutive funding opportunities)
  • Attend and actively engage in weekly Community of Practice meetings with other Coaches and program staff, to share ideas and troubleshoot together
  • Progress Assessment (25%)
  • Review team deliverables submitted in Canvas — the Problem Opportunity Brief, Customer Validation Brief, MVP/Prototype Package, and Final Pitch Package — providing written feedback and leveraging a grading rubric to score each one
  • Review Canvas checkpoint submissions ahead of each Workshop and Maker Day to identify teams that are stuck or under-prepared, and intervene before the live session rather than discovering the gap during it
  • Review “knowledge check” activities in Canvas to identify areas where fellows are struggling with Lean Startup concepts; and use that information to create concept review content for Workshops and Maker Days
  • Partner with Break Through Tech program staff to identify any fellows or teams who are failing to meet program expectations, and assist with intervention and follow-up as needed

Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience teaching, advising, mentoring, or coaching Lean Startup, customer discovery, Design Thinking, entrepreneurship, innovation management, or a comparable methodology
  • Working knowledge of customer discovery, hypothesis-driven experimentation, MVP development, value propositions, and business model development
  • Ability to coach multidisciplinary teams and provide constructive, specific feedback without taking ownership of the team’s venture
  • Comfortable working with early-stage ideas where significant uncertainty remains and the appropriate next step may not yet be clear
  • Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) for research, analysis, or product development
  • Commitment to developing inclusive and equitable working relationships with fellows from a variety of backgrounds, volunteers, other Coaches, and program staff
  • Experience evaluating and giving feedback on team work products
  • Prior teaching, tutoring, or mentoring experience
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills
  • Ability to thrive in a virtual work environment
  • Availability for all Workshop, Maker Day, and Flagship Event dates

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working for, advising, or launching a startup or early-stage venture
  • Experience supporting technology commercialization, product development, accelerator programs, incubators, or university entrepreneurship programs
  • Experience obtaining or advising ventures pursuing startup financing (e.g. seed or investor funding, Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) grants, non-dilutive funding opportunities, etc.)
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled products, or experience building with AI-assisted prototyping tools (e.g. Figma Make, no-code platforms)
  • Experience judging pitch competitions, demo days, or venture showcases

Important Notes

  • This is a part-time, remote, temporary position beginning on January 4th, 2027 and ending around May 20th, 2027.
  • Estimated time commitment: 15 -20 hours per week. Actual weekly hours will vary depending on program activities.
  • This role is not eligible for benefits.
  • This role is open to any eligible candidate across the US.
  • Visa sponsorship (including H-1B) is not available. Candidates authorized to work through F-1 CPT or OPT are welcome to apply.
  • Pay rate: $35 per hour.
  • Coaches will be required to participate in about 10 hours of pre-program training in early January 2027.
  • Coaches will be required to be available to facilitate 8 events (four 90-minute Workshops and four 4-hour Maker Days, including Final Presentations) on to-be-determined dates, from January-May, 2027.

Break Through Tech believes in creating a more equitable playing field for applicants and values the depth of relevant skills built through successful education, work, and life experiences. If your background and skills are a close match for this position, you are strongly encouraged to apply. Break Through Tech is committed to further building and maintaining a staff that reflects the full range of communities we serve and is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture. Break Through Tech is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment at Break Through Tech is contingent upon successful completion of references and a background check, which may include verification of employment history, education, criminal record, and other relevant screenings as permitted by law. Background checks are conducted after a conditional offer of employment and in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Job Title: SeniorSoftware Developer — Professional Service
Company: SMRTR

About Us

You will join the engineering team that serves three Solen Software Group companies: DTEC, which builds ERP software for distribution businesses; Shea, a SYSPRO ERP partner; and SMRTR, a document-management and supplier-compliance software company. Our customers run their day-to-day operations on our systems, and they count on us to understand their business, not just the software.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a senior, hands-on developer who enjoys working directly with customers. Your first priority will be clearing DTEC's development backlog and stabilising the product. From there, you will deliver customer projects (customisations, reports, integrations and enhancements) for DTEC customers and for Shea's SYSPRO customers.

Most of your time will be billable customer work, with real ownership of scope, estimates and delivery dates. You will also help move DTEC onto our modern stack (Vue, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL).

Key Responsibilities

Backlog and product stability (first priority)

  • Work through the DTEC development backlog with engineering leadership, agreeing scope and dates for each item.
  • Investigate and fix defects in the DTEC product, including legacy Visual FoxPro code.
  • Improve release quality and reduce repeat support issues.

Customer projects

  • Gather requirements with customers, estimate effort and agree scope before work starts.
  • Develop, test and deploy customisations, reports, data fixes and integrations for DTEC and Shea customers, including SYSPRO work.
  • Give customers regular, clear status updates and manage change requests.
  • Track time accurately against projects for monthly billing.

Modernisation

  • Build and maintain components on our modern stack (Vue, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL) as DTEC modernises.

Ways of working

  • Use Jira and Git, document your changes and hand over cleanly to support.
  • Share knowledge and set good practices for other developers.

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years developing or customising ERP or business software, including customer-facing project work.
  • Visual FoxPro development experience.
  • Production experience with Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL.
  • Strong SQL and data skills.
  • Experience estimating work and delivering to agreed dates; comfortable with billable, time-tracked work.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with non-technical customers.
  • Legally authorized to work in Canada; set up for remote work.

Nice to Have

  • SYSPRO development or customisation experience.
  • Android or Xamarin.
  • Distribution, food & beverage or manufacturing industry experience.
  • Report writing (e.g., Crystal Reports, SSRS) and ERP integration experience.
  • Jira.

How Success Is Measured

  • Reduction in the open development backlog
  • Billable utilisation
  • Projects delivered on time and within estimate
  • Quality of fixes (reopened defects, regressions)
  • Customer satisfaction

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base salary of CAD 100,000–120,000, depending on experience
  • Benefits, PTO and other programs
  • Fully remote work with a collaborative, experienced team

Recruitment Disclaimer

Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Salary: $100,000 – $120,000 / year

Associate Attorney

Because our firm’s headquarters are in New York, this position entails communicating with our main office exclusively via telephone and electronic means (e-mail, Microsoft Teams, etc.).

Candidates should be currently located within the Houston, TX area to be considered for this role.

  • Communicating with opposing parties to resolve/settle claims.
  • Legal research related to simple and complex issues in contract law and other areas of consumer law.
  • While this role is based from home, you will be required to travel for in court appearances.

  • Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience at a law firm

jobs.excerpt: Global Change Facilitator – Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (ATMP) Help shape the future of advanced therapies and accelerate progress across the life sciences industry.
jobs.description:
Global Change Facilitator – Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (ATMP)

Help shape the future of advanced therapies and accelerate progress across the life sciences industry.

Make a difference to the future of medicine

What if your ability to bring people together could help accelerate the development of life-changing therapies?

At BioPhorum, we bring together experts from across the global biopharmaceutical industry to collaborate on shared challenges, exchange knowledge and turn collective expertise into meaningful change. Established in 2004, we are a business-to-business membership organisation working with more than 150 organisations, including 18 of the 20 largest global biopharmaceutical companies. Through our collaborative network, more than 7,000 subject matter experts contribute to over 90 initiatives designed to improve the industry.

We are now looking for a Global Change Facilitator to join our Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (ATMP) Phorum, helping industry experts work together to address some of the most important challenges facing the development and manufacture of advanced therapies.

This is an opportunity to combine your scientific understanding, project management expertise and people skills to help shape industry-wide progress in an exciting and rapidly evolving area of medicine.

Be at the heart of advanced therapies

About BioPhorum ATMP

BioPhorum's Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (ATMP) Phorum supports organisations developing, manufacturing and testing cell, gene and RNA therapies and vaccines. Bringing together more than 600 participants across 24 workstreams and over 30 member organisations, the Phorum creates a collaborative environment where industry experts can tackle shared challenges and develop practical solutions.

From accelerating development and improving commercial manufacturing processes to strengthening analytical standards and navigating regulatory challenges, our members work together to improve the way advanced therapies are developed, controlled and manufactured.

Through dedicated workstreams, members share best practice, benchmark performance, develop industry guidance and tools, and engage with regulatory and standards organisations. The ultimate goal is to encourage greater alignment, consistency and efficiency across the industry, helping advanced therapies progress towards patients.

As Global Change Facilitator, you will play a central role in this collaboration. You will guide subject matter experts through complex discussions, help turn scientific and technical challenges into clearly defined projects, and ensure that collective expertise translates into valuable, tangible outcomes.

What will you be doing?

  • Lead and facilitate workstreams: Guide a portfolio of collaborative initiatives, helping members define priorities, agree objectives and deliver outcomes aligned with BioPhorum's strategy and governance.
  • Bring experts together: Create engaging, inclusive meetings that encourage open discussion, draw out expertise and build strong working relationships across member organisations.
  • Drive projects forward: Apply your project management skills to establish clear deliverables, manage timelines, monitor progress and keep workstreams focused on achieving their objectives.
  • Turn complexity into clarity: Bring together complex scientific, technical and regulatory information and translate it into clear, accessible outputs that support industry-wide understanding and change.
  • Deliver meaningful outputs: Work with members to develop publications, industry guidance, proof of concepts, business cases, benchmarking tools and conference presentations that demonstrate real value.
  • Create impactful events: Collaborate with Phorum colleagues and the events team to plan and facilitate engaging virtual and in-person meetings, workshops and industry events.
  • Build member engagement: Monitor participation, identify emerging challenges and work with colleagues to maintain momentum, strengthen relationships and support member satisfaction.
  • Champion collaboration and continuous improvement: Share member insights, identify opportunities to demonstrate the value of BioPhorum's work and contribute to the ongoing development of our collaborative approach.

Bring your scientific knowledge and people skills together

We are looking for someone who understands science and enjoys bringing people together to solve complex problems. You will be comfortable working with highly knowledgeable experts, navigating technical discussions and turning different perspectives into practical action.

A scientific education or background is essential for this role. Given the technical complexity of advanced therapies, you will need a solid understanding of the scientific environment to engage credibly with subject matter experts and grasp the challenges being discussed. Experience working within the ATMP industry, particularly in cell therapy, gene therapy, RNA therapeutics, advanced therapy development or manufacturing, would be highly advantageous.

You do not need to be the technical expert in every discussion. However, you should have the scientific grounding, curiosity and confidence to understand complex topics, ask insightful questions and help experts move towards a shared outcome.

You will bring:

  • A degree in a relevant scientific discipline, or an equivalent scientific education and background that enables you to engage confidently with complex life sciences topics.
  • Ideally, experience within the advanced therapies industry, such as cell or gene therapy, RNA therapeutics, ATMP development, manufacturing, testing or related regulatory environments.
  • Experience managing projects, programmes or change initiatives, ideally within life sciences, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, CDMOs or related consulting environments.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, build trust, adapt your communication style and bring diverse groups of people on a journey.
  • A collaborative mindset and a genuine enjoyment of facilitating constructive discussions, drawing out information and helping groups reach decisions.
  • The ability to synthesise complex information and communicate it clearly to different audiences.
  • Excellent organisation and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, competing priorities and agreed deadlines.
  • Sound judgement, initiative and a bias towards action, combined with the flexibility to adapt as priorities and discussions evolve.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and the ability to work effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a remote, fast-paced and growing organisation.

Help shape what comes next

If you are scientifically minded, thrive on collaboration and enjoy turning complex challenges into practical solutions, this is an opportunity to use your expertise in a role with a wider industry impact.

At BioPhorum, you will work alongside leading experts and organisations across the global biopharmaceutical sector, helping to develop shared approaches to the challenges shaping advanced therapies.

Location: Home-based, with occasional travel required. You must be able to commit to at least two UK trips and two international trips each year to support our annual events programme.

Ready to help advance the future of advanced therapies?

Apply today and bring your scientific knowledge, collaborative approach and project leadership skills to BioPhorum.

Job Title

Product Strategy Intern

Job Description

UnderwriteMe is an InsurTech company and subsidiary of Pacific Life Re (PL Re), dedicated to transforming the life insurance industry through innovative data and technology products. Our mission is to make insurance more accessible by enabling the future of underwriting and the future of distribution for our clients.

The Protection Platform (PP) is our digital distribution platform that connects advisers and insurers (B2B2C), helping to streamline the protection sales process and make protection easier to buy and sell. The Decision Platform (DP) is our B2B Enterprise Software product that aims to help insurers optimise their underwriting and claims process and realise that future of underwriting & claims. Both play an equally crucial role in achieving the mission.

We are seeking a Business / Product Strategy Intern to support our strategy development within the Protection Platform. As you build context on the company, this may also lead to involvement on the Decision Platform.

Role & Responsibilities

You will work alongside the Head of Strategy, the CPO, and the Product Leadership on both PP and DP. During your internship, you will be focusing on validating growth and expansion opportunities for the PP in the UK and beyond. As part of this role, you will be building an understanding of:

  • Market sizing & dynamics
  • Competitive landscape & our right-to-win
  • Proposition assessment and development
  • Long-term opportunities & moonshots
  • Critical path to launching new offerings and markets

Skills & Experience

  • 3-5+ years’ work experience from a consulting and strategy background
  • Experience working across Product and Tech
  • Currently Studying for an MBA
  • Someone with a keen interest in tech start-ups / scale-ups and preferably the InsurTech sector


Additional information:

  • This is a paid internship position (£25 per hour); you will be provided a defined scope for your first project and will be expected to define and scope out future projects with support of the teams
  • We are open to part-time interns (2-3 days a week to fit around studying)

About UnderwriteMe

UnderwriteMe is an Insurtech software business and subsidiary of Pacific Life Re (PL Re), a global life and pensions reinsurance firm. We have a vision to help everyone purchase protection insurance by using data and disruptive technology to transform our partners and markets in order to make their underwriting processes as quick and efficient as possible.

Our core products are:

• Decision Platform - a B2B enterprise platform that provides a best-in-market Underwriting Rules Engine used by over 30 insurers to power their underwriting decisions. The product is sold across UK & Ireland, Asia-Pacific and North America. The platform combines our engine with technology to source and process third-party information supporting underwriting decisions for insurers. We are already working on capabilities, powered by AI, to make these decisions even more efficient.
• Protection Platform - a B2B2C marketplace used by over 15,000 advisors to power quoting and purchase of protection products in the UK. We currently deliver 16% of the UK markets protection policies and we are already working to increase our reach.

Working for UnderwriteMe

Joining UnderwriteMe means being part of a technology company that is committed to bringing a fresh and dynamic approach to insurance. You’d be working with a team of highly technical experts made up of people with backgrounds in software, fintech, and insurance.

Every person in our global team is valued for the unique qualities they bring to our business and we seek to build their expertise and support their individual ambitions at every step. Of course, we take our work seriously and we know our team can operate under great pressure. We work hard and thrive on achievement, but we also know how to have fun and relax too. We regularly host a range of team building days to strengthen our team's connection with each other and reflect on their successes.

Providing employees with a healthy work-life balance is very important to our culture. We have a wide range of employee benefits and we host regular social activities and wellbeing initiatives. We are also committed to supporting our employee's involvement in their communities, by actively fundraising, hosting charity events, and overseeing volunteering opportunities.

We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at

What will I be doing?

This position plays a key role in supporting the company’s profitable growth through financial analysis and pricing insights. Working within the Pricing team, this individual will leverage financial and operational analysis to support pricing decisions, contract renewals, commercial decision-making, and business performance.

The role works closely with the Client Development organization to provide analytical support for client Requests for Proposals (RFPs), contract renewals, and other pricing-related decisions. This individual will also collaborate with Senior Leadership, Retention, Commercial Finance, Legal, Product Management, and Technology to support key client relationships and ensure accurate, timely execution.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced analyst who enjoys solving problems, building structure, and working in a dynamic environment. As the Pricing team continues to evolve its processes and ways of working, the successful candidate will bring curiosity, initiative, sound judgment, and comfort navigating changing priorities. They will ask thoughtful questions, speak up when clarification is needed, and take ownership of moving work forward.

Direct pricing experience is helpful but not required. Candidates with experience in FP&A, financial analysis, commercial finance, revenue analysis, business analysis, or another analytical function are encouraged to apply.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop financial analyses and pricing recommendations that support client decisions, profitability, and revenue growth.
  • Analyze pricing, margins, and business performance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and support informed decision-making.
  • Provide analytical support for client RFPs, contract renewals, and other pricing-related requests in partnership with Client Development and cross-functional teams.
  • Analyze commercial agreements to ensure alignment between Legal drafts and approved pricing outputs.
  • Utilize the Configure, Price and Quote (CPQ) module to support revenue recognition and billing for subscription-based contracts and ad hoc projects.
  • Collaborate across functions to understand end-to-end pricing and contracting processes, resolve issues, and support change initiatives.
  • Create and maintain data quality checks, including reconciliations, exception reporting, and audit trails, to ensure pricing and contract data accuracy.
  • Manage multiple concurrent contract renewals, analyses, and pricing-related activities while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
  • Partner with stakeholders across the business to gather information, clarify priorities, resolve issues, and support commercial decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes, improve data quality, and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Prepare materials for board meetings, internal presentations, business reporting, and other ad hoc financial analysis projects.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field from an accredited institution.
