ABOUT HAPPY MONEY

Happy Money is a consumer finance company that empowers people to achieve their goals through simple, transparent loans funded by trusted financial institutions. Through its proprietary lending platform, Hive, Happy Money delivers a fully digital experience that simplifies borrowing for consumers and helps credit unions, banks and asset managers diversify balance sheets and scale with confidence.

Happy Money’s end-to-end loan origination and participation programs provide partners with turnkey access to high-performing assets, underpinned by disciplined credit expertise and robust risk management. Together with its lending partners, Happy Money has originated more than $7 billion in loans to help nearly 350,000 people take greater control of their financial futures. Learn more at happymoney.com. View our Employee Privacy Policy here.

Happy Money is a 100% fully distributed company based in the United States. Remote work doesn’t mean less work, we work full-time jobs and show up to them fully every day. To learn more about our values and the way we work, review our Happy Money Way Overview!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an execution-focused Head of Customer Operations to lead our Loan Fulfillment, Customer Experience, and Collections teams. Reporting directly to the Chief Operations Officer you will have full ownership of the entire operations function, including managing operational teams, driving initiatives to enhance efficiency and effectiveness, optimizing the applicant experience, and overseeing key third-party vendor relationships.

This role is instrumental in delivering a seamless, secure, and highly efficient lending experience, with significant emphasis placed on collections effectiveness, streamlining the applicant verifications process, and driving improvements in application-to-funding pull-through rates. You’ll ensure robust risk controls, continuously improve operational processes, and collaborate cross-functionally to scale operations and implement strategies that balance growth, efficiency, customer satisfaction, and rigorous risk management.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and Drive Operational Strategy:Define, track, and evolve critical performance metrics across operations, prioritizing scalability, efficiency, and execution. Proactively optimize processes that enhance verification efficiency, increase pull-through rates, and elevate the applicant and borrower experience.
  • Optimize Loan Application and Verification Processes:Lead efforts to streamline and accelerate the application-to-funding journey. Implement best-in-class verification processes that reduce friction, increase conversion, and support scalable growth.
  • Enhance Collections and Servicing:Lead the development and continuous refinement of collections strategies to improve performance , reduce losses, and maintain exceptional customer interactions throughout the repayment lifecycle.
  • Elevate the Customer and Applicant Experience:Advocate strongly for the Voice of the Customer, ensuring every interaction—from initial application to loan servicing—is frictionless and supportive. Continuously measure and enhance customer satisfaction while balancing growth, risk, and operational efficiency.
  • Vendor and Partner Management:Fully own relationships with third-party service providers, ensuring vendors effectively support collections, underwriting verification processes, fraud detection, and customer service objectives. Ensure strong performance accountability with all external partners.
  • Build a Culture of Operational Excellence:Recruit, mentor, and develop operational leaders and their teams, creating a culture focused on accountability, execution, efficiency, and data driven decision making.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally:Actively collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Finance teams to align operations with broader company objectives, ensuring seamless integration and execution of strategic initiatives.
  • Drive Process and Technology Improvements:Proactively identify and implement automation, be comfortable with implementing AI agents, and advanced analytics that significantly improve operational efficiency, pull-through rates, collections effectiveness, and the overall customer experience.
  • Ensure Compliance and Robust Risk Management:Maintain rigorous compliance practices and embed strong risk controls within loan operations, verifications, servicing, and collections.

Note: This role requires quarterly in-person domestic/international travel for vendor and BPO visits.

ABOUT YOU

  • 10+ years of experience in loan operations, servicing, verifications, and collections, with deep expertise in collections and proven experience optimizing verification processes and improving pull-through rates.
  • 5+ years of senior leadership experience managing high-performing operational teams, demonstrating success in developing talent and fostering accountability and high performance.
  • Track record of optimizing and scaling operations, specifically enhancing collections processes, verification efficiency, and application-to-funding conversion.
  • Strong experience overseeing operational processes related to fraud prevention, verification, and customer support, with demonstrated capability in balancing exceptional customer experiences with risk management and operational efficiency.
  • Proven ability to effectively balance growth initiatives with rigorous compliance and risk management in regulated financial environments.
  • Customer-focused mindset, ensuring all applicant and borrower interactions remain efficient, supportive, and frictionless throughout their lending journey.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations Management, or related field required.
  • Experience in FinTech, consumer lending, personal loans, or high-growth financial services companies.

BONUS POINTS FOR

  • Proven success scaling operations and successfully implementing AI-agents, whether internally developed or through partnerships.
  • Prior experience collaborating or working closely with credit unions, banks, or other financial institutions.

BENEFITS & PERKS

About Us:PMAT is an innovative small business founded with a passion for developing forward-leaning solutions from exceptional people that increase the mission's capability. We focus on designing and building impactful digital solutions that utilize modern cloud, data, and software concepts. Our passion is working on complex and progressive challenges such as edge platform computing, containerizing legacy platforms, distributed data platforms, or heterogeneous data analysis.

We recruit, retain, and foster a team motivated to pursue passions, investigate new ways of doing things, and embody an innovative and entrepreneurial spirit. We believe in being curious about every element of a problem and experiment relentlessly. We foster continuous learning in an environment that encourages positive collaboration and expands our capabilities. We tap into collective intelligence, acknowledging that the most brilliant people may not be in the room. Above all else, we believe that delivering and demonstrating is more potent than a sheet of paper. We are passionate about mission-centric design and delivering effective capabilities to and for the warfighter.

Whether you’re an experienced engineer or just beginning your career, you’ll work alongside experts who are committed to solving mission-critical problems. If you’re passionate about using your skills to make a real difference, apply today and become part of a team that’s shaping the future of defense technology!

About the Role: The Senior Systems Engineer is a full-time, integral role responsible for overseeing multiple subsystems and projects while contributing to high-level system design. This position leads impactful initiatives by assessing and resolving system-wide challenges, developing designs, and maintaining alignment across platforms. The role requires close collaboration with technical leads, project managers, and external government and private sector partners to address risk and scalability concerns while sustaining legacy combat readiness and optimizing complex systems for world-class integrated weapon systems at land and sea.

The successful candidate is delivery-focused, demonstrates leadership abilities and is passionate about designing and developing rapid prototypes through modern approaches and methodologies producing world-class mission architecture supporting the successful development, modernization, and maintenance of systems critical to our warfighters and protecting national security. This position will work collaboratively with other System Engineers, Team Leads, and Program Management to achieve PMAT goals. This is a unique opportunity to drive high-level designs, mentor and develop a team.

Responsibilities:

The Senior Systems Engineer will oversee the complete system lifecycle—from initial concept through to deployment—while defining high-level architecture and establishing robust systems interfaces. This role is responsible for ensuring that all systems meet regulatory standards and stakeholder requirements. In addition, the engineer will mentor junior team members to drive technical excellence and work closely with leadership to ensure that systems solutions are fully aligned with business objectives.

  • Oversee configuration management and system lifecycle, from concept to deployment
  • Develop and design complex network architectures and system infrastructures
  • Define and implement robust interface standards for systems integration
  • Oversee the installation, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of computer systems and networks on Naval ships and land based facilities
  • Ensure optimum functionality and proactive monitoring of system performance
  • Diagnose and resolve system inefficiencies, technical issues, and downtime incidents
  • Implement timely solutions to ensure continuous system availability and performance
  • Maintain detailed documentation of system configurations, network diagrams, and operational procedures
  • Collaborate with managers, technical leads, and external partners to determine system needs and align architecture with business objectives
  • Communicate technical information effectively to non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior engineers and guide team development to drive technical excellence
  • Ensure all systems are compliant with regulatory requirements and industry standards
  • Implement and maintain cybersecurity measures to protect the organization’s IT assets

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Minimum 10 years of systems engineering experience, with at least 5 years supporting DoD or Navy acquisition programs (e.g., NAVSEA, NAVWAR, PEO C4I, PEO Digital).
  • Strong knowledge of systems engineering principles (V-model, Agile, etc.)
  • Familiarity with Navy Modernization Process Management and Operations Manual for ship alteration
  • Knowledge of system design tools and methods. (CAMEO, MATLAB, SysML, or requirements management tools)
  • Proficient knowledge of industry-relevant standards such as the INCOSE SE Handbook
  • Demonstrated ability to develop strategic plans and effectively manage risks
  • Proven ability to lead and deliver large, complex projects successfully
  • Demonstrated aptitude for inspiring, guiding, and aligning teams with strategic objectives
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale, cross-functional engineering projects while mentoring junior engineers and fostering technical excellence
  • Ability to stay up to date with new technologies in the evolving industry to ensure proactive innovation and competitive systems
  • Proven ability to effectively communicate technical information and brief senior government representatives, program leadership, and review boards.
    • Ability to speak publicly and brief senior government officials

Preferred Skills & Experience:

  • Advanced degree from an accredited institution.
  • Demonstrated experience developing System Requirements Specifications (SRS), Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and test documentation (Test Plans, Procedures, Reports) in accordance with DoD systems engineering standards (e.g., MIL-STD-961, MIL-STD-3022, or program-specific SE processes).
  • Demonstrated experience supporting Naval intelligence systems and Over-the-Horizon Targeting (OTH-T) architectures, including familiarity with tactical data links, sensor-to-shooter integration, and intelligence data flows supporting fleet-level situational awareness and targeting decision cycles.
  • Expertise in defining and implementing complex system architectures and interfaces that meet both current and future needs
  • Strong background in developing strategic plans, assessing project risks, and executing effective risk mitigation strategies
  • Experience collaborating and negotiating effectively with both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience following a formal procedure for coordinating system integration activities among multiple teams, ensuring complete coverage of all interfaces
  • Experience with some of the following, or similar:
    • System Design and Architecture
    • Requirements Analysis and Management
    • System Integration and Testing
    • Risk Assessment and Mitigation
    • Documentation and Reporting
    • Configuration Management

Education and Certification Requirements:

  • INCOSE Certified Systems Engineering Professional (CSEP) or similar, preferred

Clearance:

  • Active TS required

jobs.description:
Canada-Based Staff Veterinarian

Location: Remote, Canada

Position Type: Full-Time

Expected Commitment: ~ 40 hours per week

About Vetster & The Role

Vetster expands access to veterinary care by connecting pet owners with licensed veterinarians through a digital platform that supports professional veterinary advice, diagnoses, treatment, and prescriptions.

Vetster is seeking an experienced Staff Veterinarian to provide high-quality virtual veterinary care through the Vetster platform. This is a primarily clinical, fully remote role. The Staff Veterinarian will maintain a consistent virtual appointment caseload, including Vetster marketplace appointments and consultations involving animals cared for through retail and strategic partnerships. In addition to scheduled appointments, the role includes continuity-of-care responsibilities, collaboration with Vetster’s RVT team, and clinical input across other internal teams.

What You’ll Do

Provide Virtual Veterinary Care to Clients

  • Provide virtual assessments, treatment recommendations, and prescriptions within applicable regulatory requirements through the Vetster platform.
  • Identify cases requiring emergency or specialty care and recommend escalation.

Continuity of Care

  • Serve as an Assigned Continuing Veterinarian when the originating Marketplace Veterinarian is unavailable, in accordance with applicable VCPR requirements.
  • Review medical records and support continuity-of-care needs, including:
    • Prescription renewals and fulfillment inquiries
    • Follow-up questions related to established treatment plans
  • Collaborate with the RVT team on escalated cases and cases requiring further review.

Clinical Expertise

  • Provide practical clinical feedback to Product, Engineering, Operations, and other Vetster teams regarding workflows that affect veterinary care.
  • Maintain knowledge of applicable state veterinary telemedicine laws, proposed legislative changes, VCPR requirements, and relevant regulatory changes.

Education & External Engagement

As mutually agreed upon and based on availability, the Staff Veterinarian may also:

  • Participate in media, PR, and industry events.
  • Contribute to educational content for pet owners and veterinarians.

Schedule & Caseload

This role requires an expected commitment of approximately 40 hours per week, inclusive of scheduled appointments, medical records, administrative time, continuity-of-care activities, internal meetings, and clinical follow-up.

  • Appointments with clients are scheduled in 20-minute increments.
  • The anticipated average caseload is approximately 12–16 appointments per day.
  • Appointments are generally scheduled consecutively (varies by demand), with protected time given for meal breaks, medical records, and administrative responsibilities.
  • Veterinarians have flexibility in establishing their schedule while also maintaining consistent Monday through Friday weekday availability.
  • No routine nights, holidays, or on-call responsibilities are expected.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years companion animal clinical experience with a DVM or VMD degree.
  • Active veterinary licensure in good standing within Canada.
  • Willingness and ability to obtain additional provincial licenses.
  • Strong clinical judgment and ability to determine when virtual care is appropriate.
  • Excellent written & verbal communication skills
  • Strong medical record and documentation ability
  • Ability to collaborate with veterinarians, RVTs, and cross-functional teams.

Previous experience in veterinary telemedicine or multi-province practice is considered an asset.

Licensure & Professional Expenses

Vetster will cover veterinary licenses and license renewals required for the role.

Remote Work & Travel

The veterinarian is responsible for providing and maintaining internet access and private workspace needed to perform the role.

Quarterly travel within Canada and/or the continental United States is expected. Vetster will cover or reimburse reasonable expenses associated with required business travel.

Why Join Vetster?

  • The expected salary band for this position is $175,000-$185,000
  • Fully remote veterinary practice with flexible scheduling
  • No routine nights, holidays, or on-call responsibilities
  • Protected medical record and administrative time
  • Vetster-paid required veterinary licenses and renewals
  • Predictable clinical caseload
  • Quarterly company-paid travel
  • Unlimited access to Vetster for your pets.
  • Generous vacation and personal day policy.
  • Comprehensive health and dental benefits for you and your family.
  • Competitive salary with market alignment.
  • RRSP matching and Employee Stock Option Plan.
  • Opportunities for career growth and international assignments.
  • A culture of inclusivity, equity, and team engagement.
  • Opportunities to contribute to the continued growth of virtual veterinary care

Recruitment Process

Our recruitment process includes:

  • A 30-minute introductory video call with People & Culture
  • A 45-minute clinical interview with members of Vetster’s Operations and Veterinary teams
  • A 45-minute final-round interview with members of Vetster leadership

Vetster uses a third-party provider to conduct background checks following an offer

Ready to Make a Difference?

Embark on a fulfilling journey with us to shape the future of pet healthcare. If you're driven by innovation, collaboration, and a love for pets, apply now to join our mission-driven team.

Accommodations

Vetster welcomes and encourages applications from everyone! We are committed to accommodating candidates in ways that will make them comfortable and successful throughout the hiring process - both physically and mentally. These accommodations are available at every stage of the application process upon request.

AI Use Statement

For this role, we will use AI screening in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) to identify keywords and minimum qualifications as well as note-taking in interviews. These tools will assist us in pinpointing qualified candidates and moving the recruitment process along at a progressive pace. If you have any questions about our use of AI, please reach out to us.

Salary: $175,000-$185,000 CAD

jobs.title: Specialist, Industrial AI & Digital Skills (2026-0200)
jobs.excerpt: The Information and Communications Technology Council (ICTC) is seeking a Specialist, Industrial AI & Digital Skills to serve as the organization's embedded Applied AI Subject Matter Expert within its learning and workforce development team.
jobs.description:
The Information and Communications Technology Council (ICTC) is seeking a Specialist, Industrial AI & Digital Skills to serve as the organization's embedded Applied AI Subject Matter Expert within its learning and workforce development team.

This role combines hands-on AI expertise with learner-centered facilitation. The successful candidate is both a practitioner and an educator: someone who builds, evaluates, and demonstrates AI-powered solutions while helping learners, employers, and workforce-development partners understand and apply them in real-world contexts.

Reporting to the Manager, Digital Training & Industry Transformation, the Senior Specialist will play a critical role in ensuring that ICTC's AI and digital-skills programming is technically accurate, current, practical, and aligned to labour market demand. The role is responsible for validating AI-related learning content and credentials, facilitating learner cohorts, coaching participants through applied projects, and acting as a trusted internal resource on emerging AI tools, technologies, and workplace applications.

The ideal candidate combines strong facilitation and curriculum expertise with demonstrated experience building or implementing AI-enabled workflows, automations, copilots, agents, or other AI-powered solutions in organizational environments. They are equally comfortable evaluating technical training content, mentoring learners, facilitating workshops, and translating complex technologies into practical business value.

Key Responsibilities

Applied AI Leadership & Technical Expertise

  • Serve as ICTC's primary internal Applied AI Subject Matter Expert across workforce development and digital skills initiatives.
  • Build, test, evaluate, and demonstrate practical AI-enabled workflows, automations, agents, and productivity solutions that can be used in learning environments and employer-facing engagements.
  • Evaluate emerging industrial AI tools, platforms, and technologies to assess their relevance for workforce development, digital skills training, and employer adoption.
  • Develop practical demonstrations, use cases, project templates, and hands-on exercises that help learners understand how AI can be applied in workplace settings.
  • Provide technical guidance and coaching to learners undertaking AI-related projects, workplace placements, and implementation activities.
  • Advise internal teams on AI trends, opportunities, limitations, responsible use considerations, and adoption approaches.
  • Maintain current knowledge of developments in generative AI, automation, workflow integration, prompt engineering, data analytics, and productivity technologies.

Learning Facilitation & Learner Success

  • Facilitate live, virtual, and hybrid learning experiences for learners participating in AI and digital skills programs.
  • Deliver engaging workshops, webinars, office hours, project reviews, and coaching sessions that support learner success.
  • Help learners translate theoretical concepts into practical implementation through hands-on projects and applied learning activities.
  • Foster inclusive and supportive learning environments encourage participation, collaboration, experimentation, and continuous learning.
  • Monitor learner engagement and progress throughout the program lifecycle and identify risks to completion or participation.
  • Provide individualized guidance, coaching, and interventions to support learner achievement.
  • Collaborate with program teams to integrate applied learning opportunities throughout the learner journey.

AI & Digital Skills Content Validation, and Platform Management

  • Evaluate, curate and validate AI, automation, data analytics, and digital-skills content sourced from third-party providers and industry partners.
  • Assess learning content for technical accuracy, industry relevance, practical use case, pedagogical quality, accessibility, instructional quality, alignment with labour-market needs and ICTC objectives, maintaining an updated library of approved courses and credentials
  • Review and recommend learning pathways, certifications, micro credentials, and training resources that align with program objectives.
  • Identify outdated, obsolete, or low-value content and recommend replacements or enhancements.
  • Ensure curriculum remains relevant as AI technologies, workplace practices, and employer needs evolve.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with third-party training vendors and content partners; coordinate access, enrollment, licensing, or partnership agreements as required.

Digital Readiness Assessment & Skills Mapping

  • Administer learner assessments to evaluate digital literacy, technical readiness, and learning needs.
  • Develop and maintain learner skills profiles and pathway recommendations.
  • Match learners to appropriate learning journeys, training options, and credential opportunities.
  • Identify recurring skills gaps and learning challenges within learner cohorts.
  • Use assessment insights to improve curriculum sequencing, learner support, and program outcomes.

Participant Onboarding, Progress Monitoring & Engagement

  • Schedule, onboard, and orient learners to the platform and program expectations.
  • Monitor each learner's progress, proactively identify those at risk of falling behind or disengaging, and escalate concerns with recommended interventions.
  • Design and lead learning-engagement strategies discussion groups, manage learning-community spaces, webinars, and applied challenges and recruit and coordinate industry practitioners, AI experts, and sector leaders as guest speakers.
  • Collaborate closely with program teams to integrate live, applied AI facilitation touchpoints throughout the learner journey.

Program Planning, Quality Assurance & Reporting

  • Support program planning, scheduling, and delivery activities.
  • Track learner participation, progression, completion, and outcome metrics.
  • Establish and monitor learning-quality indicators and program KPIs.
  • Contribute to program evaluation, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Produce insights and recommendations based on learner outcomes, participant feedback, and performance data.
  • Identify risks to learner success, program targets, or deliverables and recommend corrective actions.
  • Ensure program delivery aligns with funder requirements, internal standards, and quality-assurance practices.

Curriculum Design & Continuous Improvement

  • Curate and assemble blended learning curricula; develop and validate learning outcomes, competency frameworks, and assessment criteria.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs for course quality, learner progression, completion rates, and post-program outcomes.
  • Support the creation and continuous improvement of AI and digital skills training programs.
  • Conduct structured content reviews every 6–12 months (and scan continuously between them) to keep curriculum technically current, replacing deprecated tools and references with current alternatives.
  • Engage employers and host organizations to gather insight on emerging skills needs and workplace AI-adoption trends, using this to keep training aligned with real-world employer expectations.
  • Support the development and validation of digital credentials and micro-credentials and recognize prior learning where a learner can already demonstrate a target skill.

What We Are Looking For

Education

  • Post-secondary degree in Instructional Design, Education Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent experience as an educator, trainer, or applied-AI practitioner will be considered.
  • Graduate degree, and formal credentials in instructional design, e-learning, or digital pedagogy (e.g., CPLP or equivalent), are strong assets.
  • Credentials or certifications in AI, machine learning, data analytics, automation, or digital transformation are strongly preferred.
  • Candidates with a background in technology education (cloud computing, telecommunications, IoT, AI) will be prioritized.

Work Experience

  • Demonstrated experience applying AI-powered tools, automation solutions, agents, data-driven workflows, or digital technologies to address real-world challenges in industrial environments.
  • 5-7 years of relevant experience across applied AI, digital skills training, workforce development, learning facilitation, instructional design, technology enablement, or digital transformation. Equivalent combinations of education, industry experience, and applied AI expertise will be considered.
  • Experience facilitating adult learning and coaching diverse learner groups.
  • Demonstrated experience curating and evaluating third-party technical training content from major online platforms.
  • Experience designing and administering digital-readiness or skills assessments and building corresponding learning pathways.
  • Proven experience scheduling, onboarding, and monitoring learner cohorts, and establishing learning-outcome frameworks, KPIs, and quality-assurance processes.
  • Experience with LMS and project-management tools (e.g., Wrike, Microsoft Project, or equivalent).
  • Experience national program delivery is strongly preferred; non-profit, government-funded, or workforce-development experience is an asset.
  • Familiarity with Canada's digital-skills ecosystem, AI education landscape, and WIL programs is an asset.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bilingual proficiency in English and French written and spoken is considered an asset.
  • Applied AI fluency: proficiency in automation, prompt engineering, workflow integration, data analytics, AI agents build and low-code/no-code technologies - paired with the ability to teach these concepts accessibly.
  • Deep expertise in instructional design, curriculum architecture, and e-learning best practices.
  • Strong knowledge of major third-party technical training platforms and their content ecosystems.
  • Proficiency with LMS, e-learning authoring/curation tools, and Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace.
  • Strong analytical skills for defining and tracking learning KPIs and quality metrics.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-engagement skills; comfort explaining technical concepts in plain language to non-technical learners.
  • Ability to work independently, lead with limited precedent, and manage multiple curricula and program streams in a fast-paced environment.

Are You?

  • An applied AI practitioner and educator — Do you bring genuine, hands-on industrial AI experience and the ability to make that knowledge accessible to learners and employers?
  • Curriculum architect — Do you design rigorous, engaging learning journeys matched to where learners are and where they need to go?
  • A discerning course curator — Can you cut through hundreds of online courses to identify the ones that are technically excellent, current, and right for the learner?
  • A digital-readiness expert— Can you assess where learners truly are and build skills maps that set them up for success?
  • Analytically rigorous, ethical, dependable, collaborative, and a continuous learner committed to inclusive, equitable learning across Canada.

Why Join Us?

Be part of a dynamic, mission-driven, entrepreneurial organization advancing Canada's competitive advantage in the digital economy; lead high-impact programs that shape the future of Canadian businesses; and work in an agile, collaborative, forward-thinking environment.

Position Details

  • Location: Remote
  • Term: 12-month term contract with competitive salary, benefits, vacation and personal time

Additional notes:

  • ICTC is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. If you require accommodation measures during any phase of the hiring process, please notify us as soon as possible. All information received in relation to accommodation requests will be kept confidential.

About ICTC

ICTC is a neutral, not-for-profit national centre of expertise with the mission of strengthening Canada's digital advantage in the global economy. For over 30 years, and with a team of 80+ experts, we have delivered forward-looking research, practical policy advice, and capacity building solutions for individuals and businesses. Our goal is to ensure that technology is utilized to drive economic growth and innovation, and that Canada's workforce remains competitive on a global scale.

ICTC respectfully acknowledges that ICTC headquarters is on the ancestral and unceded territory of the Algonquin Anishinaabeg People.

El Rol:

El TL supervisa la calidad del código, orienta las mejores prácticas de CI/CD e infraestructura y facilita la resolución de bloqueos sin enfocarse en el desarrollo directo de código.

Carga Operativa:

80% - Gestión Consultiva, Cliente y Equipo: Reuniones ejecutivas, diseño y sustentación de arquitectura, alineación con stakeholders, coordinación con equipos del cliente (ej. redes/seguridad), liderazgo técnico y ceremonias ágiles.

20% - Supervisión Técnica y Arquitectura: Revisión y supervisión de código fuente (code reviews), definición de infraestructura como código (IaC), soporte técnico a arquitectura y optimización de soluciones.

Responsabilidades:

  • Relación Consultiva y Gestión Ejecutiva (Cliente): Actuar como interlocutor técnico estratégico. Dirigir discusiones de arquitectura, gestionar expectativas, sostener conversaciones difíciles y guiar al cliente en decisiones técnicas de alto valor.

  • Diseño e Integración de Arquitectura Cloud & Datos: Diseñar arquitecturas sólidas en Azure (80-90% del ecosistema), con integración de plataformas de datos (Databricks / Fabric) y patrones de Inteligencia Artificial (RAG, Agentes, AI Foundry).

  • Supervisión y Revisión de Código: Auditar y supervisar la calidad del código desarrollado por el equipo (Python, SQL, PySpark, JS/TS, C#/.NET), velando por las buenas prácticas y estándares sin necesidad de realizar desarrollo directo.

  • Implementación de Redes y Seguridad Aplicada: Diseñar e implementar con IaC (Terraform) la conectividad segura de la plataforma de datos (Private Endpoints, Hub-Spoke, Private Link) articulándose con el equipo de red del cliente.

  • DevOps e Infraestructura como Código (IaC): Promover e implementar prácticas de integración y despliegue continuo (CI/CD) e infraestructura automatizada mediante Terraform o Bicep.

  • Liderazgo Técnico y Mentoría: Guiar al equipo asignado, resolver bloqueos, hacer seguimiento a entregables y asegurar la excelencia técnica en la ejecución.

  • Gobierno y Cumplimiento Básico: Aplicar conceptos fundamentales de gobernanza de datos, seguridad y buenas prácticas de desarrollo seguro.

Requisitos:

  • Educación y Formación Académica

    • Título Profesional: Ingeniería de Sistemas, Computación, Electrónica, Datos o carreras afines.

    • Formación Complementaria: Cursos o conocimientos en Arquitectura de Datos, Liderazgo Tecnológico, Gobierno de Datos o Estrategia Cloud.

  • Experiencia Laboral

    • Entre 7 y 10 años de experiencia general en tecnología, con experiencia comprobada liderando soluciones de arquitectura de datos/cloud e interactuando de forma directa con clientes.

Competencias Técnicas:

  • Nube & Redes

    • Azure (Avanzado - 80/90% del trabajo): Dominio amplio del ecosistema Azure.

    • AWS / GCP (Deseable): Nivel conceptual para entender equivalencias y sostener conversaciones multinube con clientes.

    • Redes Cloud: Comprensión clara e implementación en Terraform de esquemas tipo Hub-Spoke, Private Link, Private Endpoints (para Storage, Databricks, SQL) e integración con redes corporativas.

  • Datos & Analítica

    • Databricks vs. Microsoft Fabric: Dominio fuerte en al menos una de las dos plataformas con base sólida en Apache Spark/PySpark. Se valora la disposición para aprender la otra herramienta según requerimiento del proyecto.

  • Inteligencia Artificial Aplicada (Conceptos e Integración)

    • Entendimiento de arquitecturas de IA Generativa: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), KAG, CAG, integración con Azure AI Search y Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, considerando aspectos de seguridad e integración con la plataforma de datos. (No se requiere ser especialista puro en IA; las brechas específicas se pueden nivelar internamente).

  • Lenguajes de Programación (Nivel Revisión y Supervisión)

    • Principales: Python, SQL, PySpark.

    • Secundarios / Desarrollo Web: JavaScript / TypeScript (React, Angular, Next.js).

    • Ocasionales: C# / .NET. (Nota: El TL no codifica en el día a día, pero debe contar con la capacidad técnica para auditar, revisar PRs y supervisar código en estos stacks).

  • Estándares y Normativas (Nivel Conceptual / Plus)

    • Conocimiento general y de contexto sobre normativas y marcos como OWASP (evaluación de código), ISO y SOX. (Saber qué son y su propósito es suficiente; no se exige nivel especialista).

Ваша робота допомагатиме створювати рішення, завдяки яким фармацевтичні компанії швидше виводять інновації на ринок, а люди в усьому світі отримують кращий доступ до інформації про здоров’я. Leah empowers enterprises to build, orchestrate, and govern intelligent AI agents across legal, procurement, finance, and beyond. Founded in 2015, Leah automates complex workflows, connects data silos, and drives measurable ROI at scale.

Trusted by over 400 global enterprises and backed by leading investors including Insight Partners and SoftBank, Leah, a ContractPod Technologies Limited company, has been recognized as a CLM Visionary by Gartner for five consecutive years and a Leader in the 2025 IDC MarketScape. Headquartered in London with offices worldwide, we are helping enterprises build the AI intelligent infrastructure of the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Leah is redefining how enterprises run their most complex business processes. What began as AI for legal teams has grown into an enterprise orchestration platform: Maestro, our super-orchestrator, and the Leah Agentic OS coordinate pre-built domain agents across Legal, Procurement, and Finance to turn fragmented, manual workflows into connected, autonomous ones.

We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Executive who is a true hunter: someone who builds their own pipeline from scratch, leads consultative conversations with General Counsel, CPOs, and CFOs, and closes complex, multi-stakeholder deals. You won’t be handed a book of business. You’ll build one, and help define how the enterprise buys agentic AI.

  • Sell across the C-suite. Engage General Counsel, Chief Procurement Officers, CFOs, and CIOs/CAIOs, often in the same deal, and align them around a shared outcome.
  • Be a consultant, not a pitch. Diagnose cross-functional pain such as contract-to-invoice leakage, supplier risk, spend visibility, and manual reconciliation, then design solutions that map Leah’s agents to measurable business value.
  • Build the business case. Quantify ROI and partner with solutions engineering to scope proofs of concept that prove value quickly, even in organizations with messy data or legacy ERP environments.
  • Land and expand. Win an initial use case in one function and grow it across Legal, Procurement, and Finance into a platform relationship.

  • Consistently exceed targets in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where every deal you close shapes the company’s trajectory.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Proven enterprise hunter. 8+ years of enterprise software sales, with a consistent record of exceeding quota on net-new logos you sourced yourself.
  • Domain credibility. Consultative selling experience into Legal, Finance, or Procurement buyers. Familiarity with how these functions operate, from contracting and sourcing to procure-to-pay and financial close, lets you speak their language from the first call.
  • Complex deal mastery. A track record of closing six- and seven-figure deals with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, and rigorous procurement, legal, and InfoSec reviews.

  • Builder’s mentality. Comfortable with ambiguity, energized by a fast-moving startup environment, and motivated to help shape a new category.
  • Education. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. A background in law, finance, procurement, or professional services consulting is highly valued.
  • Be where the deals happen. Willingness to travel to meet clients, partners, and attend industry events.

  • Follow an assigned daily schedule with a degree of independence, effectively managing multiple concurrent tasks while exercising sound judgment to prioritize work activities and allocate time efficiently in accordance with established procedures and guidelines.
  • Maintain a high level of productivity and be able to work within or close to most Standard Repair Times.

You’re a skilled technician who enjoys solving problems and delivering reliable service in the field. You also have the following:

Minimum Requirements

  • A high school diploma/GED and 3 years of experience in a related field; or any degree/certification above a high school diploma/GED with one year of related work experience; or 5 years of related work experience without a degree.

  • ASE T5 (Suspension) certification
  • ASE T6 (Electrical and Electronic Systems)
  • ASE T7 (HVAC) certification
  • ASE 608/609 certification

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift, bend, climb, stand and walk for extended periods of time and perform moderately heavy physical work as required.
  • Ability to perform physical tasks for extended periods, including repetitive movements and activities.
  • Ability to accurately judge distances and determine the location and position of objects in relation to oneself.

As a Senior GCP Platform Enablement Engineer, you will design and implement infrastructure, identity, networking, and security controls that enable safe, enterprise-scale adoption of cloud services. You will codify all infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, policies, and compliance guardrails to deliver a repeatable, auditable platform ready for regulatory oversight.

  • Policy & Compliance as Code: Define and enforce guardrails using GCP Organization Policy, OPA/Rego, Terraform policy checks, or equivalent tooling to provide audit-ready evidence.
  • Service Enablement: Onboard enterprise cloud and platform services into production along with the controls, patterns, and runbooks needed for safe consumption.

ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Web Software Engineer III who will contribute to meaningful, real-world outcomes that have a lasting impact for customers and the business. In this role, you’ll build and scale experiences for hunters as part of the Hunt team. You’ll support onX's goal of delivering a best-in-class Hunt experience from onboarding through the season. You’ll take ownership of your work, collaborate closely with partners across the organization, and help move initiatives forward in an environment where priorities evolve, learning is celebrated, and you’re encouraged to keep stretching your skills. This role will report to an Engineering Manager.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

  • Build, support, and evolve our web products for hunters using technologies like TypeScript, Vue, GraphQL (Apollo Client), and Mapbox
  • Own technical solutions from ideation through delivery, collaborating in decisions about architecture, performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability
  • Partner with Product, Design, QA, and engineers across teams to deliver cohesive, high-quality customer experiences and navigate cross-team dependencies
  • Run and instrument A/B tests and feature rollouts using Split, Eppo, and Amplitude, to measure impact and make data-informed decisions
  • Raise the quality bar through design reviews, mentorship, and frontend best practices across teams
  • Monitor production health and participate in triaging and resolving incidents affecting web experiences
  • Write unit and end-to-end tests using Jest, Vitest, Cypress, and/or Playwright
  • Look for opportunities to embed AI as a repeatable co-pilot in daily workflows by integrating experimentation into real work, and continuously refining its use with sound judgment and validation.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Four (4) or more years of professional software development experience is required, where at least two (2) years were focused on web client development
  • You have a strong foundation in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, and browser fundamentals
  • Experience with modern web frontend frameworks such as Vue, React, or Angular
  • Experience working with REST APIs and/or Apollo Client with GraphQL
  • Experience writing unit tests with Jest or Vitest
  • A strong sense of ownership and a get stuff done attitude
  • A willingness to collaborate, provide and receive mentorship, and advocacy for the customer experience
  • Willingness to flex across and contribute to platforms outside of Web, such as mobile clients or backend, when team priorities require it
  • A strong curiosity for exploring new technologies, including AI
  • A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.
  • Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.
  • Ability to travel on occasion for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

  • Experience with TypeScript and Vue
  • Familiarity with experimentation and analytics tooling - e.g., Split/Eppo, client event instrumentation with Amplitude
  • Experience with Mapbox or other mapping tools
  • Experience across other platforms (mobile and backend)
  • Familiarity with caching using Apollo Client for GraphQL
  • Experience writing end-to-end tests with Playwright or Cypress

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, we are open to considering candidates ranging in two levels (level II and level III). Spanning these levels, applicants can expect to make between $130,000 - $153,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based on experience, skills, certifications, and education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and a potential annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

  • Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan

Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA)

Remote | Chiropractic Clinic | 30 Hours/Week | $5-$6.50/hour
performance-based increase after 6 months

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly capable Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA) to support the overall operational health of a busy healthcare clinic. This role is ideal for someone who is very sharp, proactive, detail-oriented, emotionally intelligent, and able to take ownership of important clinic workflows with minimal supervision.

This is not a basic task-following role. The ideal candidate must be able to think ahead, identify operational gaps, take initiative, and help remove administrative and billing-related tasks from the provider's plate.

We are looking for someone with excellent English communication skills, strong executive presence, high accountability, and the ability to build a trust-based working relationship with the provider and care team.

Key Responsibilities

Insurance Verification

Verify patient insurance after the patient checks in, typically around 15 minutes after the scheduled appointment time. Ensure all insurance information is accurate, updated, and properly documented.

Denied Claims Management

Review denied claims, identify denial reasons, and assist with claim reprocessing. Track issues, follow up on missing information, and help prevent repeat claim errors.

EOB Processing

Review and process Explanation of Benefits documents. Help organize, validate, and clear EOB backlogs while ensuring billing and insurance documentation is accurate.

Patient Balance Resolution

Review outstanding insurance balances and patient account issues. Track unresolved balances, identify the source of the issue, and coordinate next steps for resolution.

Claims Processing

Support claims-related workflows, including Cigna and Veterans Affairs claims. Ensure claims are reviewed, tracked, and escalated when necessary.

Payment Coordination

Assist with vendor payment coordination, including check payments when needed. Ensure payment-related tasks are completed accurately and on time.

SOAP Note Monitoring

Monitor SOAP note completion, accuracy, and compliance. Track missing, incomplete, or delayed documentation and communicate concerns appropriately.

Appointment Tracking

Track missed appointments, canceled appointments, and scheduling trends. Identify patterns that may affect clinic revenue, patient flow, or provider productivity.

Reports and Operational Tracking

Prepare reports on outstanding balances, missed appointments, canceled appointments, EOB backlog, denied claims, and other operational metrics. Reports should include clear insights and practical recommendations when needed.

Team Coordination

Support smooth communication between the provider, care team, and administrative staff. Help ensure updates are clearly shared, priorities are followed through, and important tasks are not missed.

Operational Support

Proactively identify workflow gaps, billing concerns, documentation delays, scheduling issues, and patient account problems. Recommend practical solutions to improve clinic efficiency.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant

  • Experience supporting a US healthcare practice

  • Experience with insurance verification, EOBs, claims, denied claims, patient balances, or billing support

  • Exposure to CPT and ICD-10 codes

  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Strong executive presence and professional communication style

  • Must be a Mac OS user

  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  • Proven leadership, ownership, or high-accountability experience in a previous role

Required Soft Skills

  • Proactive and able to anticipate needs before being asked

  • Highly detail-oriented with billing, documentation, and reporting tasks

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Emotionally intelligent and patient when working with a busy provider

  • Confident, professional, and organized in communication

  • Able to take personal responsibility for assigned work

  • Resourceful and self-motivated when learning new workflows

  • Trustworthy, dependable, and comfortable handling sensitive information

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience supporting a chiropractic clinic

  • Experience with Cigna or Veterans Affairs claims

  • Experience clearing EOB or billing backlogs

  • Experience preparing operational or billing reports

  • Experience mentoring, training, or supporting new team members

  • Experience working closely with a clinic owner, provider, or executive-level leader

Schedule and Compensation

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday

  • Hours: 6 hours per day, 30 hours per week

  • Rate: $6 per hour

  • Work Setup: Remote

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who does not wait to be told every step. This person should be observant, organized, and confident enough to identify what needs attention.

They should be able to manage detailed billing and administrative tasks while also thinking about the bigger picture of clinic operations. The right candidate will be sharp, emotionally intelligent, highly reliable, and capable of becoming a trusted operational support partner for the provider and care team.

🙌 The role

As a Senior Full Stack Developer at Boundless Life, your mission is to build the technology that powers a seamless experience for families living, learning and exploring the world.

You will play a key role in developing and scaling our digital ecosystem, from our admissions and booking platforms to our family community app and internal operational tools.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who combines strong technical expertise with a product mindset, takes ownership of complex challenges and cares deeply about the quality, reliability and maintainability of what they build.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and business stakeholders to turn complex operational needs into intuitive, scalable solutions that create real value for families and our teams.

A key part of the role will be balancing speed of delivery with engineering excellence — helping us move fast without compromising code quality, system reliability or long-term scalability.

We’re also looking for someone who embraces AI-powered development, modern engineering practices and continuous improvement to help us build smarter and more efficiently.

🎯 Key responsibilities will include:

1. Full Stack Product Development

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable applications across our customer-facing platforms and internal operational systems.
  • Own features end-to-end, from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment and production monitoring.
  • Build intuitive, responsive and performant user interfaces that deliver a premium customer experience.
  • Develop reliable backend services, APIs, integrations and data models that support complex business workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Design to translate business requirements into practical, elegant technical solutions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to simplify functionality, improve user experiences and reduce technical complexity.

2. Software Architecture & Engineering Excellence

  • Contribute to architectural decisions that ensure our technology remains scalable, secure and maintainable as Boundless grows.
  • Write clean, modular, well-tested and reusable code, following modern software engineering principles.
  • Identify and eliminate technical debt, duplicated logic, performance bottlenecks and fragile implementations.
  • Champion engineering best practices, including separation of concerns, automated testing, documentation and code reviews.
  • Design robust workflows that account for edge cases, failures, data consistency and transactional integrity.
  • Ensure critical business operations, particularly payments, bookings and customer data, are implemented with strong reliability and error-handling standards.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and challenge approaches that introduce unnecessary complexity or long-term maintenance risks.

3. Platform Reliability, Security & Performance

  • Take ownership of the stability, performance and reliability of the systems you develop.
  • Implement appropriate monitoring, logging and error-handling mechanisms to identify and resolve issues proactively.
  • Investigate production incidents, identify root causes and implement sustainable fixes rather than temporary workarounds.
  • Optimize database queries, API performance and application responsiveness.
  • Apply security best practices across authentication, authorization, data protection and third-party integrations.
  • Build resilient integrations with external services, including payment providers, communication platforms and other business-critical systems.
  • Ensure changes are deployed safely, with appropriate testing, rollback strategies and consideration for existing users and workflows.

4. AI-Powered Development & Continuous Improvement

  • Actively leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate implementation, debugging, testing and code quality.
  • Explore opportunities to use AI and automation to improve development workflows and engineering productivity.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment when using AI-generated code, ensuring all implementations meet our quality, security and maintainability standards.
  • Contribute to improving development processes, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and deployment practices.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend practical improvements that deliver measurable value.
  • Help establish an engineering culture that combines modern tooling, rapid experimentation and disciplined execution.

5. Technical Collaboration & Leadership

  • Collaborate with Product to understand the business context behind requirements and help shape effective technical solutions.
  • Take ownership of technical decisions within your scope, clearly communicating trade-offs, risks and dependencies.
  • Provide thoughtful, constructive code reviews that improve quality and help other developers grow.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers and contribute to raising engineering standards across the team.
  • Break down complex initiatives into manageable deliverables with realistic estimates and clear technical requirements.

  • Meaningful impact – create environments where children and families thrive together
  • Work-life integration – structured schedules with time to explore and recharge

  • Family benefits - Enjoy discounted tuition for your children at our Boundless Schools

🚀 What we’re looking for

Technical experience

    • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with significant experience building and maintaining payment systems, e-commerce, CRM or booking systems
    • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, Hotwire, React including modern frontend architecture, state management and performance optimization.

About Niyam IT (Niyam)

Niyam was founded in 2007 by a group of consultants who shared a unique vision: a technology company steeped in orderly process yet driven by passion and innovation. For nearly two decades, we have served the U.S. Federal government delivering mission-critical IT solutions across Emergency Preparedness and Response, Civilian Agency Services, and Law Enforcement and Public Safety.

Niyam is CMMI DEV Level 3 accredited and ISO certified (ISO 9001:2015, ISO/IEC 20000-1, ISO/IEC 27001), and holds an active CMMC Level 2 certification. We are proud to be recognized as a Best Places to Work by The Washington Post (2025) and USA Today (2026).

What We Offer:

  • Flexible Work Hours: Life doesn’t always fit into a 9-to-5 schedule. We offer flexibility to help you manage your work-life balance effectively.
  • Remote Work: Niyam understands the value of flexibility. We offer remote work.
  • Career Growth: Niyam is not just a job; it’s a career journey. We provide a supportive environment for your professional development and offer fully paid opportunities for training and advancement within the company.
  • Great People: Our people are the blueprint of who Niyam is to the industry and community.
  • Great Environment: Niyam fosters a great environment where innovation, collaboration, and personal growth thrive.
  • Diversity & Inclusion: We believe in the strength of diverse perspectives. Your unique ideas are welcomed and celebrated every day at Niyam.

Join us in creating a workplace where innovation, diversity, and well-being thrive. Your journey at Niyam awaits. Apply today!

Niyam is seeking a Principal Engineer, GIS / Geospatial Solutions to serve as the company's senior-most hands-on technical authority for geospatial engineering. This individual will define technical strategy and reference architecture for our GIS solution accelerators (GeoCube, SPHERE, RisQ), serve as lead Solution Architect on GIS-focused proposals and captures, and represent Niyam externally as a recognized geospatial thought leader through technical publications and conference speaking. The role combines deep hands-on delivery across active federal contracts with enterprise-level influence on Niyam's geospatial technical direction and growth strategy, and requires the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance to support Niyam's continued expansion into DoD and Intelligence Community work.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership & Strategy
    • Serve as the company-wide expert and recognized thought leader in GIS/geospatial engineering, setting technical direction for GeoCube, SPHERE, RisQ, and related capabilities.
    • Define technical strategy, reference architectures, and engineering standards for geospatial data ingestion, the Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) data architecture, and the Model Lifecycle Management Framework.
    • Solve the organization's most complex or ambiguous geospatial and spatial-analytics challenges, from data fusion and geoprocessing to real-time situational awareness dashboards.
    • Collaborate closely with Niyam's Technical Directors (GIS, Solutions Engineering, Data Analytics) to align geospatial strategy with enterprise technical direction.
    • Drive innovation, such as AI/ML-enabled geospatial analytics and predictive risk modeling, that materially improves platform capability, performance, or revenue.
    Solution Architecture & Delivery
    • Serve as the primary Solution Architect on GIS-related engagements, providing hands-on architecture and delivery leadership across multiple active contracts/projects concurrently.
    • Design and oversee geodatabase architecture, geoprocessing models, and cloud-native geospatial pipelines that meet performance, security, and scalability requirements.
    • Resolve high-impact technical risks and escalations across GIS programs, ensuring solutions align with client mission needs and Niyam engineering standards.
    • Directly influence revenue and CPAR/customer-satisfaction performance by shaping technical strategy and solution quality across multiple projects.
    Business Development & Proposal Leadership
    • Act as lead Solution Architect and technical author on GIS-focused proposals and capture efforts, defining win themes, technical differentiators, and solution strategy.
    • Advise capture leadership and executives on technical feasibility, innovation opportunities, and competitive positioning for geospatial pursuits.
    • Support orals preparation, client technical due diligence, and solution demonstrations as the geospatial subject matter expert.
    • Partner with the GIS Technical Director and capture teams to protect and grow revenue through differentiated, credible geospatial solution offerings.
    Thought Leadership & External Representation
    • Author and publish technical blog posts, white papers, and case studies that position Niyam IT as an innovator in geospatial intelligence and disaster/risk analytics.
    • Speak at industry conferences, client forums, and technical webinars as a recognized geospatial subject matter expert, building Niyam's brand and pipeline visibility.
    • Represent Niyam in professional GIS/geospatial communities (e.g., Esri User Conferences, GEOINT, FedGeoDay) to strengthen market positioning and teaming relationships.
    Mentorship & Organizational Growth
    • Mentor engineers at all levels (Associate Engineer through Staff Engineer/Lead Architect) on geospatial engineering practices and career growth.
    • Make substantial contributions to the GIS/Geospatial Center of Competency (CoC), including standards, training materials, and reusable technical assets.
    • Support hiring and technical interviews for geospatial roles across the organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Top Secret (TS) security clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in GIS, Geography, Computer Science, Geospatial Engineering, or a related field (equivalent experience considered in lieu of degree).
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in GIS/geospatial engineering, including architecture-level design of geospatial platforms and analytics solutions.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with the Esri ArcGIS platform (ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro), geodatabase design, and geoprocessing model development.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting cloud-native, scalable geospatial data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) including data pipelines and API-enabled analytics.
  • Proficiency in Python and/or other languages used for geospatial data engineering, automation, and analytics.
  • Proven track record leading technical proposal content, solution architecture, and capture support for federal government contracts.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and driving technical standards across teams or programs.
  • One or more industry-recognized certifications of considerable difficulty in a relevant technical discipline (e.g., Esri Technical Certification, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, GISP).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience authoring technical publications and presenting to technical and executive audiences.

Preferred Skills

  • Active Top Secret clearance or prior DoD/Intelligence Community clearance eligibility.
  • Experience with hazard risk modeling, emergency management, or disaster response platforms (e.g., FEMA, DHS, or similar mission areas).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML-enabled geospatial analytics, predictive modeling, or the Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) data architecture pattern.
  • Prior publication of technical white papers, blog content, or peer-reviewed papers, and experience speaking at industry conferences (e.g., Esri UC, GEOINT Symposium, FedGeoDay).
  • Experience supporting GSA MAS, OASIS+, or other federal contract vehicle proposal efforts.

Why Join Niyam

  • Recognized as a Washington Post and USA Today Top Workplace (2025, 2026).
  • SBA Certified HUBZone small business with a growing federal past performance portfolio (FEMA, CBP, NOAA, DOJ, TSA, and more).
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of proprietary solution accelerators (GeoCube, SPHERE, RisQ) used across the federal government.
  • Clear, transparent technical career path with growth potential to Distinguished Engineer.

Join Niyam and help us win the work that matters.

Reports To: Delivery Manager
Employment Status: Full Time
Salary: Up to £110,000 + Benefits

Who is ControlPlane?

ControlPlane is a London-headquartered consultancy specialising in cloud-native, Kubernetes, and open-source security solutions. Our expertise lies in helping organisations adopt and secure complex cloud infrastructures by implementing security measures that are "secure-by-design" and "secure-by-default." This engineering excellence drives ControlPlane deep into cybersecurity, providing services like zero-trust architectures, threat modeling, supply chain security, and platform engineering.

We are acclaimed for our work in highly regulated industries, such as finance, healthcare, and national infrastructure. We help clients consume next-generation and open-source projects safely and securely. In addition to consulting, we are active contributors to the open-source community supporting projects like Flux CD, OpenBao, and FINOS AI Readiness.

What We're Looking For

We are seeking an OpenBao Consultant with a strong hybrid background in technical consulting, secrets management, and pre-sales solution architecture.

As part of a globally distributed team, you will be our technical expert based in European time zones (UK/EU). In this role, you will bridge technical expertise and commercial enablement. Joining sales calls, leading discovery sessions, designing tailored open-source secrets management architectures, and driving technical confidence to close deals. Beyond pre-sales, you will lead high-impact client engagements, perform hands-on OpenBao/Vault migrations and implementations, and contribute to internal labs and upstream open-source security projects.

What You’ll Do

Pre-Sales & Solution Architecture

  • Technical Sales Enablement: Serve as the primary technical subject matter expert on sales calls and prospect meetings across UK and European business hours.
  • Architecture & Scoping: Partner with account teams to discover client requirements, design scalable OpenBao/Vault solutions, draft technical proposals, and define statements of work (SOWs).
  • Proof-of-Concept (PoC) Leadership: Lead technical demonstrations, PoCs, and architectural evaluations to showcase value and overcome technical objections to close deals.
  • Global Collaboration: Work closely with our distributed global team to align pre-sales solution designs with delivery capabilities and ensure seamless project handovers.

Technical Delivery & Consulting

  • Secrets Management Architecture: Architect, deploy, and harden enterprise-grade OpenBao instances running across cloud-native and on-premises environments.
  • Migrations & Upgrades: Advise and execute seamless migration paths from proprietary or legacy secrets management systems to OpenBao.

Community & Thought Leadership

  • Contribute to open-source tools, upstream OpenBao initiatives, and internal ControlPlane security research.
  • Represent ControlPlane at technical conferences, webinars, and community meetups.

What We’re Looking For

Core Secrets Management Expertise

  • Deep, practical experience with either OpenBao or HashiCorp Vault (architectural design, high availability, dynamic secrets, PKI, auto-unseal mechanisms, namespace/policy design, and identity engines).
  • Hands-on experience with secrets migration, lifecycle management, and disaster recovery strategies.

Pre-Sales & Client-Facing Skills

  • Proven track record in a technical pre-sales, solution architecture, or customer-facing consulting role.
  • Strong ability to translate complex security and compliance concepts into business value for C-level executives, security leadership, and platform engineers.
  • Confident presentation skills with a demonstrated ability to guide clients through complex sales cycles and build technical trust.

Cloud-Native & DevSecOps Engineering

  • Experience with cloud-native architectures and container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes, EKS, GKE, AKS, or OpenShift).
  • Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or OpenTofu.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD security automation and pipeline hardening.
  • Working knowledge or desire to code/script in Golang, Python, or CLI tooling.

Location & Eligibility

  • Must be located in the UK or Europe with existing right to work (remote or hybrid London).
  • Ability to align work hours with European client time zones while collaborating with a global team.

Benefits

ControlPlane is a dynamic, cutting-edge and passionate business to work for. Our employees are at the heart of our business, which means we care about our culture, our people and their progression.

Alongside this, as a colleague you will have the following benefits:

  • Generous and competitive salary + Bonus
  • 33 days of paid holiday, including paid leave for the standard 8 UK Bank Holidays
  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance
  • An individual training budget for personal development, including but not limited to:
    • Conferences
    • Training (books, courses, coaching, as well as internal training which is of course included beyond budget)
    • Qualifications

We believe our peers are equally as important as the technology we use. We’re looking for people of the highest personal calibre: quietly confident, with a strong work ethic, keenness to learn, emotional maturity and respect, who understand that “we” is more than “me” and who embrace human diversity of all kinds.

As we grow, you’ll help us build a company culture of which we can all be proud. If you share these values, we want to hear from you!
