  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes resource management and scheduling: requests and limits, OOM and CPU throttling behavior, affinity and anti-affinity, taints and tolerations, and topology spread constraints

  • Solid grasp of the pod lifecycle and disruption management, including graceful termination, pod disruption budgets, and node draining

  • Experience enforcing configuration standards through admission control and policy-as-code (for example, OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno)

  • Proficiency in Go or Python, including building production infrastructure software such as Kubernetes controllers, operators, or admission webhooks

  • Strong production debugging skills and a demonstrated ability to turn recurring incidents into systemic fixes

  • Track record of leading technical initiatives across multiple teams, driving adoption of shared standards, and mentoring other engineers

jobs.description:
Position Summary

Scicom Infrastructure Services is seeking an experiencedDatabricks Practice Lead / Engineering Managerto provide hands-on technical leadership while managing a team of data engineers, architects, and consultants supporting complex enterprise and government programs.

This role requires a senior Databricks expert who can design and oversee modern data platforms, establish technical standards, guide delivery teams, and remain actively involved in architecture, troubleshooting, code reviews, and client-facing solution development. The successful candidate will balance deep technical expertise with strong people leadership, delivery management, and stakeholder communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

Databricks Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the organization’s subject-matter expert for the Databricks Lakehouse Platform.
  • Design scalable, secure, and highly available data architectures using Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and cloud-native technologies.
  • Lead the implementation of batch, streaming, ETL, ELT, analytics, machine-learning, and AI-enabled data solutions.
  • Define architectural standards for medallion architectures, data modeling, ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data consumption.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog, including data lineage, access controls, auditing, metadata management, and secure data sharing.
  • Guide Databricks workspace design, cluster configuration, serverless computing, workload isolation, performance tuning, and cost optimization.
  • Oversee integration between Databricks and cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  • Develop or review solutions involving PySpark, Spark SQL, Python, Delta Live Tables, Structured Streaming, Auto Loader, MLflow, and Databricks Workflows.
  • Lead platform migrations and modernization efforts from legacy databases, data warehouses, Hadoop environments, and traditional ETL platforms.
  • Establish development standards for source control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and production support.
  • Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, technical assessments, and root-cause analyses.
  • Evaluate emerging Databricks capabilities and recommend appropriate adoption strategies.

Team Leadership and Management

  • Manage, mentor, and develop a team of Databricks engineers, data engineers, architects, and technical consultants.
  • Assign resources and responsibilities based on project needs, employee strengths, availability, and technical complexity.
  • Establish measurable goals, performance expectations, development plans, and technical competency standards.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, coaching sessions, and technical development activities.
  • Support recruiting, interviewing, candidate evaluation, onboarding, and workforce planning.
  • Identify technical or performance gaps and coordinate training, mentoring, or corrective action as appropriate.
  • Promote collaboration, accountability, documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop reusable accelerators, reference architectures, templates, and delivery playbooks.
  • Build and maintain a strong Databricks practice capable of supporting multiple concurrent client engagements.

Program and Delivery Management

  • Provide delivery oversight for Databricks and data-engineering projects from planning through implementation and operational support.
  • Translate business, functional, security, and contractual requirements into technical plans and deliverables.
  • Develop project estimates, staffing plans, delivery schedules, milestones, and risk-mitigation strategies.
  • Monitor project scope, schedule, quality, budget, resource utilization, dependencies, and technical risks.
  • Ensure deliverables meet client requirements, internal quality standards, security controls, and contractual commitments.
  • Coordinate work across engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, data governance, analytics, project-management, and client teams.
  • Track delivery metrics and provide clear status reports to internal leadership, clients, and program stakeholders.
  • Lead technical escalations and ensure issues are resolved promptly and appropriately documented.
  • Support statements of work, technical proposals, solution estimates, presentations, and client demonstrations.
  • Participate in client meetings as the technical and delivery authority for Databricks-related work.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, data engineering, engineering, or a related discipline.
  • At least 10 years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, analytics engineering, or related technology roles.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience designing and implementing solutions using Databricks.
  • At least 3 years of experience managing or formally leading technical engineering teams.
  • Advanced experience with:
    • Databricks Lakehouse Platform
    • Apache Spark and PySpark
    • Spark SQL and advanced SQL development
    • Delta Lake and medallion architecture
    • Unity Catalog and enterprise data governance
    • ETL and ELT pipeline architecture
    • Batch and real-time data processing
    • Data modeling and data warehousing
    • Python-based data engineering
    • Databricks Workflows, Jobs, and cluster management
  • Experience deploying Databricks solutions in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with CI/CD, Git-based development, automated testing, and infrastructure as code.
  • Demonstrated ability to optimize Spark workloads, cluster configurations, query performance, reliability, and cloud costs.
  • Experience managing technical delivery, resource assignments, risks, schedules, and client expectations.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to executives, business stakeholders, and nontechnical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional, Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate, or Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional.
  • Databricks Certified Data Architect or comparable advanced architecture credentials.
  • Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud professional-level certification.
  • Experience working in a consulting, professional-services, systems-integration, or managed-services environment.
  • Experience supporting federal, state, or local government clients.
  • Experience working with major consulting or systems-integration partners.
  • Knowledge of federal security, privacy, governance, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, AWS Glue, Amazon S3, Snowflake, dbt, Kafka, Airflow, or Terraform.
  • Experience with MLflow, MLOps, generative AI, Databricks Mosaic AI, vector search, or machine-learning deployment.
  • Familiarity with data standards, metadata frameworks, data catalogs, data-sharing protocols, and open-data environments.
  • Experience managing geographically distributed or remote technical teams.
  • Experience contributing to proposals, technical responses, statements of work, and project estimates.

Leadership Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Hands-on technical credibility and sound architectural judgment.
  • The ability to lead without becoming disconnected from the technology.
  • Strong accountability for team performance and project outcomes.
  • Effective coaching, delegation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Clear and proactive communication with clients and internal leadership.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  • A commitment to quality, security, documentation, and continuous improvement.

Success Measures

Performance in this role will be evaluated based on:

  • Quality, scalability, security, and reliability of Databricks solutions.
  • On-time and within-budget delivery of client commitments.
  • Team performance, retention, development, and technical growth.
  • Client satisfaction and effective stakeholder communication.
  • Reduction in delivery risks, production incidents, and technical debt.
  • Adoption of standardized architectures, engineering practices, and reusable solutions.
  • Effective management of Databricks consumption, infrastructure, and cloud costs.
  • Growth and maturity of the organization’s Databricks practice.

jobs.description:
Founded in 2015 in Athens, Greece, Welcome redefines the way people travel by going above and beyond the commoditized transfer service and being the first company to deliver a complete, personalised, in-destination travel experience. From the moment a traveler arrives at a new destination, until their return journey home, Welcome accommodates all their travel needs, including transfers, sightseeing trips, and local information, in the easiest, friendliest, and most personalised way possible. Welcome's drivers are experts in the area and share their local know-how to make travellers feel at home wherever they are. The company has also introduced contactless rides, thorough cleaning protocols, and protective equipment to make every journey safe.

Being a travel tech startup, Welcome continues to grow and scale its operations and is quickly becoming a global category leader for in-destination travel services.

  • One of the highest-rated global transportation companies with a rating of 4.9/5 stars.
  • Expanded from 200 destinations last year to 350, achieving our ambitious 2024 growth target.
  • Over 4,000 travel partners including 2,500 hotels, numerous vacation rentals, and travel agents, adding 50+ new ones every month.
  • Over 2.5 million happy travellers every year.

⭐️ If you want to dive deeper into the awesomeness of Welcome's culture, click on this link to check our TikTok account. ⭐️

The Team

We are a group of vibrant, diverse people who love travelling and never settle on quality. Each one of us didn’t join Welcome by chance and believes deeply in what Welcome is trying to achieve, so we work relentlessly to make that happen. We challenge common logic, focus on design, put simplicity and usability first, and create memorable experiences. We keep learning and exploring better ways to serve our community and grow personally and professionally in our respective fields. We stay humble along the way, with a “pay it forward” mentality, but with big and bold goals.

As a MarTech Manager at Welcome Pickups, you will be owning the technical backbone connecting our customer data to the platforms our Commercial team runs on - Braze, HubSpot, and the tooling around them - and acting as the technical bridge between Commercial and our central Product team. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role: it builds and maintains the data pipelines, integrations, and platform infrastructure that CRM and Marketing depend on, implementing the requirements and tooling decisions the CRM team sets rather than setting them independently. This role owns the data, pipelines, and platform administration behind Commercial's marketing technology - keeping customer data clean, audiences flowing reliably into Braze, HubSpot, Google, and Meta, and the stack running day-to-day - while campaign strategy, content, and budget stay with CRM and Marketing.

Responsibilities

Customer Data & Audience Infrastructure

  • Own the technical architecture of the customer database — how data is captured from Braze, HubSpot, site, product, and other sources, and how it's structured and kept clean.
  • Define identity resolution, consent, and suppression logic for marketing data flows, partnering with Data and Engineering.
  • Build and maintain the marketing activation layer on top of the data warehouse — defining and delivering the customer attributes and audiences CRM and Marketing need, to their specifications.
  • Own the pipelines that push audiences and attributes from the warehouse into Braze, HubSpot, Google, and Meta, and the engagement data flowing back in, including coverage, freshness, and failure handling.

MarTech Platform Administration

  • Own day-to-day technical administration of the Commercial team's marketing technology stack — Braze, HubSpot, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Implement and configure new platforms once tooling decisions are made by the CRM team; lead technical rollout and integration rather than tool selection.
  • Maintain documentation of how the stack fits together — data flows, integrations, and ownership.
  • Identify and remove technical friction in Commercial's day-to-day tooling and workflows, partnering with Product and Data to automate manual work.

Commercial-Product Liaison

  • Collect and triage technical feature requests from Partnerships, Marketing, Pricing, and CRM, sequencing them into a clear delivery backlog.
  • Build business cases for prioritised initiatives, framing expected impact, effort, and trade-offs.
  • Represent Commercial in Product's planning and prioritisation forums, and keep Commercial informed on delivery status and trade-offs.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in CRM/marketing technology, growth or lifecycle operations, or a technical product management role, ideally in a B2C or marketplace business.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM/marketing automation platforms such as Braze, HubSpot, Iterable, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and audience/segmentation tooling such as Segment, mParticle, or Tealium.
  • Solid understanding of customer data concepts: identity resolution, consent and permissions, event tracking, and how data flows between systems via APIs.
  • Product management fundamentals: prioritisation frameworks, writing user stories and requirements, and partnering effectively with engineering and design teams to ship.
  • Comfortable building a business case, framing impact, effort, and trade-offs to support clear decision-making.
  • Strong technical implementer who thrives executing within someone else's roadmap and tooling decisions, rather than setting technology strategy independently.
  • Strong cross-functional collaborator, able to work closely with Data & Analytics, Product, and Commercial teams.
  • Experience in fast-growth environments; comfortable with ambiguity and evolving scope.
  • Experience in travel, mobility, marketplaces, or similar multi-sided businesses is a plus.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages a plus.

Benefits

  • Vibrant and fresh work environment
  • Flexible work-from-home policy
  • The tools you need to perform your daily tasks successfully
  • L&D personal budget
  • +4 extra PTO days annually
  • The unique opportunity to join “the next big thing” at ground level

CONTROLLER

Allied Roofing Partners (ARP)

Remote | Full-Time | Exempt

Travel: Approximately 20% National Travel
Compensation: $170,000–$200,000 Base Salary DOE + Performance Bonus

ABOUT ALLIED ROOFING PARTNERS

Allied Roofing Partners (ARP) is one of the fastest-growing residential exterior services platforms in the United States. We partner with established roofing and exterior home improvement companies and provide the financial, operational, technology, HR, and strategic resources needed to help them continue to grow.

ARP operates a growing multi-brand, multi-entity, multi-state organization that includes residential roofing, insurance restoration, siding, gutters, and other exterior home services.

Our continued growth is driven by a combination of organic expansion and strategic acquisitions. As new companies join the ARP portfolio, our Corporate Accounting team plays a critical role in integrating those businesses, standardizing financial processes, strengthening controls, and providing leadership with accurate and timely financial information.

We are seeking an experienced Controller who can help lead that effort.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

POSITION SUMMARY

The Controller will oversee core accounting and financial reporting across the Allied Roofing Partners portfolio while playing a significant role in acquisition integration, multi-entity consolidation, percentage-of-completion accounting, job costing, financial controls, forecasting, and team development.

This is not a Controller position focused on maintaining a single company's accounting function.CFO, Accounting Manager, Senior Accountants, M&A and integration teams, operating company leadership, and executive management.

The successful candidate must be comfortable operating within a growing multi-brand environment, integrating newly acquired businesses, consolidating financial results across multiple entities, and creating consistent accounting standards and processes across the organization.

This individual will work closely with the

The Controller will also provide leadership and development to an accounting organization that includes an Accounting Manager and multiple Senior Accountants supporting ARP's operating brands.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE

Candidates should have direct, hands-on experience in ALL or the majority of the following areas:

Acquisition Integration

  • Direct experience integrating newly acquired companies into an existing accounting and financial reporting structure
  • Experience assessing acquired-company accounting processes and identifying gaps
  • Ability to implement standardized accounting policies, procedures, controls, and reporting expectations following an acquisition
  • Experience working with local accounting teams during post-acquisition integration

Multi-Entity Accounting & Consolidations

  • Experience managing accounting across multiple companies, brands, subsidiaries, or operating entities
  • Hands-on experience preparing and/or reviewing consolidated financial statements
  • Experience standardizing financial reporting across multiple entities
  • Ability to manage multiple close processes and reporting deadlines simultaneously

Percentage-of-Completion Accounting & Job Costing

  • Strong understanding and practical experience with percentage-of-completion accounting
  • Hands-on experience with job costing and WIP reporting
  • Ability to review job-level profitability, estimated costs, margins, and revenue recognition
  • Experience identifying job-costing discrepancies and working with Operations to resolve them

QuickBooks

  • Strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online
  • Ability to work across multiple QuickBooks entities
  • Experience improving accounting processes and reporting within QuickBooks environments

Month-End Close & GAAP

  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP
  • Experience owning and leading the monthly and year-end close process
  • Strong balance sheet reconciliation and general ledger experience
  • Ability to establish close calendars, deadlines, review processes, and accountability across an accounting team
  • Experience preparing and reviewing accurate monthly financial statements

External Audit Leadership

  • Experience leading an external financial statement audit
  • Ability to coordinate audit requests, supporting schedules, documentation, and communication with external auditors
  • Experience ensuring accounting records and supporting documentation are audit-ready

Forecasting & Budgeting

  • Experience developing and managing annual budgets and financial forecasts
  • Ability to analyze actual results against budget and forecast
  • Experience identifying financial trends and communicating meaningful variances to leadership
  • Strong understanding of cash forecasting and financial planning

Team Leadership & Development

  • Proven experience managing, mentoring, and developing accounting professionals
  • Ability to review the work of Senior Accountants and other accounting team members
  • Experience providing coaching, feedback, training, and accountability
  • Ability to build stronger accounting capabilities as the organization grows

Internal Controls

  • Experience developing, implementing, and improving internal controls
  • Ability to identify control weaknesses and implement appropriate solutions
  • Experience developing accounting policies, procedures, and SOPs
  • Strong understanding of financial risk and segregation of duties

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Oversee general ledger and accounting operations across multiple ARP brands and entities
  • Lead accurate and timely monthly and year-end close processes
  • Prepare and review monthly financial statements and consolidated management reporting
  • Ensure accounting practices comply with GAAP and established ARP accounting policies
  • Review balance sheet reconciliations and ensure appropriate resolution of outstanding items
  • Oversee AP, AR, cash management, and other core accounting functions
  • Monitor cash balances and support short- and long-term cash forecasting
  • Oversee commission accounting and processing
  • Prepare monthly Financial Reporting Packages and support Monthly Operating Reviews
  • Improve reporting processes and identify opportunities for automation

Multi-Entity Consolidation

  • Oversee financial reporting across ARP's growing portfolio of operating companies
  • Review individual entity financial results and consolidated reporting
  • Ensure consistent accounting methodology across operating companies
  • Identify and resolve intercompany and consolidation issues
  • Establish scalable reporting processes as additional companies join ARP

Percentage-of-Completion & Job Costing

  • Provide oversight of percentage-of-completion accounting across applicable ARP brands
  • Review job costing, WIP schedules, percent-complete calculations, and revenue recognition
  • Analyze job margins and identify significant variances or unusual trends
  • Partner with Operations and accounting teams to improve job-cost accuracy
  • Help standardize job-costing and POC processes across the organization

M&A & Acquisition Integration

  • Partner with the CFO and M&A/integration teams during acquisitions
  • Assist with financial due diligence and pre-close accounting assessments
  • Help transition newly acquired companies into ARP's financial reporting structure
  • Implement standardized accounting policies, procedures, SOPs, and internal controls
  • Support migration and standardization within QuickBooks Online and other financial systems
  • Establish appropriate close processes and reporting expectations for newly acquired companies
  • Work directly with local accounting teams during the integration process
  • Provide training and ongoing support following acquisition

Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Analysis

  • Lead and support annual budgeting and forecasting processes
  • Analyze actual performance against budgets and forecasts
  • Review KPIs, margins, job costing, backlog, cash flow, and operating performance
  • Identify financial trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Translate financial results into actionable information for operating and executive leadership
  • Support financial dashboards and management reporting

Internal Controls & Process Improvement

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve internal controls
  • Establish standardized accounting policies and procedures across ARP brands
  • Identify gaps in existing accounting processes and implement solutions
  • Improve financial reporting accuracy and efficiency
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual accounting processes
  • Help build a scalable accounting infrastructure capable of supporting continued acquisition growth

Accounting Team Leadership

  • Provide leadership and financial oversight to an Accounting Manager and multiple Senior Accountants supporting ARP's operating brands
  • Review financial schedules and accounting work for accuracy and completeness
  • Establish clear expectations and accountability around close and reporting deadlines
  • Coach and develop accounting team members
  • Identify development opportunities and help team members expand their capabilities
  • Build a strong, scalable Corporate Accounting organization capable of supporting ARP's continued growth

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience
  • Previous Controller, Assistant Controller, Accounting Manager, or comparable senior accounting leadership experience
  • Acquisition integration experience
  • Multi-entity/multi-brand accounting experience
  • Financial consolidation experience
  • Percentage-of-completion accounting experience
  • Strong job-costing experience
  • QuickBooks Online experience
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP and month-end close
  • Experience leading an external financial statement audit
  • Experience with budgeting and forecasting
  • Experience managing and developing accounting professionals
  • Experience developing and implementing internal controls
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote, multi-company environment
  • Ability to travel nationally approximately 20% as needed

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

HIGHLY PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Accounting leadership experience within construction, roofing, exterior home improvement, restoration, or another project/job-cost-based industry
  • Roofing industry experience is especially valuable
  • Experience working within a private equity-backed organization
  • Experience in a high-growth, acquisition-focused environment
  • Experience integrating multiple acquisitions
  • Experience building scalable accounting processes within a rapidly growing organization
  • Experience working with CRM, ERP, reporting, and business intelligence platforms

Private equity-backed experience is preferred but is NOT required.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

The successful Controller will be someone who can move comfortably between high-level financial leadership and hands-on accounting execution.

You should be able to review consolidated financial results with executive leadership, lead an external audit, coach a Senior Accountant, troubleshoot a job-costing issue, improve a month-end close process, and help integrate the accounting function of a newly acquired business.

You will be joining an organization that is continuing to grow, which means processes and systems will continue to evolve.

We are looking for someone who can build structure rather than simply operate within an existing structure.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base Salary: $170,000–$200,000 DOE

Additional Compensation: Performance Bonus

ARP offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Medical insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid company holidays
  • Career growth and advancement opportunities

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHY JOIN ALLIED ROOFING PARTNERS?

This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible financial leadership position within a rapidly growing organization.

As ARP continues to acquire and integrate successful roofing and exterior home improvement companies, the Controller will have a direct impact on how we integrate businesses, develop accounting teams, strengthen internal controls, improve reporting, standardize processes, and build a scalable financial infrastructure.

You will work directly with executive leadership while helping shape the accounting organization needed to support ARP's next stage of growth.

If you have experience with acquisition integration, multi-entity accounting and consolidations, percentage-of-completion accounting, job costing, QuickBooks, GAAP financial reporting, external audits, forecasting, and building strong accounting teams, we would like to hear from you.

Apply today to join Allied Roofing Partners.

Salary: 170k-200k

jobs.excerpt: The E&S General Liability Senior Underwriter OR AVP is responsible for underwriting new and renewal middle market accounts within an E&S/non-admitted environment.
jobs.description:
The E&S General Liability Senior Underwriter OR AVP is responsible for underwriting new and renewal middle market accounts within an E&S/non-admitted environment. This role requires strong technical underwriting judgment, thoughtful risk selection, and the ability to structure coverage/terms to achieve profitable growth. The Senior Underwriter should have established wholesale broker relationships with individual brokerage offices. The Senior Underwriter will independently manage a renewal book, grow new business through select wholesale broker relationships, and provide mentorship and technical guidance to underwriting team members.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Underwrite and manage a middle market GL portfolio including new business, renewals, and account stewardship to achieve profitability, retention, and growth objectives.
  • Evaluate risk and exposure by analyzing operations, loss history, financials (as appropriate), coverage needs, and industry trends; determine suitability within company appetite.
  • Develop coverage, pricing, and terms aligned with risk characteristics and rate adequacy; leverage deductibles/SIRs, endorsements, and coverage restrictions when needed to achieve appropriate risk-adjusted return.
  • Structure and negotiate deals with wholesalers, including quote development, proposal presentation, counteroffers, and binding decisions within delegated authority.
  • Oversee account lifecycle management, including:
    • underwriting file documentation (analysis, rationale, pricing support, referrals),
    • issuance coordination and policy review,
    • mid-term endorsements,
    • renewal strategy and execution,
    • collaboration with claims, loss control, and operations as applicable.
  • Maintain excellent underwriting governance: ensure compliance with guidelines, regulatory/non-admitted requirements, documentation standards, and referral/authority protocols.
  • Broker relationship management and marketing
    • manage a targeted group of wholesale brokers,
    • actively source and qualify middle market opportunities,
    • communicate underwriting appetite clearly and consistently,
    • differentiate through expertise, responsiveness, and creative problem solving—not price alone.
  • Portfolio management
    • monitor aggregates, concentration, mix of business, and loss trends,
    • identify remediation actions on underperforming segments/accounts,
    • contribute to planning and forecasting efforts.
  • Mentor and support junior underwriters
    • provide technical coaching, file guidance, and decision support,
    • participate in training, peer reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to underwriting discipline and continuous improvement
    • assist in refining guidelines, workflows, tools, and product/coverage approach for middle market GL,
    • support underwriting file audits/reviews and participate in system testing/enhancements as needed.

Required Education and/or Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of General Liability underwriting experience, with demonstrated success underwriting E&S/non-admitted business.
  • Experience underwriting middle market accounts with higher complexity (e.g., multi-location, multi-state, higher hazard classes, layered or manuscript coverage considerations, heavier loss history, complex operations).

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong technical knowledge of GL coverage, policy forms, exclusions/endorsements, and non-admitted market practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess risk, analyze data, and make sound decisions with clear underwriting rationale.
  • Strong command of pricing concepts and rate adequacy, including using terms/structure (not just price) to appropriately underwrite risk.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain wholesale broker relationships and to generate profitable submissions.
  • Excellent communication skills—able to explain decisions and coverage positions clearly to brokers and internal partners.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across underwriting, claims, loss control, and operations.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; able to manage multiple accounts and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred / Beneficial Qualifications

  • Insurance designations (e.g., CPCU, AU, ARM, RPLU) preferred.
  • Experience with specific middle market segments relevant to your appetite (e.g., construction, habitational, products, light manufacturing, distribution, social services, etc.).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel) and underwriting systems/analytics tools.
  • Experience participating in audits/file reviews, guideline creation, or product refinement.

Compensation & Benefits

The applicable base salary for this opportunity is $135,000 – $200,000. The base pay offered will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. In addition to the base salary, this opportunity may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

We offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition and professional certification assistance, 401(k) savings, elective participation in the Employee Stock Purchase Program, paid time off, paid holidays, and child bonding leave, as well as other employee assistance programs.

Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING

Join the Kingdom of Saudia Arabia (KSA) Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence (C4I) Modernization Team and be a critical contributor on the first-phase design team helping to shape the project’s overarching modernization initiatives.

The team’s primary focus during the design stage is to shape the functional architecture and system capabilities that will rapidly modernize the customer’s product line. Day-to-day activities will include (but are not limited to) requirements governance, architecture definition, system documentation, CONOPs development, and integration guidance/planning. This is an opportunity to help design and develop the updated baseline while working directly with an international customer.

THE WORK

The KSA C4I Team is seeking a systems engineer to join our development team. In this role, you will:

  • Decompose customer requirements and use cases into system capabilities and functions
  • Perform requirements tracing to ensure that the necessary system and subsystems are developed in accordance with customer requirements/expectations
  • Create/refine MBSE models depicting system architecture and system activity/sequence diagrams
  • Help contribute to various SE CDRL documents, including (but not limited to): SEMP, ICD, SDD’s, TEMP
  • Help refine and develop overall system CONOPs to ensure planned modernization capabilities continue to meet the overall mission needs

PLEASE NOTE

  • This position may require travel to customer sites throughout the KSA.
  • This position may occasionally support off-hours test events, including overnight and weekend activities.

WHO WE ARE

The KSA C4I Modernization Team is a geographically dispersed project team that will operate in an Agile Scrum environment. Team members have the opportunity to work directly with an international customer and gain exposure to the technologies and processes supporting this upgrade.

Come be a part of a rapidly developing, fast-paced project team that is empowered to quickly develop and iterate potential design upgrades, with a condensed feedback loop that allows for quick iterations on proposed updates. This customer environment is a unique experience for an engineer to put their stamp on drafting new system functionality with a very engaged customer in an accelerated design cycle. If the thought rapidly performing various design activities and growing your knowledge on the numerous types of systems engineering artifacts that are developed and delivered as part of design stage of a modernization upgrade project is exciting, then the KSA C4I Team is the place to be!

This team/position is contingent upon contract award.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience in MBSE (Cameo, Rhapsody)
  • Experience with Requirements Definition and Documentation (DOORS, Jama)
  • Experience with Use Case and CONOPs Refinement
  • Familiarity with the various activities in the Systems Engineering V-Diagram
  • 2+ years of relevant work experience (OR an Advanced Degree in STEM)

Desired Skills

  • Experience performing Requirements tracing
  • Experience Developing CDRL Documentation
  • Experience participating in Early system design/maturation activities
  • Previous C2 Domain Experience
  • Experience in Agile Methodologies & Tools
  • Previous International Customer Experience
  • Active Secret Clearance

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLE Technosylva builds software that supports high-stakes, time-sensitive decisions for wildfire and natural-hazard management, and AI is a core part of how we build it.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Technosylva builds software that supports high-stakes, time-sensitive decisions for wildfire and natural-hazard management, and AI is a core part of how we build it. As a Senior AI Platform Engineer, you'll build and run the core services of our AI platform: gateway integrations, the skills/plugins review pipeline, the curated MCP registry, and the cost and observability tooling that shows how AI is used across the company. You'll write code, run production services and take part in on-call.

RESPONSABILITIES

  • Gateway operations & integration. Configure, extend and run our AI gateway: routing, authentication, rate limits, quotas, metadata tagging, and onboarding new teams and models (cloud, third-party and on-prem).
  • Skills & plugins pipeline. Build and run the review pipeline for our skills/plugins repository: automated validation, review gates, versioning and release workflows. Write and review skills, agents and plugins yourself.
  • Curated MCP registry. Run the MCP server intake process, including security reviews of third-party servers, tool scoping, and allowlisting, within a published approval SLA. Build internal MCP servers when there's a gap.
  • FinOps tagging & reporting. Implement cost tagging and attribution in the gateway and tools so token and compute spend can be traced to teams, products and use cases. Build the dashboards and alerts on top.
  • Observability & evaluation. Instrument AI services and agents with tracing, metrics and evals, and build dashboards and alerts for latency, errors, quality and cost per request.
  • Agent identity & secrets. Set up scoped, non-shared identities and secrets for agents and automations, following the platform's standards.
  • Security collaboration. Work with the Security teams on MCP server and plugin reviews, incident response for AI services, and implementing controls such as access scoping, audit logging and secrets rotation.
  • Model routing operations. Configure and maintain routing rules, fallbacks and load balancing across model providers, and monitor how routing affects cost, latency and output quality.
  • Self-service & enablement. Build golden-path templates, CLIs and documentation so engineers can adopt AI without constant support. Help run office hours and workshops for engineers across the company.
  • Operations. Join the on-call rotation, handle incidents for production AI services, and turn what you learn from incidents into fixes and runbooks.

EXPERIENCIA/HABILIDADES REQUERIDAS

  • 5+ years in software, platform, DevOps or SRE engineering, building and running production services.

Overview: Building Autonomous AI Agents

The AI/ML Engineer with an AI Agent Focus is a specialized role dedicated to designing, building, and deploying autonomous AI agents that handle complex business processes independently. You will be at the forefront of integrating cutting-edge Large Language Models (LLMs) and reasoning frameworks into our e-commerce and supply chain ecosystem, driving efficiency and innovation through intelligent automation.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of agent development, from initial design to production optimization and monitoring.

  • Agent Architecture & Development: Design and build autonomous AI agent architectures utilizing LLMs, advanced reasoning frameworks, and decision-making systems to achieve specific business goals (e.g., customer support automation, sales assistance, workflow optimization).

  • Business Process Automation: Create agents that integrate directly into the platform to automate critical supply chain and administrative tasks, such including:

    • Customer Support Agents integrated into the e-commerce storefront.

    • Internal Workflow Automation agents (e.g., Slack integration, Jira automation).

  • Multi-Agent Systems: Implement and orchestrate multi-agent systems where specialized agents collaborate to solve complex, multi-step problems across different modules (MES, WMS, OMS).

  • Advanced Agent Capabilities: Develop and implement memory systems, sophisticated context management, and tool integration strategies (allowing agents to use internal APIs, search, or code execution) to enhance agent efficacy.

  • Model Optimization: Implement techniques for agent improvement, including fine-tuning of LLM models and applying concepts from Reinforcement Learning for optimal decision-making.

  • Safety & Monitoring: Implement safety guardrails, define ethical usage guidelines, and build robust monitoring systems (collaborating with MLOps) to track and analyze agent behavior and performance in production.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess deep experience in machine learning, LLM technology, and production deployment:

  • LLM/Agent Frameworks: Mandatory hands-on expertise with agent construction frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and AutoGen.

  • Programming & ML: Expert proficiency in Python and standard ML/Deep Learning libraries (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).

  • Data & APIs: Experience preparing data for model fine-tuning and integrating agents via API endpoints into production services (Node.js/NestJS).

  • Deployment: Familiarity with MLOps concepts (versioning, deployment) and containerization (Docker) for agent deployment.

  • Databases: Understanding of vector databases and retrieval augmented generation (RAG) techniques.

Supply Chain Integration (Domain Focus)

You will integrate intelligent agents directly into our core supply chain and data systems.

  • Data Analysis Agents: Build agents capable of complex data analysis and insight generation using aggregated data from MES, WMS, and OMS.

  • E-commerce Integration: Deploy agents that assist users directly within the e-commerce platform by accessing real-time catalog and inventory data.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Agent Autonomy: Measurable increase in the percentage of business tasks handled end-to-end by autonomous agents.

  • Business Impact: Quantifiable improvements in metrics driven by the agents (e.g., reduced customer support response time, increased sales conversion).

  • Model Performance: Accuracy and efficiency of fine-tuned models and the reliability of multi-agent systems.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Head of Technology/CTO, working closely with the Data Architect and MLOps Engineer to productionize and scale agent capabilities.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. What you will do as a Customer Engineer
The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.
  • Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices. Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.
  • Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.
  • Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes.
  • AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.
  • Education & Enablement: Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).
  • Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.
  • Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.
  • Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.
  • Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.
  • Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:
    • Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.
    • Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.
    • Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.
    • AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.
    • Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.
    • Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")

  • Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms.
  • Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.
  • Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.

Education

Transactional Revenue Intelligence & Systems Analyst

Location: LATAM · Work Model: Fully remote · Language: Spanish + English C1/C2

About Koronet

Koronet is the leading vertical SaaS, B2B e-commerce, and payments software company for the over $50 Billion global B2B floral industry. Our solution consists of an inventory and operations management SaaS solution and an e-commerce network that enables end-to-end transactions through the B2B supply chain. Managing many of the largest businesses in the industry, our products help keep florists’ shelves stocked, weddings brightly bloomed, and Valentine’s Day brilliant red.

We are the parent company to the leading ERP, operations and e-commerce solutions in the floral industry, including Komet Sales, Axerrio and UNOSOF. The company has teams in Florida, Ecuador, Argentina, Uruguay, Netherlands and Colombia. Our global Network of partners includes hundreds of flower growers, importers, and wholesalers who collectively represent a material portion of the global flower market. Our mission is to be the unified operating floral supply chain by providing mission-critical business operations solutions powering the largest B2B e-commerce network.

We are a fast-growing company backed by a leading growth equity fund, fueling our expansion across North America and Europe through both organic growth and acquisitions.

Role Mission:

Koronet grows when our customers succeed in buying, selling, and operating. Your job is to build the systems and intelligence that identify where we can add value, what blocks that growth, and how to scale our impact.

You will work as a solo operator, not a passive analyst. You will build dashboards, decision-making tools that empower teams to act faster and smarter and execute scalable campaigns. You are responsible for transforming raw data into clear, actionable insights and driving real business outcomes at scale.

How we work:

We’re one team with one goal: delivering actual value. We share what we learn from customers, help our colleagues succeed, and focus on outcomes, not just checking boxes like 'completed call' or 'closed ticket.'

Transactions at Koronet:

Transactions connect how our customers actually work with what our platform can do. We sit between customer feedback and product development, turning what we see in the field into real product improvements. We don't just 'do tasks'—we look for ways to solve problems and use what we learn to make the whole platform better for everyone.

What you will do:

  • Build and maintain dashboards and tools for Transactions, Success, Product, and leadership.
  • Turn business questions into reliable decision systems: define the problem, find the evidence, and measure the result.
  • Connect data from calls, feedback, email, and market research to understand how customers buy, list, and sell.
  • Spot patterns across customers to identify where Koronet can add value—whether through better processes, product changes, or new integrations.
  • Drive the marketplace growth model by helping customers improve their sourcing, catalog reliability, and digital sales.
  • Create feedback loops to track if campaigns and product changes actually drive adoption, transaction volume, or efficiency.
  • Design, launch, and execute campaigns to expand and make buying and selling digitally in our ecosystem easier.
  • Track impact on and ensure data quality by investigating inconsistencies rather than guessing.
  • Turn customer insights into clear evidence for other teams to use.
  • Identify and fix internal bottlenecks with automation and better workflows.

How you will use tools:

  • You will be a solo operator using automation, data analysis, and research tools to move faster.
  • Define the problem, inputs, and goals clearly.
  • Use research and prototyping to build better workflows.
  • Measure results against real customer outcomes.
  • Know when to use automation and when to rely on human judgment or customer context.

Success Criteria:

  • You drive business results at scale through your campaigns and indirectly enabling teams
  • Customer-facing teams have stronger context to drive customer behavior.
  • Product receives clear, prioritized evidence of customer problems and their impact.
  • Insights compound over time into better enablement and product decisions.
  • Your dashboards are trusted because they are accurate and useful, not because they are complex.
  • You accelerate other teams without becoming a bottleneck.

A few things this role isn't!

  • A passive reporting or dashboard-making role.
  • A product manager making roadmap promises.
  • The final decision-maker on strategy.
  • An AI developer hired only to build agents.

What do we expect from you:

  • Strong analytical judgment and commercial curiosity.
  • Able to solve ambiguous problems using data, spreadsheets, SQL, or code.
  • Comfortable working across structured and unstructured data.
  • Excellent communication skills; you can turn complex data into useful narratives for other teams.
  • Interest in marketplaces, B2B SaaS, and operational systems.
  • Humble, rigorous, and team-first: you surface uncertainty and improve the system rather than defending your first guess.
  • Fluent in English (must).
  • Experience in the floriculture industry will be considered a strong plus.

What We Offer:

  • An independent, flexible, and versatile role within a fast-growing international organization.
  • Flexible / Remote working environment.
  • We encourage continuous learning and professional growth.

Why Join Koronet:

  • Global and Remote-First: Work with a diverse team across the Americas and Europe, with flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Ownership Culture: We foster an environment where each team member takes ownership and is empowered to contribute to the company's success.
  • Growth & Development: We support continuous professional growth and offer financial assistance for technical certifications and other learning opportunities.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and an indefinite contract, with salary negotiable based on experience.

If you're passionate about making an impact and growing with a dynamic, remote-first company, we want to hear from you!

As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Position Summary

Join a high-impact team at the forefront of investment risk management. You will lead the development of a multi-year stochastic credit risk model and deliver a production-ready solution to support specialty finance underwriting. Over time, this role will expand to influence pricing of other products, such as annuities. We're looking for someone experienced in structural credit risk modeling who is intellectually curious, eager to learn, and excited to work on meaningful challenges.


Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the specialty finance team and asset managers to fully develop a Merton-approach, multi-year stochastic credit risk model for corporate bonds, commercial mortgage loans, and structured assets
  • Conduct research on credit default history and credit risk cycles; set proper assumptions and clearly define model scope and limitations
  • Design and execute comprehensive model validation
  • Build analytical frameworks that link assumptions, inputs, and outputs to interpret modeling results clearly
  • Develop and guide junior-level credit risk analysts; strengthen the credit risk modeling function into a competitive advantage

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience in portfolio credit risk modeling, such as single-factor models, Merton models, and Gaussian copula frameworks
  • Deep insight into credit default and migration behavior - credit risk cycles, rating migration dynamics, default probabilities, and loss recovery experience
  • Strong understanding of asset and risk characteristics across corporate bonds, commercial mortgage loans, and structured assets
  • Proven modeling and programming skills (Python, MATLAB, or similar) in developing Monte Carlo simulation models
  • Working knowledge of insurance investment portfolio risk and statutory capital frameworks
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate complex modeling concepts to senior leaders
  • Preferably 5+ years of experience in quantitative risk modeling
  • Preferred professional designations (or progress toward them): CFA, FRM, or actuarial credentials (FSA/FCAS)

This role does not qualify for employer sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the STEM OPT extension program.

Do you have the desire to analyze data and perform groundbreaking research to drive business outcomes? Nationwide has been using data to serve our members and drive business outcomes for almost 100 years. Our industry-leading workforce adopts an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. Our Risk Analytics Researchers play a key role in harnessing the power of data to deliver business results. Specifically, they are responsible for modeling sophisticated problems, discovering insights, and identifying business opportunities from data using a variety of techniques from mathematics, actuarial studies, statistics, data science, and financial engineering.

As a Senior Consultant, you’ll lead projects associated with the design, development and application of unique risk models. You’ll need an understanding of strategic business objectives and will work with business partners across the organization to develop solutions to pressing business needs. We’ll count on you to be a subject matter authority in Nationwide’s risks. It’s imperative that you are fully proficient with basic and sophisticated mathematical, statistical, and analytical techniques associated with risk modeling.

Key Responsibilities:

Proven mathematical knowledge of specialized risk models such as those used in hedging, economic scenario generation, catastrophe, credit risk, etc. Advanced understanding of risk management operations such as asset-liability management, portfolio risk assessment, hedging, etc. Sophisticated written and verbal communication skills. Advanced proficiency with Excel and common statistical software such as R, SAS, Python, or MATLAB.

Mozilla Corporation is a non-profit-backed technology company that has helped shape the internet for the better over the past 25 years. We’re the makers of Firefox, the privacy-focused web browser used by more than 225 million people around the world each month. As we look to the future, we’re working to shape the next 25 years of the internet—one that’s built for people, not just for profit.

Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the 501(c) non-profit Mozilla Foundation, meaning we’re accountable not to shareholders, but to our mission. Alongside thousands of contributors and collaborators around the world, Mozillians design, build, and maintain open-source software that empowers people to use the internet on their own terms.

About this team and role

Firefox Enterprise is seeking a Staff Product Manager to own a major part of our 2027 product roadmap as we grow from our first release into a multi-product enterprise offering. This is a high-impact role for someone who has taken enterprise security products from zero to one. You will set direction, align engineering, design and go-to-market partners, and deliver.

This role is ideal for someone who can work across teams with empathy, build trust with a wide range of partners, and move work forward in a practical, low-ego way. You do not need to know browsers inside out, but you do need to bring structure to ambiguity, make clear product decisions, and follow through.

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. Description

We are hiring Junior AI/ML Engineers to help build AI agents that handle customer conversations through voice and chat.

You'll work on the retrieval, orchestration, APIs, and integrations behind these systems, helping turn working prototypes into reliable production solutions. You'll collaborate with full-stack engineers, CX designers, and operations teams to develop AI-powered experiences that are practical, secure, and effective.

We welcome candidates with relevant professional experience, internships, research, or hands-on projects who are eager to develop their skills and contribute to real-world AI applications.

What You'll Do

  • Build AI agents: Develop conversational agents that interact with users, call tools and APIs, and hand conversations off to human agents when needed.
  • Develop retrieval pipelines: Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that help AI agents answer questions using approved information sources.
  • Integrate systems: Connect AI agents with CRMs, ticketing systems, databases, and messaging channels.
  • Build and manage APIs: Work with API gateways, authentication, rate limits, and versioning.
  • Support voice AI development: Help build voice agents using speech-to-text, large language models (LLMs), and text-to-speech in English and Spanish.
  • Test and improve quality: Use evaluations, automated tests, and guardrails to improve accuracy, reliability, and safety.
  • Support deployment and monitoring: Ship and maintain solutions through CI/CD, monitoring, and documentation.
  • Collaborate across teams: Work with engineering, CX design, and operations colleagues to turn prototypes into production-ready solutions.

Our Technology Stack

Our primary cloud platform is Microsoft Azure, but experience with AWS or Google Cloud is also valuable.

Relevant technologies include Python, Git, Docker, SQL, LLM APIs, agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, REST APIs, API gateways, webhooks, messaging systems, and cloud-based AI services.

Experience with any one of the named tools in each relevant area is sufficient. You don't need to have used every framework or platform listed.

Working Environment

This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates based in Colombia or Mexico. You'll work with full-stack engineers, CX designers, and operations teams to build and improve AI-powered customer conversation solutions.

We value curiosity, practical problem-solving, collaboration, and a willingness to learn. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to AI agents, retrieval systems, integrations, and voice AI applications while developing your engineering skills.

﻿

﻿Hiring Process

To ensure fairness and consistency, all applicants must complete every stage of the hiring process.

Our process includes:

  1. Resume Review
  2. Pre-Screen Questionnaire
  3. One-Way Video Interview
  4. Live Interview

Please Note

  • ﻿This is an English-speaking role that requires strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • All resumes must be submitted in English to be considered for this position.

Requirements

What You'll Bring

  • 1–3 years of experience in software engineering or ML engineering. Relevant internships and research experience count.
  • Solid Python skills and familiarity with Git, Docker, and basic SQL.
  • Experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with an LLM API, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Azure OpenAI.
  • Experience building an AI agent that calls tools or APIs, using a framework such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel.
  • Experience building a RAG pipeline, including document chunking, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval tuning.
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs, including authentication, rate limits, and versioning, with some exposure to API gateways.
  • Experience connecting systems through webhooks, SDKs, or message queues, such as integrating an application with a CRM or database.
  • Understanding of ML fundamentals, including embeddings, train/test splits, and evaluation metrics such as precision and recall.
  • Professional written and spoken English and Spanish.
  • Based in Colombia or Mexico.

Candidates with strong foundational knowledge and relevant academic, internship, research, or personal project experience are encouraged to apply.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with speech AI or voice agent technologies, such as Azure AI Speech, Whisper, LiveKit, or Pipecat.
  • Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or integration platforms such as Azure Logic Apps or n8n.

Founding Practice Lead — Delphi Digital

Delphi Digital is hiring a Managing Director to build and lead a new Stablecoins, Payments & Fintech
advisory practice within our Research & Consulting business.

This is not a traditional business-development role. You will not inherit a finished product, a mature delivery team, or a predetermined sales playbook.

You will help determine:

  • Where Delphi should compete
  • Which clients and partners we should pursue
  • What services we should offer
  • How we win and deliver our first engagements
  • What intellectual property we need to build
  • How the practice should scale

You will operate like a founding partner inside a consulting firm, with meaningful ownership across strategy, revenue, client delivery, thought leadership, and team building.

The opportunity

Delphi has spent years building deep crypto-native expertise across:

  • Stablecoins and tokenization
  • Wallets, custody, and onboarding
  • Payment and settlement infrastructure
  • Liquidity and market fragmentation
  • User adoption and retention
  • Digital-asset market structure
  • Incentive and network design
  • Emerging financial infrastructure

We are now looking to bring that expertise to payments companies, fintechs, banks, investors, strategic acquirers, and advisory firms navigating the transition toward programmable money and onchain financial infrastructure.

Our goal is not to become a large implementation consultancy. We want to be the independent, opinionated strategic partner clients call when they need to determine:

  • What is real versus narrative
  • Where stablecoins create genuine commercial value
  • Where traditional payment rails remain superior
  • Whether to build, buy, or partner
  • Which markets, products, and infrastructure providers matter
  • Where the client has a credible right to win
  • What actions it should take next

What you will own

Build the practice

  • Validate the most attractive markets, customer segments, and buying triggers.
  • Define Delphi’s initial service offerings, positioning, and pricing.
  • Build the practice strategy, revenue model, and target-account plan.
  • Identify where Delphi has a differentiated right to win — and where we should not compete.

Originate and close business

  • Develop senior relationships across payments, fintech, banking, treasury, investment, and corporate strategy.
  • Personally originate and close complex advisory engagements.
  • Own discovery, qualification, scoping, pricing, proposals, negotiation, and account expansion.
  • Convert initial projects into repeat engagements and retained relationships.
  • Maintain rigorous pipeline, attribution, and forecasting discipline.

Build partner-led distribution

Develop relationships with firms that already have relevant client and transaction flow, including:

  • Investment banks and M&A advisers
  • PE and VC firms
  • Corporate-development teams
  • Consulting and strategic-advisory firms
  • Law and accounting firms

Position Delphi as their specialist partner for commercial diligence, market assessment, private research, expert advisory, and digital-asset strategy.

Productize Delphi’s expertise

Initial service areas may include:

  • Stablecoin and payments strategy
  • Commercial and market diligence
  • Private, opinionated research
  • Retained strategic advisory
  • Executive and board briefings
  • Expert advisory

You will turn Delphi’s expertise into clearly scoped and repeatable offerings rather than a collection of unrelated bespoke projects.

Lead initial client delivery

  • Personally lead the first anchor engagements.
  • Establish the quality bar for institutional advisory work.
  • Ensure our work is decision-oriented and difficult to replicate with generic consulting or AI-generated analysis.
  • Convert early engagements into reusable frameworks, diagnostics, and intellectual property.
  • Build a delivery model that can scale beyond your direct involvement.

Build authority and the team

  • Work closely with Delphi Research and Delphi Media on high-conviction stablecoin, payments, and fintech themes.
  • Publish or materially shape differentiated points of view.
  • Participate in executive briefings, podcasts, industry events, and closed-door roundtables.
  • Recruit and develop the delivery team as demand is proven.

Who you are

You bring significant experience across one or more of:

  • Payments and fintech
  • Banking or treasury technology
  • Financial infrastructure
  • Stablecoins and digital assets
  • Enterprise partnerships
  • Institutional advisory

You have:

  • A demonstrated record of personally originating and closing meaningful institutional business.
  • An active network across payments, fintech, banking, treasury, investment, or strategic advisory.
  • Credible fluency in both traditional payment economics and crypto-native infrastructure.
  • Experience selling complex, consultative engagements to senior decision-makers.
  • The ability to create commercial opportunities without an established playbook.
  • The judgment to explain where stablecoins create real value—and where they do not.
  • The ability to turn an ambiguous client question into a scoped and priced engagement.
  • Strong written, verbal, and executive communication skills.
  • The willingness to remain hands-on across selling, delivery, thought leadership, and team building.

You should be equally comfortable speaking with a skeptical CFO, pressure-testing a payments strategy, closing a complex advisory engagement, leading a client workstream, and developing an opinionated market thesis.

What success looks like

During your first year, you will:

  • Validate Delphi’s priority markets and customer segments.
  • Define and launch the initial service portfolio.
  • Build a high-quality direct and partner-led pipeline.
  • Win several anchor clients and productive channel relationships.
  • Establish a recognized Delphi point of view in stablecoins and payments.
  • Create repeatable Research-to-advisory and Media-to-advisory motions.
  • Build the foundation for a durable, multi-million-dollar practice

Over time, success means creating a practice with:

  • Repeatable offerings
  • Strong client references
  • Recurring and retained revenue
  • Healthy delivery economics
  • Distributed client ownership
  • A team and operating model that can scale beyond any one individual

Why join Delphi

This is an opportunity to build a new business using Delphi’s established crypto expertise, research
capabilities, market relationships, and brand.

The role offers substantial autonomy, direct influence over the practice’s strategy and team, and a highly competitive compensation package with significant performance-linked upside and meaningful long-term incentives.

We are looking for someone who wants to build a business — not simply occupy a role.

Location

United States-based candidates are preferred. Proximity to New York, Miami, or another major financial services and payments hub is helpful but not required for an exceptional candidate.

Regular travel for clients, partners, industry events, and internal collaboration should be expected.

Express interest

Please share your résumé or LinkedIn profile along with a short note covering:

  1. Two or three significant engagements or partnerships you personally originated and closed.
  2. The first five companies or channel partners you would approach.
  3. One stablecoin or payments use case you believe the market currently overestimates.
  4. Why you believe Delphi has a right to win in this market.
  5. Why you want to build a practice rather than simply occupy a role.
