POSITION SUMMARY

The Claims Business Process Analyst optimizes and modernizes claims processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and alignment. This role analyzes workflows, identifies bottlenecks, and drives improvements by partnering with stakeholders and consultants to document gaps, define future processes, and implement solutions aligned with strategic priorities.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Evaluate claims business processes and identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
  • Conduct root cause analyses to uncover operational gaps, data inconsistencies, or process bottlenecks.
  • Define and document “as-is” and “to-be” workflows using process mapping and related methodologies.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, to design improved end-to-end claims processes.
  • Translate business needs into functional process requirements for automation, system enhancement, or workflow redesign.
  • Work with the support partner vendor to implement fixes and enhancements to the Duck Creek Claims system.
  • Document requirements, perform user acceptance testing and validation during release cycles for the claims system.
  • Produce release notes and update the department as necessary on system changes.
  • Develop, standardize, and maintain claims-related business processes, procedures, and performance metrics.
  • Serve as a liaison between Claims and other departments to ensure process coherence, data alignment, and to enhance system capabilities (e.g. Duck Creek, OnBase).
  • Support Single Source of Truth initiatives ensuring consistent data usage, definitions, and reporting across systems.
  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure process effectiveness and turnaround times.
  • Prepare and present insights, findings, and process improvement recommendations to leadership.
  • Support internal and external audits with accurate process documentation and data integrity assurance.
  • Lead or participate in business process reengineering (BPR) and operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Promote continuous improvement through feedback loops, metric- driven decision making, and proactive issue resolution.
  • Perform any other tasks required to support the Association’s Mission, Values, and Strategic Objectives.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.
  • Experience with Homeowners and Catastrophe (CAT) claims, particularly wind and fire events, preferred — with emphasis on understanding end-to-end claims workflows, dependencies, and process challenges.
  • Proven experience in process management or business process improvement.
  • Advanced knowledge and practical application of process improvement tools and methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Business Process Management (BPM).
  • Experience with the Duck Creek Claims platform (or similar claims management systems) preferred.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) with the ability to develop clear documentation, process visuals, and performance tracking templates.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with internal stakeholders, consultants, and leadership.
Salary: $80,000-$85,000

jobs.description:
Pipeworks Studios is seeking a UI/UX Designer II to serve as the senior UI/UX individual contributor and primary experience-design owner for a high-profile digital collectible card game. This role will define the information architecture, interaction models, and player flows for data-driven actions across core card gameplay, persistence, progression, and related metagame systems.
The designer will translate complex game rules, feature requirements, and data states into cohesive player experiences that UI art and engineering can implement clearly and consistently. The role owns UX strategy, interaction design, and production-ready specifications while partnering with UI art on visual execution and engineering on implementation.
Experience with free-to-play (F2P) collectible card games (CCGs), whether through professional development or demonstrated subject matter expertise, is highly preferred. A strong understanding of the genre's player expectations, collection management, progression systems, and interconnected gameplay loops will be particularly valuable for success in this role.
This is a full-time temporary role with the possibility of extension or conversion to regular full-time employment after six months. Our studio is based in Eugene, Oregon, and the successful candidate may choose to work fully remotely, in a hybrid arrangement, or in the office.

Day To Day

Responsibilities
  • Own end-to-end UX for data-driven actions and player flows across core card gameplay, persistence, progression, and related metagame systems.
  • Translate game design goals, rules, and system data into information architecture, user journeys, screen flows, wireframes, prototypes, and implementation-ready specifications.
  • Define interaction behavior, content hierarchy, states, transitions, edge cases, data requirements, and acceptance criteria so art and engineering can execute with minimal ambiguity.
  • Partner with game design, UI art, engineering, production, QA, and external stakeholders to carry features from concept through implementation, validation, and delivery.
  • Lead UX reviews, communicate design rationale, reconcile feedback, and maintain a consistent player experience across interconnected features.
  • Validate designs through playtests, usability reviews, and available player feedback, then iterate based on findings.
  • Establish reusable UX patterns and documentation practices that improve consistency and reduce rework.
  • Scope and plan owned work, surface risks and dependencies early, and provide craft guidance to designers working on connected flows.

Skills Knowledge and Expertise

Must Have Skills
  • Strong interaction-design and systems-thinking skills, with demonstrated experience turning complex rules, data, and state changes into clear player actions and feedback.
  • Proficiency in information architecture, user flows, wireframing, interactive prototyping, and annotated production specifications.
  • Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, usability, accessibility, readability, and consistency across data-rich interfaces.
  • Ability to anticipate alternate states, transitions, edge cases, error conditions, and the ways content may scale over time.
  • Proficiency with Figma or comparable UI/UX design and prototyping tools.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with UI artists and engineers throughout implementation while balancing player needs, creative goals, and technical constraints.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present rationale, resolve conflicting feedback, and document decisions for distributed teams and external partners.

Nice-To-Have Skills
  • Experience designing UI/UX for digital collectible card games, deck-builders, strategy games, or other data-dense game systems.
  • Shipped ownership of persistence, progression, collection, or other interconnected metagame experiences.
  • Experience working on licensed intellectual property or in a co-development environment with external partner reviews.
  • Familiarity with in-engine UI frameworks, proprietary UI tools, or implementation workflows.
  • Experience using usability studies, playtest findings, or telemetry to evaluate and improve player flows.

Experience and Portfolio
  • Five or more years of professional UI/UX, product design, or game design experience.
  • Contributions to two or more shipped games or comparable production releases, including at least one feature or system led from concept through delivery.
  • Prefer portfolio demonstrating ownership of complex interaction flows, design rationale, iteration, cross-discipline collaboration, and final outcomes.

A Flexible Working EnvironmentAlmost all of our roles allow for your choice of work location. We're happy to support our team no matter where they prefer to work: remote, in office, or hybrid.

By diversifying our workforce, increasing equity, and ensuring that our individual differences are valued, we are better able to deliver an experience that reflects, inspires, and connects with our audience... because games are for everyone!

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Executive Assistant

Position Location: United States, Remote

Salary

QC Servion recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Why This Role, Why Now

To keep pace with scaling our Ecosystem of companies, we are seeking high-level Executive Assistants to partner directly with C-Suite executives. This is not a general administrative role. It is for seasoned Executive Assistants who have operated at the very top of an organization, who treat calendar, travel, expense and inbox management as a craft and who use AI every day to work faster, sharper and smarter.

If you are the person executives trust to run their day, protect their time and anticipate what they need before they ask, we want to talk with you.

Job Summary

The Executive Assistant is a trusted, high-touch partner to C-Suite executives across our Ecosystem of companies, ensuring seamless execution of strategic initiatives in a fully remote, fast-moving, high-growth environment. Drawing on deep organizational savvy, executive presence, advanced technical and AI acumen and a polished, service-oriented mindset, this professional shields senior leaders from operational friction so they can stay focused on the decisions that move the business.

The Executive Administrative Assistant will be self-directed on day-to-day work, receive high-level direction on new projects and assignments and execute work of complex scope with minimal oversight. This individual will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, exercise sound judgment and absolute discretion, and adapt quickly as priorities, tools and the organization itself evolve.

Essential Functions

Executive Calendar & Inbox Management (40%)

  • Own complex, multi-time-zone calendars for one or more C-Suite executives; anticipate conflicts, focus time and proactively negotiate solutions with other executive offices
  • Triage high-volume executive inboxes: prioritize, flag, respond on the executive’s behalf, where authorized, and surface only what requires their attention
  • Draft, proofread and format executive correspondence, briefing materials, slide decks and proposals to a polished, executive-ready standard
  • Prepare executives for every meeting with agendas, pre-reads, background and follow-up actions
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, including partners and senior leaders

Travel & Expense Management (25%)

  • Plan and manage domestic and international executive travel end-to-end, including complex multi-leg itineraries, visas, risk-mitigation protocols, ground transportation and on-site logistics
  • Rebook and resolve travel disruptions in real time, with contingency plans ready before they are needed
  • Prepare, reconcile and submit expense reports accurately and on time; track receipts, maintain budget and policy compliance, and partner with Finance on corrections and audits

Executive Meeting & Event Support (15%)

  • Assist in executive and leadership and committee meetings, including scheduling, materials assembly, distribution and secure document handling
  • Assist in coordinating hybrid and virtual leadership off-sites, annual strategy sessions and executive briefings end-to-end
  • Capture and track decisions and action items; ensure timely follow-through

Leadership Reporting & Cross-Functional Coordination (10%)

  • Assemble and circulate leadership status reports, synthesizing inputs from multiple companies and departments into concise executive summaries
  • Track action items and follow-ups across functional teams, ensuring timely completion and transparent communication
  • Provide project-management / coordination support for strategic initiatives as needed

AI Enablement, Information Governance & Process Optimization (10%)

  • Use AI tools (Microsoft Copilot, Claude) daily to draft, summarize, research, prepare briefings and automate repetitive work
  • Identify and implement process improvements, automations and AI-enabled workflows that scale executive support as the Ecosystem grows
  • Maintain confidential files and records, ensuring adherence to policies and security protocols, including safe and appropriate use of AI with sensitive information

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

  • Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Required Core Skills: Impeccable Execution Expected

Candidates must demonstrate mastery in each of the following. These are assessed directly during the interview process.

  • Calendaring: Proven ownership of complex, multi-executive, multi-time-zone calendars at the C-Suite level, with zero tolerance for errors
  • Travel: Complex domestic and international travel planning and real-time issue resolution for senior executives
  • Expense Management: Accurate, timely expense reporting and reconciliation using enterprise systems
  • Email Triage: Proven ability to manage high-volume executive inboxes, prioritize with sound judgment and communicate on the executive’s behalf
  • AI Use & Adaptability: Strong, hands-on daily use of AI tools for drafting, summarizing, research and automation, plus the adaptability to learn new tools and workflows quickly as the organization scales

Position Requirements

Advanced level for all the following unless otherwise noted:

  • Executive presence and the ability to interact confidently and credibly with C-Suite executives and external partners
  • Absolute discretion with highly confidential information, including transactions, personnel and financial data
  • Advanced skill in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint)

  • Knowledge of administrative procedures and systems, including managing files and records, designing forms and document control
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in all deliverables
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, technical and non-technical
  • Ability to anticipate needs, think several steps ahead and act without being asked

Qualifications

Physical Demands

This role requires exceptional English language proficiency, with precise pronunciation and highly effective conversational skills, to ensure clear, confident, and professional communication with customers.

A Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement estate needs a business-facing functional consultant who can run the work in German. You will sit between the business and the delivery team: working out what the business needs, deciding how Dynamics should meet it, and writing it down so the team can build it. This is a functional role, not a development one.

What you will do

Run requirement and process workshops with German-speaking business users, in German. Produce the fit gap: what configures, what needs customising, and what the business changes instead. Write the target process and solution design at a level a delivery team can pick up, and defend it with the business. Take the business through testing and sign-off, and support them into live use. Report findings, risks and options to the programme in English.

What you bring

6 to 7 years of experience, with D365 Customer Engagement (or Dynamics CRM) delivered as a functional consultant or business analyst, in Sales, Customer Service or both. Discovery and fit gap work as a named deliverable, with the written work to show for it. Fluent German, good enough to run a workshop and write a design in it, and fluent English. Comfortable working remotely with business stakeholders you have not met in person.

Practical

Fully remote. You need to be based in the UK or Europe with the right to work where you are. Contract through Yadimen Consulting Limited, a financial services IT consulting company.

Social Media Manager - Insurance & Business Services Specialist

ABOUT US

321 is a creative marketing agency using strategic data to create the kinds of meaningful moments that connect, inspire, and engage. We thrive on collaboration, agility, and heart — and we're powered by teammates who focus on what matters, bring proactive solutions to the table, and take full ownership of their work. We believe great work starts with great people, and we're looking for one more to join the team.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Social Media Manager - Insurance & Business Services Specialist at 321, you will serve as the strategic lead for organic social media across a diverse portfolio of client accounts, with primary focus on insurance (home, auto, and related product lines) and business services industries including roofing, legal services, real estate, healthcare, and home services. You'll develop comprehensive content strategies that align with business objectives, manage editorial calendars across multiple platforms, and oversee the day-to-day execution of social media programs that drive engagement, brand awareness, and business results.

This role requires specialized expertise in insurance marketing dynamics including seasonal enrollment periods, life event triggers, policy education, claims positioning, and trust-building for financial services. You understand how to translate complex insurance products into accessible, engaging content that builds consumer confidence and drives quote generation while navigating regulatory compliance requirements.

This role sits at the intersection of content strategy, brand storytelling, platform expertise, insurance industry knowledge, and AI-enhanced content creation. You'll bring deep expertise in social media management alongside proven ability to craft compelling narratives for insurance brands and professional services organizations. Your strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution skills will enable you to balance creative excellence with platform best practices, compliance requirements, and business outcomes. As part of an AI-first organization, you'll leverage intelligent tools to scale content production, optimize performance, and deliver exceptional results across a high volume of client accounts.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Social Media Strategy & Planning

  • Develop comprehensive social media strategies for multiple insurance and business services client accounts that align with business objectives, target audiences, and brand positioning
  • Create insurance-specific content strategies that address the full customer lifecycle: awareness, quote consideration, policy purchase, claims experience, and renewal/retention
  • Understand and optimize for insurance consumer behavior including comparison shopping, life event triggers (home purchase, vehicle purchase, marriage, relocation), and seasonal patterns
  • Conduct competitive analysis, audience research, and platform audits to identify opportunities in insurance and business services verticals
  • Define content pillars, messaging frameworks, and brand voice guidelines tailored to insurance audiences and professional service consumers
  • Develop strategies that build trust and credibility for insurance brands while addressing common concerns (price transparency, claims reputation, coverage clarity, customer service quality)
  • Establish KPIs and success metrics for each client account, tracking performance against goals for reach, engagement, quote generation, and business impact
  • Leverage AI tools to analyze audience insights, predict content performance, and optimize strategy based on data-driven insights
  • Stay current on platform algorithm changes, emerging features, and social media trends in insurance marketing, adapting strategies to maximize organic reach
  • Monitor insurance industry trends, regulatory changes, and competitive landscape to inform content strategy

Content Strategy & Calendar Management

  • Create and manage comprehensive editorial calendars across multiple platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube) for 8-12+ client accounts simultaneously
  • Plan insurance-specific content calendars that align with seasonal opportunities including:
    • Weather-related awareness campaigns (storm season, winter driving, hurricane preparedness)
    • Life event marketing (moving season, graduation, back-to-school, wedding season)
    • Annual enrollment periods and open enrollment windows
    • Policy renewal cycles and retention campaigns
    • National awareness months relevant to insurance (Distracted Driving Awareness, Fire Prevention Week, etc.)
  • Develop content mix that balances promotional messaging, educational content (coverage explanations, claims tips, risk prevention), community engagement, and brand storytelling
  • Create content themes and campaigns that support insurance business objectives including quote generation, brand awareness, policy education, and customer retention
  • Coordinate content timing around client priorities, seasonal trends, industry events, regulatory changes, and platform-specific best practices
  • Utilize AI-powered content planning tools to generate ideas, optimize posting schedules, and maintain consistent publishing cadence
  • Manage content approval workflows with clients and compliance reviews, ensuring regulatory adherence and timely production schedules
  • Balance evergreen insurance education content with timely, reactive posts that capitalize on trending topics, weather events, and cultural moments
  • Develop content series that simplify complex insurance concepts for consumer audiences (coverage types, deductibles, claims process, bundling benefits)

Content Creation & Asset Coordination - Insurance Focus

  • Write compelling social media copy that resonates with insurance consumers and drives engagement across all platforms while maintaining regulatory compliance
  • Create insurance-specific content including:
    • Policy coverage explainers and educational posts
    • Claims tips and customer support content
    • Risk prevention and safety guidance (home maintenance, safe driving, disaster preparedness)
    • Customer testimonials and claims success stories
    • Agent/team spotlights and humanizing brand content
    • Savings tips and bundle promotions
    • Life event-triggered content (new homeowner tips, first-time car buyer advice)
  • Leverage AI tools for content ideation, copywriting assistance, and optimization to scale insurance content production efficiently
  • Navigate insurance advertising regulations and compliance requirements across all content
  • Collaborate closely with Creative team to brief designers and video editors on asset needs, providing clear direction on specifications, creative concepts, and compliance considerations
  • Review and provide feedback on creative assets to ensure they align with brand guidelines, platform requirements, regulatory standards, and strategic objectives
  • Create basic visual content and graphics using design tools (Canva, Adobe Express) and AI-powered design platforms when needed
  • Capture on-location content including photos and video footage during client site visits, industry events, or content creation sessions (bonus skill)
  • Edit and optimize content assets for platform-specific requirements including aspect ratios, file sizes, and caption lengths
  • Maintain organized asset libraries and content repositories for efficient reuse and adaptation across insurance and business services clients

Post Scheduling & Community Management

  • Schedule and publish social media content across all platforms using management tools (Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Meta Business Suite, or similar)
  • Monitor social media channels daily for comments, messages, and mentions, responding promptly and appropriately on behalf of insurance and business services clients
  • Manage insurance-specific community engagement including:
    • Responding to policy and coverage questions with accurate, compliant information
    • Directing quote requests and complex inquiries to appropriate client contacts
    • Addressing claims-related comments and concerns with empathy and professionalism
    • Handling negative feedback or service complaints according to client protocols
    • Navigating sensitive situations including denied claims, rate increases, or coverage disputes
  • Engage with client audiences authentically, fostering community growth and brand loyalty through thoughtful interactions
  • Manage social media reputation by addressing customer inquiries, concerns, and feedback in coordination with client teams while adhering to insurance compliance standards
  • Utilize AI-powered moderation and response tools to efficiently manage high-volume community engagement while maintaining quality and compliance
  • Escalate sensitive issues, regulatory concerns, or complex inquiries to appropriate client contacts with recommended responses
  • Identify and amplify user-generated content, testimonials, positive claims experiences, and brand mentions
  • Monitor and respond to reviews on Facebook, Google, and other platforms, coordinating with clients on reputation management strategies

Performance Analysis & Optimization

  • Track and analyze social media performance metrics including reach, engagement, follower growth, website traffic, and quote-funnel impact
  • Measure insurance-specific performance indicators including:
    • Content performance by topic (coverage education vs. promotional vs. community engagement)
    • Engagement during seasonal campaigns and life event marketing
    • Click-through rates to quote pages and policy information
    • Audience sentiment around claims, pricing, and service quality
    • Competitive share of voice in insurance category
  • Generate monthly performance reports with insights, trends, and strategic recommendations for each client account
  • Use AI-powered analytics to identify content patterns, predict performance, and optimize future content strategies
  • Conduct A/B testing on content formats, posting times, captions, and creative approaches to continuously improve results
  • Translate social media metrics into business impact, connecting engagement to quote generation, brand awareness, policy education, and client objectives
  • Present performance insights and strategic recommendations to clients and internal teams through clear, compelling storytelling
  • Monitor competitor social media activity, insurance industry benchmarks, and category best practices to identify opportunities and maintain competitive positioning

Industry Expertise & Client Collaboration

  • Develop deep understanding of insurance products including home insurance, auto insurance, renters insurance, umbrella policies, and bundling strategies
  • Understand insurance consumer behavior, purchase cycles, comparison shopping patterns, and decision-making factors
  • Navigate insurance-specific compliance requirements including state regulations, advertising disclosure requirements, and industry-specific guidelines
  • Maintain expertise in business services industries including roofing, legal services, real estate, healthcare, and home services marketing
  • Navigate industry-specific compliance requirements across all verticals, particularly for regulated sectors like insurance, legal services, and healthcare
  • Educate clients on social media best practices, platform changes, and emerging opportunities relevant to insurance and business services industries
  • Partner with Client Success teams to align social media strategies with broader marketing campaigns, lead generation initiatives, and business development objectives
  • Identify content opportunities from insurance client operations including claims success stories, community involvement, agent profiles, customer testimonials, and risk prevention thought leadership
  • Participate in client meetings and strategy sessions, representing social media perspective and recommending integrated approaches
  • Stay current on insurance industry news, regulatory changes, InsurTech innovations, and category trends that create content opportunities

WHAT YOU HAVE

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in social media management, preferably in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • 2+ years of direct experience managing social media for insurance brands (home insurance, auto insurance, personal lines) or financial services organizations required
  • Proven track record developing and executing successful social media strategies for insurance, business services, professional services, or B2B brands
  • Experience managing social media for insurance companies, insurance agencies, roofing companies, legal firms, real estate professionals, healthcare providers, or similar business services industries is highly valued
  • Deep understanding of insurance consumer behavior, purchase considerations, and content that drives trust and engagement in the insurance category
  • Knowledge of insurance industry regulations and advertising compliance requirements across multiple states/jurisdictions
  • Familiarity with insurance products, coverage types, claims processes, and industry terminology
  • Strong writing skills with ability to craft platform-appropriate content that resonates with insurance consumers and professional audiences while maintaining regulatory compliance
  • Expertise across major social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube, with deep understanding of platform-specific best practices
  • Proficiency with AI-powered content creation tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Jasper, Copy.ai, or similar) with demonstrated ability to produce high-quality, on-brand content efficiently
  • Experience using AI tools for content ideation, image generation (Midjourney, DALL-E), video editing, and performance optimization
  • Experience with social media management platforms (Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Later, Buffer, or similar) and native platform tools
  • Strong understanding of social media analytics with ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable strategies
  • Proficiency with design tools (Canva, Adobe Express, or Adobe Creative Suite) for creating basic graphics and visual content

Nice to Haves

  • Bonus: Photography and videography skills with experience capturing on-location content including project documentation, team profiles, customer testimonials, and behind-the-scenes footage
  • Bonus: Video editing capabilities using tools like CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or AI-powered video editing platforms
  • Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance knowledge or insurance licensing
  • Experience with insurance technology platforms, quote systems, or agency management systems
  • Understanding of social media advertising principles and how organic content supports paid campaigns (execution handled by Digital team)
  • Experience managing social media during major weather events, natural disasters, or crisis situations
  • Knowledge of compliance considerations for regulated industries including HIPAA (healthcare), attorney advertising rules, insurance advertising regulations, and industry-specific guidelines
  • Experience with customer service and reputation management for service-based industries
  • Background in financial services marketing beyond insurance
  • Understanding of SEO and content marketing strategies

Essential Skills & Attributes

  • Exceptional organizational skills with ability to manage multiple editorial calendars, deadlines, compliance reviews, and stakeholder approvals simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail ensuring brand consistency, regulatory compliance, platform specifications, and error-free content across all posts
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to build relationships with clients, collaborate with creative teams, and present strategic recommendations
  • Proactive problem-solver who takes ownership of accounts and drives results without constant oversight
  • Continuous learner who stays current on social media trends, platform changes, AI tools, insurance industry developments, and regulatory updates
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and tight deadlines
  • Professional demeanor with ability to represent insurance and professional services brands authentically and handle sensitive community management situations
  • Empathy and customer service orientation for managing claims-related inquiries and service concerns
  • Ability to simplify complex insurance concepts into accessible, engaging content for consumer audiences

REPORTING STRUCTURE

This position reports to the SVP of Strategy.

This position collaborates closely with Creative, Client Success, and Digital teams.

COMPENSATION

$60,000 - $75,000 per year (dependent on experience and insurance industry expertise)

321 BENEFITS

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K after one year of employment
  • 2 Weeks (80 Hrs) Paid Time Off [Additional 40Hrs at 3 Years]
  • 3 Sick/Mental Health Days
  • 8 Hours Volunteer Time
  • Additional PTO at holiday and management discretion
  • Paid parental leave
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Leadership training opportunities and career advancement pathways
  • A collaborative, creative, and ambitious team environment

321 is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.

Salary: $65,000-$80,000

Overview

Supports accurate month-end close, invoicing, revenue application, and inventory reporting through detailed validation, reconciliation, and analysis. This role researches discrepancies, monitors operational and financial metrics, identifies potential revenue leakage, and prepares recurring reports and invoice support. The role escalates material findings and collaborates with internal partners to maintain financial accuracy and effective controls.

Responsibilities

  • Support month-end revenue validation by reconciling outputs, exceptions, adjustments, open inventory, and close support schedules.

Terra Nova Solutions (« TNS ») est une société du groupe Solon qui agit en tant que fournisseur de services pour Solon. TNS est une société de services professionnels qui renforce les capacités de ses clients au sein des marchés Africains, y compris ceux avec des défis importants. TNS fournit une gamme de services de finance, de conformité, de consultant et de conseil dans plusieurs secteurs et zones géographiques en Afrique subsaharienne.

L'opportunité :

Solon entreprend de bâtir un système de développement des joueurs de football à travers l'Afrique de l'Ouest - en éliminant les barrières structurelles pour permettre aux talents émergents du continent de s'épanouir. Lancé au Ghana en avril 2024, nous poursuivons la mise en en œuvre de la première phase de ce projet : un programme gratuit de formation de base au football pour les garçons et les filles à partir de l'âge de 6 ans, réparti dans les écoles primaires de chaque marché cible en Afrique de l'Ouest. La Guinée est notre prochain marché cible.

Nous recherchons un responsable de programme expérimenté et proactif pour soutenir l'intention de Solon de mettre en œuvre cette phase initiale de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football en Guinée. Le rôle consistera à travailler avec une équipe soudée pour évaluer et développer les opportunités de mise en œuvre du programme. Vous rejoindrez une équipe collégiale, collaborative et curieuse.

Responsabilités :

Le candidat idéal adoptera une approche pratique pour gérer avec succès divers groupes de travail afin d'évaluer la Guinée en tant que nouveau marché pour la mise en place de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football. Il devra travailler en étroite collaboration avec les communautés, le gouvernement et d'autres partenaires pour résoudre les problèmes et faire avancer les différentes initiatives et étapes du projet. Il s'agira également d'être capable de répondre avec enthousiasme à un ensemble de demandes et de défis rapides et variés.

Quelques exemples de responsabilités :

  • Évaluation des opportunités. Identifier et évaluer les possibilités de partenariat avec les établissements scolaires en Guinée afin de mettre en place la première phase de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football - un programme de formation de base au football pour les garçons et les filles à partir de l'âge de 6 ans, réparti dans les écoles primaires existantes.
  • Mise en œuvre du programme. En coordination avec l'équipe de Solon, mettre en œuvre et développer le programme de formation de base au football avec les propriétaires et réseaux d'écoles primaires identifiés en Guinée y compris l’éducation nationale ; assurer une supervision efficace pour veiller à ce que le programme réponde aux normes et aux objectifs de Solon.
  • Engagement des parties prenantes. Établir et entretenir des relations avec les principales parties prenantes, notamment les prestataires de services, les représentants du gouvernement, les partenaires donateurs, les consultants et les membres des communautés. Collaborez avec les potentiels partenaires locaux, les experts du secteur et d’autres parties prenantes pour recueillir des informations et promouvoir les intérêts de Solon.
  • Rapports et évaluation. Préparer des rapports détaillés et des présentations pour l’équipe d’encadrement de Solon afin de faciliter les processus de prise de décision.
  • Gestion de projets. Gérer les délais, les ressources et les délivrables pour les projets désignés. Veiller à ce que toutes les activités du projet respectent les normes et les objectifs de Solon, en produisant des résultats dans les délais et le respect des budgets établis.

Qualifications :

Les qualifications de base pour cette mission sont les suivantes

  • Diplôme bac +4 en administration des affaires ; Sciences économiques ; Relations internationales ; école de commerce ou domaines connexes.
  • Expérience avérée en développement commercial ou dans un rôle similaire, de préférence en Guinée ou sur des marchés similaires.
  • Solides compétences en communication écrite et orale, y compris la préparation de rapports de projet détaillés et la présentation à un public diversifié.
  • Superbe attention aux détails et application au travail
  • Capacité à travailler efficacement dans un environnement d'équipe multiculturelle et en rapide évolution.
  • Solides compétences interpersonnelles et aptitudes à la résolution de problèmes.
  • Connaissance approfondie de la culture, des coutumes et des pratiques commerciales de la Guinée.
  • Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (à l'oral et à l'écrit).
  • Intégrité, bonne capacité de jugement et sens des affaires.
  • Bonne présence et comportement professionnel.
  • Capacité à résider et travailler légalement en Guinée.
  • Passion ou intérêt pour le football

Une expérience et/ou des connaissances dans les domaines du football, de l'éducation, ainsi que des initiatives de développement de projets dans ces domaines sont souhaitables.

Nature de l'engagement : un engagement contractuel de 6 mois dont la durée peut être prolongée et évoluer plus tard vers un rôle à temps plein au sein de la société.

Horaires de travail : Prendre en compte des possibilités de devoir assister en virtuel à des réunions à des heures de bureau standard de plusieurs fuseaux horaires, en particulier l’Amérique du Nord et le Pakistan.

Lieu de travail : Ce rôle exige que le candidat réside en Guinée. jobs.excerpt: We are Hiring! We have an exciting new opportunity at Scope for a Regulatory Affairs Business Partner (Senior RA Specialist) to join our US team!
jobs.description:
We are Hiring!

We have an exciting new opportunity at Scope for a Regulatory Affairs Business Partner (Senior RA Specialist) to join our US team!

We are looking for people who can connect their own personal vision and values into some of what we do at Scope.

Our vision as a company is to become a leading force in Eyecare, with people at our core.

Please read below the full job description for the role and if this is something that you would be interested in, please click apply and a member of the Scope team will be in touch regarding your application.

Regulatory Affairs Business Partner (Senior RA Specialist)

SCOPE is an international, specialist eye care company, and our US business is growing fast. We are looking for an experienced regulatory professional to own US regulatory affairs for our eye care portfolio: OTC ophthalmic drug products marketed under the FDA OTC monograph, Class I/II medical devices, cosmetics and dietary supplements.

This is a senior, hands-on role (Senior Regulatory Specialist level) for someone with US regulatory experience in OTC/consumer health and/or medical devices. You will be the go-to US regulatory expert in a small, close-knit team: setting regulatory strategy, making confident decisions on pathways, labelling and claims, and seeing products through from concept to launch and beyond.

You will work closely with Innovation, Product Development, Quality, Commercial, Marketing and Customer Care, and help bring products that are already successful in the UK and Europe to US patients and eye care professionals.

This role reports to the Senior Regulatory Affairs Manager.

Location: Remote, US-based, with occasional travel for team meetings and industry events. Candidates must be authorised to work in the US.

Key Responsibilities

US Regulatory Strategy & Ownership

  • Own the US regulatory strategy for assigned products from concept through launch and lifecycle management.
  • Determine the right US pathway and classification for each product (OTC monograph drug, 510(k), De Novo, 510(k)-exempt device, cosmetic or dietary supplement).
  • Assess products already marketed in the UK/EU (including CE-marked medical devices) for the US market, identifying classification differences and the changes needed to formulation, claims, labelling or testing.
  • Lead regulatory feasibility and risk assessments and give clear, practical recommendations to the business.
  • Monitor and interpret US regulatory changes (for example OTC monograph reform/OMUFA, MoCRA and FDA QMSR) and assess their impact on the portfolio.

Submissions, Registrations & Market Maintenance

  • Prepare and own 510(k) submissions, Pre-Submissions and responses to FDA requests for additional information.
  • Ensure OTC monograph compliance, including Drug Facts labelling and supporting documentation.
  • Manage establishment registrations and product listings for drugs, devices, and MoCRA cosmetic registration and listing.
  • Act as the point of contact for FDA correspondence and support FDA inspections with Quality.
  • Maintain complete, inspection-ready regulatory files and records.

Labelling, Claims & Promotion

  • Lead the regulatory review and approval of labelling, packaging, claims and promotional materials, including websites, social media and retailer/e-commerce content, against FDA and FTC requirements.
  • Work with Marketing and Innovation to build claims that are compliant, well substantiated and commercially strong.

Innovation & Business Partnering

  • Give early regulatory input to R&D and Innovation on new concepts and guide projects through the stage-gate process.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Commercial, Marketing, Quality and Customer Care, finding solutions that enable commercial opportunities.
  • Partner with Quality on complaints, adverse event reporting (device MDRs and OTC serious adverse events) and other post-market obligations.
  • Provide expert answers to regulatory enquiries from customers, retailers, distributors and internal teams.

Project Leadership

  • Lead the regulatory workstream on cross-functional projects end to end, owning deliverables, timelines and milestones.
  • Manage external partners where needed, such as consultants and test laboratories.
  • Help improve regulatory processes and ways of working, including the use of digital and AI tools.

Qualifications:

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biomedical Science, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs or a related discipline.
  • Desirable: RAC (Regulatory Affairs Certification) or equivalent.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Hands-on US regulatory affairs experience in OTC/consumer health products and/or medical devices.
  • Direct experience with OTC monograph drug products, including Drug Facts labelling, monograph compliance and drug listing (SPL).
  • Direct experience with US medical devices, including classification, establishment registration and listing, and preparing 510(k) submissions.
  • A track record of independently leading regulatory projects from concept to launch.
  • Strong working knowledge of FDA and FTC labelling, advertising and claims requirements, and the confidence to give clear sign-off.
  • Experience managing correspondence with FDA.
  • Comfortable covering several product categories in a lean team and being the go-to regulatory person.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence commercial teams.

Desirable Experience

  • Ophthalmic products in the US market (for example lubricant eye drops, eyelid hygiene or other eye care products).
  • Sterile products, including ophthalmic sterility requirements.
  • Cosmetics (MoCRA) and dietary supplements (DSHEA, structure/function claims).
  • Bringing UK/EU products to the US market or working with an international regulatory team.
  • FDA QMSR / ISO 13485 quality systems.
  • Consumer health or FMCG environments, including retail and e-commerce channels.
  • Experience with AI, digital tools or process improvement initiatives.

Personal attributes

We're looking for someone who:

  • Makes confident, well-reasoned regulatory decisions and owns them.
  • Thinks creatively and finds practical routes to market rather than just identifying barriers.
  • Is collaborative, approachable and enjoys being part of a close-knit team.
  • Is driven and proactive, and enjoys a fast-paced, growing business.
  • Is motivated by making a meaningful impact through better eye care.

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose - moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We are seeking an Executive Director, Biostatistics (Scientific Advisory) to join our team in a remote capacity based in United Kingdom or Ireland. As Executive Director, Biostatistics, you will provide statistical consulting and strategic advice on optimal study designs and analyses across drug, device, and diagnostic clinical development, including preparation for regulatory authority interactions. You will serve as a leader in innovative study designs for client accounts and support new business through project proposals, bids, and client presentations.

This role offers the opportunity to shape clinical development programs, guide complex statistical strategy, and represent clients in important regulatory discussions.   • Participate in departmental meetings, training initiatives, and project team meetings while maintaining effective relationships with other departments, clients, and regulatory agencies.

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Excellent organizational, communication, negotiation, problem-solving, analytical, and consulting skills
  • Technical leadership and the ability to contribute to a high-performing team
  • Expertise in innovative trial designs, protocol and development program optimization, submission strategies, and regulatory interactions

Required Qualifications

jobs.description:
Job Title: Manager, Security Governance, Risk & Compliance

Job Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

The Manager, Security Governance, Risk & Compliance is a hands-on program leadership role supporting the security governance, risk, and compliance program for Cedar Gate Technologies, a healthcare technology business recently acquired by IQVIA. The role reports to the Associate Director responsible for Cedar Gate security and works in close partnership with that leader to run and mature a program that directly supports client trust, audit commitments, and revenue.


Cedar Gate maintains SOC 1, SOC 2, and HITRUST r2 certifications and supports a steady flow of client security reviews, questionnaires, and audit requests. This role oversees the execution of recurring compliance controls — performed largely by an operations team in Nepal — and leads the programs built around them: audit administration, customer assurance, enterprise risk, business continuity, policy, and third-party risk.


A core near-term priority is rebuilding and maturing the enterprise risk program, including interview-driven risk assessments, business impact analyses, disaster recovery planning, and risk exception management with business owners, application leaders, and remediation teams. As integration with IQVIA progresses, the role will help align Cedar Gate’s program with IQVIA’s security and compliance frameworks and expand to support the broader Information Security organization. You will sit within the global Information Security organization, working closely with Cedar Gate IT, product, business operations, and leadership teams, the Nepal operations team, external auditors, and clients.


Principal responsibilities will include:

  • Partner with the Associate Director to run Cedar Gate’s security governance, risk, and compliance program, driving planning, execution, and reporting across compliance, audit, risk, and customer assurance workstreams.
  • Administer annual SOC 1 and SOC 2 audits and HITRUST r2 and interim assessments, coordinating evidence requests, interviews, and walkthroughs between auditors and internal control owners, and driving gap resolution and escalations.
  • Manage audit vendor relationships in partnership with the Associate Director, including vendor selection, contracts, deliverables, and payment.
  • Oversee the execution and quality of recurring compliance controls performed by the Nepal operations team, including logical and physical access reviews, termination reviews, elevated access reviews, backup validation, patching compliance audits, and the annual facility security audit — reviewing results, identifying gaps, and escalating issues to resolution.
  • Oversee data protection controls, including monthly data destruction sample audits, review and issuance of data destruction certificates for clients, and DLP reviews of PHI activity across AWS WorkSpaces users.
  • Support client security reviews, questionnaires, and audit-related communications, including executing SOC 2 NDAs and distributing SOC reports to clients and prospects.
  • Mature the enterprise risk program, maintaining the risk register, leading interview-based risk assessments, managing risk exceptions, and tracking treatment and remediation plans with accountable owners.
  • Deliver regular risk reporting to Cedar Gate and IQVIA leadership on risk register changes, results, and trends, alongside metrics on control effectiveness and audit status.
  • Lead the annual business impact analysis and maintain business continuity and disaster recovery plans, assessing new products and updating plans for existing ones.
  • Develop, review, and update security policies and procedures in partnership with the Associate Director, coordinating stakeholder input and approvals.
  • Oversee third-party risk management for Tier 1 Cedar Gate vendors, including annual reviews of vendor security posture.
  • Coordinate same-day response to significant audit findings, emerging security risks, compliance issues, and customer-driven requests across multiple stakeholders.
  • Support integration by aligning Cedar Gate controls, policies, and evidence processes with IQVIA frameworks, and contribute to broader IQVIA governance, risk, and compliance initiatives as integration progresses.

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • 5–8 years of experience in security governance, risk and compliance, IT audit, or security compliance roles.
  • Hands-on experience administering SOC 1 and SOC 2 audits, including evidence management, auditor coordination, and control owner walkthroughs.
  • Hands-on experience with HITRUST CSF assessments, ideally including r2 and interim assessments.
  • Experience operating or testing IT general controls, including access reviews, termination and elevated access processes, patch management, backup, and data destruction.
  • Experience building or maturing an enterprise or IT risk management program, including risk registers, interview-based risk assessments, exception processes, and remediation tracking.
  • Experience with business impact analysis, business continuity, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Experience supporting customer assurance activities such as security questionnaires, client audits, and SOC report distribution.
  • Experience with third-party risk management and vendor security assessments.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA/HITECH requirements and PHI handling controls.
  • Experience overseeing work performed by offshore or distributed teams without direct reporting lines, including quality review, follow-up, and escalation.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments, preferably AWS, and common security controls such as DLP and endpoint protection.
  • Strong organizational and program management skills, with the ability to run a recurring control calendar and multiple concurrent audits against firm deadlines.
  • Ability to work credibly with executives, auditors, clients, and control owners, and to drive decisions on sensitive findings and risk treatment.
  • Experience in healthcare, health technology, or other regulated environments is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience is preferred.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or HITRUST CCSFP are preferred.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Senior Analyst roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential team placements include:

  • Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
  • Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
  • Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
  • Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
  • Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
  • International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.

About the Role

As a Senior Analyst in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Senior Analyst roles share a common foundation: owning complex analytical problems end to end, translating data into business strategy, and influencing decisions across technical and non-technical teams.

You will operate with autonomy to own the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision. You bring exceptional analytical rigor, deep domain expertise, and the ability to translate complex regulatory, economic, and machine learning insights into actionable business strategies. You thrive in ambiguity, balance growth with resilience, and are comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels to influence stakeholders across the organization.

What You Will Do

  • Optimize End-to-End Strategy: Leverage advanced data analytics to independently derive insights, develop, and optimize business, risk, or growth strategies across products and geographies.
  • Manage Macro & Market Trends: Monitor portfolio performance and exogenous macroeconomic trends, proactively adjusting analytical and operational strategies to mitigate risk and balance growth.
  • Model & Capability Building: Partner deeply with Engineering and Machine Learning teams to design, build, and interpret performance metrics for scalable risk, fraud, or growth models.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance teams to interpret evolving regulatory and market requirements, translating them directly into analytical policy and product design recommendations.
  • Oversee Frameworks & Launches: Oversee the development and execution of analytical frameworks. Drive cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with risk appetite, operational capabilities, and local regulations.
  • External & Strategic Alignment: Engage with external stakeholders, including merchants, vendors, and partners, to align practices, ensure compliance, and strengthen strategic relationships.
  • AI Leverage & Mentorship: Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows that compound across the team's analyses, while mentoring junior analysts on technical craft and domain nuances.

What We Look For

  • 2–5 years of proven experience in an analytically driven role within the consumer lending, credit, or fintech industry, specifically leveraging advanced analytics to develop and optimize business strategies.
  • Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
  • Deep expertise in data mining, data visualization, and statistical modeling, with experience applying machine learning techniques to business or risk management problems.
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional initiatives that bridge Product, Legal, Compliance, and Engineering to align analytical strategies with business objectives.
  • Strong understanding of consumer lending regulations, regional market dynamics, and the broader economic landscape influencing policy and growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory and economic insights into actionable strategies.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across technical and non-technical functions.

Pay Grade - K
Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $112,000 - $172,000

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

HubSpot-Philosophie und -Produkte

Wir finden, die Welt hat sich verändert. Wir sehen, wie Unternehmen statt weniger immer mehr Arten von Software einsetzen – und dabei ist es unerlässlich, dass diese alle zusammen funktionieren. Die Flywheel-Philosophie von HubSpot basiert darauf, dass zufriedene Kundinnen und Kunden Empfehlungen geben und damit Wiederverkäufe fördern. Wir haben auch verstärkt in Integrationen mit unserer Software investiert, mit denen Kundinnen und Kunden unsere Produkte für noch vielfältigere Aufgaben einsetzen können und die zusätzlichen Mehrwert für Unternehmen generieren, die unsere gesamte Produktpalette nutzen.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

Experience-Leveling:

Sr. SCS/Contract Manager III: Minimum of two (2) years of direct site contract and budget negotiation required. Demonstrates strong skillset in overall contract and budget management/oversight and has a minimum of one (1) year of progressive experience leading site contract negotiations as client-facing point of contact within an industry sponsored clinical trial setting.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;

  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

About The Company

FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.

In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices.

Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state-of-the-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents. FairMoney thrives on its diverse workforce, bringing together talent from over 27 nationalities.

We operate at massive scale, move fast, and expect leaders to think in systems, not silos. Decisions are data-driven, accountability is explicit, and impact matters.

This role sits at the heart of how FairMoney decides who to lend to, how much to lend, at what price, and why.

About The Role

We are hiring a Lead: Unit Economics & NPV Strategy to own, improve, and operationalise FairMoney’s existing NPV and unit economics frameworks and ensure they become a core operating system for decision-making, not just analytical artefacts.

While FairMoney already has NPV models in place, they are not yet consistently embedded into credit decisions, pricing, experimentation, and growth trade-offs. This role exists to close that gap.

The successful candidate will be the single source of truth on value creation vs value destruction, expected vs actual performance, and the economic impact of risk, pricing, and growth decisions.

This is a senior, high-ownership role for someone who pushes the bar, challenges assumptions, and thrives in a high-growth, high-pressure environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own NPV & Unit Economics: Own, audit, and improve NPV and unit economics models across lending products, ensuring consistent assumptions and decision-ready outputs for pricing, credit cut-offs, and capital allocation.
  • Measure Expected vs Actual Performance: Build frameworks to measure performance across products, cohorts, credit policies, pricing strategies, and experiments, identifying key drivers of variance and feeding insights back into risk and pricing decisions.
  • Drive Experimentation & Value Attribution: Partner with Risk, Data Science, Product, and Growth to define NPV hypotheses, measure incremental economic value, and identify which initiatives should be scaled, improved, or stopped.
  • Influence Business Decisions: Translate complex economic analysis into clear trade-offs and provide credible insights to senior leadership, challenging models, policies, and decisions when the economics do not support them.
  • Embed NPV in Decision-Making: Integrate NPV thinking into credit policy reviews, risk governance, pricing and limit discussions, and planning cycles, while setting standards for transparency, documentation, and assumption discipline.
  • Raise the Analytical Bar: Operate with high ownership and integrity, challenge analytical and execution standards, stay adaptable under pressure, and contribute to FairMoney’s mission of providing responsible access to credit.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Strong experience in unit economics, NPV, LTV, or portfolio profitability (lending, fintech, banking, or adjacent sectors).
