Job Title: Officer, Marketing & Events (EN-7)

Organizational Unit: Communications

Reports To: Chief Communications Officer

Supervises: This position does not supervise staff.

Location: Equality Now is a remote organization. This position has a strong preference for candidates based in Bulgaria or Portugal.

MISSION OBJECTIVE:

To expand Equality Now's reach and strengthen relationships with priority audiences through effective marketing, events and external engagement. Working across Communications, Development and Advocacy, the role helps translate organisational priorities into compelling audience experiences and clear pathways for involvement that support advocacy, fundraising and long-term engagement.

PORTFOLIO OVERVIEW:

Officer, Marketing & Events sits within Equality Now's worldwide Communications Team. The portfolio covers major events and convenings, including the annual Gala; multi-channel marketing and audience acquisition; ambassador and talent stewardship; corporate, cultural and professional partnerships; and the promotion of strategic campaigns, products and knowledge.

The role also maintains audience and event data, supports CRM-based follow-up and cross-team hand-offs, and uses engagement data to improve future activity. It has a particular focus on growing and diversifying Equality Now's audiences, including the new and 'unusual suspect' audiences identified in the organisational strategy.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Purpose: Coordinates Connected Workflows

Marketing campaigns

  • Deliver marketing activity that supports the acquisition and deeper engagement of priority audiences, including Equality Now's Professionals Network, prospective funders, corporate audiences, senior decision-makers and other high-value supporters agreed with Development and Advocacy colleagues.
  • Help grow Equality Now's total addressable audience by identifying practical ways to reach people beyond our existing supporter base, particularly the 'unusual suspect' audiences prioritised in the organisational strategy across paid advertising, social acquisition, email, events, partnerships, external platforms and other appropriate channels, working within agreed campaign objectives, audiences and budgets.
  • Support the marketing and audience development of the Equal Justice Academy, working with relevant programme, Digital and Communications colleagues to increase awareness, participation and ongoing use.
  • Work with Digital, Advocacy Communications and Production colleagues to ensure Equality Now's knowledge products are packaged, promoted and distributed to the audiences most likely to use, share or act on them.
  • Help connect launches, knowledge products, events, partnerships and campaigns into coherent audience journeys rather than one-off moments, ensuring there is a clear next action for priority audiences.

Audience Data and Relationship Management

  • Maintain accurate and useful audience, stakeholder, ambassador and event data in Equality Now's CRM and agreed planning systems, ensuring records are current, appropriately segmented and usable across teams.
  • Build a practical understanding of who is in Equality Now's audience database, how different groups are engaging, where there are gaps and which contacts may be ready for deeper Development, Advocacy, partnership or ambassador engagement.
  • Work closely with Development, Advocacy and Communications colleagues to clarify relationship ownership, audience segments and appropriate outreach pathways so teams understand which contacts sit within their portfolios and where cross-team opportunities exist.
  • Ensure new contacts generated through events, campaigns, partnerships and external engagement are captured promptly and routed into appropriate supporter or stakeholder journeys.

Monitoring, Learning and Data Management

  • Maintain agreed KPI trackers and compile regular reporting on event attendance, audience acquisition, engagement, conversion, relationship progression, campaign performance and other agreed indicators.
  • Use campaign, event and CRM data to identify clear patterns, gaps and practical opportunities to improve targeting, follow-up, audience journeys and future activity.
  • Gather qualitative feedback from events, partners, ambassadors and priority audiences and feed useful learning into future planning.
  • Support good data-management and data-protection practice and ensure stakeholder, participant and talent information is handled appropriately.

Engagement: Align

Content creation

  • Produce and coordinate campaign materials including invitations, landing-page copy, email communications, presentations, partner materials, promotional assets and briefing information, working with Digital and Production colleagues to maintain brand and messaging quality.

Ambassadors and Talent

  • Work with Advocacy, Development, Executive Office, regional teams and other colleagues to identify ambassadors and external voices aligned to Equality Now's focus areas, geographies and wider organisational priorities.
  • Provide day-to-day coordination of Equality Now's ambassador and talent programme, maintaining accurate lists, relationship histories, interests, availability and previous engagement so that suitable people can be identified quickly for events, campaigns, speaking opportunities and advocacy moments.
  • Act as a consistent relationship point for agreed ambassadors and talent, coordinating communications, opportunities, briefings and follow-up and helping create clear pathways for people to deepen or broaden their involvement with Equality Now.

Strategic Partnerships

  • Research and coordinate agreed corporate brand, cultural and organisational partnership opportunities that can expand Equality Now's audience, strengthen campaigns or create new routes into high-value supporter and stakeholder groups.
  • Prepare concise background information, partnership materials and activation plans for review by the relevant manager, with strategic negotiation, major commitments and high-risk decisions retained by senior colleagues.

Delivery: Sustain Service

Events and Convenings

  • Coordinate the practical planning and delivery of Equality Now events, including the annual Gala and other in-person, virtual and hybrid events that support advocacy, fundraising, audience engagement and brand development.
  • Coordinate event logistics including venues, production suppliers, speakers and talent, invitations, briefing materials, run-of-show documents, travel and accommodation requirements, event communications and on-the-day delivery.
  • Support PR and promotional activity around the Gala and other events or campaigns where earned media can extend reach, coordinating with Media colleagues on assets, talent information, schedules and follow-up.
  • Project-manage assigned events from planning through delivery and follow-up, maintaining project plans, critical paths, task trackers, schedules and clear ownership so that colleagues and suppliers meet agreed deadlines. Inclusive of event administration including supplier liaison, contracts, purchase and payment processes, invoices, budgets, approvals, guest and speaker information, registration and other event records, escalating material risks or changes to the relevant manager.
  • Work across Communications, Development, Advocacy and relevant regional or focus-area teams to ensure each event has clear objectives, audiences, messaging, follow-up and relationship outcomes.

Event Marketing, External Moments and Follow-up

  • Coordinate event marketing across email, social, digital, paid and partner channels, working closely with Digital, Production, Media and other colleagues to maximise attendance, reach and post-event engagement.
  • Support Equality Now's presence at external convenings and high-value moments by coordinating materials, schedules, speaking opportunities, relationship follow-up and opportunities to extend the organisation's visibility.
  • Maintain an organisation-wide calendar of priority events and convenings, identifying moments where Equality Now can bring together priority audiences through repeatable, human-centred event formats and experiences.
  • Capture attendee, engagement and follow-up data after events and ensure agreed actions, new contacts and relationship opportunities are recorded and routed to the appropriate internal owner.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS & TARGET SKILLS PROFILE:

Substantive Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of integrated marketing communications, audience acquisition, event delivery and relationship-based engagement, gained through relevant practical experience.
  • Understanding of how events, marketing, partnerships and ambassador activity can support organisational reputation, advocacy, audience growth and fundraising.
  • Working understanding of audience segmentation, supporter journeys, CRM data and how communications activity can move people from awareness to deeper engagement.
  • Awareness of good practice in brand marketing, digital acquisition, partnerships, event promotion and stakeholder engagement.
  • An interest in social justice, human rights and Equality Now's mission, strategy and operating environment.

Communication Skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear audience-facing copy, event communications, campaign materials and concise stakeholder information.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and confidence building professional relationships with speakers, talent, ambassadors, partners, suppliers, donors and other external stakeholders.
  • Ability to adapt communications for different audiences while working within agreed messaging, brand and reputational guidance.
  • Tact and cultural awareness when working across countries, cultures and professional contexts.

Execution Skills

  • Strong event and project-management skills, with the ability to maintain plans, task trackers, deadlines, budgets, contracts, invoices and multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Experience coordinating in-person, virtual and/or hybrid events and working with venues, production partners, suppliers, speakers or talent.
  • Ability to deliver multi-channel marketing and audience-acquisition activity within agreed plans, processes and budgets.
  • Ability to coordinate cross-functional activity, keep colleagues and suppliers on track, identify delivery risks and escalate decisions outside agreed parameters.
  • Strong attention to detail and confidence maintaining accurate relationship, campaign and event records.
  • Ability to collect, organise and interpret routine marketing, CRM and event-performance data and identify clear trends or follow-up actions.
  • Ability to work flexibly when events or global time zones require work outside standard hours.

Targeted Specialised Knowledge

  • Experience using CRM, email marketing, audience-management or event-management systems.
  • Experience supporting paid, social, email or partnership-based audience acquisition campaigns.
  • Experience creating or coordinating content and assets for email, website, social media, events and partner channels.
  • Experience working with ambassadors, talent, creators, speakers, corporate partners or other external relationship groups is desirable.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Google Workspace, Canva and online event/webinar platforms.
  • Knowledge of data protection and good practice in managing stakeholder and supporter information.
  • Experience working in an international, charitable, campaigning or mission-led organisation is desirable.

CONSULTANCY FEE RANGE (Annual, Gross):

  • USD $27,000 - $34,074.

The final consultancy fee within this range will be determined based on factors including geographic location, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, qualifications, and the agreed scope and duration of services.

Consultant fees are set with consideration for the scope of work, level of expertise, and market benchmarks, and are intended to reflect the independent and professional nature of consultancy engagements.

HOW TO APPLY

Please visit: and submit a resume/CV and cover letter. The applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the application period closes at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on November 13, 2026.

Due to the volume of applicants anticipated for this role, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now offers a competitive compensation package, including base salary, savings, health and vacation benefits, and is an Equal Opportunity employer. Equality Now employees are selected on the basis of ability without regard to race, colour, religious beliefs, sex, gender identity and expression, language, political or other opinion, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, pregnancy, mental status, HIV status, age, marital status, or sexual orientation.

We welcome all kinds of diversity. Candidates are selected on the basis of ability, in accordance with all country and location-specific laws.

Salary: $27,000 - $34,074

jobs.description:
Overview

The Vice President, Global Talent Acquisition is the enterprise leader for how Medical Solutions attracts, selects, and hires talent across its U.S. (onshore) and Philippines (offshore) operations. This executive sets the global talent acquisition vision and operating model, advises the executive leadership team on workforce strategy, and leads a multi-country recruiting organization through its leaders.

The VP has full accountability for both the onshore and offshore talent acquisition teams, including their people, budget, technology, vendors, and results. This leader builds one integrated function with shared standards, shared data, and a consistent experience, while respecting the local market, cultural, and regulatory realities of each country.

Success is measured by how reliably the function delivers the talent the business plan requires, at the right quality, speed, and cost. It is also measured by candidate and hiring-manager experience, cost efficiency across the onshore and offshore delivery model, and the strength of the talent acquisition leadership bench.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Talent Strategy

  • Set the global talent acquisition vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap, aligned to Medical Solutions' growth strategy and enterprise workforce plan.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the executive leadership team on talent supply, labor-market conditions, workforce risk, and organizational capability. Provide talent insights for Board updates as needed.
  • Partner with Finance and business leaders on annual and long-range workforce planning, including headcount, location strategy, and the right mix of onshore and offshore talent.
  • As a member of the HR leadership team, shape the broader people strategy and connect talent acquisition to workforce planning, internal mobility, total rewards, and retention.

Global Operating Model: Onshore and Offshore

  • Lead and integrate the U.S. and Philippines talent acquisition teams into one global function with a shared strategy, standards, metrics, and technology.
  • Design the global operating model, including centers of excellence (sourcing, recruiting operations, employer brand, and analytics), service-delivery tiers, and the clear division of work between onshore and offshore teams.
  • Build offshore recruiting capability and capacity that scales, including expanding the Philippines team's support of U.S. hiring where it improves speed, quality, or cost.
  • Ensure talent acquisition practices comply with employment, privacy, and recruiting requirements in each country, including U.S. EEO and OFCCP obligations and Philippine labor and data privacy law, in partnership with Legal and HR.
  • Advise on location strategy and entry into new talent markets as the business grows.

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead a multi-level, multi-country organization through Directors and Managers. Set direction, hold leaders accountable for results, and build a strong succession bench.
  • Design the organization's structure, roles, career paths, and capacity model so the function can flex with business demand.
  • Build an inclusive, high-performance culture that bridges geographies and time zones and is grounded in accountability, trust, and continuous learning.
  • Develop leaders on both teams and raise talent acquisition capability across the function.

Financial and Vendor Stewardship

  • Own the global talent acquisition budget, including staffing, technology, advertising, agency, and vendor spend. Manage to plan and report on return on investment.
  • Set strategy for RPO, agency, and vendor partnerships. Negotiate contracts, manage performance, and consolidate where it adds value.
  • Drive improvements in cost per hire and recruiter productivity, including thoughtful use of the offshore delivery model.

Technology, Data, and Innovation

  • Own the global recruiting technology strategy and roadmap (ATS, CRM, sourcing, assessment, and AI-enabled tools), with one source of truth for talent data across both markets.
  • Establish enterprise talent acquisition metrics and executive dashboards, including hiring-plan attainment, time to fill, quality of hire, cost per hire, funnel conversion, slate diversity, and candidate and hiring-manager satisfaction.
  • Use data and market intelligence to anticipate hiring needs, diagnose gaps, and guide executive decisions.
  • Lead the responsible adoption of AI and automation in recruiting, with governance for fairness, privacy, and compliance.

Employer Brand and Hiring Excellence

  • Partner with Marketing and Communications to shape a global employer brand and talent value proposition that works in each market.
  • Set the enterprise standard for selection, including structured interviewing, hiring-manager enablement, and sound hiring decisions.
  • Deliver a consistent, high-quality candidate and hiring-manager experience in every market, from first contact through onboarding.
  • Develop sourcing and pipeline strategies for critical, hard-to-fill, and leadership roles, and broaden access to qualified, diverse talent.
  • Oversee executive and confidential senior leadership searches, and personally lead select executive searches.

Change Leadership

  • Lead enterprise-wide change in talent acquisition, including operating-model shifts, new technology, organizational changes, and integration of acquired businesses as applicable. Bring stakeholders along and sustain adoption.
  • Track recruiting trends, emerging technology, and competitive practices globally, and turn relevant insights into recommendations for executive leadership.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 12+ years of progressive talent acquisition experience, including 6+ years leading talent acquisition functions at the director level or above.
  • Experience leading a multi-level talent acquisition organization through Directors or Managers, including teams in more than one country.
  • Direct leadership of offshore or global shared-services recruiting teams, ideally in the Philippines or another major offshore market.
  • Proven record of designing and executing an enterprise talent acquisition strategy and operating model that supported significant business growth.
  • Experience owning a multimillion-dollar talent acquisition budget and managing RPO, agency, and vendor relationships.
  • Track record as a trusted advisor to C-suite leaders, with the executive presence to influence workforce decisions using data and market insight.
  • Deep command of talent acquisition metrics and analytics, including building executive-level reporting.
  • Experience selecting, implementing, or transforming recruiting technology at enterprise scale, including AI-enabled tools.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. employment and recruiting requirements, including EEO and OFCCP/affirmative action, and working knowledge of international employment considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale change and build scalable processes across geographies.
  • Excellent executive communication, consultation, and facilitation skills.
  • Sound judgment and discretion with confidential information.

Preferred

  • Master's degree or MBA.
  • Experience in healthcare staffing, healthcare, or professional services.
  • Experience building or scaling an offshore recruiting center or global capability center.
  • Experience integrating talent acquisition teams after a merger or acquisition.
  • SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or talent acquisition certification.

Pay Range

USD $175,000.00 - USD $200,000.00 /Yr.

About Niobium

At Niobium Microsystems, we develop high performance microelectronic products to enable the secure collection, processing, and distribution of critical data. We are a trusted partner of government research teams and commercial customers whose solutions require lower power, higher efficiency, and proven security.

Founded as a 2021 spinout from Galois, Inc., a world-class security and computing systems research and development company, our team combines decades of experience in advanced semiconductor design with a record of delivering world class solutions.

About This Role

We are seeking a highly experienced ASIC Physical Design to drive the implementation of complex SoC designs from RTL handoff through tapeout. The ideal candidate has 8+ years of hands-on experience in advanced node physical implementation, proven ownership of multiple successful tapeouts, and the ability to lead both technically and organizationally.

In this role, you will partner closely with Architecture, RTL Design, Verification, DFT, and Power teams to deliver high-performance, power-efficient silicon across cutting edge technology nodes.

Responsibilities

As the Physical Design Lead, you will be responsible for:

End-to-End Physical Implementation Leadership

  • Own and lead all physical design activities from RTL handoff, floorplanning, and PnR through final GDSII delivery.
  • Define execution strategy, schedules, design methodology, and quality checkpoints for the entire physical design flow.

Floorplanning & SoC Integration

  • Architect and execute floorplanning strategies for large, hierarchical SoCs, including:
    • IP integration and macro placement
    • Physical partitioning and hierarchy definition
    • Power grid architecture and clock distribution topology
    • DIE size, aspect ratio, and physical constraints
  • Collaborate with Architecture and RTL teams to ensure physical feasibility, timing closure readiness, and area/power targets.

Place & Route + Timing Closure

  • Lead block-level and top-level PnR using industry standard EDA tools (Cadence, Synopsys).
  • Drive timing convergence across corners, modes, voltage domains, and operating conditions.
  • Own optimization for PPA (Power, Performance, Area), congestion mitigation, and physical integrity.

Clocking, Power, and Sign-Off

  • Implement CTS and drive skew, latency, and clock power optimization.
  • Lead IR/EM sign-off strategy, thermal analysis, and full chip physical verification (DRC/LVS/ERC).
  • Integrate and validate low power methodologies, including UPF/CPF flows.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Quality Ownership

  • Partner with DFT and PD teams to ensure scan insertion, BIST structures, and test modes are physically robust and timing clean.
  • Work with Packaging and SI teams on bump planning, floorplan constraints, and package-aware timing.
  • Set physical design quality standards, conduct design reviews, and ensure flawless execution through tapeout.

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide technical leadership to a team of junior and mid-level physical designers.
  • Mentor, coach, and guide engineers in methodology, debug, and best practices.
  • Champion continuous improvement across flows, scripts, and design methodology.

Key Qualifications

Education

  • BS/MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
    (Advanced degree preferred for leadership roles.)

Required Technical Expertise

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in ASIC Physical Design, with a strong track record of multiple tape-outs at advanced technology nodes (16nm → 3nm preferred).
  • Deep expertise in:
    • Floorplanning
    • Place & Route
    • CTS
    • STA/Timing Closure
    • Physical verification & sign-off
    • Low power design and UPF
  • Strong hands on proficiency with Cadence and/or Synopsys physical design toolchains.
  • Solid understanding of RTL-to-GDS flows, design architecture trade-offs, and SoC integration complexities.
  • Ability to translate product requirements into physical design goals, budgets, constraints, and deliverable plans.

Required General Skills

  • Strong communication skills—able to articulate technical decisions across cross-functional teams.
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and able to operate effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Comfortable owning schedules, deliverables, and quality in a fast-moving development cycle.
  • Exceptional analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with a meticulous attention to detail.

Location

Niobium is headquartered in Columbus, Ohio with additional locations in Fayetteville, Arkansas, Portland, Oregon, and Dayton, Ohio. We will not be limited by geography for the right candidate.

Benefits

Niobium offers a highly competitive benefits program to support employees and their families, including:

  • Employer paid medical insurance plan
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with serious depth in SAP HANA Cloud and graph databases to own the data layer beneath OMS+ IA. Our product lives on top of large, complex, deeply interconnected enterprise data, and the quality of that data layer sets the ceiling for everything built above it.You will model and optimize on HANA Cloud, and design graph data models that let the product answer connected questions relational queries handle poorly. Things like material substitutions and compatibility, product and customer hierarchies, and supply and fulfillment networks. You will also make sure that layer serves our machine learning and search engineers well, since their pipelines start where your work ends.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize data models on SAP HANA Cloud, including tables, calculation views, CDS artifacts, stored procedures, and SQLScript.
  • Design and implement graph data models and traversal queries for connected-data problems such as material substitution and compatibility, product and organizational hierarchies, and supply and fulfillment networks.
  • Write and tune high-performance SQL and SQLScript: read execution plans, find the real bottleneck, and fix it.
  • Assist with performance engineering across the data layer — partitioning, indexing, memory management, workload classes, and result caching.
  • Build data ingestion and replication into HANA Cloud from SAP and non-SAP sources using things like SDI, SDA, SLT, change data capture, or comparable approaches.
  • Expose data to the TypeScript product stack through clean, secure, well-documented service layers.
  • Set and enforce standards for schema design, migrations, versioning, and code review of database artifacts.
  • Implement security and access control: roles and privileges, data masking and anonymization, and multi-tenant data isolation.
  • Work closely with machine learning and search engineers so the data layer serves feature pipelines and search indexing efficiently.
  • Own monitoring, alerting, backup and recovery, capacity planning, and HANA Cloud upgrade readiness.
  • Document data models and graph schemas so the rest of engineering can build on them confidently.

Required Qualifications

  • Deep SAP HANA or HANA Cloud engineering expertise — modeling, SQLScript, calculation views, and production performance tuning.
  • Experience with graph database capabilities: graph data modeling plus a traversal query language such as SAP HANA Graph, Cypher/Neo4j, Gremlin, or SPARQL, and the judgment to know when a graph model is genuinely the right tool.
  • Expert SQL, including execution plan analysis and optimization of complex analytical and transactional queries.
  • Experience with data replication and integration into HANA from source systems, and a realistic view of how those pipelines fail.
  • Strong grasp of relational and dimensional modeling, normalization trade-offs, and safe schema evolution.
  • Proficiency in at least one application language (TypeScript/JavaScript or Python ) for building services and tooling around the data layer.
  • Database security and multi-tenant data isolation experience.
  • Clear communication and a genuine habit of documenting data models for other engineers.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) experience, including the Cloud Application Programming (CAP) model and HDI containers.
  • Working knowledge of SAP SD and MM data structures and order-to-cash processes.
  • Experience with the HANA Cloud vector engine, spatial engine, or machine learning libraries (PAL/APL).
  • Graph algorithms at scale: pathfinding, centrality, community detection, or graph-based recommendation.
  • Knowledge graph, ontology, or RDF modeling experience.
  • Experience supporting machine learning feature pipelines or search indexing from the data layer.
  • CI/CD for database artifacts using tools, particularly HDI deployment pipelines.
  • Containerization and Kubernetes experience.
  • SAP HANA certification.

About the Team:
CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity.

The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.

This is a Sr. Software Engineer role in the engineering team that delivers the sensor (lightweight agent) on macOS. Engineers in the team own the design and development of core features on the platform. Features will cross-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking. Sales Processes and Technology

  • Identify opportunities to simplify sales workflows and reduce administrative effort
  • Gather business requirements for Salesforce enhancements, reporting, and automation

  • Experience supporting international sales teams or working in supply chain technology, enterprise integration, manufacturing, or logistics is very highly preferred
  • Hands-on experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, reporting, and CRM data quality

Who We Are

Elemica is a leading provider of Digital Supply Chain Management solutions and the premier multi-enterprise collaboration network for global process manufacturing industries. jobs.description:
Assurance Integrity Senior Manager

Reports to: Assurance and Traceability Senior Director

Remote – Global (Preference for Europe/North America)

About Us

Textile Exchange is a global non-profit driving positive impact on climate change across the fashion and textile industry. It guides a growing community of brands, manufacturers, and farmers towards more purposeful production from the very start of the supply chain.

By 2030, its goal is to guide the industry to achieve a 45% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions within fiber and raw material production. Its focus is holistic and interconnected, accelerating the adoption of practices that improve the state of our water, soil health, and biodiversity too.

For real change to happen, everyone needs a clear path to positive impact. That’s why Textile Exchange believes that approachable, step-by-step instruction paired with collective action can change the system to make preferred materials and fibers an accessible default, mobilizing leaders through attainable strategies, proven solutions, and a driven community.

At Textile Exchange, materials matter. To learn more, visit TextileExchange.org.

Working at Textile Exchange 

We work remotely with a team located in 20+ countries. We are a diverse group committed to harnessing the strengths of the global textile industry to accelerate change toward climate and other key environmental goals. We work collaboratively on important environmental issues around the world by working and interacting with farming groups, processors, brands, retailers, and environmental experts in the textile and fashion industries around the world. We offer an opportunity to join a cutting-edge global environmental nonprofit and to help strengthen the impact of our organization.

Position Summary

​​​The Senior Manager, Assurance Integrity leads the team responsible for performance management of assurance providers in the Textile Exchange standards system to ensure credibility of the standards system. This role ensures that assurance models are understood and implemented efficiently and effectively while identifying any gaps and risks to inform continuous improvement of the assurance providers and the assurance system. This role is responsible for ensuring a robust system is in place to track certification body performance across the elements of the system, including the auditing and certification process, reporting and ongoing surveillance of certified organizations. This role is also responsible for identifying training and support needs, managing risks to the system, and ensuring the effective implementation of field monitoring and complaints management. The intended outcome of this work is a high performing network of assurance providers in the Textile Exchange system that instills trust and credibility in the system.

​

​The Senior Manager leads the Assurance Integrity sub-team and reports to the Senior Director, Assurance & Traceability. The Senior Manager works closely with other teams across the department as well as engagement, communications and legal teams to ensure coordinated risk and incident management.​​

Key Responsibilities

  • ​​Advance strategies to ensure excellence across the standards system through monitoring, oversight and transparency of assurance across the standards system.
  • ​Identify and track mitigation of risks in the assurance system, ensuring proper escalation and collaboration where appropriate.
  • ​Manage the assurance integrity sub-team, creating a high-performing and highly engaged team.​
  • Responsible for the systems that oversee assurance provider performance, that ensure transparency, risk management, internal escalation and reporting, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage the risks, complaints, disputes, and other grievances related to assurance providers within the standards system.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

​​​Oversight and Monitoring

  • ​Lead the development, implementation and management of the strategy of assurance provider oversight and performance management.
  • ​Lead the development and management of our monitoring strategy as part of our overall plan for performance management. This should complement and enhance the organizational assurance model.
  • ​Establish systems to track changes in performance over time and implementation of corrective actions taken by assurance providers to address identified issues.
  • ​Implement processes to provide transparency on certification body performance, utilizing incentives and sanctions to drive improvement.

​Data and Traceability

  • ​Collaborate with Standards Data and Traceability sub-teams to leverage data as a tool to identify risks and strengthen credibility of the standards system.
  • ​Ensure regular reporting on assurance system performance, identifying trends and risks and informing key decisions where appropriate.
  • ​Collaborate to ensure the development of our supply chain tracking strategy is backed by a robust and aligned assurance model, incorporated into our assurance system.

​Incident and Risk Management

  • ​Lead the internal processes for timely response to complaints and incidents that are assigned to the assurance integrity team, ensuring assignment of appropriate team members and coordination of communications with relevant teams.
  • ​Ensure that when risks that arise from assurance integrity activities arise that these are internally communicated and logged in accordance with the requirements provided by the relevant teams within the department and across the organization.

​Assurance Provider Engagement

  • ​Contribute to engagement, communication and development of training content for certification bodies and accreditation bodies related to areas identified through oversight and monitoring. ​​

Secondary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide support as needed from other teams across the department for the development of standards, policies and procedures where input on integrity topics are properly reflected.
  • ​Support compliance with the ISEAL Code of Good Practice and regulatory requirements (e.g. EA 1/22) from an assurance lens. 
  • ​Coordinate with the claims and trademark teams on ​market monitoring activities, such as claims policy and trademark adherence, by both certified and non-certified entities.​​ ​​

Minimum Qualifications

  • ​​​A minimum of 7 years of combined experience in sustainability standards systems and certification, with at least 3 years at a management level.
  • Training and/or experience working as a qualified lead auditor, especially in varying regional contexts.
  • ​Experience in oversight, monitoring, and performance management of assurance providers.
  • ​Technical knowledge of certification and accreditation body operations, including management experience at a certification or accreditation body.
  • ​Training and/or experience working as a qualified lead auditor.
  • ​Technical knowledge in supply chain management, textile and/or apparel sectors.
  • ​Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills and experience working across cultures as part of a global team.
  • ​A driven individual with a strong work ethic and high degree of autonomy. Self-starting and proactive.
  • ​Able to hit the ground running while working in a fast-paced and demanding environment.
  • ​Motivated, energetic, determined, and with strong interpersonal skills.
  • ​Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Native-level proficiency in English and at least one other language.
  • ​Strong work ethic and high degree of autonomy. Ability to work independently as well as to collaborate effectively with key internal and external stakeholders.
  • ​Track record of professional, honest, discreet conduct, and able to act with the organization’s highest confidence at all times.
  • ​Excellent computer skills including advanced proficiency in Microsoft suite, databases and the ability to quickly learn new systems. 
  • ​Ability to travel frequently, up to 20% of time.​​

Preferred Qualifications

  • ​​​Experience working with Textile Exchange standards or other similar standards systems, ideally ISEAL members.
  • ​Advanced experience and knowledge of assurance systems, ISEAL-compliant standards systems, and chain of custody models and principles.
  • ​Previous experience conducting technical writing (e.g. policies, standards) and training.
  • ​Proficiency in Chinese.​​

Employment Package

  • Full-Time Position, 40 Hours a Week
  • Required travel: up to 20%
  • Annual Salary Range: $115,000 - $150,000 USD

Who We Are

Indigenous Youth Roots is a national, Indigenous youth-led organization rooted in community. We envision a future where Indigenous youth are connected, empowered, and thriving as leaders within their communities. We work alongside communities to offer programs, grants, and opportunities grounded in Indigenous ways of knowing and being, with the goal of strengthening and uplifting Indigenous youth voices. Our work is guided by seven core principles: Reciprocity, Innovation, Accountability, Reclamation, Advocacy, Resurgence, and Solidarity; along with being centered in Indigenous youth perspectives, that shape how we act and relate to one another.

At IYR, we center our people and our communities in all that we do. As a living wage employer, we honour the importance of balance by supporting flexible ways of working, time for ceremony, and the responsibilities that shape our lives. We are committed to meeting accessibility needs and creating a supportive, responsive work environment. Guided by purpose, we focus on meaningful outcomes that reflect our values, rather than upholding the status quo.

Your Impact

The Director of Communications, Knowledge & Impact (CKI) leads a department responsible for amplifying Indigenous youth voices, advancing organizational priorities through strategic initiatives, and embedding knowledge mobilization and impact measurement into IYR’s work. The Director provides strategic leadership, oversight, and coordination across communications, strategic initiatives, and knowledge systems. This role ensures IYR’s public presence, storytelling, and evidence of impact are clear, accessible, and aligned with the organization’s vision, values, and purpose.

Summary of Duties & Responsibilities

Leadership & Collaboration:

  • Provide vision, leadership, and direction for the Communications, Knowledge & Impact Department.
  • Champion cross-department collaboration to ensure communications and knowledge strategies strengthen organizational priorities.
  • Represent IYR with external stakeholders, partners, and funders, positioning the organization as a leader in youth-centered, equity-driven communications and impact.
  • Foster an inclusive, culturally safe, and equitable workplace culture rooted in humility, integrity, and collaboration.
  • Support departments in building capacity for adaptive leadership, effective decision-making, cross-team collaboration, and navigating organizational change.
  • Lead the development and oversight of the department annual work plans and budgets.
  • Participate actively as a member of the IYR Directors Circle, contributing to unified, principled decision-making and modeling values-based leadership in alignment with IYR’s guiding principles and leadership commitments.
  • Hold accountability for team performance, goal achievement, and organizational alignment.
  • Supervise and support departmental staff, providing direction, training, mentorship, and performance management.

Strategic Communications:

  • Oversee the development and execution of communication strategies across digital platforms, media relations, publications, and events.
  • Lead the preparation and release of organizational documents such as the Annual Report, newsletters, evaluation summaries, and public statements.
  • Provide quality checks such as copy-review and Indigenous cultural accuracy alignment throughout communications projects and campaigns.
  • Direct the planning and delivery of major communication campaigns, ensuring accessibility, inclusivity, and innovation.
  • Cultivate and manage constructive relationships with media, partners, and community organizations.
  • Ensure staff formal performance evaluations are conducted with a focus on continuous development.
  • Recruit and onboard staff, students, or volunteers as needed, ensuring equity-driven hiring and culturally safe integration.

Strategic Initiatives:

  • Lead the planning, development, and delivery of special and large-scale initiatives prioritized by IYR leadership and guided by the Strategic Plan.
  • Provide executive oversight of IYR’s cornerstone events, including the Youth Gathering, the Celebration, and other high-profile strategic engagements that advance the organization’s mission and strengthen its visibility.
  • Oversee event budgets to ensure alignment with IYR and funder commitments.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with external partners to collaborate on shared initiatives that expand IYR’s impact and reach.
  • Provide engagement and event support for ongoing programs in other departments as needed, ensuring alignment with organizational values and priorities.

Data & Impact Measurement

  • Embed knowledge mobilization practices across all initiatives, translating research, data, and evaluation into accessible resources for youth, partners, and the public.
  • Oversee the development of internal systems and processes that support outreach, impact measurement, and strategic communications.

Community Engagement:

  • Promote a collaborative, transparent, and accountable organizational culture that reflects IYR’s values.
  • Participate actively in staff meetings, working groups, and committees to advance organizational goals.
  • Uphold and promote the organization’s cultural values and guiding principles in all workplace practices.
  • Engage with the Indigenous community and support initiatives that strengthen relationships and collaboration.

Health, Safety, and Wellness:

  • Co-operate, support, and engage with any measures introduced in the workplace to improve occupational health & safety.

Other:

  • Maintain high ethical standards and demonstrate integrity, honesty, and trustworthiness in all endeavours and communications. 
  • Support and participate in all IYR staff, department, and team meetings. 
  • Participate in external and internal committees, working groups, or projects as required. 
  • Be available for in-person engagements when required and provided reasonable notice.
  • Undertake other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Post-secondary Degree in communications, public relations, journalism, media studies, evaluation, knowledge mobilization, public policy, or a related field is preferred.
  • A graduate degree in a relevant discipline (such as communications, organizational leadership, or evaluation) is considered an asset.
  • 5 or more years’ of progressive experience in a management capacity.
  • 3 or more years’ experience in a senior leadership capacity.
  • 5 or more years’ of experience in communications, knowledge mobilization, evaluation, or strategic initiatives.
  • Demonstrated expertise in digital communications, media relations, branding, storytelling, and public engagement.
  • Hands-on experience with evaluation, impact measurement, and knowledge mobilization, including the ability to translate complex information into accessible formats for diverse audiences.
  • Leadership experience in planning and executing public-facing events and gatherings.
  • Experience working in values-based, Indigenous-led, or trauma-informed organizations.
  • Experience working with Indigenous youth communities an asset
  • Experience managing diverse teams of graphic designers, event planners, data researchers, and/or media coordinators.
  • Strong administrative experience, with the ability to manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with a high attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects and create shared ownership for outcomes. Proven success in setting vision, managing cross-departmental initiatives, and aligning resources with strategic priorities.
  • Experience cultivating and sustaining relationships with funders, partners, and stakeholders in youth-serving or community-based contexts.
  • Demonstrated financial management skills, including overseeing departmental budgets and ensuring resource alignment with organizational strategy.
  • Bilingual in French and English is an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Visionary and Strategic Leadership: Ability to set a clear direction, connect strategy to action, and drive implementation in alignment with IYR’s mission and values.
  • Exceptional Communication: Skilled at conveying ideas with empathy, transparency, and adaptability across diverse audiences, including youth, staff, funders, and community partners.
  • Coaching and Mentorship: Proven ability to support staff development, build team confidence, and nurture future leaders.
  • Emotional Intelligence and Integrity: Demonstrates humility, honesty, and self-awareness, fostering trust and accountability.
  • Innovation and Creativity: Brings fresh thinking to communications, storytelling, knowledge mobilization, and impact measurement, encouraging proactive approaches rather than reactive responses.
  • Equity and Inclusion: Applies equity-driven approaches, centers Indigenous youth voices, and integrates cultural safety and anti-racism into all aspects of leadership.
  • Collaboration and Partnership-Building: Works effectively across departments and with external stakeholders to achieve shared goals.
  • Resilience and Crisis Management: Provides steady leadership during periods of change, risk, or conflict, while supporting staff and organizational stability.
  • Organizational Skills: Balances multiple priorities, manages complex workflows, and delivers results on time.

Compensation

  • Health benefits: will begin following a 3-month probationary period
  • Other: GRRSP employer contribution that is 5% of salary
  • Vacation: 15 days and statutory holidays, in addition to a 2-week winter closure

  • Volunteer Hours: 5 hours monthly at any organization of your choice
  • Flexible Work Week Options: 4 and 5 Day work week options

Application Method

As a part of your expression of interest, please provide a cover letter that introduces yourself and share your passion for working alongside youth (especially youth in Indigenous, racialized, and newcomer communities) and highlight how your qualifications align with this role. IYR Prioritizes internal applications in an effort to support our commitments to development and growth, should we not have a qualified and interested internal applicant, external candidates will be considered based on competencies, skills, and relevant experiences (both lived and worked experience).

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

CoLab is hiring a Senior Director of Brand Marketing to lead brand design, multimedia, brand content, and communications. This is a team leadership role, with an existing team of 6. You will also build two competencies we don’t have today: executive communications and integrated brand campaigns.

If you are a passionate operator with insanely high standards, this is an opportunity to build an organization you can be proud of — with a clear philosophy, operating model, creative process, and reputation inside CoLab.

This is your chance to make technical ideas feel consequential: to take something complex and create work that makes people understand why it matters and want to be part of the future it represents.

Our Ideal Candidate

You have a brand worldview. You don’t just know the mechanics of brand; you have beliefs about what makes one distinctive, memorable, and worth caring about.

You have taste backed by conviction. You push the work further. You might watch a video six times before finally realizing the first five seconds are wrong, then sit with the producer until you figure out what will make them right.

The details of the brand should be more top-of-mind for you than they are for our CEO or CMO. For some people, that sounds exhausting. For you, it’s probably your natural operating mode.

You know how to win support for your ideas. You can walk into a room where an ambitious creative idea feels too big, make the strategic case for it, and get executives excited to take the bet.

Job Responsibilities

Build the brand function and protect the standard

  • Shape CoLab’s brand function across design, multimedia, brand content, communications, and campaigns.
  • Establish the standards, operating model, and creative processes that enable exceptional work without turning the team into an internal creative-services desk.
  • Own how the brand shows up across every touchpoint and develop principles that make the brand easier to recognize and harder to forget
  • Stay close enough to the work to know when something is almost right but not right and help the team make it better.

Create memorable campaigns that make technical ideas feel consequential

  • Partner with Product Marketing to identify the ideas CoLab should amplify, then turn them into bold, integrated campaigns.
  • Make complex ideas in AI, engineering, and manufacturing understandable, compelling, and worth remembering.
  • Push beyond safe creative when the strategy warrants it, and build the internal support required to take bigger bets.

Build an executive communications platform

  • Own a cohesive communications strategy for our CEO, CTO, and Chief Strategy Officer across earned media, bylines, social, conferences, and CoLab events.
  • Identify the ideas each executive can credibly own and create opportunities for them to contribute meaningfully to relevant conversations.
  • Oversee media relations, press releases, executive visibility, and proactive communications opportunities.

Develop an exceptional team

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning brand design, multimedia, content, and communications.
  • Give clear feedback, create shared context, and help talented specialists do the best work of their careers.
  • Identify where new talent, agencies, or partners can materially raise the standard of the function.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience across brand marketing, creative strategy, communications, design, or related disciplines, including meaningful ownership of a brand or creative function.
  • A body of work that demonstrates taste backed by conviction: distinctive judgment, unusually high standards, and the ability to explain why something works or doesn’t.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across several of the following: design, video, content, communications, production, and campaigns.
  • Exceptional executive communication skills. You can challenge an idea, advocate for a bigger one, and earn trust because your point of view is grounded in strategy.
  • The ability to move comfortably between setting direction and getting close to the work. You care about the big idea and the five-second edit.

Job title: Finance Analyst (Startup, AI & International Focus)
Location: Remote in Portugal
Type: Professional Internship (+Talento IEFP Program)
Level: Junior (0 to 3 years)

Most finance internships in Portugal are an education in one spreadsheet. You reconcile the same accounts for six months, you never see how the number got there, and nobody tells you why it matters. This is not that. BRIDGE IN is bootstrapped and profitable, which means every euro has to make sense to somebody, and often that somebody will be you. You will work on the real close, the real forecast, the real models, and the real numbers that decide what we do next, across three countries and a client base spread over 35+ countries. If you want to learn how a business actually works rather than learning where the cells are, read on.

One more thing. Finance at BRIDGE IN is not done the old way. AI and automation take care of the copying, matching, and chasing, which means your time goes toward analysis, judgment, and telling people things they did not already know. If you want an early look at what a finance function looks like when it is built with modern tools from the start, this is a rare seat at that table.

🌍 Why BRIDGE IN?

We are a bootstrapped, profitable, remote-first company on a mission to make international bureaucracy disappear. We simplify payroll, accounting, legal, and compliance operations for foreign companies expanding into Portugal, Spain, and Italy. Our clients range from high-growth startups to publicly listed companies and unicorns. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in Southern Europe, and we are still accelerating.

This role exists because we run finance for three countries and a growing client base with a small team, and we want someone who will grow into real ownership of it.

🚀 What You'll Be Working

  • Supporting the monthly and quarterly close, then building the reporting packs that show how Portugal, Spain, and Italy are actually performing;
  • Owning recurring reporting over time, including KPI dashboards, cash position, and revenue by market;
  • Working on the forecast and the annual budget: helping build them, then tracking actuals against plan and explaining the variances;
  • Digging into financial data to spot trends, margin leaks, and anomalies, then bringing them to management in plain language;
  • Working alongside our accounting team to keep us compliant with local financial regulations and with our own internal policies;
  • Preparing documentation and reports for audits, due diligence, and client-facing financial requests, with guidance at first and increasing autonomy over time.

💡 Who You Are

  • You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Management, or a related field;
  • Based in Portugal, under 35 years of age, and eligible for the +Talento IEFP program;
  • You are fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken, and can explain a number to someone who is not a finance person;
  • You are genuinely comfortable in Google Sheets: lookups, pivots, clean model structure, and formulas someone else can follow up;
  • You are rigorous. You tie things out, you check twice, and you would rather flag a discrepancy early than have it surface in a client meeting;
  • You do not need someone to follow up with you twice. You manage your own workload;
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and can make reasonable judgment calls;
  • You see AI and automation as tools that make your work sharper and faster, not as threats;
  • Bonus points for international experience, personal or professional, and for any familiarity with Portuguese, Spanish, or Italian financial and tax rules.

🌱 What We Offer

We are not hiring for a temporary slot. This internship is structured to convert into a full-time contract for the right person, and that is the plan from day one.

  • Compensation structured around the +Talento IEFP grant, adjusted upward based on experience and profile;
  • Variable bonus aligned with business results;
  • Fully remote setup with flexibility on hours, built around outcomes not attendance;
  • Direct exposure to multi-country finance, accounting, and startup operations from your first week;
  • A merit-based environment where your track record speaks louder than your title or tenure;
  • Colleagues who will challenge you, and a client base that will stretch your thinking.

What Happens Next

We don't do corporate black holes. This is a real, open role, and not a ghost job to harvest resumes. Here is the general roadmap: start with a quick application form. If we're aligned, we'll send over a self-evaluation survey, followed by human-to-human interviews and a hands-on challenge so you can show, not just tell, what you can do. We're a startup, so the exact steps might iterate, but we guarantee three things: we (try to) move fast, we are radically transparent, and we will never waste your time.

Our Story

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We've grown 2-3x year over year for three years running, and we're now building the operations, systems, and teams to scale without sacrificing quality or culture. We're fully remote, and we value ownership, open communication, and speed. If you want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel at home here.

The Opportunity

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling, fully integrated personal injury firm. We need a Senior Intake Specialist who can take on our exception cases: the ones where the intake form doesn't give us enough to know whether we should sign. Many of these are potentially high-value commercial and catastrophic injury matters, and the people calling us are often in the hardest moment of their lives. You'll make them feel supported, dig into the details with an expert eye, and help our managing attorneys decide which cases we sign and which we refer to a partner firm. You'll work closely with the managing attorney in your state to sharpen our intake criteria over time.

This role is an opportunity to:

  • Join a rapidly growing national firm at a formative stage
  • Work alongside top-caliber attorneys on complex, high-value cases
  • Grow your skills and influence as the firm scales nationally

What You Will Own

  • Review exception cases and dig into injuries, liability, and red flags
  • Spot commercial vehicle involvement and catastrophic or high-value potential
  • Talk with prospective clients and families with empathy, and ask the right follow-up questions
  • Give the managing attorney a clear recommendation (sign, refer, or decline) with your reasoning
  • Document everything in Filevine and our intake systems, and hand off signed cases cleanly
  • Review intake calls and recommend improvements to agent training and the intake questionnaire.
  • Proactively follow up with escalated clients to resolve concerns, improve client satisfaction, and prevent client-initiated case withdrawals.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 5 or more years of personal injury law experience
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with real comfort talking to seriously injured clients and grieving families
  • Strong critical thinking and attention to detail
  • Consistent follow-through in a fast-moving environment

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Paralegal experience
  • Candidate lives in MS, but not required
  • Bilingual in Spanish

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

  • Base Salary: $60,000-$80,000 commensurate with experience
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.

jobs.title: Mobile User Acquisition Manager
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionMWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe.
jobs.description:
Description

MWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. We offer opportunities to work on international products in a stable and professional environment.

Why does MWDN rock?

Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN:

  • Security: We carefully vet our clients to minimize risks and ensure reliability and timely payments - no fraud or unpleasant surprises.
  • Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals.
  • Legal assistance: We provide guidance on legal matters, including opening and managing your independent contractor or sole proprietorship status, taxes, and related processes.
  • Professional development: We offer English courses and professional growth opportunities, as well as team-building events.

Why choose us? MWDN is ranked among the top 5 IT employers in our region according to DOU. We take pride in our transparency and strong commitment to our team. Curious to learn more? See what our employees say about working with us on DOU.

What is your new project?

Our client builds and grows mobile apps used by millions of people worldwide. Their apps are primarily monetized through in-app advertising, so every UA decision is judged on real ad revenue per user, not vanity installs. We move fast, run on data, and give UA managers real budgets and real ownership.

What makes this project exciting?

We’re looking for a Mid/Senior UA Manager to own and scale paid acquisition across our mobile portfolio. You’ll manage significant daily budgets across Meta, TikTok, Mintegral, AppLovin, Unity and other networks, with one clear goal: profitable growth measured by ROAS. This is a hands-on role with direct impact on company revenue and a short path from idea to live test.

What makes you a great fit

  • 3+ years of hands-on mobile UA experience (5+ years for Senior)
  • Proven track record managing significant budgets on at least two of: Meta, TikTok, Mintegral, AppLovin, Unity
  • Deep understanding of ROAS-based bidding (tROAS, AEO/VO, CPI/CPE) and cohort-based KPIs
  • Strong analytical skills: comfortable with Excel/Sheets, BI tools, and MMP data (AppsFlyer, Adjust or similar)
  • Ownership mindset: you treat the budget like your own money
  • Excellent English, written and spoken

Big advantages:

  • Experience in mobile gaming or adtech companies
  • Experience growing apps monetized mainly through in-app ads (IAA) or hybrid models, not only IAP
  • ⁠Understanding of ad monetization: mediation, eCPM, ARPDAU and how they drive LTV and ROAS
  • Hands-on experience with AppLovin and Mintegral at scale
  • SQL skills (Snowflake, BigQuery or similar)
  • ⁠Experience launching new networks and geos from zero
  • Experience with creative testing frameworks and working with creative teams

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Plan, launch and optimize mobile UA campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Mintegral, AppLovin, Unity and additional networks (Google App Campaigns, ironSource, Moloco, Liftoff, DSPs)
  • Own budgets and hit ROAS targets (D0/D3/D7) by managing tROAS bids, daily caps and budgets at campaign and country level
  • Scale winners and cut losers fast, based on trends and total profit, not single-day noise
  • Build and run a structured testing roadmap: new networks, geos, bidding strategies, audiences and creatives
  • ⁠Work closely with the Creative team on briefs, concepts and creative performance analysis
  • Partner with Data and Monetization teams to connect UA cost with ad revenue (eCPM, ARPDAU, LTV curves)
  • Analyze performance in SQL and BI dashboards, and spot issues before they cost money
  • Manage relationships with network account managers and push for betas, better terms and support
  • Report weekly to management on spend, ROAS, learnings and next steps

Why work with us?

  • People-first management with minimal bureaucracy
  • A friendly company culture, proven by employees who choose to return
  • Flexible working hours
  • Full financial and legal support for independent contractors
  • Free English classes, with native speakers or Ukrainian teachers
  • Dedicated HR support

Location: Remote- Eligible US Locations

About the role and about You:

Great support starts with great training. When our members hit a snag, our Community Support team gets them back into Watopia and helps them make the most of their Zwift experience. To help support our frontline agents, we’re hiring a hands-on Training Specialist to build and maintain the training they rely on.

Our training program already has a strong foundation: a structured new hire curriculum, an established design framework, and experienced subject matter expert trainers who facilitate instructor-led training. In this role, you’ll keep that program accurate and effective as Zwift evolves. When products, processes, or policies change, you’ll revise new hire training and build and deploy update training to match. When the team identifies a need for refresh training, you’ll build it. When something new and complex launches, you’ll be a crucial part of supporting it.

You’ll be a part of our Content & Learning team, who own training, user-facing self-service content, and the internal knowledge enabling Zwift’s support team. In this role, you’ll also be the subject-matter expert in Seismic, our learning management system, ensuring we’re maximizing the benefits of the tool, keeping groups and enrollments clean, tracking completion and assessment results, and partnering with our BPO partners to close gaps.

You’re organized, dependable, and easy to work with. You take direction well, own your work from start to finish, and partner effectively with your teammates. You know when to hold firm on accuracy and when to flex on format or timing. You’re comfortable working outside a defined box: you pick up new tools, figure things out on your own, take on new work as the team’s needs change, and handle shifting priorities with ease. You use AI thoughtfully, knowing where it speeds up work and where human validation is essential.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop new eLearning and instructor-led training (including exams and certifications) to support product launches and updated policies and procedures, while keeping existing training current.
  • Build and deploy refresh training when the team identifies a need, indicated by QA results, Customer Effort Scores, or related performance data.
  • Host train-the-trainer sessions to prepare subject matter expert (SME) trainers for seasonal new hire classes and update training rollouts.
  • Run regular audits of training materials with SMEs to catch inaccurate, outdated, or missing information.
  • Build and sustain strong working relationships with SME trainers, partner teams, and BPO leaders, rooting feedback in curiosity and respect while openly receiving it in return.
  • Own Seismic (our LMS): managing distribution groups, reporting on completion and assessment results, and working with BPO leaders to close gaps. Explore unused and emerging features, while recommending ones worth adopting.

What we’re looking for:

  • 2+ years of instructional design, training, or learning and development experience.
  • Experience building eLearning, instructor-led training, and assessments using ADDIE or a similar model, with tools such as Articulate or Camtasia.
  • Familiar with Kirkpatrick or a similar model for measuring training effectiveness.
  • Experience as an LMS administrator using tools like Seismic (formerly Lessonly), Docebo, or equivalent, including user groups, enrollments, and reporting.
  • Experience facilitating virtual training, including train-the-trainer sessions, ideally with globally distributed or BPO teams.
  • Flexibility with an eagerness to support your team beyond training when priorities shift, whether for a short-term need or a longer-term change in focus.

Bonus points:

  • A passion for cycling, running, or fitness.
  • Experience supporting both internal and BPO (outsourced) contact center teams.
  • Familiarity with Zwift, gaming, the software industry, or fitness technology.

If Zwift determines in any stage of our interviews that any AI tools are being used without disclosure or citation, your candidacy will be disqualified.

Your resume/CV is enough to show off your skills, accomplishments, and experience. However, if you choose to include a cover letter introducing us to your awesome personality, we will read that too.

Overview:The Software Developer QA/QC independently evaluates development work completed by Software Developers and Senior Software Developers to ensure solutions meet approved requirements and MCU standards for functionality, security, performance, reliability, maintainability, documentation, and production readiness. The role reviews code and technical designs, coordinates and performs testing, validates defect remediation, and serves as a quality gate throughout the software development lifecycle while working collaboratively with developers, business analysts, stakeholders, and end users.

Responsibilities:

Specific duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Review business requirements, acceptance criteria, technical designs, and development deliverables for completeness, traceability, accuracy, and testability.
  • Perform independent peer reviews of source code, APIs, integrations, microservices, widgets, automation, database objects, reports, and application workflows developed by Software Developers and Senior Software Developers.
  • Validate adherence to MCU development standards, software architecture, coding conventions, source control practices, security requirements, and documentation standards.
  • Develop, execute, and maintain risk-based test strategies, test plans, test cases, test scripts, test data, and regression test suites.
  • Create and execute manual and automated test cases; identify, document, and track defects using defect‑tracking tools
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to identify, document, and resolve defects early in the development lifecycle
  • Perform functional, integration, system, regression, negative, security, performance, and production-readiness testing, as appropriate to the change.
  • Confirm that approved requirements and acceptance criteria have been implemented and that test evidence supports the results.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects; communicate findings clearly; and verify remediation through retesting before release.
  • Validate data integrity, SQL logic, interfaces, error handling, logging, exception management, monitoring, and auditability.
  • Review authentication, authorization, encryption, sensitive-data handling, input validation, dependency risks, and other secure coding controls.
  • Assess application performance, scalability, reliability, supportability, and maintainability and escalate material risks or unresolved quality concerns.
  • Validate deployment packages, configuration changes, release notes, implementation plans, rollback procedures, and production-readiness checklists.
  • Review automated test coverage and collaborate with developers to improve unit, integration and regression testing.
  • Maintain objective evidence of reviews, test execution, defects, approvals, exceptions, and release decisions in approved systems of record.
  • Apply appropriate QA approaches across Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall development methodologies
