jobs.title: Senior Agentic Backend Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Join beqom — where tech meets impactbeqom is a high-growth B2B SaaS company that provides industry-leading tools for pay equity and transparency, compensation, and performance management.
jobs.description:
Join beqom — where tech meets impact

beqom is a high-growth B2B SaaS company that provides industry-leading tools for pay equity and transparency, compensation, and performance management.

Trusted by some of the world’s most respected companies, beqom enables HR and business leaders to navigate global compliance and make smarter pay decisions that attract, retain, and motivate top talent.

Founded in Switzerland and serving clients worldwide, our powerful, enterprise-ready products are fuelled by beqom pay intelligence.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Agentic Backend Engineer to join our Data Platform Core team, which owns the services at the heart of beqom’s data architecture — multi-tenant data ingestion, schema management, snapshots, calculated fields, and the data contracts powering analytics and reporting across the product.

In this role you will not write the code. AI agents will. You will own the specifications that govern these services, the agentic pipeline that turns those specifications into production software, and the verification machinery that proves the output is correct — with the explicit goal of reaching fully AI-embedded development: no human-written code, no human line-by-line review, and external behavioural scenarios, not traditional test suites, as the quality gate.

You will collaborate closely with Data Platform and Analytics engineers, Support teams, and Product stakeholders — translating their needs into agent-executable specifications. Specs are our system of record; agents do the typing.

What you'll be doing

Agentic Delivery

  • Deliver features across multi-tenant data platform services — data ingestion, schema management, effective dating, snapshots, calculated fields, and exports — exclusively through AI agents working from your specifications.
  • Author structured, testable Product Requirement Prompts (PRPs) and spec files as the primary engineering artefact, and maintain the versioned spec library that governs the codebase.
  • Run multiple agents in parallel across workstreams; evaluate outcomes against specs; progress agent first-pass success rate, defect escape rate, and the share of changes merged without human review steadily upward.

Pipeline Engineering

  • Build and maintain the agentic pipeline: agent harness, blueprint engine interleaving deterministic steps (lint, build, git) with AI reasoning, MCP tool layer exposing internal APIs, warm sandbox pool, and retrieval over the codebase, tickets, and historical PRs.
  • Own the economics of the pipeline: observability over token usage, task latency, and cost per run; model-tier routing and cost-per-outcome gating.
  • Embed governance into the pipeline — machine-generated audit trails, named ownership per feature, data-classification gates keeping production secrets and PII out of agent context.

Verification Engineering

  • Engineer verification, not code: external behavioural scenario suites and holdout sets stored outside the codebase (agents never see the evaluation criteria), digital twins of the systems we integrate with, layered AI-reviews-AI gates, and automated remediation for self-healing services.
  • Set and enforce the constraints that keep agent output correct on performance-critical paths: bulk ingestion throughput, large export streaming, memory behaviour, and complex SQL — validated by scenario and load gates rather than line-by-line reading.

Production Ownership & Collaboration

  • Diagnose and resolve production data issues through agents — with deep enough functional understanding of every service you own to steer remediation quickly, in collaboration with Support and Engineering.
  • Document the specs, scenarios, and pipeline decisions that govern the platform — artefacts both humans and agents can act on — and help other engineers make the same shift.

Skills & Experience

What you'll bring

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience building production backend services — including .NET/C# and PostgreSQL systems — with a demonstrable shift from writing code to directing agents: the majority of your recent production output should be AI-generated under your direction.
  • Hands-on mastery of AI coding agents — Claude Code strongly preferred — including parallel agent sessions, custom skills and sub-agents, and structuring codebases and context so agents work reliably.
  • Excellence in specification writing — turning ambiguous business needs into precise, agent-executable PRPs and spec files. In this role, spec quality is the single most load-bearing skill.
  • Strong verification engineering: behavioural and scenario-based testing, holdout evaluation, quality gates, and validation frameworks — the ability to trust and judge output you did not write.
  • Strong architecture judgement: assessing whether an agent-proposed solution meets performance, scalability, and reliability requirements, and challenging designs that will not hold up under real workloads.
  • Experience building agent infrastructure: MCP servers and tool layers, sandboxed execution, and CI/CD adapted for agent-driven workflows.
  • Deep enough .NET/C# and SQL reading fluency to audit generated code when quality gates flag it — schema design, query plans, streaming vs. buffering, memory behaviour.
  • Excellent written communication: specs, scenario definitions, and design docs that both humans and agents can act on.

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience building digital twins or service virtualisations of external systems for agent evaluation environments.
  • Experience with LLM evaluation at scale: eval suites, red-teaming AI-generated code, benchmarking agent workflows.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS architecture experience, CDC/event-driven ingestion (Debezium, Kafka, RabbitMQ/MassTransit), or lakehouse exposure (Microsoft Fabric).
  • Azure services, Docker, Kubernetes/Helm.
  • Experience with legal, security, or compliance frameworks for AI-authored code.
  • Familiarity with compensation, HR, or pay transparency domains.

Why join us?

  • Your career, your design. Unleash your ambition in our dynamic, autonomous environment.
  • Drive meaningful change. Build a fairer future for every employee by joining a market leader that is improving the world of work.
  • Belong to something bigger. Collaborate with a passionate, diverse and talented team around the globe.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice before submitting your application.

Facilities Management eXpress is looking for an Engineer Manager to join our team!

At FMX, our Engineering Managers have a direct impact on our product, our people, and our culture. As manager of a Core Team, you’ll coach and mentor a talented group of software engineers, give them clarity on priorities and expectations, and help them grow technically and professionally while delivering high-quality software for our customers. You’ll partner closely with product, design, QA, and other engineering leaders to align your team’s work with business goals and build a healthy, high-performing, inclusive engineering culture.

This is a player-coach role. We want a manager who still loves to build: someone who stays close to the code, picks up bugs and non-mission-critical work alongside the team, and leads by example. You’ll also help shape how FMX builds software in an AI-first world, setting the practices, tools, and standards that help our engineers ship faster without lowering the bar on quality.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and grow your team: Give every engineer clarity on their role, responsibilities, goals, and the team’s processes, and clearly communicate changes to practices, priorities, and expectations. Provide regular coaching, feedback, and career guidance, and advocate for each person’s professional and technical growth.
  • Build a strong culture: Foster trust, accountability, and continuous improvement, where engineers feel valued, heard, and connected to FMX’s mission. Keep the team engaged with challenging, meaningful problems and help them see the customer impact of their work.
  • Clear the path: Actively remove blockers so the team works efficiently with minimal friction.
  • Stay technical: Keep a strong understanding of your team’s systems so you can guide architecture decisions and unblock engineers directly. Champion operational excellence, including observability, CI/CD health, and production readiness.
  • Drive AI-first development: Evaluate, adopt, and set standards for AI-assisted coding, code review, and testing tools.
  • Shape the bigger picture: Contribute to engineering leadership discussions, decisions, and process evolution; partner with product and design leads on priorities and long-term vision; and help hiring teams identify, recruit, and onboard top engineering talent.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

  • 2-4 years of engineering management or technical leadership experience, and prior experience as a software engineer, ideally in SaaS.
  • A builder’s mindset: you still enjoy writing code and will regularly contribute fixes, features, and triage work that isn’t mission-critical.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-first development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, agentic workflows) and a point of view on best practices you can teach others.
  • This role requires working Eastern Time hours to join daily team meetings, so candidates should be based in or able to work on Eastern Time.
  • A proven ability to coach and grow engineers at every career stage, with strong, empathetic, and clear communication.
  • Experience improving engineering processes and development workflows, plus familiarity with agile practices and cross-functional collaboration.
  • The ability to think strategically while attending to the details of day-to-day execution.
  • A passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams that value continuous learning and an excellent developer experience.
  • Enthusiasm for FMX’s mission and alignment with our core pillars: Teamwork, Excellence, and Integrity.

Nice to Have:

  • Native mobile experience (Swift or Kotlin)
  • Cloud infrastructure experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform
  • Containerization with Docker
  • CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance
  • Observability (logging, metrics, traces, and alerting) or SIEM experience

Our Tech Stack:

  • .NET / C#
  • React and TypeScript
  • React Native
  • Azure

The Hiring Process:

  • 1. Apply! Submit your resume and brief application questions directly through our Workable portal to get started.
  • 2. PeopleOps Phone Screen (30 min) A introductory conversation to dive into your background, introduce you to FMX culture, and clarify core role expectations. This is also your chance to ask about compensation, benefits, and life at FMX.
  • 3. Hiring Manager Conversation (60 min) An in-depth chat with our Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Come ready to discuss your experience, career goals, and ideal next steps, as well as to ask detailed questions about team dynamics and role expectations.
  • 4. Final Interview (60 min) A panel and peer interview designed to introduce you to key team members and explore technical alignment and collaborative fit.
  • 5. Offer & Onboarding Once an offer is extended, we’ll initiate a standard background check to complete your onboarding process.

Benefits

FMX Benefits & Life at FMX:

  • Make a big impact: You’ll have significant influence over the direction and future of our engineering teams, flagship product and company. We are scaling rapidly and there is a lot of room for advancement.
  • Enjoy a collaborative culture and a close-knit team: We're a team of hard-working, high-fiving, friendly folks. We take collaboration, transparency, continuous improvement, and work/life balance seriously.
  • Get to hire and work with the best: We believe in building high-quality, well-designed products and that requires the best talent. You’ll have the opportunity to work with and grow a highly-talented team.

We bring in industry-experts as our advisors, provide leadership training, invest in team-building activities, and have a training budget and incentive program. Our Engineering team also dedicates 10% of their time to learning or working on projects that interest them.
  • Enjoy flexible working hours: Have a dentist appointment at 8:30 AM? Need to tack on an extra 15 minutes at lunch to squeeze in that workout? As long as you're getting your work done then our working hours are flexible.
  • Work from home: At FMX we are remote first, but you’re welcome to use our office as you need. We have two all-company events a year to ensure that you can put a face to that name and establish high-trust relationships with your teammates and co-workers. When you’re in the office, you can take advantage of our free snacks, beverages, and office kegerator.

While FMX is formally founded and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, on the day-to-day, we like to think of ourselves as headquartered “in the cloud”.   • Participate in technical screening and code reviews to help validate the quality and originality of development work across the team.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven, ground-up (build-from-scratch) hands-on development experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE — not limited to support, break-fix, or modification of existing solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with the Sales module and the Field Service module is required.
  • Strong command of C#, .NET, JavaScript, and the Dataverse/Dynamics 365 SDK.

NICE TO HAVE:

jobs.title: Professional Services - Canada
jobs.excerpt: Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data.
jobs.description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

Our customers with the most demanding deployments subscribe to Advanced Services. These are the enterprises where Solace is carrying something the business cannot do without, and where an outage is a business event rather than a support ticket. They pay for a higher standard of service, and the Service Owner is accountable.

You carry a portfolio of these customers and you own their experience of Solace: how well we understand their environment, how quickly problems get found, how clearly we explain what we are doing about them, and whether the platform keeps up with where their business is heading. This is a continuous relationship rather than a project, and it does not get handed off at the end of a phase. It is yours.

What You’ll Do

Own the customer relationship

  • Be the named technical contact for a portfolio of Advanced Services customers, and the person inside Solace who understands their environment best
  • Build the kind of relationship where their architects call you before they make a decision rather than after
  • Report on service quality and the health of their estate in a way both their engineers and their leadership can act on
  • Advise them on where the Solace platform is going and which parts of it are worth their attention
  • Maintain ownership of all open support tickets for your accounts, ensuring they are progressed, accurately documented, and closed promptly
  • Produce and deliver service status reports for every customer with different levels of detail and frequencies

Own the quality of the service

  • Keep your customers' environments under active watch so that problems are found by us and not reported by them
  • Take issues end to end: triage, resolution, documentation and follow-up, including the ones nobody else wants to pick up
  • Pull in Support, Engineering and the account team when an issue needs them, and stay accountable for the outcome until it is closed
  • Hold the line on the standard. If the service is falling short for one of your customers, you should be the first to know it and the first to say so

Get new customers to steady state

  • Lead onboarding for new Advanced Services customers and bring them to a stable, well-understood steady state
  • Keep onboarding on schedule and raise blockers early instead of letting a date slide quietly
  • Keep adjusting after go-live until the service fits how the customer actually operates

Keep customers ahead of their own growth

  • Watch capacity and growth trends and flag what is needed well before it becomes urgent
  • Keep deployments on supported, current versions and coordinate upgrades with as little disruption as possible
  • Track advisories and known issues, and tell each customer what, if anything, it means for them

Make the practice better

  • Improve the playbooks you work from, so the next customer and the next Service Owner both benefit
  • Feed product gaps, architecture problems and customer education needs back to Product, Account and Customer Success
  • teams
  • Give the account team the technical credibility they need at renewal, and speak up where a customer would genuinely benefit from more Solace. Growth here comes from running the service well and being straight about what you see, not from a pitch
  • Use and contribute to the team's operational tooling (Example, Python-based CLIs for monitoring management) to streamline day-to-day service delivery tasks

Location and travel

  • This role can be based anywhere in Canada, the United States or Mexico, and the work is mostly remote
  • Travel is light but not zero. Expect a handful of customer visits a year for onboarding, service reviews, and the situations where being in the room is worth more than being on the call

About You

  • You take ownership. You treat the customer's environment as yours to look after, and you follow up on things without being chased
  • You want to know why. Restarting the broker is not a root cause, and you are not satisfied until you can explain what actually happened
  • You can write and you can present. A report a director will read, and a troubleshooting call with their engineers, are both well within range
  • You work well without scaffolding. Several customer relationships at once, no two days the same, and nobody planning your week for you

What You’ll Bring to the Role

Required

  • 5+ years in professional services, technical consulting, managed services or enterprise infrastructure operations, in a customer facing role
  • Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture, messaging middleware or distributed systems (Solace, Kafka, IBM MQ,TIBCO, RabbitMQ or similar)
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts across the application, middleware, network and cloud layers, plus the discipline to write down what you found
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling
  • Scripting and automation ability, Python preferred
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes, containerized deployments and at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and business audiences
  • Highly organized and self-directed, comfortable running several customer relationships at the same time

Preferred

  • Direct Solace Platform experience in any form factor: Solace Cloud, software broker or appliance
  • Familiarity with MQTT, AMQP, JMS, REST and SMF
  • Background in managed services, SRE or a NOC, somewhere you were close to the customer rather than behind a queue
  • ITIL or a similar service management framework
  • Data center and hardware appliance experience
  • Hands-on experience with Datadog or an equivalent enterprise observability platform (dashboards, alerting, monitors, notebooks), Datadog specifically is a strong advantage
  • Spanish or French, which comes in handy across our Americas customer base

What Success Looks Like

In 3 Months

  • You know your customers' environments, teams and priorities in detail
  • They treat you as their contact at Solace, and reach out to you first
  • Your reporting goes out reliably and says something worth reading

In 6 Months

  • Problems are getting found and addressed before your customers notice them
  • You run onboarding for new customers and land it on schedule
  • Support, Customer Success and Sales treat you as the authority on your accounts

In 12 Months

  • Service quality across your portfolio is consistent, and does not depend on heroics
  • Capacity and upgrade planning happens well ahead of need rather than in reaction to it
  • Your customers renew and expand because they can point at what the service did for them

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

  • Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.
  • Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.
  • Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.
  • Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.
  • Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.
  • Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).
  • Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.
  • Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

  • Strong understanding of application architecture, software design patterns, and scalable engineering principles.

AI-Enabled Product Development

  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, vector search, tool use, and AI orchestration.
  • Understanding of the reliability, security, privacy, governance, and user-experience considerations associated with AI-enabled applications.
  • Interest in using AI-assisted development tools and workflows to improve engineering productivity.

Engineering Leadership & Architecture

  • Demonstrated ability to influence application architecture and engineering standards.
  • Experience designing scalable, maintainable solutions within SaaS environments.
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, security principles, and multi-tenant application patterns.
  • Ability to balance long-term technical excellence with pragmatic business and delivery goals.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and helping elevate team-wide development practices.

Modern Web Engineering Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture and separation of concerns.
  • Experience building accessible, performant, and responsive web applications.
  • Familiarity with modern data-fetching, state management, routing, and application architecture patterns.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering workflows to improve productivity, quality, and consistency.

Preferred Qualifications

Als durch und durch digitales Lifestyle-Scale-up stehen wir aktuell an der Schwelle zur nächsten großen Wachstumsphase: der Entwicklung von einem erfolgreichen Online-Shop hin zu einer globalen Multichannel-Brand. Für diese Reise suchen wir ein entscheidendes Puzzleteil für unser Dev-Team: Einen technologisch versierten Kopf mit ausgeprägter Shopware-Expertise und echter Hands-on-Mentalität. Als Shopware Full Stack Backend Developer bist du das Herzstück unserer technologischen Weiterentwicklung. Deine Mission: Du gestaltest, optimierst und skalierst unser Backend-Setup, um ein nahtloses, hochperformantes Shopping-Erlebnis auf das nächste Level zu heben - vollständig remote und ortsunabhängig.
Gleichzeitig ist es uns ein echtes Anliegen, die Tech-Branche diverser zu gestalten. Wir möchten weibliche Tech-Talente ausdrücklich ermutigen, sich bei uns zu bewerben (Women in Tech) – bei uns im Team ist jede und jeder im Sinne echter Gleichberechtigung gleichermaßen herzlich willkommen!
Du hast Lust, die digitale Zukunft einer aufstrebenden Brand aktiv zu prägen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

deine aufgaben

  • Entwicklung unseres Shopware Backends: Du unterstützt uns in den Bereichen Plugin-Entwicklung, CLI-Scripts, API-Design und Stock-Handling. Du hilfst insbesondere bei der Performance-Optimierung von Cart und Order Processing und beim Ausbau unserer Vertriebskanäle.
  • Instandhaltung & Stabilisierung der Infrastruktur: Du führst regelmäßige Updates von Shopware und den Plugins durch, damit unser Onlineshop stets reibungslos läuft – insbesondere in der High Season. Zudem stellst du sicher, dass alle APIs zu DWH, Produktion, Versand oder CRM intakt sind und jederzeit auf die benötigten Daten zugreifen können. Du unterstützt die anderen Teams bei der Anbindung neuer Tools.
  • Optimierung & Skalierung: Du bist up-to-date im Shopware-Kosmos und hilfst uns, unseren Shop kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, sei es im Hinblick auf Plugins, neue AI-Features oder Developer Experience. Du erkennst, an welchen Stellen unser Headless-Setup von einer Überführung in den Shopware-Standard profitieren würde.
  • Technische Konzeption & Beratung: Als Teil des Dev-Teams berätst du die anderen Teams im Hinblick auf die technische Umsetzung der verschiedenen textilwerk-Projekte mit starkem Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit, Performance und das Shopping-Erlebnis für die Kund:innen.

dein profil

  • Shopware 6 Skills: Ausgeprägte Kenntnisse im modernen Shopware 6 Ökosystem (App-System, Plugin-System, Rule Builder, Flow Builder, Administration). Idealerweise bringst du sogar eine Shopware-Backend-Zertifizierung mit und kennst dich sowohl mit Headless- als auch mit Standard-Shopware-Setups aus
  • Fullstack Skills: Idealerweise bringst du zudem Kenntnisse in Next.js, TypeScript und NestJS mit
  • Datenbanken & Suche im Enterprise-Scale: Fundiertes Wissen in MySQL/MariaDB sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Elasticsearch / OpenSearch zur Optimierung unseres Produktdatenhandlings

Automatisierte Tests und der zielgerichtete Einsatz von KI gehören dabei selbstverständlich zu deiner Arbeitsweise.

Founding Platform Engineer | AI, Distributed Systems & SaaS

AllUnited StatesUnited States - San FranciscoUnited States - New York City23 Oct

  • New York City or San Francisco Bay Area
  • Python | AWS | Distributed Systems | Multi-tenant SaaS
  • Pre-seed AI startup | Founding engineering team

Build the platform that makes AI customer conversations accountable

Are you a Staff or Principal-level engineer who thrives on building complex systems from the ground up?

We're looking for a Founding Platform Engineer to help architect and build the core platform of an early-stage AI startup tackling one of the biggest emerging challenges in enterprise technology: ensuring AI-powered customer interactions are safe, compliant, reliable, and accountable.

As the first senior engineer, you'll work directly with the CTO, take ownership of the platform's architecture, and write production code while establishing the engineering foundations for future growth.

This is an opportunity to shape both the technology and the engineering culture of a company from its earliest stages.

The opportunity

Enterprises are deploying AI agents to handle customer conversations across voice, chat, email, and SMS. But as these systems take on increasingly sensitive interactions, businesses need more than capable AI — they need independent oversight, measurable quality and reliable evidence that their AI systems meet the standards required of them.

The company is building an AI monitoring and assurance platform that evaluates customer interactions against applicable regulations and business requirements, helping enterprises identify issues early, reduce risk, and demonstrate accountability.

You'll help build the infrastructure that makes this possible, from high-volume conversation processing to enterprise-grade auditability and security.

What you'll own

Core platform architecture

  • Design and build the backend systems that power a scalable, multi-tenant SaaS platform.
  • Establish robust APIs, data models, and distributed processing architecture.
  • Make key technical decisions that will shape the platform as the company grows.

Conversation pipelines and integrations

  • Build pipelines that transform raw conversations into structured, enriched, and scorable data.
  • Develop integrations with contact-centre platforms, ticketing systems and direct-upload workflows.
  • Help evolve the voice-processing architecture, including transcription and audio ingestion.

Auditability and data provenance

  • Implement immutable versioning for scoring rubrics and configurations.
  • Build tamper-evident audit trails and preserve evidence throughout the conversation lifecycle.
  • Ensure historical results can be reproduced and explained, including why a particular interaction received its original score.

Infrastructure and engineering excellence

  • Own infrastructure as code, CI/CD, environment management and deployment workflows.
  • Establish observability, logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, secrets management and disaster recovery.
  • Take responsibility for production reliability, incident response and operational readiness.

Scale, performance and reliability

  • Build reliable data storage, retention and queueing systems.
  • Implement idempotent processing and reprocessing to prevent duplicate work and unnecessary AI inference costs.
  • Define service-level objectives and help scale the platform from early pilots to millions of interactions per month.

Security and enterprise readiness

  • Build tenant isolation, permissions, customer-specific configuration, and entitlements into the platform.
  • Implement sensitive-data handling and redaction before conversations reach AI models.
  • Support evidence exports, SOC 2 readiness, and enterprise security reviews.

What we're looking for

  • Senior engineering ownership: You've operated at Staff, Principal or equivalent scope, owning critical production systems and setting technical direction for other engineers.
  • Strong backend and distributed-systems expertise: You understand high-volume data processing, event-driven architectures, API design and data modelling.
  • Hands-on infrastructure experience: You've built infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability capabilities yourself, rather than relying entirely on a dedicated platform team.
  • Early-stage startup experience: You've shipped products in an early-stage or high-growth environment where ambiguity, broad ownership and limited support functions were part of everyday life. This is essential.

jobs.description:
Remote (Pakistan preferred) · Full-time

🧭 About the role

iClosed.io is a SaaS platform for sales and marketing teams, scaling to millions of users. This role sits in our Performance Team and owns the performance and scalability of our Node.js/TypeScript backend services and data layer.

We believe the biggest gains come from design, not just tuning: matching each store to its access pattern, moving work off the critical path, and drawing service boundaries that scale cleanly. You'll solve the problem in front of you, then shape the architecture so whole classes of problems never come up.

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, high autonomy and significant technical influence.

🔀 How the work splits

You'll own performance across three connected areas, with genuine depth expected in both system design and data-layer internals:

  • Design: how a request flows, what runs synchronously, where state lives, and what happens when a dependency is slow.
  • Diagnosis: reading traces, execution plans and metrics to find the real cause rather than the obvious one.
  • Prevention: instrumentation, review standards and regression gates, so issues are caught long before they reach customers.

🎯 What you'll do

  • Lead the design of high-traffic flows end to end, keeping them fast under load and resilient when dependencies fail.
  • Diagnose latency across the full request path using traces, execution plans and metrics.
  • Match each workload to the right data store, and document the reasoning.
  • Scale reads and writes through caching, replicas, partitioning, sharding and queue-buffered writes.
  • Build reliable background processing on SQS and EventBridge with idempotency, retries, dead letters and backpressure.
  • Eliminate N+1 queries and chatty data access, including inefficient queries generated by ORMs such as Prisma and Mongoose.
  • Own data-layer capacity planning and cost per request alongside latency.
  • Set engineering standards: design and query review for hot paths, migration standards, CI regression gates, and load testing at production-realistic volumes.
  • Review architecture proposals from feature teams, and write the design docs others build from.

🧑‍💻 Who we're looking for

Required

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with 3+ where performance and scale were a named part of your job.
  • Performance ownership of a multi-tenant SaaS product under real load.
  • Systems you designed yourself, including the alternatives you rejected and the tradeoffs you accepted.
  • A concrete track record: a problem you diagnosed, its root cause, your fix, and the before-and-after numbers.
  • Strong system design judgement across caching, sharding, CQRS, queues, real-time delivery (WebSockets/SSE), autoscaling, high availability and resilience patterns. Knowing when not to use one matters more to us than listing its benefits.
  • Real depth in at least two of PostgreSQL/MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB and Redis, with working competence in the rest.
  • Production ownership of Node.js/TypeScript services, and a solid understanding of how ORMs and ODMs such as Prisma and Mongoose generate queries.
  • Hands-on Datadog APM and tracing experience (or equivalent), plus production experience on AWS (ECS/EKS), including the cost behaviour of managed data services.
  • Clear writing: design docs a team can build from and an executive can follow.

🗄️ Data layer depth

Nobody is deep in all four engines, and we'd rather you tell us where you are. Across your areas of depth, we expect you to reason about:

  • Relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL): execution plans as routine, composite and partial indexes and their write cost, locking, isolation levels, connection pooling and replica lag.
  • Document (MongoDB): embedding vs referencing, shard key selection, aggregation performance and working set sizing.
  • Key-value: access-pattern-first modelling, partition keys, hot partition avoidance, secondary indexes and capacity cost.
  • In-memory cache (Redis/Memcached): caching patterns, key design, eviction and TTL, and system behaviour when the cache is cold or unavailable.
  • Across engines: consistency boundaries, dual-write problems, and recognising when a query problem is really an application design problem.

🌟 What success looks like

  • Diagnosis: latency is attributed to real causes with evidence, and per-tenant investigations end with clear answers.
  • Design: critical paths have documented designs others can reason about, store selection is deliberate and written down, and queues behave predictably under load.
  • Measurable improvement: meaningful latency reduction on the highest-cost paths, with before-and-after numbers, and cost per request trending down.
  • Prevention: design and query review is standard practice for hot paths, regressions are caught before merge, and migration standards are followed across teams.
  • Partnership: feature teams bring you proposals early because you make them better, not slower.

➕ Nice to have

APM, error tracking and database performance tooling using tools like Datadog and Sentry · event streaming or messaging at scale · real-time delivery and fan-out at scale (Socket.IO) · third-party integrations where latency is outside your control · noisy-neighbour and tenant isolation · load testing tools and building that capability · SLOs and error budgets · infrastructure as code

🚫 What this role is not

  • Not a DBA role. Backups, patching and routine operations sit with DevOps. You set the performance requirements.
  • Not feature work. Your output is latency removed and regressions prevented.
  • Not a management role today. Leading the function as it grows is an open conversation.

💎 Why join

  • Shape the performance function and its priorities from day one.
  • Have direct influence on architecture across every engineering team.
  • Work on a polyglot stack at real scale.

📋 Practicalities

  • Location: Remote (Pakistan preferred)
  • Type: Full-time, permanent
  • Level: Senior individual contributor, no direct reports
  • Compensation: Market competitive
  • On-call: Part of the escalation rota
Salary: Market Competitive

We build the underlying platform that supports hundreds of services and is used by over 400 globally distributed engineers.

We're scaling into a cell-based architecture, and the number of cells we run is growing fast, taking our Kubernetes footprint from dozens of clusters toward hundreds. That takes the platform in three directions at once: infrastructure configuration becomes a first-class layer with its own lifecycle, independent of application code; provisioning a new cell becomes a days-long automated operation rather than a multi-week effort; and cross-cell control points become standard, reusable, and consistent everywhere.

This is a Principal Engineer role with real breadth within the cloud platform. You'll set the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform as it scales with AlphaSense's growth, and take dedicated ownership of the cloud-side configuration and Helm chart layer that every service depends on. Data storages are a critical part of this surface, and we're looking for genuine depth there.

It requires a deep cloud of both operational and software development skills, the ability to lead ambitious technical programmes, and the credibility to set direction with Engineering leaders and very senior engineers across dozens of teams.

We're looking for someone who genuinely embraces AI tooling in their day-to-day work, appreciates the productivity value it brings, and is motivated to make our infrastructure ever-more AI friendly.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform
  • Own cloud-side configuration and the Helm chart layer for Cloud Core
  • Build the cell registry and automate provisioning to take new cell setup from weeks to days
  • Design the cross-cell gate mechanism as the reusable standard checkpoint across every cell
  • Own, operate and evolve our Cloud and Kubernetes platform, including our data storage layers
  • Make operations (upgrades, patching, lifecycle management) routine across hundreds of clusters
  • Continuously improve the security, reliability, cost efficiency and performance of our infrastructure
  • Champion standards and drive initiatives to promote uniformisation and eliminate duplication
  • Enable truly self-service and agentic workflow patterns that support a Build it - Own it model
  • Build tooling and AI powered integrations that reduce the cognitive load in cloud
  • Architect, design and implement simple and maintainable solutions

Who You Are:

  • Extremely experienced in Kubernetes and its various components, containerisation and AWS cloud
  • Proven track record of running Kubernetes and Cloud based production SaaS systems at scale
  • Experience operating Kubernetes as a large fleet with hundreds of clusters
  • Strong knowledge of data storages across SQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch
  • Strong operational and troubleshooting skill with Kubernetes, databases and messaging systems
  • Deep understanding of networking and production level usage of service meshes and gateways
  • Experience separating infrastructure configuration from application code at scale
  • Experience with cell-based, multi-tenant or multi-region architectures
  • Proficiency in Python and Golang
  • Evangelist of highly performant CI/CD practices that are supportive of agentic workflows
  • Ability and desire to design, lead, influence and deliver on ambitious technical roadmaps

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Vespa
  • Automated provisioning of new environments, regions or cells end-to-end
  • Management of large fleets of Kubernetes clusters with lifecycle management tools
  • Production usage of Hashicorp Vault or similar secret management systems

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.

jobs.description:
Somos a Conexa, o maior ecossistema digital de saúde física e mental da América Latina. Contamos com milhares de médicos, psicólogos, nutricionistas e enfermeiros que, por meio de nossa plataforma, conseguem cuidar de pacientes em qualquer lugar que eles estejam. Unimos pacientes, profissionais, empresas e operadoras com o objetivo de reduzir as ineficiências de custo e qualidade de atendimento do sistema de saúde brasileiro.

Nascemos com o objetivo de democratizar o acesso à saúde de qualidade, e acreditamos que corpo e mente precisam ser tratados de forma integrada para que o paciente tenha uma vida saudável. Atualmente, realizamos mais de 7,2 milhões de consultas por ano, com mais de 6.000 profissionais de saúde em mais de 35 especialidades. Com nosso modelo de negócios, cobrimos mais de 35 milhões de vidas elegíveis, com 190+ operadoras parceiras e 10.000+ clientes corporativos.

Temos um time formado por pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem e que acreditam em um futuro com mais saúde física e mental para todos!

✨ Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Full Stack Sênior para integrar nosso time de Engenharia em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado a resultados. Essa pessoa será responsável por desenvolver soluções técnicas robustas e escaláveis, atuando em toda a stack tecnológica com autonomia, senso crítico e excelência técnica. A posição é ideal para profissionais experientes que buscam impacto direto no produto, trabalhando com tecnologias modernas e contribuindo ativamente para a evolução da arquitetura, qualidade do código e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

Aviso importante! 🚨

A Conexa nunca cobra qualquer valor para participação em seus processos seletivos. Todas as nossas vagas são divulgadas exclusivamente pela Gupy e o processo de inscrição é totalmente gratuito. Caso receba qualquer pedido de pagamento ou oferta de vaga fora da Gupy, desconfie! Isso não faz parte da nossa prática de recrutamento.

🎯 Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e evoluir sistemas já existentes, com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.
  • Ter domínio de arquitetura de software e capacidade de propor evoluções estruturais no sistema
  • Implementar integrações entre serviços internos e externos (APIs, microsserviços, sistemas distribuídos).
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e eficiente, seguindo boas práticas de engenharia e padrões definidos pela área.
  • Criar e executar testes automatizados e unitários para garantir a qualidade das entregas.
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de produto, QA, front end e dados, garantindo a entrega ponta a ponta.
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews, contribuindo para o aprendizado coletivo e a manutenção de padrões técnicos.
  • Monitorar e otimizar desempenho de aplicações, identificando e resolvendo gargalos.
  • Documentar fluxos, arquiteturas e práticas adotadas, fortalecendo o compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Colaborar em cerimônias ágeis (plannings, refinamentos, retrospectivas), trazendo postura propositiva e resolutiva.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores plenos e júniors.

🧩 Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Software Full Stack, atuando em projetos de produto digital com stack completa (frontend e backend).
  • Domínio da linguagem Javascript, proficiência em (foco principal) e frontend com React.
  • Experiência comprovada com arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços e APIs RESTful/GraphQL.
  • Conhecimento prático de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, etc.).
  • Vivência com práticas modernas de engenharia: CI/CD, testes automatizados, code review, versionamento (Git) e DevOps.
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis e desenvolvimento colaborativo (Scrum, Kanban, XP).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com senso de dono e foco em entregas de qualidade.
  • Habilidade de comunicação técnica clara, tanto com time de engenharia quanto com stakeholders de produto e negócio.
  • Proficiência no uso de ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao desenvolvimento de software, como Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor e similares, utilizando-as para acelerar entregas com qualidade e senso crítico.

🌟 Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura de nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure) e ferramentas de containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Vivência em scale-ups ou empresas em fase de rápido crescimento.
  • Atuação em healthtechs ou setores regulados.
  • Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Sentry).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura event-driven e mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS).
  • Experiência com ambientes de alto volume transacional e integrações complexas.
  • Histórico de contribuição em melhorias arquiteturais e redução de débito técnico.
